AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch alarms for testing how TreatMissingData settings affect alarm state transitions

Resources:
  AlwaysOKAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysOKAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data is treated as within the threshold (notBreaching), so the alarm should transition to OK.
      Namespace: AWS/NetworkELB
      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  AlwaysFAILAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysFAILAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data is treated as breaching the threshold (breaching), so the alarm should transition to ALARM.
      Namespace: AWS/NetworkELB
      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data is not evaluated (missing), so the alarm should remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
      Namespace: AWS/NetworkELB
      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      ActionsEnabled: false

    Description: Name of the AlwaysOKAlarm alarm
    Value: !Ref AlwaysOKAlarm
  AlwaysOKAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the AlwaysOKAlarm alarm

  AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm alarm
    Value: !Ref AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Provisions an Amazon Detective behavior graph for security monitoring.
  The graph aggregates and correlates security telemetry (VPC Flow Logs,
  CloudTrail management events, and — when available — Amazon GuardDuty
  findings) into a linked dataset for security investigation and analysis.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEPLOYMENT NOTES (informational):
#
# 1. Amazon Detective permits exactly ONE behavior graph per account per Region.
#    A behavior graph already exists in this account and Region, so this stack
#    adopts that graph and applies the requested Name tag to it; a graph is
#    created only when none exists. On stack removal the graph is deleted only
#    if this stack created it — an adopted graph is left intact.
#
# 2. Amazon GuardDuty is NOT required to create or use a behavior graph. When
#    GuardDuty is enabled in the same account and Region, Detective ingests its
#    findings as an additional data source. No AWS::GuardDuty::Detector is
#    declared here; GuardDuty is outside the scope of this request.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  DetectiveGraphManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DetectiveGraphManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # ListGraphs and CreateGraph act at account/Region scope and
              # cannot be constrained to a specific graph ARN.
              - Sid: DetectiveDiscoverAndCreate
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - detective:ListGraphs
                  - detective:CreateGraph
                Resource: '*'
              # Tagging and deletion are scoped to graphs in this account/Region.
              - Sid: DetectiveTagAndDelete
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - detective:TagResource
                  - detective:DeleteGraph
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:detective:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:graph:*'
              # First use of Detective provisions AWSServiceRoleForDetective.
              - Sid: DetectiveServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/detective.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForDetective'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: detective.amazonaws.com

  DetectiveGraphManagerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        CloudFormation custom resource handler that adopts the existing Amazon
        Detective behavior graph or creates one, applies the Name tag, and
        deletes the graph on stack removal only if this stack created it.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt DetectiveGraphManagerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 1024
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TAGS = {'Name': 'MyDetectiveGraph'}
          CREATED = 'created'
          ADOPTED = 'adopted'


          def send(event, context, status, data, pid, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or 'See log stream %s' % context.log_stream_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': pid or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'NoEcho': False,
                  'Data': data,
              }).encode('utf-8')
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'], data=body, method='PUT',
                  headers={'content-type': '', 'content-length': str(len(body))})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                  print('response status %s' % resp.status)


          def split(pid):
              if pid and '|' in pid:
                  owner, arn = pid.split('|', 1)
                  if owner in (CREATED, ADOPTED) and arn:
                      return owner, arn
              return '', ''


          def existing(client):
              # Detective allows one graph per account/Region: page one is final.
              for graph in client.list_graphs(MaxResults=50).get('GraphList', []):
                  if graph.get('Arn'):
                      return graph['Arn']
              return None


          def handler(event, context):
              pid = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              try:
                  kind = event['RequestType']
                  if kind == 'Delete':
                      owner, arn = split(pid)
                      if owner == CREATED:
                          try:
                              boto3.client('detective').delete_graph(GraphArn=arn)
                          except ClientError as err:
                              if err.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceNotFoundException':
                                  raise
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, pid)
                      return
                  if kind == 'Update':
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'GraphArn': split(pid)[1]}, pid)
                      return

                  client = boto3.client('detective')
                  arn = existing(client)
                  owner = ADOPTED
                  if not arn:
                      try:
                          arn = client.create_graph(Tags=TAGS)['GraphArn']
                          owner = CREATED
                      except ClientError as err:
                          # Service is authoritative on the one-graph limit.
                          if 'graph' not in err.response.get('Error', {}).get('Message', '').lower():
                              raise
                          arn = existing(client)
                          if not arn:
                              raise
                  if owner == ADOPTED:
                      client.tag_resource(ResourceArn=arn, Tags=TAGS)
                  send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'GraphArn': arn}, '%s|%s' % (owner, arn))
              except Exception as err:  # never leave CloudFormation waiting
                  print('handler failed: %s' % err)
                  send(event, context, 'FAILED', {}, pid, str(err))

  DetectiveGraph:
    Type: Custom::DetectiveGraph
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt DetectiveGraphManagerFunction.Arn

Outputs:

  DetectiveGraphArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon Detective behavior graph managed by this stack.
    Value: !GetAtt DetectiveGraph.GraphArn

  DetectiveGraphRegion:
    Description: >-
      AWS Region in which the Amazon Detective behavior graph resides.
      Detective graphs are Region-scoped and are only usable in this Region.
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-1ebcc262' on aws", 'iac-god-eval-1ebcc262: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - User Initiated', 'DetectiveGraphManagerRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'DetectiveGraphManagerRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'DetectiveGraphManagerRole: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'DetectiveGraphManagerFunction: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'DetectiveGraphManagerFunction: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'DetectiveGraphManagerFunction: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Eventual consistency check initiated', 'DetectiveGraphManagerFunction: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'DetectiveGraph: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'DetectiveGraph: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - Resource creation Initiated', 'DetectiveGraph: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A', 'iac-god-eval-1ebcc262: CREATE_COMPLETE - N/A']
deploy_completed_resources: DetectiveGraphManagerRole | DetectiveGraphManagerFunction | DetectiveGraph

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an AWS Backup Audit Manager compliance framework with five controls
  (backup plan coverage, recovery point encryption, manual deletion protection,
  minimum retention, and backup plan frequency/retention) and its AWS Config
  prerequisites (IAM role, configuration recorder, KMS-encrypted S3 delivery
  bucket, bucket policy and delivery channel).

# NOTE: Only one AWS Config configuration recorder and one delivery channel can
# exist per account per region. Deployment fails if AWS Config is already
# enabled in the target account/region, which is acceptable for this greenfield
# target.
#
# NOTE: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder does not start recording on its own.
# Recording begins once both the configuration recorder and the delivery
# channel exist. No separate recorder status resource is required.
#
# NOTE: Global resource types (IAM) are intentionally not recorded. The backup
# controls do not need them, and the IncludeGlobalResourceTypes flag is not
# supported in some regions.

Resources:
  # The key policy intentionally does not reference ConfigRole to avoid a
  # circular dependency (ConfigRole -> ConfigBucket -> ConfigBucketKey). The
  # account root statement delegates access control to IAM policies, which
  # lets the ConfigRole inline policy grant use of the key.
  ConfigBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Encrypts AWS Config delivery data for the backup compliance framework
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSConfigUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BackupCompliance
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConfigBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/backup-compliance-config
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ConfigBucketKey

  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BackupCompliance
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConfigBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketPermissionsCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketExistenceCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                's3:x-amz-acl': bucket-owner-full-control
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS Config to record resource configurations
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigS3Delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    's3:x-amz-acl': bucket-owner-full-control
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BackupCompliance
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ConfigurationRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      Name: default
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
      RecordingMode:
        RecordingFrequency: CONTINUOUS

  # The recorder and the delivery channel are created in parallel on purpose:
  # CloudFormation starts the recorder once the delivery channel exists, so
  # making the channel depend on the recorder can deadlock recorder
  # stabilization. The only explicit dependency is on the bucket policy, so
  # that AWS Config's bucket access check succeeds when the channel is created.
  DeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Name: default
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket
      S3KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
      ConfigSnapshotDeliveryProperties:
        DeliveryFrequency: TwentyFour_Hours

  # Backup Audit Manager controls are evaluated as AWS Config rules, so AWS
  # Config must be recording before the framework is created.
  BackupComplianceFramework:
    Type: AWS::Backup::Framework
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigurationRecorder
      - DeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      FrameworkName: BackupComplianceFramework
      FrameworkDescription: Audits backup plan coverage, encryption, deletion protection, retention and frequency
      FrameworkControls:
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RESOURCES_PROTECTED_BY_BACKUP_PLAN
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_ENCRYPTED
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MANUAL_DELETION_DISABLED
        - ControlName: BACKUP_RECOVERY_POINT_MINIMUM_RETENTION_CHECK
          ControlInputParameters:
            - ParameterName: requiredRetentionDays
              ParameterValue: '35'
        - ControlName: BACKUP_PLAN_MIN_FREQUENCY_AND_MIN_RETENTION_CHECK
          ControlInputParameters:
            - ParameterName: requiredRetentionDays
              ParameterValue: '35'
            - ParameterName: requiredFrequencyUnit
              ParameterValue: 'hours'
            - ParameterName: requiredFrequencyValue
              ParameterValue: '24'
      FrameworkTags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: BackupCompliance
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  FrameworkArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS Backup Audit Manager framework
    Value: !GetAtt BackupComplianceFramework.FrameworkArn
  FrameworkDeploymentStatus:
    Description: Deployment status of the AWS Backup Audit Manager framework
    Value: !GetAtt BackupComplianceFramework.DeploymentStatus
  ConfigBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket receiving AWS Config snapshots and history
    Value: !Ref ConfigBucket
  ConfigBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket receiving AWS Config snapshots and history
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
  ConfigBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting AWS Config delivery data
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
  ConfigRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by AWS Config
    Value: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
  ConfigurationRecorderName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Config configuration recorder
    Value: !Ref ConfigurationRecorder
  DeliveryChannelName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Config delivery channel
    Value: !Ref DeliveryChannel

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) foundation for
  multi-region API failover: a single ARC cluster and three control panels
  (ExternalApiControlPanel, Service1ControlPanel, Service2ControlPanel)
  associated with that cluster.

# Deployment region note:
#   The Route 53 ARC control-configuration API is homed in us-west-2. Confirm
#   that the AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::* resource types are supported in the
#   target deployment region before creating this stack. If they are not
#   supported in us-east-1, deploy this stack in us-west-2. Do not substitute
#   other or non-existent resource types.
#
# Cost note:
#   An ARC cluster incurs significant hourly charges (it provides five regional
#   data-plane endpoints) for as long as it exists. This template creates
#   exactly one cluster. No DeletionPolicy or UpdateReplacePolicy is set, so
#   deleting the stack removes the cluster and all control panels.
#
# Scope note:
#   Routing controls, safety rules, health checks, and Route 53 records are
#   intentionally out of scope. Add them later against the control panel ARNs
#   exported by this stack.

Resources:
  RecoveryCluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: ApiFailoverCluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ApiFailover
        - Key: Component
          Value: Route53ARC

  ExternalApiControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: ExternalApiControlPanel
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ApiFailover
        - Key: Component
          Value: Route53ARC

  Service1ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: Service1ControlPanel
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ApiFailover
        - Key: Component
          Value: Route53ARC

  Service2ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: Service2ControlPanel
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: ApiFailover
        - Key: Component
          Value: Route53ARC

Outputs:
  # RecoveryCluster.ClusterEndpoints is a list of objects (Endpoint, Region),
  # which cannot be serialized as a string stack output. Retrieve the regional

Description: >-
  Serverless Step Functions workflow that publishes custom events to a custom
  EventBridge event bus, with a catch-all rule forwarding every event on the bus
  to a CloudWatch Logs log group for testing and debugging.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: sfn-eventbridge-demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${ProjectName}-debug'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: eventbridge-debug

  EventBridgeDebugLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-eventbridge-to-logs'

                "logs:PutLogEvents"

    Type: AWS::Events::Rule

Resources:
  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork

      PolicyDocument:
        version: '2021.12'
        core-network-configuration:
          asn-ranges:
            - '64512-65534'
          edge-locations:
            - location: us-east-1
            - location: us-west-2
        segments:
          - name: production
            description: Production segment with isolated attachments
            isolate-attachments: true
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
          - name: development
            description: Development segment
            isolate-attachments: false
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        network-function-groups:
          - name: inspectionVpcs
            description: Network function group for egress inspection VPCs
            require-attachment-acceptance: false
        attachment-policies:
          - rule-number: 100
            description: Route inspection VPCs into the inspection network function group
            condition-logic: or
            conditions:
              - type: tag-value
                operator: equals
                key: inspection
                value: 'true'
            action:
              add-to-network-function-group: inspectionVpcs
          - rule-number: 200
            description: Associate attachments with a segment based on their domain tag
            condition-logic: or
            conditions:
              - type: tag-exists
                key: domain
            action:
              association-method: tag
              tag-value-of-key: domain
        segment-actions:
          - action: send-to
            segment: production
            via:
              network-function-groups:
                - inspectionVpcs
          - action: send-to
            segment: development
            via:
              network-function-groups:

        - Key: Purpose

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Testing stack that creates an SSM parameter holding a database username, a
  Python Lambda function that reads the parameter at runtime via boto3, and a
  least-privilege IAM role for the function.

Parameters:
  DbUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: alice
    Description: Database username stored in the dbUsername SSM parameter.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, digits, underscore, period, or hyphen.

Resources:
  DbUsernameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: dbUsername
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref DbUsername
      Description: Database username for testing purposes.

  FunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-get-db-username'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  GetDbUsernameFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the get-db-username Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GetDbUsernameFunctionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadDbUsernameParameter
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${DbUsernameParameter}'
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FunctionLogGroup.Arn

  GetDbUsernameFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: FunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-db-username'
      Description: Retrieves the database username from SSM Parameter Store at runtime.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt GetDbUsernameFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PARAM_NAME: !Ref DbUsernameParameter
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")


          def handler(event, context):
              param_name = os.environ["PARAM_NAME"]
              try:
                  response = ssm.get_parameter(Name=param_name)
              except ClientError as err:
                  logger.error("Failed to read parameter %s: %s", param_name, err)
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 500,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": "Unable to retrieve parameter"}),
                  }

              username = response["Parameter"]["Value"]
              logger.info("Retrieved parameter %s", param_name)
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"dbUsername": username}),
              }

Outputs:
  FunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref GetDbUsernameFunction
  FunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt GetDbUsernameFunction.Arn
  ParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter storing the database username.
    Value: !Ref DbUsernameParameter
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt GetDbUsernameFunctionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Encrypted general-purpose EFS file system with automated backups disabled for testing.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
    Description: Environment name used in resource names and tags.

Resources:
  EfsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${EnvironmentName} EFS encryption at rest'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEfsServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'elasticfilesystem.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EfsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-efs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EfsKmsKey

  EfsFileSystem:
    Type: AWS::EFS::FileSystem
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Encrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EfsKmsKey.Arn
      PerformanceMode: generalPurpose
      ThroughputMode: bursting
      # Automatic backups are intentionally DISABLED for non-production testing use only.
      # This MUST be set to ENABLED for production workloads.
      BackupPolicy:
        Status: DISABLED
      LifecyclePolicies:
        - TransitionToIA: AFTER_30_DAYS
        - TransitionToPrimaryStorageClass: AFTER_1_ACCESS
      FileSystemPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowClientAccessViaMountTargets
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - elasticfilesystem:ClientMount
              - elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                elasticfilesystem:AccessedViaMountTarget: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action: 'elasticfilesystem:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
      FileSystemTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: BackupStatus
          Value: disabled-for-testing

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EfsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows NFS (TCP 2049) access to EFS mount targets from within the VPC only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 2049
          ToPort: 2049
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: NFS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 2049
          ToPort: 2049
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: NFS responses within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EfsMountTarget1:
    Type: AWS::EFS::MountTarget
    Properties:
      FileSystemId: !Ref EfsFileSystem
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref EfsSecurityGroup

  EfsMountTarget2:
    Type: AWS::EFS::MountTarget
    Properties:
      FileSystemId: !Ref EfsFileSystem
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref EfsSecurityGroup

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref EfsFileSystem

    Value: !GetAtt EfsFileSystem.Arn
  FileSystemDnsName:
    Description: DNS name of the EFS file system

  KmsKeyArn:

    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and tagging.

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-state-machine
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Execution role for the ${ProjectName} Step Functions state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: XRayTracing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'

        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EC2StateChangeStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-state-machine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Definition:
        Comment: Routes EC2 instance state-change events to placeholder business-logic handlers.
        StartAt: EvaluateInstanceState
        States:
          EvaluateInstanceState:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.detail.state
                StringEquals: running
                Next: HandleRunning
              - Variable: $.detail.state
                StringEquals: stopped
                Next: HandleStopped
              - Variable: $.detail.state
                StringEquals: terminated
                Next: HandleTerminated
            Default: UnhandledState
          HandleRunning:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when an instance enters the running state.
            Result:
              action: instance-running
            ResultPath: $.handlerResult
            Next: WorkflowComplete
          HandleStopped:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when an instance enters the stopped state.
            Result:
              action: instance-stopped
            ResultPath: $.handlerResult
            Next: WorkflowComplete
          HandleTerminated:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when an instance enters the terminated state.
            Result:
              action: instance-terminated
            ResultPath: $.handlerResult
            Next: WorkflowComplete
          UnhandledState:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Defensive path for unexpected states; the EventBridge rule only delivers running, stopped, and terminated.
            Result:
              action: unhandled-state
            ResultPath: $.handlerResult
            Next: WorkflowComplete
          WorkflowComplete:
            Type: Succeed
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Allows EventBridge to start executions of the ${ProjectName} state machine

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:

            Statement:

      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DeadLetterQueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key encrypting the ${ProjectName} EventBridge dead-letter queue
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/${ProjectName}-ec2-state-change
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DeadLetterQueueKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-event-dlq
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DeadLetterQueueKey

  EventTargetDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-event-dlq
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueueKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EC2StateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-ec2-state-change
      Description: Triggers the Step Functions workflow when an EC2 instance transitions to running, stopped, or terminated.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
            - stopped
            - terminated
      Targets:
        - Id: StepFunctionsTarget
          Arn: !Ref EC2StateChangeStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn
          RetryPolicy:
            MaximumRetryAttempts: 3
            MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 3600
          DeadLetterConfig:
            Arn: !GetAtt EventTargetDeadLetterQueue.Arn

  EventTargetDeadLetterQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref EventTargetDeadLetterQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeSendMessage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt EventTargetDeadLetterQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt EC2StateChangeRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Catalogs AWS CloudTrail logs stored in S3 with an AWS Glue database and crawler so they can be queried with Amazon Athena.

Parameters:
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
    Description: Prefix used for the Glue database name and the Athena workgroup name.

Resources:
  LogsBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting CloudTrail logs and Athena query results in the logs bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailEncrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              StringLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailBucketDefaultEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ResourcePrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-analytics

  LogsBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ResourcePrefix}-cloudtrail-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsBucketKey

  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LogsBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireAthenaQueryResults
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: athena-results/
            ExpirationInDays: 30
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ResourcePrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-analytics

  LogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the Glue crawler that catalogs CloudTrail logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailLogsBucketReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListCloudTrailPrefix
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    s3:prefix:
                      - cloud-trail/
                      - cloud-trail/*
              - Sid: GetBucketLocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadCloudTrailObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'
              - Sid: DecryptCloudTrailObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt LogsBucketKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ResourcePrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-analytics

  CloudTrailDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-kk-admin-db'
        Description: Glue Data Catalog database for CloudTrail logs queried with Athena.

  CloudTrailCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Description: Crawls CloudTrail logs under cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ and catalogs them for Athena.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref CloudTrailDatabase
      TablePrefix: cloudtrail_
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${LogsBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
            Exclusions:
              - '**/CloudTrail-Digest/**'
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: UPDATE_IN_DATABASE
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_EVERYTHING
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}},"Grouping":{"TableGroupingPolicy":"CombineCompatibleSchemas"}}'
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 1 * * ? *)
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ResourcePrefix
        Purpose: cloudtrail-analytics

  CloudTrailWorkGroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-workgroup'
      Description: Athena workgroup for querying CloudTrail logs cataloged by Glue.
      State: ENABLED
      RecursiveDeleteOption: true
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration: true
        PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub 's3://${LogsBucket}/athena-results/'
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_KMS
            KmsKey: !GetAtt LogsBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ResourcePrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cloudtrail-analytics

Outputs:
  LogsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !Ref LogsBucket
  LogsBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket that stores CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
  LogsBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the logs bucket; use as KMSKeyId for a future trail.
    Value: !GetAtt LogsBucketKey.Arn
  LogsBucketKeyId:
    Description: ID of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the logs bucket.
    Value: !Ref LogsBucketKey
  CloudTrailS3KeyPrefix:
    Description: S3 key prefix to configure on a CloudTrail trail that delivers to this bucket.
    Value: cloud-trail
  CloudTrailLogsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path crawled by the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Sub 's3://${LogsBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database containing the CloudTrail tables.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailDatabase
  GlueCrawlerName:
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler that catalogs CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailCrawler
  GlueCrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the Glue crawler.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
  AthenaWorkGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Athena workgroup for querying CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailWorkGroup
  AthenaQueryResultsLocation:
    Description: S3 location where Athena query results are stored.
    Value: !Sub 's3://${LogsBucket}/athena-results/'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates two AppSync GraphQL APIs for testing - one protected by a regional WAF WebACL with a default block action, and one unprotected with no WAF attached.

Resources:
  WafProtectedApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-waf-protected-api'
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  WafProtectedApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt WafProtectedApi.ApiId
      Description: API key for the WAF-protected test API

  WafProtectedApiSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt WafProtectedApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ping: String
        }

  WafProtectedNoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt WafProtectedApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Description: NONE data source returning static values for the WAF-protected test API
      Type: NONE

  WafProtectedPingResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: WafProtectedApiSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt WafProtectedApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ping
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt WafProtectedNoneDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": "pong"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: $util.toJson($context.result)

  UnprotectedApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-unprotected-api'
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  UnprotectedApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt UnprotectedApi.ApiId
      Description: API key for the unprotected test API

  UnprotectedApiSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt UnprotectedApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ping: String
        }

  UnprotectedNoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt UnprotectedApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Description: NONE data source returning static values for the unprotected test API
      Type: NONE

  UnprotectedPingResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: UnprotectedApiSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt UnprotectedApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ping
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt UnprotectedNoneDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": "pong"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: $util.toJson($context.result)

  AppSyncWebAcl:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-appsync-webacl'
      Description: Regional WebACL that blocks all requests to the WAF-protected AppSync test API
      Scope: REGIONAL
      DefaultAction:
        Block: {}
      Rules: []
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-appsync-webacl'

  AppSyncWebAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation
    Properties:
      ResourceArn: !GetAtt WafProtectedApi.Arn
      WebACLArn: !GetAtt AppSyncWebAcl.Arn

Outputs:

Description: >-

  IAM role (assumed via SSM hybrid activation), and an SSM registration document

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-cluster
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'

  ContainerInstanceName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-instance
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-128 characters of letters, numbers, periods, hyphens or underscores.
    Description: Default name attribute applied to registered external container instances.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.

Resources:
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref ClusterName
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ECSAnywhereRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by ECS Anywhere external instances through an SSM hybrid activation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSAnywhereLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterName}-ecs-anywhere-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ClusterName}-ecs-anywhere-registration'
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content: !Sub |
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Registers an external instance with an ECS Anywhere cluster.
        parameters:
          activationId:
            type: String
            description: SSM hybrid activation ID created out-of-band with aws ssm create-activation.
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
          activationCode:
            type: String
            description: SSM hybrid activation code created out-of-band with aws ssm create-activation.
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+/=]+$'
          region:
            type: String
            description: AWS Region of the ECS cluster.
            default: '${AWS::Region}'
            allowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
          clusterName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the ECS cluster to register with.
            default: '${EcsCluster}'
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
          instanceName:
            type: String
            description: Name attribute applied to the registered container instance.
            default: '${ContainerInstanceName}'
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,128}$'

            name: registerEcsAnywhereInstance
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '1800'
              runCommand:
                - set -e
                - mkdir -p /etc/ecs
                - >-
                  echo 'ECS_INSTANCE_ATTRIBUTES={"instance-name":"{{instanceName}}"}' >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config
                - curl --proto "https" --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh "https://amazon-ecs-agent.s3.amazonaws.com/ecs-anywhere-install-latest.sh"
                - bash /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh --region "{{region}}" --cluster "{{clusterName}}" --activation-id "{{activationId}}" --activation-code "{{activationCode}}"
                - rm -f /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ClusterName}-ecs-anywhere-registration'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS Anywhere cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Anywhere cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsCluster.Arn

    Description: Name of the SSM document used to register external instances.
    Value: !Ref EcsAnywhereRegistrationDocument

    Value: !Ref ContainerInstanceName

  ActivationCommand:
    Description: Command to create the SSM hybrid activation out-of-band for external instances.
    Value: !Sub 'aws ssm create-activation --iam-role ${ECSAnywhereRole} --region ${AWS::Region} --default-instance-name ${ContainerInstanceName}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Forwards critical operational events from the deploying account's default event bus
  to org-sink event buses in a central monitoring account in us-east-1. The IAM roles
  (PRX-*OrgSinkRole) referenced by each target are external prerequisites: they must exist
  in the deploying account, trust events.amazonaws.com, and allow events:PutEvents on the
  corresponding central bus. The central bus resource policies must allow PutEvents from
  this account or organization. Deploy in us-east-1 so IAM and console sign-in CloudTrail
  events are delivered. CloudTrail management-event logging must be enabled in the account
  or organization. Event-bus-to-event-bus delivery uses EventBridge's default retry behavior
  because per-target retry policies are not supported for event bus targets.

Parameters:
  CentralMonitoringAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '578003269847'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: AWS account ID of the central monitoring account that hosts the org-sink event buses.

  CentralMonitoringRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1
    Description: Region of the central monitoring account's org-sink event buses.

  SlackRelayEventSource:
    Type: String
    Default: custom.slack.relay
    MinLength: 1
    Description: >-
      Event source used by the application that publishes Slack message relay events via PutEvents.
      Confirm this matches the publishing application before deployment.

  SlackRelayDetailType:
    Type: String
    Default: Slack Message Relay
    MinLength: 1
    Description: >-
      Detail-type used by the application that publishes Slack message relay events via PutEvents.
      Confirm this matches the publishing application before deployment.

Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards CloudWatch alarm state change events to the central CloudWatch-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudwatch
        detail-type:
          - CloudWatch Alarm State Change
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudWatchOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudWatch-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudWatchOrgSinkRole'

  CloudFormationToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards CloudFormation resource, stack, stack set, and stack set operation status change events to the central CloudFormation-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.cloudformation
        detail-type:
          - CloudFormation Resource Status Change
          - CloudFormation Stack Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Status Change
          - CloudFormation StackSet Operation Status Change

        - Id: CloudFormationOrgSinkBus

        - Id: GuardDutyOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/GuardDuty-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-GuardDutyOrgSinkRole'

  SlackRelayToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards application-published Slack message relay events to the central Slack-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - !Ref SlackRelayEventSource
        detail-type:
          - !Ref SlackRelayDetailType
      Targets:
        - Id: SlackOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/Slack-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-SlackOrgSinkRole'

  AutoScalingToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards EC2 Auto Scaling instance lifecycle and instance refresh events to the central AutoScaling-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.autoscaling
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance Launch Successful
          - EC2 Instance Launch Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Successful
          - EC2 Instance Terminate Unsuccessful
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Checkpoint Reached
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Started
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Succeeded
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Failed
          - EC2 Auto Scaling Instance Refresh Cancelled
      Targets:
        - Id: AutoScalingOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/AutoScaling-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-AutoScalingOrgSinkRole'

  CloudTrailRootActivityToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards root user API calls and console sign-ins recorded by CloudTrail to the central CloudTrail-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
          - AWS Console Sign In via CloudTrail
        detail:
          userIdentity:
            type:
              - Root
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'

  CloudTrailIamUserKeyCreationToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards IAM CreateUser and CreateAccessKey API calls recorded by CloudTrail to the central CloudTrail-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.iam

          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - iam.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - CreateUser
            - CreateAccessKey
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'

  CloudTrailIdentityCenterAdminToOrgSink:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Forwards IAM Identity Center (SSO) permission set, user, and group administrative actions recorded by CloudTrail to the central CloudTrail-org-sink event bus.
      EventBusName: default
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        detail-type:
          - AWS API Call via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - sso.amazonaws.com
            - sso-directory.amazonaws.com
            - identitystore.amazonaws.com
          eventName:
            - CreatePermissionSet
            - ProvisionPermissionSet
            - CreateTrustedTokenIssuer
            - PutInlinePolicyToPermissionSet
            - PutPermissionsBoundaryToPermissionSet
            - PutPermissionsPolicy
            - UpdatePermissionSet
            - CreateUser
            - EnableUser
            - AddMemberToGroup
            - UpdateUser
            - UpdateGroup
      Targets:
        - Id: CloudTrailOrgSinkBus
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${CentralMonitoringRegion}:${CentralMonitoringAccountId}:event-bus/CloudTrail-org-sink'
          RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/PRX-CloudTrailOrgSinkRole'

Outputs:

    Description: Central monitoring account ID that receives the forwarded events.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB idempotency store for hybrid (polling and event-driven) file-processing deduplication.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage notes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key design:
#   pk (String, HASH)  - logical file identity, e.g. "FILE#<volume>/<path>"
#   sk (String, RANGE) - file version discriminator, e.g. "VER#<etag-or-mtime>"
#
# Time-to-Live:
#   DynamoDB TTL is attribute-based. Writers MUST set the "expires_at" attribute
#   (Number, epoch seconds) to:
#     expires_at = <current epoch seconds> + (TtlDefaultDays * 86400)
#   The TtlDefaultDays value is exported as a stack output for consumers.
#
# Recommended deduplication pattern:
#   Use a conditional PutItem with
#     ConditionExpression: attribute_not_exists(pk) AND attribute_not_exists(sk)
#   Both the polling path and the event-driven path attempt the same conditional
#   write. Exactly one wins per file and version; the loser receives a
#   ConditionalCheckFailedException and must skip processing.
#
# IAM:
#   The managed policy is not attached here. Consuming stacks attach the
#   exported policy ARN to Lambda execution roles and Step Functions state
#   machine roles through ManagedPolicyArns.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 2-31 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
    Description: Project prefix used for naming resources and exports.

  TtlDefaultDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Default retention in days for idempotency records. Writers set expires_at = now + TtlDefaultDays * 86400.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable Point-in-Time Recovery on the idempotency table.

Conditions:
  IsPitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      # Writers must set expires_at (epoch seconds) = now + TtlDefaultDays * 86400.
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expires_at
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [IsPitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectPrefix
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: idempotency-store

  IdempotencyTableAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-table-rw'
      Description: Grants Lambda and Step Functions read/write access to the idempotency DynamoDB table.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn

Outputs:
  IdempotencyTableName:
    Description: Name of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-table-name'

  IdempotencyTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-table-arn'

  IdempotencyTableAccessPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed policy granting read/write access to the idempotency table. Attach via ManagedPolicyArns on Lambda and Step Functions roles.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTableAccessPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-table-rw-policy-arn'

  TtlAttributeName:
    Description: Name of the TTL attribute (Number, epoch seconds) that writers must set on each item.
    Value: expires_at
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-ttl-attribute'

  TtlDefaultDays:
    Description: Default retention in days. Writers set expires_at = now + TtlDefaultDays * 86400.
    Value: !Ref TtlDefaultDays
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-ttl-default-days'

  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Description: Whether Point-in-Time Recovery is enabled on the idempotency table.
    Value: !Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-pitr-enabled'

Description: Test Step Functions standard workflow that runs DynamoDB PutItem and then GetItem on a stack-managed table.

        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the DynamoDB PutItem/GetItem test state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:

        - PolicyName: DynamoDBPutGetItemAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPutAndGetItemOnTestTable

                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt TestTable.Arn

  DynamoDBTestStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:

            Type: Task
