final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  ECS chaos-engineering workflow. A Step Functions state machine terminates a
  dedicated EC2 chaos-target instance, waits 300 seconds, checks the health of
  an ECS Fargate service, and sends an SNS alert if the service is unhealthy.
  The workflow is single-use per deployment. After the first execution the
  target instance is terminated, and later runs fail at TerminateInstance and
  route to ChaosFailed. To reset the target, update the stack so that the
  instance is replaced. For example, increment the TargetGeneration tag in the
  launch template, which creates a new launch template version. ECS image
  pulls use an ECR pull-through cache over VPC interface endpoints. The cached
  repository is created at runtime and remains after stack deletion.

Metadata:
  ChaosWorkflowNotes:
    SingleUse: >-
      Each deployment supports one chaos run. After the first execution the
      ChaosTargetInstance is terminated. Re-running fails at TerminateInstance
      and transitions to ChaosFailed.
    ResetProcedure: >-
      Increment the TargetGeneration tag value in the
      LaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateData.TagSpecifications section and run a
      stack update. The new launch template version forces replacement of
      ChaosTargetInstance and restores a fresh target.
    StartExecution: >-
      aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn <StateMachineArn output> --input '{}'
    ImagePullPath: >-
      Fargate tasks run in subnets without public IPs and without internet
      egress. The nginx image is pulled from public.ecr.aws through an ECR
      pull-through cache rule. Image layers and container logs travel over
      the ecr.api, ecr.dkr, s3, and logs interface VPC endpoints.
    CachedRepositoryLifecycle: >-
      The pull-through cache creates the private repository
      <ProjectName>-ecrpub/nginx/nginx on the first image pull. That repository
      is not managed by this stack and remains after stack deletion. Delete it
      manually if it is no longer needed.
    RootVolumeEncryption: >-
      The chaos target root volume is encrypted with the stack-owned
      EbsVolumeKey customer managed key rather than the lazily created
      aws/ebs key. The volume size is inherited from the AMI snapshot.
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - LatestAmiId

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: chaos-ecs
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a lowercase letter and contain 3-21 lowercase letters,
      digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Project name used to prefix resource names and tags.

  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: Public SSM parameter path for the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TargetInstanceSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-target-sg'
      GroupDescription: Chaos target instance - no inbound access, HTTPS egress within the VPC only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to endpoints within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-target-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EcsServiceSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-service-sg'
      GroupDescription: ECS Fargate tasks - HTTP from within the VPC only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTP from within the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints (image pulls, logging)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-service-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  VpcEndpointSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from within the VPC only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC interface endpoints for the private ECS image and log path
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSG
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecr-api-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSG
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSG
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      DnsOptions:
        DnsRecordIpType: ipv4
        PrivateDnsOnlyForInboundResolverEndpoint: AllResolvers
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSG
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Chaos target EC2 instance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EbsVolumeKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${ProjectName} chaos target EBS volumes'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEbsUseViaEc2InAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EbsVolumeKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-ebs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EbsVolumeKey

  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-target-lt'
      TagSpecifications:
        - ResourceType: launch-template
          Tags:
            - Key: Name
              Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-target-lt'
            - Key: Project
              Value: !Ref ProjectName
            - Key: Purpose
              Value: chaos-engineering
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName
              - Key: Purpose
                Value: chaos-engineering
              - Key: TargetGeneration
                Value: '1'
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-target-root'
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName
              - Key: Purpose
                Value: chaos-engineering

  ChaosTargetInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref TargetInstanceSG
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsVolumeKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      DisableApiTermination: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-target'
        - Key: ChaosTarget
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS cluster and service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EcsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${ProjectName}'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EcrPullThroughCacheRule:
    Type: AWS::ECR::PullThroughCacheRule
    Properties:
      EcrRepositoryPrefix: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecrpub'
      UpstreamRegistryUrl: public.ecr.aws

  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-task-execution'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ecs-task-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteContainerLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt EcsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PullThroughCacheImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:CreateRepository
                  - ecr:BatchImportUpstreamImage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${EcrPullThroughCacheRule}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EcsTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: web
          Image: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${EcrPullThroughCacheRule}/nginx/nginx:stable'
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref EcsLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: web
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - EcrApiEndpoint
      - EcrDkrEndpoint
      - LogsEndpoint
      - S3Endpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-service'
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref EcsTaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: 2
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet1
            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref EcsServiceSG
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alerting
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SnsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${ProjectName} chaos alert SNS topic'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  SnsTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-sns'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKey

  ChaosAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-alerts'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ProjectName} chaos alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  ChaosAlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowHealthCheckLambdaPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambdaRole.Arn
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TerminateLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-terminate-instance'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  HealthCheckLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-health-check'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  TerminateLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-terminate-lambda'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: terminate-chaos-target
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: TerminateTaggedChaosTarget
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/${ChaosTargetInstance}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/ChaosTarget: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  HealthCheckLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-health-check-lambda'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ecs-health-check-and-alert
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Effect: Allow

                  - logs:CreateLogStream

              - Sid: DescribeEcsService
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Ref EcsService
              - Sid: PublishAlert
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref ChaosAlertTopic
              - Sid: UseSnsCustomerManagedKeyViaSns
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  TerminateInstanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-terminate-instance'
      Description: Terminates the chaos target EC2 instance supplied in the event payload.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref TerminateLambdaLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")


          class TargetAlreadyTerminated(Exception):
              pass


          def handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event["InstanceId"]
              logger.info("Terminating chaos target instance %s", instance_id)

              response = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              changes = response.get("TerminatingInstances", [])
              if not changes:
                  raise RuntimeError(f"No termination state returned for {instance_id}")

              previous_state = changes[0]["PreviousState"]["Name"]
              current_state = changes[0]["CurrentState"]["Name"]
              logger.info(
                  "Instance %s state transition: %s -> %s",
                  instance_id,
                  previous_state,
                  current_state,
              )

              if previous_state in ("shutting-down", "terminated"):
                  raise TargetAlreadyTerminated(
                      f"Instance {instance_id} was already {previous_state}; "
                      "replace the target via a stack update before re-running."
                  )

              result = {
                  "InstanceId": instance_id,
                  "PreviousState": previous_state,
                  "CurrentState": current_state,
              }
              logger.info(json.dumps(result))
              return result
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  HealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-health-check'
      Description: Checks ECS service health and publishes an SNS alert if unhealthy.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref HealthCheckLambdaLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ecs = boto3.client("ecs")
          sns = boto3.client("sns")


          def evaluate(cluster, service_name):
              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service_name])
              services = response.get("services", [])
              if not services:
                  return False, {
                      "Reason": "Service not found",
                      "Failures": response.get("failures", []),
                  }

              svc = services[0]
              desired = svc.get("desiredCount", 0)
              running = svc.get("runningCount", 0)
              pending = svc.get("pendingCount", 0)
              primary = next(
                  (d for d in svc.get("deployments", []) if d.get("status") == "PRIMARY"),
                  {},
              )
              rollout_state = primary.get("rolloutState", "UNKNOWN")

              healthy = (
                  svc.get("status") == "ACTIVE"
                  and desired > 0
                  and running >= desired
                  and rollout_state != "FAILED"
              )
              return healthy, {
                  "Status": svc.get("status"),
                  "DesiredCount": desired,
                  "RunningCount": running,
                  "PendingCount": pending,
                  "RolloutState": rollout_state,
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              cluster = event["ClusterArn"]
              service_name = event["ServiceName"]
              topic_arn = event["TopicArn"]

              healthy, details = evaluate(cluster, service_name)
              logger.info(
                  "Service %s healthy=%s details=%s", service_name, healthy, json.dumps(details)
              )

              alert_sent = False
              if not healthy:
                  message = {
                      "Alert": "ECS service unhealthy after chaos experiment",
                      "Cluster": cluster,
                      "Service": service_name,
                      "TerminatedInstanceId": event.get("TerminatedInstanceId"),
                      "ExecutionId": event.get("ExecutionId"),
                      "Details": details,
                  }
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=topic_arn,
                      Subject="ECS chaos experiment: service unhealthy",
                      Message=json.dumps(message, indent=2, default=str),
                  )
                  alert_sent = True
                  logger.warning("Published unhealthy alert to %s", topic_arn)

              return {
                  "Healthy": healthy,
                  "AlertSent": alert_sent,
                  "Details": details,
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  # Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-chaos'

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-state-machine'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-chaos-lambdas

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeChaosLambdas
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${HealthCheckFunction.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: VendedLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chaos-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "ECS chaos experiment: terminate an EC2 instance, wait, check ECS service health, alert if unhealthy.",
          "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
          "States": {
            "TerminateInstance": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "InstanceId": "${ChaosTargetInstance}"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.termination",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Lambda.ServiceException",
                    "Lambda.AWSLambdaException",
                    "Lambda.SdkClientException",
                    "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                  "ResultPath": "$.error",
                  "Next": "ChaosFailed"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "WaitForRecovery"
            },
            "WaitForRecovery": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 300,
              "Next": "CheckServiceHealth"
            },
            "CheckServiceHealth": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${HealthCheckFunction.Arn}",
              "Parameters": {
                "ClusterArn": "${EcsCluster.Arn}",
                "ServiceName": "${EcsService.Name}",
                "TopicArn": "${ChaosAlertTopic}",
                "TerminatedInstanceId.$": "$.termination.InstanceId",
                "ExecutionId.$": "$$.Execution.Id"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.health",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Lambda.ServiceException",
                    "Lambda.AWSLambdaException",
                    "Lambda.SdkClientException",
                    "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                  "ResultPath": "$.error",
                  "Next": "ChaosFailed"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "EvaluateHealth"
            },
            "EvaluateHealth": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.health.Healthy",
                  "BooleanEquals": true,
                  "Next": "ServiceHealthy"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "ServiceUnhealthy"
            },
            "ServiceHealthy": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            },
            "ServiceUnhealthy": {
              "Type": "Fail",
              "Error": "ServiceUnhealthy",
              "Cause": "ECS service did not recover within 300 seconds; SNS alert published."
            },
            "ChaosFailed": {
              "Type": "Fail",
              "Error": "ChaosExperimentFailed",
              "Cause": "A chaos workflow step failed. If TerminateInstance failed, the target may already be terminated; replace it via a stack update."
            }
          }
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: chaos-engineering

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates an AWS DevOps Agent Space, its IAM roles for the agent service and operator application, and a primary monitoring-account association for the current AWS account.

Parameters:
  AgentSpaceName:
    Type: String
    Default: DevOpsAgentSpace
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters consisting of letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
    Description: Name of the DevOps Agent Space.

Resources:
  DevOpsAgentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent service to investigate resources in this account.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AIDevOpsAgentAccessPolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCreateResourceExplorerServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/resource-explorer-2.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForResourceExplorer'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: resource-explorer-2.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DevOpsAgent
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DevOpsOperatorAppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the AWS DevOps Agent operator web application.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aidevops.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:aidevops:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agentspace/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AIDevOpsOperatorAppAccessPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DevOpsAgent
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AgentSpace:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::AgentSpace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref AgentSpaceName
      Description: AWS DevOps Agent Space for investigating operational issues in this account.
      OperatorApp:
        Iam:
          OperatorAppRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsOperatorAppRole.Arn

  PrimaryMonitoringAccountAssociation:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsAgent::Association
    Properties:
      AgentSpaceId: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
      ServiceId: aws
      Configuration:
        Aws:
          AssumableRoleArn: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentRole.Arn
          AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          AccountType: monitor

Outputs:
  AgentSpaceId:
    Description: ID of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId
  AgentSpaceArn:
    Description: ARN of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentSpace.Arn
  AgentSpaceName:
    Description: Name of the DevOps Agent Space.
    Value: !Ref AgentSpaceName
  OperatorAppUrl:
    Description: URL of the DevOps Agent operator web application.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AgentSpace.AgentSpaceId}.aidevops.global.app.aws'
  DevOpsAgentRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the DevOps Agent service.
    Value: !GetAtt DevOpsAgentRole.Arn
  DevOpsOperatorAppRoleArn:

Description: >-

Resources:

  ParameterStoreDemoLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/ParameterStoreDemo
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ParameterStoreDemoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the ParameterStoreDemo Lambda function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterStoreDemoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: ReadStackParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Sid: ListSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadStackSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${AWS::StackName}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ParameterStoreDemoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ParameterStoreDemoLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Description: Retrieves and prints SSM parameters and Secrets Manager secrets for this stack
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")
          secretsmanager = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def mask(value):
              if value is None:
                  return None
              text = str(value)
              if len(text) <= 4:
                  return "****"
              return text[:2] + "*" * (len(text) - 4) + text[-2:]


          def get_parameters(stack_name):
              path = f"/{stack_name}/"
              parameters = []
              paginator = ssm.get_paginator("get_parameters_by_path")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Path=path, Recursive=True):
                  for param in page.get("Parameters", []):
                      parameters.append(
                          {
                              "Name": param["Name"],
                              "Type": param["Type"],
                              "Value": param["Value"],
                              "Version": param["Version"],
                          }
                      )
              return parameters


          def get_secrets(stack_name):
              prefix = f"{stack_name}-"
              secrets = []
              paginator = secretsmanager.get_paginator("list_secrets")
              filters = [{"Key": "name", "Values": [prefix]}]
              for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=filters):
                  for entry in page.get("SecretList", []):
                      name = entry["Name"]
                      if not name.startswith(prefix):
                          continue
                      response = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=entry["ARN"])
                      secret_string = response.get("SecretString", "")
                      try:
                          parsed = json.loads(secret_string)
                          if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                              masked = {k: (v if k == "username" else mask(v)) for k, v in parsed.items()}
                          else:
                              masked = mask(secret_string)
                      except (ValueError, TypeError):
                          masked = mask(secret_string)
                      secrets.append(
                          {
                              "Name": name,
                              "ARN": entry["ARN"],
                              "Description": entry.get("Description", ""),
                              "Value": masked,
                          }
                      )
              return secrets


          def handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ["STACK_NAME"]
              print(f"Stack name: {stack_name}")

              parameters = get_parameters(stack_name)
              print(f"Found {len(parameters)} parameter(s) under /{stack_name}/")
              for param in parameters:
                  print(f"  {param['Name']} ({param['Type']}, v{param['Version']}): {param['Value']}")

              secrets = get_secrets(stack_name)
              print(f"Found {len(secrets)} secret(s) with prefix {stack_name}-")
              for secret in secrets:
                  print(f"  {secret['Name']}: {json.dumps(secret['Value'])}")

              return {
                  "stackName": stack_name,
                  "parameterCount": len(parameters),
                  "parameters": parameters,
                  "secretCount": len(secrets),
                  "secrets": [{"Name": s["Name"], "ARN": s["ARN"]} for s in secrets],
              }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Lambda blue/green CI/CD environment using AWS CodeDeploy canary traffic
  shifting with pre-traffic and post-traffic validation hooks.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-bluegreen
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-30 characters of lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
    Description: Project name used in resource names and tags.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Log groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PreTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pre-traffic-hook'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PostTrafficHookLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-post-traffic-hook'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName}-${Environment} main Lambda function'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MainFunctionLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt MainFunctionLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-main'
      Description: !Sub 'Main application function for ${ProjectName} (${Environment})'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref MainFunctionLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "message": "Hello from the main function",
                      "environment": os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT", "unknown"),
                      "version": context.function_version,
                  }),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # NOTE: CloudFormation only publishes a new Lambda version when this
  # resource's properties change. Bump the Description (or set CodeSha256)
  # for every release so a new version is published and CodeDeploy shifts
  # traffic to it through the alias UpdatePolicy.
  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment} release 1'

  MainFunctionAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    UpdatePolicy:
      CodeDeployLambdaAliasUpdate:
        ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
        DeploymentGroupName: !Ref CodeDeployDeploymentGroup
        BeforeAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PreTrafficHookFunction
        AfterAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PostTrafficHookFunction
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: !Sub 'Live traffic alias for ${ProjectName}-${Environment}'
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validation hook functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HookFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for ${ProjectName}-${Environment} CodeDeploy validation hooks'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HookFunctionPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PreTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PostTrafficHookLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: ReportHookStatus
                Effect: Allow
                Action: codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codedeploy:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deploymentgroup:${CodeDeployApplication}/${CodeDeployDeploymentGroup}'
              - Sid: InvokeMainFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MainFunction.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PreTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-pre-traffic-hook'
      Description: Validates the new main function version before traffic shifting.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PreTrafficHookLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TARGET_FUNCTION_ARN: !Ref MainFunctionVersion
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")
          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")


          def validate(target):
              response = lambda_client.invoke(
                  FunctionName=target,
                  InvocationType="RequestResponse",
                  Payload=json.dumps({"source": "pre-traffic-hook"}).encode(),
              )
              if response.get("FunctionError") or response["StatusCode"] != 200:
                  return False
              payload = json.loads(response["Payload"].read())
              return payload.get("statusCode") == 200


          def handler(event, context):
              status = "Failed"
              target = os.environ["TARGET_FUNCTION_ARN"]
              try:
                  if validate(target):
                      status = "Succeeded"
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Pre-traffic validation error for {target}: {exc}")
              print(f"Pre-traffic validation of {target}: {status}")
              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PostTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-post-traffic-hook'
      Description: Validates the live alias after traffic shifting completes.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PostTrafficHookLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TARGET_FUNCTION_ARN: !Sub '${MainFunction.Arn}:live'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")
          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")


          def validate(target):
              response = lambda_client.invoke(
                  FunctionName=target,
                  InvocationType="RequestResponse",
                  Payload=json.dumps({"source": "post-traffic-hook"}).encode(),
              )
              if response.get("FunctionError") or response["StatusCode"] != 200:
                  return False
              payload = json.loads(response["Payload"].read())
              return payload.get("statusCode") == 200


          def handler(event, context):
              status = "Failed"
              target = os.environ["TARGET_FUNCTION_ARN"]
              try:
                  if validate(target):
                      status = "Succeeded"
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Post-traffic validation error for {target}: {exc}")
              print(f"Post-traffic validation of {target}: {status}")
              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=event["DeploymentId"],
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"],
                  status=status,
              )
              return {"status": status}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeDeploy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CodeDeploy service role for ${ProjectName}-${Environment} Lambda deployments'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # Attached as a separate policy so the service role can reference the hook
  # functions without creating a circular dependency through the deployment group.
  CodeDeployServicePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CodeDeployLambdaDeployment
      Roles:
        - !Ref CodeDeployServiceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageMainFunctionAlias
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:GetAlias
              - lambda:UpdateAlias
              - lambda:GetProvisionedConcurrencyConfig
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn
              - !Sub '${MainFunction.Arn}:*'
          - Sid: InvokeValidationHooks
            Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PreTrafficHookFunction.Arn
              - !GetAtt PostTrafficHookFunction.Arn

  CodeDeployApplication:
    Type: AWS::CodeDeploy::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-app'
      ComputePlatform: Lambda
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  CodeDeployDeploymentGroup:

    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
      DeploymentGroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-dg'
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
      DeploymentConfigName: CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes
      DeploymentStyle:
        DeploymentType: BLUE_GREEN
        DeploymentOption: WITH_TRAFFIC_CONTROL
      AutoRollbackConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
        Events:
          - DEPLOYMENT_FAILURE

      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Description: Provisions a GitHub Actions OIDC identity provider and a read-only S3 IAM role for the guardian/facia-scala-client repository to access the facia-tool-store bucket (including its DEV prefix).

# Deployment caveat: an AWS account can hold only one IAM OIDC provider per URL.
# This stack must be the single owner of the token.actions.githubusercontent.com
# provider. Any other stack that later tries to create the same provider will fail.
#
# External bucket: facia-tool-store is an existing, globally-named bucket owned by
# the consuming organisation. It is intentionally NOT created by this template.
#
# Follow-up: if facia-tool-store uses SSE-KMS, the role will also need kms:Decrypt
# on that bucket's KMS key ARN. That ARN is unknown here, so the permission is omitted.

Resources:
  GitHubActionsOidcProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      Url: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
      ClientIdList:
        - sts.amazonaws.com
      ThumbprintList:
        - 6938fd4d98bab03faadb97b34396831e3780aea1
        - 1c58a3a8518e8759bf075b76b750d4f2df264fcd
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: GitHubActionsOidc

  GitHubActionsFaciaClientRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by GitHub Actions workflows in guardian/facia-scala-client via OIDC for read-only access to facia-tool-store.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGitHubActionsOidcAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !GetAtt GitHubActionsOidcProvider.Arn
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud: sts.amazonaws.com
              StringLike:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub: repo:guardian/facia-scala-client:*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FaciaToolStoreReadOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListFaciaToolStoreBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::facia-tool-store
              - Sid: ReadFaciaToolStoreObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::facia-tool-store/*
                  - arn:aws:s3:::facia-tool-store/DEV/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Repository
          Value: guardian/facia-scala-client
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: FaciaToolStoreReadOnly

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the GitHub Actions OIDC identity provider.
    Value: !GetAtt GitHubActionsOidcProvider.Arn
  GitHubActionsFaciaClientRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role to configure as role-to-assume in aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys a scheduled Python Lambda function that logs the current time to CloudWatch Logs every 5 minutes, triggered by a CloudWatch Events rule.

Resources:
  TimeLoggerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the time logger Lambda function with least-privilege CloudWatch Logs access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TimeLoggerLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-time-logger:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: time-logger

  TimeLoggerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-time-logger'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: time-logger

  TimeLoggerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: TimeLoggerLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-time-logger'
      Description: Logs the current UTC time to CloudWatch Logs.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt TimeLoggerExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)


          def handler(event, context):
              current_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              logger.info("Current time: %s", current_time)
              return {"currentTime": current_time}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: time-logger

  TimeLoggerScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Invokes the time logger Lambda function every 5 minutes.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(5 minutes)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: TimeLoggerFunctionTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt TimeLoggerFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: time-logger

  TimeLoggerInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref TimeLoggerFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt TimeLoggerScheduleRule.Arn

Outputs:
  TimeLoggerFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the time logger Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref TimeLoggerFunction
  TimeLoggerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the time logger Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt TimeLoggerFunction.Arn
  TimeLoggerScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Events rule that triggers the function.
    Value: !GetAtt TimeLoggerScheduleRule.Arn

    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for the function.
    Value: !Ref TimeLoggerLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Custom Systems Manager inventory collection stack. Provisions an SSM Command
  document that discovers running database and caching processes (Cassandra,
  DSE, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, Memcached) on Linux and Windows
  managed instances and writes the results as a Custom:RunningProcesses
  inventory file, plus a scheduled SSM association (Custom-Inventory-Processes)
  that runs the document against all managed instances.

# NOTE: The custom inventory files written by this document are only uploaded
# to Systems Manager Inventory when the built-in AWS-GatherSoftwareInventory
# document is also associated with the instances (for example via a separate
# inventory association or Quick Setup). That association is intentionally
# NOT created by this stack and must exist separately.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of process name or command-line substrings to search
      for on Linux instances.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      May contain only letters, digits, spaces, commas, periods, underscores
      and hyphens.

  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated list of process name substrings to search for on Windows
      instances.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      May contain only letters, digits, spaces, commas, periods, underscores
      and hyphens.

  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(30 days)
    Description: >-
      Cron or rate expression that controls how often the association runs
      (for example rate(30 days) or cron(0 2 ? * SUN *)).

Resources:
  CustomInventoryDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      TargetType: /AWS::EC2::Instance
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CustomProcessInventory
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: >-
          Collects running database and caching processes on Linux and Windows
          instances and writes them to a Custom:RunningProcesses inventory file.
        parameters:
          linuxProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of process name or command-line substrings to search for on Linux.
            default: CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
            allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._-]*$'
          windowsProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of process name substrings to search for on Windows.
            default: sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
            allowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9 ,._-]*$'
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: linuxCustomInventory
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  set -u

                  # Retrieve the instance ID from instance metadata (IMDSv2)
                  TOKEN=$(curl -s -f -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300")
                  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -f -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: ${TOKEN}" "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id")
                  if [ -z "${INSTANCE_ID}" ]; then
                    echo "Unable to determine instance ID from instance metadata" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  INV_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/${INSTANCE_ID}/inventory/custom"
                  INV_FILE="${INV_DIR}/RunningProcesses.json"
                  mkdir -p "${INV_DIR}"

                  KEYWORDS='{{ linuxProcessKeywords }}'
                  IFS=',' read -r -a KW_ARRAY <<< "${KEYWORDS}"
                  COLLECTION_TIME=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

                  json_escape() {
                    printf '%s' "$1" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' | tr -d '\000-\037'
                  }

                  ENTRIES=""
                  while read -r PID PUSER PARGS; do
                    [ -z "${PID}" ] && continue
                    [ "${PID}" = "$$" ] && continue
                    PNAME=$(cat "/proc/${PID}/comm" 2>/dev/null || true)
                    for RAW_KW in "${KW_ARRAY[@]}"; do
                      KW=$(printf '%s' "${RAW_KW}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
                      [ -z "${KW}" ] && continue
                      case "${PNAME} ${PARGS}" in
                        *"${KW}"*)
                          ENTRY=$(printf '{"ProcessId":"%s","ProcessName":"%s","User":"%s","CommandLine":"%s","MatchedKeyword":"%s","CollectionTime":"%s"}' \
                            "$(json_escape "${PID}")" \
                            "$(json_escape "${PNAME}")" \
                            "$(json_escape "${PUSER}")" \
                            "$(json_escape "${PARGS:0:1024}")" \
                            "$(json_escape "${KW}")" \
                            "${COLLECTION_TIME}")
                          if [ -z "${ENTRIES}" ]; then
                            ENTRIES="${ENTRY}"
                          else
                            ENTRIES="${ENTRIES},${ENTRY}"
                          fi
                          break
                          ;;
                      esac
                    done
                  done < <(ps -eo pid=,user=,args=)

                  TMP_FILE="${INV_FILE}.tmp"
                  printf '{"SchemaVersion":"1.0","TypeName":"Custom:RunningProcesses","Content":[%s]}\n' "${ENTRIES}" > "${TMP_FILE}"
                  mv -f "${TMP_FILE}" "${INV_FILE}"
                  echo "Custom inventory written to ${INV_FILE}"
                  cat "${INV_FILE}"
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: windowsCustomInventory
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

                  # Retrieve the instance ID from instance metadata (IMDSv2)
                  try {
                    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token' -Headers @{ 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds' = '300' }
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id' -Headers @{ 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token' = $token }
                  } catch {
                    Write-Error "Unable to determine instance ID from instance metadata: $_"
                    exit 1
                  }
                  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($instanceId)) {
                    Write-Error 'Instance metadata returned an empty instance ID'
                    exit 1
                  }

                  $invDir = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom"
                  $invFile = Join-Path $invDir 'RunningProcesses.json'
                  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $invDir -Force | Out-Null

                  $keywords = @('{{ windowsProcessKeywords }}'.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
                  $collectionTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')

                  $content = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
                  foreach ($proc in Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process) {
                    $name = [string]$proc.Name
                    foreach ($kw in $keywords) {
                      if ($name.IndexOf($kw, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
                        $owner = ''
                        try {
                          $ownerInfo = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $proc -MethodName GetOwner -ErrorAction Stop
                          if ($ownerInfo.ReturnValue -eq 0) { $owner = "$($ownerInfo.Domain)\$($ownerInfo.User)" }
                        } catch { $owner = '' }
                        $cmdLine = [string]$proc.CommandLine
                        if ($cmdLine.Length -gt 1024) { $cmdLine = $cmdLine.Substring(0, 1024) }
                        [void]$content.Add([ordered]@{
                          ProcessId      = [string]$proc.ProcessId
                          ProcessName    = $name
                          User           = $owner
                          CommandLine    = $cmdLine
                          MatchedKeyword = $kw
                          CollectionTime = $collectionTime
                        })
                        break
                      }
                    }
                  }

                  $inventory = [ordered]@{
                    SchemaVersion = '1.0'
                    TypeName      = 'Custom:RunningProcesses'
                    Content       = @($content)
                  }
                  $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $inventory -Depth 5 -Compress
                  $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
                  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($invFile, $json, $utf8NoBom)
                  Write-Output "Custom inventory written to $invFile"
                  Write-Output $json

  CustomInventoryAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - '*'
      Parameters:
        linuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        windowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

Outputs:
  CustomInventoryDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Command document that collects custom process inventory.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
  CustomInventoryAssociationId:
    Description: ID of the Custom-Inventory-Processes SSM association.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomInventoryAssociation.AssociationId
  CustomInventoryAssociationName:
    Description: Name of the SSM association that runs the custom inventory document.
    Value: Custom-Inventory-Processes
  CustomInventoryTypeName:
    Description: Custom inventory type name written by the document.
    Value: Custom:RunningProcesses
