AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an Amazon DataZone domain, producer (SalesPublisher) and consumer
  (MarketingConsumer) projects, the required IAM roles for domain execution,
  data access, and provisioning, and a DefaultDataWarehouse environment
  blueprint configuration enabled in the current region.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: cookbookChapter11
    Description: Base name of the Amazon DataZone domain. A stack-specific suffix is appended to guarantee uniqueness.

Resources:
  DomainExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Domain execution role assumed by Amazon DataZone.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                aws:TagKeys: datazone*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDataZoneDomainExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: DataZoneDomain
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  DataAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Manage-access role used by Amazon DataZone for AWS Glue and Amazon Redshift.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt Domain.Arn
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDataZoneGlueManageAccessRolePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDataZoneRedshiftManageAccessRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataZoneRedshiftSecretsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RedshiftSecretStatement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    secretsmanager:ResourceTag/AmazonDataZoneDomain: !GetAtt Domain.Id
      Tags:
        - Key: DataZoneDomain
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  ProvisioningRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Provisioning role used by Amazon DataZone to create environment resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: datazone.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDataZoneRedshiftGlueProvisioningPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: DataZoneDomain
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  Domain:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Domain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub
        - '${DomainName}-${StackSuffix}'
        - StackSuffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      Description: Amazon DataZone domain for producer and consumer data sharing.
      DomainExecutionRole: !GetAtt DomainExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: DataZoneDomain
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  SalesPublisherProject:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Project
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt Domain.Id
      Name: SalesPublisher
      Description: Producer project that publishes sales data assets.

  MarketingConsumerProject:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::Project
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt Domain.Id
      Name: MarketingConsumer
      Description: Consumer project that subscribes to published data assets.

  DataWarehouseBlueprintConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::DataZone::EnvironmentBlueprintConfiguration
    Properties:
      DomainIdentifier: !GetAtt Domain.Id
      EnvironmentBlueprintIdentifier: DefaultDataWarehouse
      EnabledRegions:
        - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      ManageAccessRoleArn: !GetAtt DataAccessRole.Arn
      ProvisioningRoleArn: !GetAtt ProvisioningRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DomainName:
    Description: Name of the Amazon DataZone domain as created.
    Value: !Sub
      - '${DomainName}-${StackSuffix}'
      - StackSuffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt Domain.Id
  DomainArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt Domain.Arn
  DomainPortalUrl:
    Description: Data portal URL of the Amazon DataZone domain.
    Value: !GetAtt Domain.PortalUrl
  SalesPublisherProjectId:
    Description: ID of the SalesPublisher producer project.
    Value: !GetAtt SalesPublisherProject.Id
  MarketingConsumerProjectId:
    Description: ID of the MarketingConsumer consumer project.
    Value: !GetAtt MarketingConsumerProject.Id
  DomainExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the domain execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt DomainExecutionRole.Arn
  DataAccessRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue and Redshift manage-access role.
    Value: !GetAtt DataAccessRole.Arn
  ProvisioningRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the provisioning role.
    Value: !GetAtt ProvisioningRole.Arn
  DataWarehouseBlueprintId:
    Description: ID of the enabled DefaultDataWarehouse environment blueprint.
    Value: !GetAtt DataWarehouseBlueprintConfiguration.EnvironmentBlueprintId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Basic AWS App Mesh setup for the colorteller demo service. It includes a mesh,
  the colorgateway virtual gateway, blue and green virtual nodes discovered via
  AWS Cloud Map, a virtual router splitting traffic 50/50, and the colorteller
  virtual service.

Resources:
  # VPC used solely to host the Cloud Map private DNS namespace (greenfield account).
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  Namespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Cloud Map namespace for the ${AWS::StackName} colorteller demo'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  # ECS tasks or other workloads register their instances into this service later.
  ColorTellerDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller
      NamespaceId: !GetAtt Namespace.Id
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: A
            TTL: 300
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  Mesh:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # NOTE: No AWS::AppMesh::GatewayRoute is defined because none was requested.
  # Without one, colorgateway listens on port 9080 but forwards no traffic to
  # the colorteller virtual service.
  VirtualGateway:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualGateway
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualGatewayName: colorgateway
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000

  BlueVirtualNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn: Namespace
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-blue-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              Port: 9080
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorteller
            Attributes:
              - Key: version
                Value: blue

  GreenVirtualNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn: Namespace
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-green-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              Port: 9080
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorteller
            Attributes:
              - Key: version
                Value: green

  VirtualRouter:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualRouter
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller-vr
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http

  Route:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Route
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualRouterName: !GetAtt VirtualRouter.VirtualRouterName
      RouteName: colorteller-route
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Match:
            Prefix: /
          Action:
            WeightedTargets:
              - VirtualNode: !GetAtt BlueVirtualNode.VirtualNodeName
                Weight: 50
              - VirtualNode: !GetAtt GreenVirtualNode.VirtualNodeName
                Weight: 50

  VirtualService:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualService
    Properties:
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      VirtualServiceName: !Sub 'colorteller.${AWS::StackName}.local'
      Spec:
        Provider:
          VirtualRouter:
            VirtualRouterName: !GetAtt VirtualRouter.VirtualRouterName

Outputs:
  MeshName:
    Description: Name of the App Mesh mesh
    Value: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
  MeshArn:
    Description: ARN of the App Mesh mesh
    Value: !Ref Mesh
  VirtualGatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorgateway virtual gateway
    Value: !Ref VirtualGateway
  VirtualServiceName:
    Description: Name of the colorteller virtual service
    Value: !GetAtt VirtualService.VirtualServiceName
  VirtualServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorteller virtual service
    Value: !Ref VirtualService
  VirtualRouterArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorteller virtual router

  RouteArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorteller route

  BlueVirtualNodeArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorteller-blue-node virtual node

  GreenVirtualNodeArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorteller-green-node virtual node

  VpcId:

  NamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace
    Value: !GetAtt Namespace.Id
  NamespaceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace

  CloudMapServiceId:
    Description: ID of the colorteller Cloud Map service
    Value: !GetAtt ColorTellerDiscoveryService.Id
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the colorteller Cloud Map service
    Value: !GetAtt ColorTellerDiscoveryService.Arn

Description: >-
  Private S3 bucket set for a data processing pipeline: source bucket, target bucket,
  and an optional EMR log bucket. All buckets are private, encrypted with a customer
  managed KMS key (SSE-KMS), versioned, and carry a lifecycle rule (enabled only on the
  EMR log bucket) that transitions objects to GLACIER or STANDARD_IA after 90 days
  depending on region and expires them after 2555 days.

Parameters:
  CreateEMRLogBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Set to "true" to create the optional EMR log bucket, its bucket policy, and its outputs.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateEMRLogBucket: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateEMRLogBucket
    - 'true'
  UseGlacierStorageClass: !Or
    - !Equals
      - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      - us-east-1
    - !Equals
      - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      - us-west-2
    - !Equals
      - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      - eu-west-1

Resources:
  PipelineBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the data processing pipeline S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'

            Resource: '*'
      Tags:

Description: Automatically enforce IMDSv2 (disable IMDSv1) on EC2 instances when they enter the running state, using AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: The HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata requests applied by the automation.
    ConstraintDescription: HttpPutResponseHopLimit must be an integer between 1 and 64 (inclusive).

Resources:
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation to enforce IMDSv2 on EC2 instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigureEC2MetadataOptions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'

  EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EventBridge to start the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartConfigureEC2MetadataAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:*'
              - Sid: PassAutomationExecutionRole

                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions an hourly scheduled Lambda function that purges expired items from the "throttle" DynamoDB table by scanning on the range key timestamp and deleting them in batches.

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(1 hour)
    Description: EventBridge schedule expression (rate or cron) for running the cleanup function. An empty string disables the schedule.
  RetentionPeriodSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    MinValue: 60
    Description: Items whose range-key timestamp (epoch seconds) is older than now minus this value are deleted.

Conditions:
  HasSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScheduleExpression, ""]]

Resources:
  ThrottleTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: throttle
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  CleanupFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  CleanupFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ThrottleTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CleanupFunctionLogGroup.Arn

  CleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CleanupFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Description: Scans the throttle DynamoDB table and deletes items whose range-key timestamp has expired.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt CleanupFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ThrottleTable
          HASH_KEY: id
          RANGE_KEY: timestamp
          RETENTION_PERIOD_SECONDS: !Ref RetentionPeriodSeconds
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import logging
          from decimal import Decimal

          import boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          HASH_KEY = os.environ["HASH_KEY"]
          RANGE_KEY = os.environ["RANGE_KEY"]
          RETENTION_PERIOD_SECONDS = int(os.environ["RETENTION_PERIOD_SECONDS"])

          # Stop starting new scan pages when less than this much time remains.
          SAFETY_MARGIN_MS = 30000

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(TABLE_NAME)


          def handler(event, context):
              cutoff = Decimal(int(time.time()) - RETENTION_PERIOD_SECONDS)
              logger.info("Deleting items from %s with %s < %s", TABLE_NAME, RANGE_KEY, cutoff)

              scan_kwargs = {
                  "FilterExpression": Attr(RANGE_KEY).lt(cutoff),
                  "ProjectionExpression": "#hk, #rk",
                  "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#hk": HASH_KEY, "#rk": RANGE_KEY},
              }

              deleted = 0
              scanned = 0
              completed = False

              with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                  while True:
                      response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                      scanned += response.get("ScannedCount", 0)
                      for item in response.get("Items", []):
                          batch.delete_item(Key={HASH_KEY: item[HASH_KEY], RANGE_KEY: item[RANGE_KEY]})
                          deleted += 1

                      last_key = response.get("LastEvaluatedKey")
                      if not last_key:
                          completed = True

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an Amazon IVS live-streaming channel and its stream key, with
  configurable latency mode, channel type, and playback authorization. NOTE -
  setting Authorized=true requires viewers to present signed playback tokens,
  which in turn requires a playback key pair (AWS::IVS::PlaybackKeyPair) whose
  public key material must be separately imported by the operator; this
  template does not create or fabricate playback key material.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: IVS Channel Configuration
        Parameters:
          - LatencyMode
          - ChannelType
          - Authorized
      - Label:
          default: Tagging
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - CustomTagKey
          - CustomTagValue
    ParameterLabels:
      LatencyMode:
        default: Latency mode
      ChannelType:
        default: Channel type
      Authorized:
        default: Require playback authorization
      Environment:
        default: Environment name
      CustomTagKey:
        default: Custom tag key
      CustomTagValue:
        default: Custom tag value

Parameters:
  LatencyMode:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Channel latency mode. LOW for near real-time interaction with viewers,
      NORMAL for broadcast-style delivery.
    Default: LOW
    AllowedValues:
      - LOW
      - NORMAL

  ChannelType:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Channel type, which determines the allowable resolution and bitrate.
      BASIC and STANDARD pass through the input; ADVANCED_SD and ADVANCED_HD
      transcode with presets.
    Default: STANDARD
    AllowedValues:
      - BASIC
      - STANDARD
      - ADVANCED_SD
      - ADVANCED_HD

  Authorized:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Whether the channel requires signed playback tokens. If true, a playback
      key pair must be separately imported into IVS for token signing.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment used for the Environment tag.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Key of the custom tag applied to all IVS resources.
    Default: Project
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^(?!aws:)[a-zA-Z0-9 _.:/=+\-@]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-128 characters of letters, digits, spaces, or _ . : / = + - @
      and must not begin with "aws:".

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Description: Value of the custom tag applied to all IVS resources.
    Default: LiveStreaming
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 256
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9 _.:/=+\-@]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 0-256 characters of letters, digits, spaces, or _ . : / = + - @.

Conditions:
  IsAuthorized: !Equals
    - !Ref Authorized
    - 'true'

Resources:
  IVSChannel:
    Type: AWS::IVS::Channel
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'IVS-${AWS::StackName}-Channel'
      LatencyMode: !Ref LatencyMode
      Type: !Ref ChannelType
      Authorized: !If
        - IsAuthorized
        - true
        - false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'IVS-${AWS::StackName}-Channel'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  IVSStreamKey:
    Type: AWS::IVS::StreamKey
    Properties:
      ChannelArn: !Ref IVSChannel
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'IVS-${AWS::StackName}-StreamKey'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

Outputs:

    Description: >-
      Channel ingest endpoint. Use rtmps://<IngestEndpoint>:443/app/ in the
      broadcasting software.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSChannel.IngestEndpoint

  PlaybackUrl:
    Description: Channel playback URL for use in the IVS player.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSChannel.PlaybackUrl

  StreamKeyValue:
    Description: >-
      Stream key value used by the broadcaster. Treat as a secret; anyone with
      this value can stream to the channel.
    Value: !GetAtt IVSStreamKey.Value

  ChannelArn:
    Description: ARN of the IVS channel.
    Value: !Ref IVSChannel
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ChannelArn'

  StreamKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the IVS stream key.
    Value: !Ref IVSStreamKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StreamKeyArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Wind Farm IoT SiteWise Demo - Creates a Turbine Asset Model (attributes,
  measurements, transforms and 5-minute tumbling window metrics) and a Wind
  Farm Asset Model that rolls up turbine metrics through a hierarchy.

Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Wind-Turbine-Asset-Model'
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind turbine in the wind farm demo.
      AssetModelProperties:
        # Attributes
        - LogicalId: turbine_make
          Name: Make
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: Amazon
        - LogicalId: turbine_model
          Name: Model
          DataType: INTEGER
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: '500'
        - LogicalId: turbine_location
          Name: Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: Renton
        # Measurements
        - LogicalId: turbine_torque_kilonewton_meter
          Name: Torque (KiloNewton Meter)
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kNm
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: turbine_wind_direction
          Name: Wind Direction
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Degrees
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: turbine_rotations_per_minute
          Name: RotationsPerMinute
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: RPM
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        - LogicalId: turbine_wind_speed
          Name: Wind Speed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Measurement
        # Transforms
        - LogicalId: turbine_rotations_per_second
          Name: RotationsPerSecond
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: RPS
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: rpm / 60
              Variables:
                - Name: rpm
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_rotations_per_minute
        - LogicalId: turbine_torque_newton_meter
          Name: Torque (Newton Meter)
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Nm
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: knm * 1000
              Variables:
                - Name: knm
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_torque_kilonewton_meter
        - LogicalId: turbine_overdrive_state
          Name: Overdrive State
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Type:
            TypeName: Transform
            Transform:
              Expression: gt(torque, 3)
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_torque_kilonewton_meter
        # Metrics (5-minute tumbling window)
        - LogicalId: turbine_avg_wind_speed
          Name: Average Wind Speed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(windspeed)
              Variables:
                - Name: windspeed
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_wind_speed
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: turbine_overdrive_state_time
          Name: Overdrive State Time
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Seconds
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: statetime(overdrive_state)
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_state
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_overdrive_state
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: turbine_avg_power
          Name: Average Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Watts
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(torque) * avg(rps) * 2 * 3.14
              Variables:
                - Name: torque
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_torque_newton_meter
                - Name: rps
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_rotations_per_second
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: WindFarmDemo

  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Wind-Farm-Asset-Model'
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind farm that aggregates wind turbines.
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - LogicalId: turbine_hierarchy
          Name: Wind Turbines
          ChildAssetModelId: !GetAtt TurbineAssetModel.AssetModelId
      AssetModelProperties:
        # Attributes
        - LogicalId: windfarm_code
          Name: Code
          DataType: INTEGER
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: '300'
        - LogicalId: windfarm_location
          Name: Location
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: Renton
        - LogicalId: windfarm_reliability_manager
          Name: Reliability Manager
          DataType: STRING
          Type:
            TypeName: Attribute
            Attribute:
              DefaultValue: Mary Major
        # Metrics (5-minute tumbling window, rolled up from turbines)
        - LogicalId: windfarm_total_average_power
          Name: Total Average Power
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Watts
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(turbine_avg_power)
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_avg_power
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_avg_power
                    HierarchyLogicalId: turbine_hierarchy
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: windfarm_total_overdrive_state_time
          Name: Total Overdrive State Time
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Seconds
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: sum(overdrive_time)
              Variables:
                - Name: overdrive_time
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_overdrive_state_time
                    HierarchyLogicalId: turbine_hierarchy
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
        - LogicalId: windfarm_average_wind_speed
          Name: Average Wind Speed
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Type:
            TypeName: Metric
            Metric:
              Expression: avg(turbine_wind_speed)
              Variables:
                - Name: turbine_wind_speed
                  Value:
                    PropertyLogicalId: turbine_avg_wind_speed
                    HierarchyLogicalId: turbine_hierarchy
              Window:
                Tumbling:
                  Interval: 5m
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: WindFarmDemo

Outputs:
  TurbineAssetModelId:
    Description: ID of the Turbine Asset Model.
    Value: !GetAtt TurbineAssetModel.AssetModelId
  WindFarmAssetModelId:
    Description: ID of the Wind Farm Asset Model.
    Value: !GetAtt WindFarmAssetModel.AssetModelId
  TurbineHierarchyId:
    Description: >-
      Logical identifier of the Wind Farm to Turbine hierarchy. CloudFormation
      does not document a Fn::GetAtt for the service-generated hierarchy UUID;
      resolve the UUID with DescribeAssetModel on the Wind Farm Asset Model if
      required.
    Value: turbine_hierarchy

  LambdaAccessIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoUnauthenticatedIdentities
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref LambdaAccessIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceExecution
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cognito-unauth-test

  StepFunctionsAccessUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCognitoUnauthenticatedIdentities
            Effect: Allow

      Tags:

        - Key: Purpose
          Value: cognito-unauth-test

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a prerequisite IAM role and custom AWS Systems Manager Automation
  documents used for PCI remediations with AWS Config Conformance Packs.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation documents below.
  #
  # PERMISSION GAP (1): The UpdateASGHealthCheckDocument calls
  #   autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup. The specification for this role allows
  #   only the listed EC2 actions, so that permission is intentionally NOT
  #   granted here. That document will fail with AccessDenied until
  #   autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup is added to this role, or until a
  #   different AutomationAssumeRole is supplied at execution time.
  #
  # PERMISSION GAP (2): When AWS Config remediation, EventBridge rules, or users
  #   start these automations with this role as AutomationAssumeRole, the
  #   caller's principal needs iam:PassRole on this role's ARN. That permission
  #   belongs to the caller, not to this role, so it is intentionally not
  #   granted here.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PCIAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by SSM Automation for PCI conformance pack remediations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIAutomationEC2Remediation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModifySecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'
              - Sid: ReleaseElasticIPs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:elastic-ip/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI

  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Restricts all traffic on a VPC default security group by revoking every ingress and egress rule.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC default security group to restrict.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[a-z0-9]+$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt PCIAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllDefaultSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    group = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    if group.get('GroupName') != 'default':
                        raise ValueError('Security group %s is not a VPC default security group.' % group_id)
                    ingress = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=ingress)
                    if egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=egress)
                    return {
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'IngressRulesRevoked': len(ingress),
                        'EgressRulesRevoked': len(egress)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Mirrors the existing CodeCommit repositories card-service, rule-service and
  ecs-pipeline from the deployment region to a replica region (ReplicaRegion)
  using a CodeBuild project triggered by EventBridge on pushes to the mainline
  branch. The source repositories are not created by this stack. Same-named
  repositories must already exist in ReplicaRegion before a push can succeed;
  missing repositories cause build-time failures, not deployment failures.
  NOTE - if this stack is deployed in us-east-1 and ReplicaRegion keeps its
  default of us-east-1, the build pushes each repository onto itself.

Parameters:
  ReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code such as us-east-1 or us-gov-west-1.
    Description: >-
      Target AWS region for the replica repositories. Repositories named
      card-service, rule-service and ecs-pipeline must already exist there.
      If the stack is deployed in this same region, the build pushes each
      repository onto itself.

Resources:
  RepoMirrorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/codebuild/${AWS::StackName}-repo-mirror'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: codecommit-repo-mirror

  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role for the CodeCommit repository mirror CodeBuild project.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RepoMirrorLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${RepoMirrorLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
        - PolicyName: SourceRepositoryPull
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PullSourceRepositories
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
        - PolicyName: ReplicaRepositoryPush
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PushReplicaRepositories
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: codecommit-repo-mirror

  RepoMirrorProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-repo-mirror'
      Description: Mirrors card-service, rule-service and ecs-pipeline CodeCommit repositories to the replica region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
      EncryptionKey: !Sub 'arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3'
      TimeoutInMinutes: 30
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 60
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/standard:7.0
        ImagePullCredentialsType: CODEBUILD
        PrivilegedMode: false
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: SOURCE_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          - Name: REPLICA_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ReplicaRegion
          - Name: REPOSITORIES
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Ref RepoMirrorLogGroup
        S3Logs:
          Status: DISABLED
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          env:
            shell: bash
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.12
              commands:
                - pip3 install --quiet --upgrade git-remote-codecommit
                - git --version
            pre_build:
              commands:
                - echo "Mirroring repositories [${REPOSITORIES}] from ${SOURCE_REGION} to ${REPLICA_REGION}"
                - if [ "${SOURCE_REGION}" = "${REPLICA_REGION}" ]; then echo "WARNING - source and replica regions are identical; pushing repositories onto themselves."; fi
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  set -euo pipefail
                  WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
                  for repo in ${REPOSITORIES}; do
                    echo "=== Mirroring ${repo} ==="
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit::${SOURCE_REGION}://${repo}" "${WORKDIR}/${repo}.git"
                    git -C "${WORKDIR}/${repo}.git" push --mirror "codecommit::${REPLICA_REGION}://${repo}"
                    echo "=== Finished ${repo} ==="
                  done
            post_build:
              commands:
                - echo "Repository mirroring completed with status ${CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: codecommit-repo-mirror

  EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start the CodeCommit repository mirror CodeBuild project.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartRepoMirrorBuild
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartBuild
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt RepoMirrorProject.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: codecommit-repo-mirror

  MainlinePushRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Triggers repository mirroring when the mainline branch is updated in card-service, rule-service or ecs-pipeline.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
          - !Sub 'arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Id: RepoMirrorCodeBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt RepoMirrorProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole.Arn
          RetryPolicy:
            MaximumRetryAttempts: 3
            MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 3600

Outputs:
  RepoMirrorProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild project that mirrors the repositories.
    Value: !Ref RepoMirrorProject
  RepoMirrorProjectArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild project that mirrors the repositories.
    Value: !GetAtt RepoMirrorProject.Arn
  CodeBuildServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild service role.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
  EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the role EventBridge uses to start the CodeBuild project.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeCodeBuildRole.Arn
  MainlinePushRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers mirroring on mainline pushes.
    Value: !GetAtt MainlinePushRule.Arn
  RepoMirrorLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group containing the mirror build logs.
    Value: !Ref RepoMirrorLogGroup
  ReplicaRegionTarget:
    Description: Region the repositories are mirrored to.
    Value: !Ref ReplicaRegion

    Default: earhustlesq.com
    AllowedPattern: ^(?!-)[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a lowercase fully qualified domain name without a trailing dot.
    Description: Apex domain name for the hosted zone (no trailing dot).
  OldSubdomainLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: old
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a single lowercase DNS label.
    Description: Label of the legacy subdomain that receives G Suite MX records.
  CreateFeedsCertificate:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Create the ACM certificate for the feeds subdomain. Set to true only after the registrar has been delegated to this zone's name servers.

  GoogleSiteVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-WITH-GOOGLE-SITE-VERIFICATION-TOKEN
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Google site verification token (value after "google-site-verification=").
  ZoomVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-WITH-ZOOM-VERIFICATION-TOKEN
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Zoom domain verification token (value after "ZOOM_verify_").
  AtprotoDid:
    Type: String
    Default: did:plc:replacewithatprotodid
    AllowedPattern: ^did:[a-z]+:[A-Za-z0-9._:%-]+$
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: ATProto (Bluesky) DID for the _atproto TXT record.
  GoogleDkimKeyPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACEWITHGOOGLEDKIMKEYPART1
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$
    MaxLength: 230
    Description: First segment (max 230 chars) of the Google Workspace DKIM public key (p= value).
  GoogleDkimKeyPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACEWITHGOOGLEDKIMKEYPART2
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Remaining segment (max 255 chars) of the Google Workspace DKIM public key.
  SquarespaceVerificationLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: squarespace-verification-placeholder
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Squarespace domain verification CNAME label (points to verify.squarespace.com).
  SquarespaceWwwTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ext-sq.squarespace.com
    AllowedPattern: ^(?!-)[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$
    Description: CNAME target for the www record.
  PodcastFeedTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.prx.org
    AllowedPattern: ^(?!-)[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$
    Description: CNAME target hostname for the podcast feeds subdomain (PRX feed host).
  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-WITH-ZENDESK-VERIFICATION-TOKEN
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: ZenDesk domain verification token for the zendeskverification TXT record.
  CampaignMonitorDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: cm
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM selector (record created at <selector>._domainkey).
  CampaignMonitorDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACEWITHCAMPAIGNMONITORDKIMKEY
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$
    MaxLength: 240
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (p= value).
  CampaignMonitorSpfSubdomainLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Subdomain label used for Campaign Monitor SPF alignment (custom return path).
  CampaignMonitorMxTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: mx.cmail20.com
    AllowedPattern: ^(?!-)[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$
    Description: Campaign Monitor MX host for the SPF alignment subdomain.
  SupercastDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: supercastpm
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Supercast DKIM selector (record created at <selector>._domainkey).
  SupercastDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACEWITHSUPERCASTDKIMKEY
    AllowedPattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$
    MaxLength: 240
    Description: Supercast DKIM public key (p= value).
  SupercastReturnPathLabel:
    Type: String
    Default: pm-bounces
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Subdomain label for the Supercast return-path CNAME.
  SupercastReturnPathTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: pm.mtasv.net
    AllowedPattern: ^(?!-)[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$
    Description: CNAME target for the Supercast return-path record.

Conditions:
  CreateCert: !Equals [!Ref CreateFeedsCertificate, 'true']

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${DomainName}."
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub Ear Hustle production DNS zone for ${DomainName}
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: prx:meta:tagging-version
          Value: '2021-04-07'
        - Key: prx:cloudformation:stack-name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: prx:cloudformation:stack-id
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackId
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

  ApexTxtRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: Apex TXT, DMARC, and ATProto records
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:_spf.createsend.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all"'
            - !Sub '"google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerification}"'
            - !Sub '"ZOOM_verify_${ZoomVerification}"'
        - Name: !Sub "_dmarc.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@${DomainName}"'
        - Name: !Sub "_atproto.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"did=${AtprotoDid}"'

  GoogleRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: Google Workspace (G Suite) MX and DKIM records
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "${DomainName}."
          Type: MX
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - 1 aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.
        - Name: !Sub "${OldSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}."
          Type: MX
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - 1 aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.
            - 10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.
        - Name: !Sub "google._domainkey.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${GoogleDkimKeyPart1}" "${GoogleDkimKeyPart2}"'

  SquarespaceRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: Squarespace website, verification, and podcast feed records
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "${DomainName}."
          Type: A
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - 198.185.159.144
            - 198.185.159.145
            - 198.49.23.144
            - 198.49.23.145
        - Name: !Sub "www.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub "${SquarespaceWwwTarget}."
        - Name: !Sub "${SquarespaceVerificationLabel}.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - verify.squarespace.com.
        - Name: !Sub "feeds.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub "${PodcastFeedTarget}."

  ZendeskRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: ZenDesk verification, domain validation, and DKIM records
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "zendeskverification.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'
        - Name: !Sub "zendesk1.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - mail1.zendesk.com.
        - Name: !Sub "zendesk2.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - mail2.zendesk.com.
        - Name: !Sub "zendesk3.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - mail3.zendesk.com.
        - Name: !Sub "zendesk4.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - mail4.zendesk.com.
        - Name: !Sub "zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - zendesk1._domainkey.zendesk.com.
        - Name: !Sub "zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - zendesk2._domainkey.zendesk.com.

  CampaignMonitorRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: Campaign Monitor DKIM, SPF alignment, and MX records
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "${CampaignMonitorDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"k=rsa; p=${CampaignMonitorDkimKey}"'
        - Name: !Sub "${CampaignMonitorSpfSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.createsend.com ~all"'
        - Name: !Sub "${CampaignMonitorSpfSubdomainLabel}.${DomainName}."
          Type: MX
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub "10 ${CampaignMonitorMxTarget}."

  SupercastRecords:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: Supercast DKIM and return-path records
      RecordSets:
        - Name: !Sub "${SupercastDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}."
          Type: TXT
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"k=rsa; p=${SupercastDkimKey}"'
        - Name: !Sub "${SupercastReturnPathLabel}.${DomainName}."
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub "${SupercastReturnPathTarget}."

  FeedsCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Condition: CreateCert
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub "feeds.${DomainName}"
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Sub "feeds.${DomainName}"
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Tags:
        - Key: prx:meta:tagging-version
          Value: '2021-04-07'
        - Key: prx:cloudformation:stack-name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: prx:cloudformation:stack-id
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackId
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle
