final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Aurora Global Database failover automation (SSM Automation, ARC routing controls, Lambda trigger)

Parameters:
  SecondaryRegionDefault:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    Description: Default value for the SecondaryRegion input of the failover automation document.

Resources:
  FailoverKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for Aurora global failover automation resources
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsForLambdaLogGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/TriggerFailover
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover

  GlobalClusterIdentifierParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /aurora-failover/global-cluster-identifier
      Type: String
      Value: UNSET
      Description: Aurora global cluster identifier used by the failover automation. Populate after creating the global cluster.
      Tags:
        Project: AuroraGlobalFailover

  ArcClusterEndpointsParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /aurora-failover/arc-cluster-endpoints
      Type: String
      Value: UNSET
      Description: 'JSON list of ARC cluster endpoints, e.g. [{"Endpoint": "https://host/v1", "Region": "us-west-2"}]. Populate after creating the ARC cluster.'
      Tags:
        Project: AuroraGlobalFailover

  PrimaryRoutingControlArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /aurora-failover/primary-routing-control-arn
      Type: String
      Value: UNSET
      Description: ARN of the ARC routing control for the primary region cell.
      Tags:
        Project: AuroraGlobalFailover

  SecondaryRoutingControlArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /aurora-failover/secondary-routing-control-arn
      Type: String
      Value: UNSET
      Description: ARN of the ARC routing control for the secondary region cell.
      Tags:
        Project: AuroraGlobalFailover

  WriterEndpointSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: aurora-global-db/writer-endpoint
      Description: Current Aurora global database writer endpoint and region, maintained by the failover automation.
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FailoverKmsKey
      SecretString: '{"writer_endpoint": "UNSET", "region": "UNSET"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Assumed by SSM Automation to execute the Aurora global database failover runbook
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutomationLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/ssm/*
        - PolicyName: AuroraGlobalFailoverAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RdsDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusterEndpoints
                  - rds:DescribeDBInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RdsGlobalFailover
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:SwitchoverGlobalCluster
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:rds::${AWS::AccountId}:global-cluster:*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:rds:*:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster:*
              - Sid: ArcRoutingControlData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:ListRoutingControls
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:route53-recovery-control::${AWS::AccountId}:controlpanel/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:route53-recovery-control::${AWS::AccountId}:controlpanel/*/routingcontrol/*
              - Sid: ArcControlConfigRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeCluster
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeControlPanel
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriterEndpointSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref WriterEndpointSecret
              - Sid: SecretKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FailoverKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: FailoverParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/aurora-failover/*
              - Sid: AutomationExecutionRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover

  TriggerFailoverLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the TriggerFailover Lambda function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TriggerFailoverAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartFailoverAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:*
              - Sid: MonitorFailoverAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*
              - Sid: ListAutomationExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassAutomationRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: FunctionLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/TriggerFailover:*
              - Sid: EnvironmentDecryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt FailoverKmsKey.Arn
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Fails over an Aurora global database to the standby region, flips ARC routing controls, and publishes the new writer endpoint to Secrets Manager.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: IAM role assumed by SSM Automation.
            default: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Region of the primary cell.
            default: us-east-1
            allowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Region of the secondary cell.
            default: !Ref SecondaryRegionDefault
            allowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
          AllowDataLoss:
            type: Boolean
            description: When true, performs an unplanned failover that may lose data. When false, performs a managed planned failover.
            default: false
          GlobalClusterIdentifierParameter:
            type: String
            description: SSM parameter holding the Aurora global cluster identifier.
            default: !Ref GlobalClusterIdentifierParameter
          ArcClusterEndpointsParameter:
            type: String
            description: SSM parameter holding the JSON list of ARC cluster endpoints.
            default: !Ref ArcClusterEndpointsParameter
          PrimaryRoutingControlArnParameter:
            type: String
            description: SSM parameter holding the primary region routing control ARN.
            default: !Ref PrimaryRoutingControlArnParameter
          SecondaryRoutingControlArnParameter:
            type: String
            description: SSM parameter holding the secondary region routing control ARN.
            default: !Ref SecondaryRoutingControlArnParameter
          WriterEndpointSecretId:
            type: String
            description: Secrets Manager secret updated with the new writer endpoint.
            default: !Ref WriterEndpointSecret
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifierParameter: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifierParameter }}'
                ArcClusterEndpointsParameter: '{{ ArcClusterEndpointsParameter }}'
                PrimaryRoutingControlArnParameter: '{{ PrimaryRoutingControlArnParameter }}'
                SecondaryRoutingControlArnParameter: '{{ SecondaryRoutingControlArnParameter }}'
              Script: |
                import json
                import boto3


                def _read_param(ssm, name):
                    value = ssm.get_parameter(Name=name)["Parameter"]["Value"].strip()
                    if not value or value == "UNSET":
                        raise ValueError("SSM parameter " + name + " has not been populated")
                    return value


                def _parse_endpoints(raw):
                    endpoints = json.loads(raw)
                    if not isinstance(endpoints, list) or not endpoints:
                        raise ValueError("ARC cluster endpoints must be a non-empty JSON list")
                    for ep in endpoints:
                        if "Endpoint" not in ep or "Region" not in ep:
                            raise ValueError("Each ARC endpoint requires Endpoint and Region keys")
                    return endpoints


                def _get_state(endpoints, control_arn):
                    last_error = None
                    for ep in endpoints:
                        try:
                            client = boto3.client(
                                "route53-recovery-cluster",
                                region_name=ep["Region"],
                                endpoint_url=ep["Endpoint"],
                            )
                            return client.get_routing_control_state(
                                RoutingControlArn=control_arn
                            )["RoutingControlState"]
                        except Exception as exc:
                            last_error = exc
                    raise RuntimeError("All ARC cluster endpoints failed: " + str(last_error))


                def _writer_region(global_cluster_id):
                    rds = boto3.client("rds")
                    clusters = rds.describe_global_clusters(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id
                    )["GlobalClusters"]
                    for member in clusters[0].get("GlobalClusterMembers", []):
                        if member.get("IsWriter"):
                            return member["DBClusterArn"].split(":")[3]
                    return None


                def handler(events, context):
                    primary = events["PrimaryRegion"]
                    secondary = events["SecondaryRegion"]
                    if primary == secondary:
                        raise ValueError("PrimaryRegion and SecondaryRegion must differ")

                    ssm = boto3.client("ssm")
                    global_cluster_id = _read_param(ssm, events["GlobalClusterIdentifierParameter"])
                    endpoints_raw = _read_param(ssm, events["ArcClusterEndpointsParameter"])
                    primary_arn = _read_param(ssm, events["PrimaryRoutingControlArnParameter"])
                    secondary_arn = _read_param(ssm, events["SecondaryRoutingControlArnParameter"])
                    endpoints = _parse_endpoints(endpoints_raw)

                    primary_state = _get_state(endpoints, primary_arn)
                    secondary_state = _get_state(endpoints, secondary_arn)
                    print("Routing control states: primary=" + primary_state + " secondary=" + secondary_state)

                    if primary_state == "On" and secondary_state != "On":
                        active = primary
                    elif secondary_state == "On" and primary_state != "On":
                        active = secondary
                    else:
                        active = _writer_region(global_cluster_id)
                        print("Routing controls ambiguous; global cluster writer region is " + str(active))
                        if active not in (primary, secondary):
                            raise RuntimeError("Unable to determine the active region")

                    standby = secondary if active == primary else primary
                    return {
                        "ActiveRegion": active,
                        "StandbyRegion": standby,
                        "GlobalClusterIdentifier": global_cluster_id,
                        "ActiveRoutingControlArn": primary_arn if active == primary else secondary_arn,
                        "StandbyRoutingControlArn": secondary_arn if active == primary else primary_arn,
                        "ArcClusterEndpoints": json.dumps(endpoints),
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: StandbyRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.StandbyRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: GlobalClusterIdentifier
                Selector: $.Payload.GlobalClusterIdentifier
                Type: String
              - Name: ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
              - Name: StandbyRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.Payload.StandbyRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
              - Name: ArcClusterEndpoints
                Selector: $.Payload.ArcClusterEndpoints
                Type: String
          - name: FailoverGlobalCluster
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                StandbyRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.StandbyRegion }}'
                AllowDataLoss: '{{ AllowDataLoss }}'
              Script: |
                import time
                import boto3


                def _describe(rds, global_cluster_id):
                    return rds.describe_global_clusters(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id
                    )["GlobalClusters"][0]


                def _member_in_region(global_cluster, region):
                    for member in global_cluster.get("GlobalClusterMembers", []):
                        if member["DBClusterArn"].split(":")[3] == region:
                            return member
                    return None


                def handler(events, context):
                    global_cluster_id = events["GlobalClusterIdentifier"]
                    target_region = events["StandbyRegion"]
                    allow_data_loss = str(events.get("AllowDataLoss", False)).lower() == "true"

                    rds = boto3.client("rds", region_name=target_region)
                    global_cluster = _describe(rds, global_cluster_id)
                    target = _member_in_region(global_cluster, target_region)
                    if target is None:
                        raise RuntimeError("No global cluster member found in " + target_region)
                    target_arn = target["DBClusterArn"]

                    if target.get("IsWriter"):
                        print("Cluster in " + target_region + " is already the writer")
                        return {"NewWriterClusterArn": target_arn, "NewActiveRegion": target_region}

                    request = {
                        "GlobalClusterIdentifier": global_cluster_id,
                        "TargetDbClusterIdentifier": target_arn,
                    }
                    if allow_data_loss:
                        request["AllowDataLoss"] = True
                    rds.failover_global_cluster(**request)
                    print("Failover initiated to " + target_arn + " (AllowDataLoss=" + str(allow_data_loss) + ")")

                    deadline = time.time() + 540
                    while time.time() < deadline:
                        time.sleep(15)
                        global_cluster = _describe(rds, global_cluster_id)
                        member = _member_in_region(global_cluster, target_region)
                        failover_state = global_cluster.get("FailoverState") or {}
                        if (
                            member is not None
                            and member.get("IsWriter")
                            and not failover_state.get("Status")
                            and global_cluster.get("Status") == "available"
                        ):
                            return {"NewWriterClusterArn": target_arn, "NewActiveRegion": target_region}
                        print("Waiting for failover: status=" + str(global_cluster.get("Status")))
                    raise TimeoutError("Global cluster failover did not complete in time")
            outputs:
              - Name: NewWriterClusterArn
                Selector: $.Payload.NewWriterClusterArn
                Type: String
              - Name: NewActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.NewActiveRegion
                Type: String
          - name: UpdateRoutingAndSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                NewActiveRegion: '{{ FailoverGlobalCluster.NewActiveRegion }}'
                NewWriterClusterArn: '{{ FailoverGlobalCluster.NewWriterClusterArn }}'
                NewActiveRoutingControlArn: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.StandbyRoutingControlArn }}'
                OldActiveRoutingControlArn: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRoutingControlArn }}'
                ArcClusterEndpoints: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ArcClusterEndpoints }}'
                WriterEndpointSecretId: '{{ WriterEndpointSecretId }}'
              Script: |
                import json
                import boto3


                def _update_routing(endpoints, entries):
                    last_error = None
                    for ep in endpoints:
                        try:
                            client = boto3.client(
                                "route53-recovery-cluster",
                                region_name=ep["Region"],
                                endpoint_url=ep["Endpoint"],
                            )
                            client.update_routing_control_states(UpdateRoutingControlStateEntries=entries)
                            return ep["Region"]
                        except Exception as exc:
                            last_error = exc
                    raise RuntimeError("All ARC cluster endpoints failed: " + str(last_error))


                def handler(events, context):
                    new_region = events["NewActiveRegion"]
                    endpoints = json.loads(events["ArcClusterEndpoints"])

                    entries = [
                        {"RoutingControlArn": events["NewActiveRoutingControlArn"], "RoutingControlState": "On"},
                        {"RoutingControlArn": events["OldActiveRoutingControlArn"], "RoutingControlState": "Off"},
                    ]
                    used_region = _update_routing(endpoints, entries)
                    print("Routing controls updated via ARC endpoint in " + used_region)

                    rds = boto3.client("rds", region_name=new_region)
                    cluster = rds.describe_db_clusters(
                        DBClusterIdentifier=events["NewWriterClusterArn"]
                    )["DBClusters"][0]
                    writer_endpoint = cluster["Endpoint"]

                    secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")
                    secrets.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=events["WriterEndpointSecretId"],
                        SecretString=json.dumps({"writer_endpoint": writer_endpoint, "region": new_region}),
                    )
                    print("Secret updated with writer endpoint " + writer_endpoint)
                    return {"WriterEndpoint": writer_endpoint, "ActiveRegion": new_region}
            outputs:
              - Name: WriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.Payload.WriterEndpoint
                Type: String
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
        outputs:
          - UpdateRoutingAndSecret.WriterEndpoint
          - UpdateRoutingAndSecret.ActiveRegion

  TriggerFailoverLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/TriggerFailover
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FailoverKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover

  TriggerFailoverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: TriggerFailoverLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Description: Starts the Aurora Global Database failover SSM Automation
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt TriggerFailoverLambdaRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt FailoverKmsKey.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
          AUTOMATION_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import re

          import boto3

          REGION_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$")
          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")


          def handler(event, context):
              event = event if isinstance(event, dict) else {}
              parameters = {"AutomationAssumeRole": [os.environ["AUTOMATION_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN"]]}

              for key in ("PrimaryRegion", "SecondaryRegion"):
                  value = event.get(key)
                  if value:
                      if not REGION_PATTERN.match(str(value)):
                          return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "Invalid " + key})}
                      parameters[key] = [str(value)]

              if "AllowDataLoss" in event:
                  allow = str(event["AllowDataLoss"]).lower() == "true"
                  parameters["AllowDataLoss"] = ["true" if allow else "false"]

              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=os.environ["DOCUMENT_NAME"],
                  Parameters=parameters,
              )
              execution_id = response["AutomationExecutionId"]
              execution = ssm.get_automation_execution(AutomationExecutionId=execution_id)
              status = execution["AutomationExecution"]["AutomationExecutionStatus"]
              print(json.dumps({"AutomationExecutionId": execution_id, "Status": status}))

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"AutomationExecutionId": execution_id, "Status": status}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: AuroraGlobalFailover

  To deploy the real dashboard application, push it to this repository under a new
  unique tag and update the stack (or bump BuildVersion) so App Runner deploys that
  image. ALLOW_IP_RANGE=0.0.0.0/0 allows access from any IP address; restrict it
  for production use.

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: qs-admin

  TemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant-dashboard-template
    Description: QuickSight template identifier.
  DataSetId:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant-dataset

  DataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant-datasource

                  - ecr:PutImage

                Resource: !GetAtt EcrRepository.Arn

  ImageBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project

      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn

      Artifacts:

      Environment:

          version: 0.2

              commands:
                - echo Logging in to Amazon ECR

                          if self.path == '/status':

                          self.send_response(200)
                          self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
                          self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))

                          self.wfile.write(body)

  ImageBuildFunction:

    Properties:

      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 256

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import uuid
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse


          def handler(event, context):
              data = {}
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'image-build')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  version = str(props.get('BuildVersion', '1'))
                  image_tag = 'v' + version + '-' + time.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S', time.gmtime()) + '-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
                  image_uri = props['RepositoryUri'] + ':' + image_tag
                  data['ImageUri'] = image_uri
                  data['ImageTag'] = image_tag
                  physical_id = image_uri
                  codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                  build_id = codebuild.start_build(
                      projectName=props['ProjectName'],
                      environmentVariablesOverride=[
                          {'name': 'IMAGE_TAG', 'value': image_tag, 'type': 'PLAINTEXT'}
                      ]
                  )['build']['id']
                  print('Started build ' + build_id + ' for ' + image_uri)
                  while True:
                      build = codebuild.batch_get_builds(ids=[build_id])['builds'][0]
                      status = build['buildStatus']
                      if status == 'SUCCEEDED':
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
                          return
                      if status != 'IN_PROGRESS':
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, data, physical_id,
                                           reason='Build ' + build_id + ' finished with status ' + status)
                          return
                      if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 30000:
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, data, physical_id,
                                           reason='Timed out waiting for build ' + build_id)
                          return
                      time.sleep(15)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print('Error: ' + str(exc))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, data, physical_id,
                                   reason=str(exc)[:250])

  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableVpcFlowLogs-Reject'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC flow logging capturing REJECT traffic to a KMS-encrypted
          CloudWatch Logs log group for the supplied VPC (CIS AWS Foundations
          Benchmark control 3.9 - Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the VPC on which to enable flow logging.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[a-f0-9]{8,17}$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role used to run this automation.
            default: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that VPC Flow Logs uses to publish to CloudWatch Logs.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving the flow log data.
            default: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableRejectFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            onFailure: Abort
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                FlowLogsRoleArn: '{{ FlowLogsRoleArn }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3


                def handler(events, context):
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    role_arn = events['FlowLogsRoleArn']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    ec2.describe_vpcs(VpcIds=[vpc_id])

                    existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[{'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]
                    ).get('FlowLogs', [])
                    matching = [
                        fl['FlowLogId']
                        for fl in existing
                        if fl.get('TrafficType') in ('REJECT', 'ALL')
                        and fl.get('LogGroupName') == log_group_name
                        and fl.get('FlowLogStatus') == 'ACTIVE'
                    ]
                    if matching:
                        return {'FlowLogIds': matching, 'Created': False}

                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn,
                        MaxAggregationInterval=60,
                        TagSpecifications=[
                            {
                                'ResourceType': 'vpc-flow-log',
                                'Tags': [
                                    {'Key': 'Compliance', 'Value': 'CIS-AWS-Foundations'},
                                    {'Key': 'Control', 'Value': 'VPC-FlowLogs'},
                                ],
                            }
                        ],
                    )
                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful', [])
                    if unsuccessful:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to create flow log: ' + str(unsuccessful))
                    flow_log_ids = response.get('FlowLogIds', [])
                    if not flow_log_ids:
                        raise RuntimeError('CreateFlowLogs returned no flow log IDs for ' + vpc_id)
                    return {'FlowLogIds': flow_log_ids, 'Created': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: CreatedFlowLogIds
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogIds
                Type: StringList
          - name: VerifyFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeFlowLogs
              Filter:
                - Name: resource-id
                  Values:
                    - '{{ VpcId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogIds
                Selector: $.FlowLogs..FlowLogId
                Type: StringList
        outputs:
          - VerifyFlowLogs.FlowLogIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ChangeManagedVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableVpcFlowLogs-ChangeRequest'
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Submits an AWS Systems Manager Change Manager change request that runs
          the VPC flow logs (REJECT traffic) remediation runbook for the supplied
          VPC after change approval (CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control 3.9 -
          Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the VPC on which to enable flow logging.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[a-f0-9]{8,17}$'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role used to run this automation and the remediation runbook.
            default: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
          ChangeTemplateName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the approved Change Manager change template used for the change request.
            default: AWS-HelloWorldChangeTemplate
          ChangeRequestName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the change request submitted to Change Manager.
            default: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs-Remediation
        mainSteps:
          - name: SubmitChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: StartChangeRequestExecution
              DocumentName: '{{ ChangeTemplateName }}'
              ChangeRequestName: '{{ ChangeRequestName }}'
              ChangeDetails: 'Enable VPC flow logs capturing REJECT traffic on {{ VpcId }} per CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control 3.9 (VPC flow logging enabled in all VPCs).'
              Runbooks:
                - DocumentName: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
                  DocumentVersion: $DEFAULT
                  Parameters:
                    VpcId:
                      - '{{ VpcId }}'
                    AutomationAssumeRole:
                      - '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
                    FlowLogsRoleArn:
                      - !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
                    LogGroupName:
                      - !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
            outputs:
              - Name: ChangeRequestExecutionId
                Selector: $.AutomationExecutionId
                Type: String
          - name: WaitForChangeRequestCompletion
            action: aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty
            onFailure: Abort
            timeoutSeconds: 86400
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetAutomationExecution
              AutomationExecutionId: '{{ SubmitChangeRequest.ChangeRequestExecutionId }}'
              PropertySelector: $.AutomationExecution.AutomationExecutionStatus
              DesiredValues:
                - Success
                - Failed
                - Cancelled
                - TimedOut
                - Rejected
        outputs:
          - SubmitChangeRequest.ChangeRequestExecutionId
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations
        - Key: Control
          Value: VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a reusable Route53 delegation set through a Lambda-backed custom resource and exports its ID, nameserver hostnames, and IPv4/IPv6 addresses.

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: ReusableDelegationSet
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters containing only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
    Description: Name of the Lambda function that manages the reusable delegation set.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain Lambda logs in CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${FunctionName}"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ReusableDelegationSetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReusableDelegationSetManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Route53DelegationSets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53:CreateReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:DeleteReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:GetReusableDelegationSet
                  - route53:ListReusableDelegationSets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${FunctionName}-role"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ReusableDelegationSetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Description: Manages a Route53 reusable delegation set for CloudFormation.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetRole.Arn
      Timeout: 90
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib
          import json
          import logging
          import re
          import socket
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          log = logging.getLogger()
          log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          r53 = boto3.client('route53')
          VALID_ID = re.compile(r'^[A-Z0-9]{1,32}$')
          # Slot order by TLD: awsdns slot 1-4 -> .com, .net, .org, .co.uk
          SUFFIXES = ['.com', '.net', '.org', '.co.uk']
          # CloudFormation rejects exports with empty values, so a non-empty
          # placeholder is used instead of an empty string on lookup failure.
          PLACEHOLDER = 'UNRESOLVED'


          def resolve(host, family):
              if not host or host == PLACEHOLDER:
                  return PLACEHOLDER
              try:
                  infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, family,
                                             socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                  if infos:
                      return infos[0][4][0]
                  log.warning('No address for %s (family %s)', host, family)
              except Exception as e:
                  log.warning('Lookup of %s (family %s) failed: %s',
                              host, family, e)
              return PLACEHOLDER


          def build(ds):
              ds_id = ds['Id'].replace('/delegationset/', '')
              servers = [s.lower().rstrip('.') for s in ds.get('NameServers', [])]
              slots = [''] * 4
              left = list(servers)
              for i, suf in enumerate(SUFFIXES):
                  match = next((s for s in left if s.endswith(suf)), '')
                  if match:
                      slots[i] = match
                      left.remove(match)
              left.sort()
              for i in range(4):
                  if not slots[i]:
                      if left:
                          slots[i] = left.pop(0)
                          log.warning('Slot %d filled by fallback with %s',
                                      i + 1, slots[i])
                      else:
                          slots[i] = PLACEHOLDER
                          log.warning('No nameserver for slot %d in %s',
                                      i + 1, servers)
              data = {'DelegationSetId': ds_id}
              for n in range(1, 5):
                  host = slots[n - 1]
                  data['NameServer%d' % n] = host
                  data['NameServer%dIPv4' % n] = resolve(host, socket.AF_INET)
                  data['NameServer%dIPv6' % n] = resolve(host, socket.AF_INET6)
              return ds_id, data


          def validate(data):
              if not data.get('DelegationSetId'):
                  raise ValueError('DelegationSetId missing from Route53 response')
              for n in range(1, 5):
                  for k in ('NameServer%d', 'NameServer%dIPv4',
                            'NameServer%dIPv6'):
                      key = k % n
                      if not isinstance(data.get(key), str) or not data[key]:
                          log.warning('Attribute %s empty; using placeholder', key)
                          data[key] = PLACEHOLDER


          def handler(event, context):
              log.info('Event: %s', json.dumps(event, default=str))
              status = cfnresponse.FAILED
              data = {}
              reason = None
              pid = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              try:
                  rt = event['RequestType']
                  if rt == 'Create':
                      raw = '%s|%s|%s' % (event['StackId'],
                                          event['LogicalResourceId'],
                                          event['RequestId'])
                      ref = hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()
                      resp = r53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=ref)
                      pid, data = build(resp['DelegationSet'])
                      validate(data)
                  elif rt == 'Update':
                      # Delegation sets are immutable; keep the existing one.
                      resp = r53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=pid)
                      pid, data = build(resp['DelegationSet'])
                      validate(data)
                  elif rt == 'Delete':
                      if pid and VALID_ID.match(pid):
                          try:
                              r53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=pid)
                              log.info('Deleted delegation set %s', pid)
                          except ClientError as e:
                              code = e.response['Error']['Code']
                              if code == 'NoSuchDelegationSet':
                                  log.info('Delegation set %s already gone', pid)
                              elif code == 'DelegationSetInUse':
                                  reason = ('Delegation set %s is still in use by '
                                            'hosted zones; detach or delete them '
                                            'first.' % pid)
                                  log.error(reason)
                                  raise
                              else:
                                  raise
                      else:
                          log.info('Physical ID %s is not a delegation set; '
                                   'nothing to delete', pid)
                  status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              except Exception as e:
                  log.exception('Request failed')
                  reason = reason or str(e)
              finally:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, data, pid,
                                   reason=reason)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # No DeletionPolicy: Retain on purpose. The delegation set holds no data, and

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a WebSocket API Gateway whose $default route asynchronously starts a
  STANDARD Step Functions workflow. The workflow waits 5 seconds and then sends
  a reply to the connected client through the API Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  ApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Only letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens are allowed.
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api"
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-statemachine"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${ApiStageName}/POST/@connections/*"
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # CloudWatch Logs vended log delivery APIs do not support
              # resource-level permissions and require Resource "*".
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: StateMachineTracing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # X-Ray trace APIs do not support resource-level permissions.
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-statemachine"
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ApiEndpoint: !Sub "${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}"
        ApiStage: !Ref ApiStageName
      Definition:
        Comment: Waits five seconds, then replies to the WebSocket client via the API Gateway Management API.
        StartAt: Wait
        States:
          Wait:
            Type: Wait
            Seconds: 5
            Next: SendResponse
          SendResponse:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::apigateway:invoke"
            Parameters:
              ApiEndpoint: "${ApiEndpoint}"
              Method: POST
              Stage: "${ApiStage}"
              Path.$: "States.Format('/@connections/{}', $.ConnectionID)"
              AuthType: IAM_ROLE
              RequestBody:
                message: "Processed by Step Functions after a 5 second wait."
                data.$: "$.data"
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway role used to start Step Functions executions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Integration: WebSocket $default -> Step Functions StartExecution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Asynchronously starts a Step Functions execution for each incoming message.
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      TemplateSelectionExpression: "\\$default"
      RequestTemplates:
        "$default": !Sub |
          {
            "input": "{\"data\": $util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$')).replaceAll("\\'","'"), \"ConnectionID\": \"$context.connectionId\"}",
            "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
          }

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$default"
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DefaultRoute
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${DefaultIntegration}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Deployment and stage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: WebSocket API deployment

  # Stage access logging and execution logging are intentionally omitted:
  # WebSocket API logging requires an account-level API Gateway CloudWatch
  # role (AWS::ApiGateway::Account), which is an account-wide setting outside
  # the scope of this stack.
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref ApiStageName
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: WebSocket API stage
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: ID of the WebSocket API
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: WebSocket URL to connect clients to
    Value: !Sub "wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiStageName}"
  ConnectionsManagementURL:
    Description: API Gateway Management API endpoint for the stage
    Value: !Sub "https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiStageName}/@connections"
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for the state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup
  ApiStage:
    Description: Deployed WebSocket API stage name
    Value: !Ref ApiStageName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cost management stack: monthly budget with KMS-encrypted SNS alerts at 80% and 99% of actual spend'

# Deployment notes:
# - Deploy this stack to us-east-1. AWS Budgets is a global service. Its notifications
#   publish to SNS topics in the region where this stack is deployed.
# - SMS delivery works only if the account is out of the SNS SMS sandbox, or if the
#   destination number is verified in the sandbox. SMS spend limits must also be set.
#   Email subscriptions need the recipient to click the confirmation link.
#   None of these steps can be automated in this template, so it creates no extra
#   resources for them.

Parameters:
  BudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Monthly budget limit in USD

  NotificationProtocol:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Default: sms
    Description: Delivery method for budget alerts

  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61400000000'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}|[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an E.164 phone number (e.g. +61400000000) or a valid email address
    Description: Mobile number in E.164 format with country code +61 (sms) or email address (email)

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting the billing alerts SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: cost-management
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingAlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Billing Alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: cost-management
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BillingAlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BillingAlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 'sns:Publish'
              - 'sns:Subscribe'
              - 'sns:Receive'
            Resource: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  BillingAlertSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
      Protocol: !Ref NotificationProtocol
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint

  MonthlyCostBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    DependsOn: BillingAlertTopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-cost-budget'
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref BudgetLimit
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingAlertTopic
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingAlertTopic

Outputs:
  BillingAlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted SNS topic that receives budget alerts
    Value: !Ref BillingAlertTopic

  BillingTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the billing alerts topic
    Value: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn

  BillingTopicKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key that encrypts the billing alerts topic
    Value: !Ref BillingTopicKeyAlias

  MonthlyCostBudgetName:
    Description: Name of the monthly cost budget
    Value: !Ref MonthlyCostBudget

  NotificationSubscriptionArn:
    Description: ARN of the alert subscription (pending until confirmed for email)
    Value: !Ref BillingAlertSubscription

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained Cognito machine-to-machine (M2M) authentication and authorization infrastructure for the ontology lookup service, with configuration values published to SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It must not contain the reserved words aws, amazon or cognito.
    Description: Application name. It is used in the Cognito domain prefix, the resource server identifier and the SSM parameter path prefix.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref AppName
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the ontology lookup service

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${AppName}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  ClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/client-id'
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref M2MClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless content moderation API. API Gateway REST API (ContentModeration) with a prod stage and a Python 3.14 Lambda that runs Amazon Rekognition DetectModerationLabels on an image fetched from a URL.

Resources:
  ContentModerationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  ContentModerationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/invokeContentModeration
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Description: Fetches an image from a URL and returns Amazon Rekognition moderation labels.
      # Change note: the request specified python3.11, but AWS deprecated that runtime
      # on 2026-06-30 and blocked creating new functions with it on 2026-07-31.
      # python3.14 is used instead. The inline code runs on it unchanged.
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ContentModerationLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 25
      MemorySize: 256
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ContentModerationLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.parse
          import urllib.error
          import boto3

          MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
          ALLOWED_EXT = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          rek = boto3.client('rekognition')


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps(body)}


          def err(code, msg):
              return resp(code, {'error': msg})


          def handler(event, context):
              raw = (event or {}).get('body')
              if not raw:
                  return err(400, 'Request body is required')
              try:
                  data = json.loads(raw)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return err(400, 'Request body must be valid JSON')
              url = data.get('url') if isinstance(data, dict) else None
              if not isinstance(url, str) or not url.strip():
                  return err(400, "Field 'url' must be a non-empty string")
              url = url.strip()
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
              if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ('http', 'https') or not parsed.netloc:
                  return err(400, 'Only http and https URLs are allowed')
              path = urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.path).lower()
              if not path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXT):
                  return err(415, 'Unsupported image format; allowed: jpg, jpeg, png')

              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ContentModeration/1.0'})
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
                      length = r.headers.get('Content-Length')
                      if length and length.isdigit() and int(length) > MAX_BYTES:
                          return err(413, 'Image exceeds 5MB limit')
                      img = r.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  if e.code == 404:
                      return err(404, 'Image not found')
                  return err(502, 'Failed to fetch image: upstream HTTP %d' % e.code)
              except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError) as e:
                  reason = getattr(e, 'reason', e)
                  if isinstance(e, TimeoutError) or isinstance(reason, TimeoutError):
                      return err(504, 'Timed out fetching image')
                  return err(502, 'Failed to fetch image')

              if len(img) > MAX_BYTES:
                  return err(413, 'Image exceeds 5MB limit')
              if not img:
                  return err(404, 'Image not found or empty')
              if not (img.startswith(b'\xff\xd8\xff') or img.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')):
                  return err(415, 'Content is not a valid JPEG or PNG image')

              try:
                  out = rek.detect_moderation_labels(Image={'Bytes': img}, MinConfidence=60)
              except rek.exceptions.InvalidImageFormatException:
                  return err(415, 'Rekognition rejected the image format')
              except rek.exceptions.ImageTooLargeException:
                  return err(413, 'Image too large for Rekognition')
              except (rek.exceptions.ThrottlingException,
                      rek.exceptions.ProvisionedThroughputExceededException):
                  return err(503, 'Moderation service busy, retry later')
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Rekognition error: %s' % e)
                  return err(502, 'Moderation service error')

              labels = [{'Name': l.get('Name'),
                         'ParentName': l.get('ParentName', ''),
                         'Confidence': l.get('Confidence')}
                        for l in out.get('ModerationLabels', [])]
              return resp(200, {'ModerationLabels': labels,
                                'ModerationModelVersion': out.get('ModerationModelVersion')})

  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: Content moderation API backed by Amazon Rekognition
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ModerateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: moderate

  ModeratePostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ModerateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ContentModerationFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/moderate

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ModeratePostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      Description: Deployment for ContentModeration API

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: POST endpoint for content moderation
    Value: !Sub https://${ContentModerationApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ProdStage}/moderate
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the ContentModeration REST API
    Value: !Ref ContentModerationApi
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the moderation Lambda function
    Value: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the moderation Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ContentModerationFunction.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ContentModerationLambdaRole.Arn
