AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Scheduled workflow that closes AWS Organizations member accounts tagged
  organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, then re-tags them ACKNOWLEDGED.
  This stack MUST be deployed in the AWS Organizations management account,
  in us-east-1, where the global Organizations API endpoint lives.

# Design note: the Resource Groups Tagging API (tag:GetResources) is intentionally
# NOT used to discover tagged accounts, because its support for Organizations
# account resources is unverified. Instead, the workflow pages through
# organizations:ListAccounts and filters each account with
# organizations:ListTagsForResource. Both are confirmed Step Functions
# AWS SDK service integrations.

Resources:
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-account-closure'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: org-account-closure

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Organizations account-closure state machine
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: account-closure-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAccountsNoResourceLevelSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeAndReadTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*'
              - Sid: CloseOnlyAccountsRequestedForClosure
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/organizations:account-closure: REQUESTED
              - Sid: TagOnlyClosureAcknowledgement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*'
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    aws:TagKeys:
                      - organizations:account-closure
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:RequestTag/organizations:account-closure: ACKNOWLEDGED
              - Sid: StepFunctionsLogDeliveryNoResourceLevelSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: XRayTracingNoResourceLevelSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: org-account-closure

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: org-account-closure
      Definition:
        Comment: >-
          Close ACTIVE Organizations accounts tagged
          organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED, then tag them ACKNOWLEDGED.
          One ListAccounts page is processed per loop iteration with bounded
          Map concurrency to stay within the EXPRESS 5-minute limit.
        StartAt: ListAccountsFirstPage
        States:
          ListAccountsFirstPage:
            Type: Task
            Comment: First page of ListAccounts (no NextToken in the input).
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                JitterStrategy: FULL
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException
                  - Organizations.AwsOrganizationsNotInUseException
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: OrganizationNotInUse
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage
          ListAccountsNextPage:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Next page of ListAccounts, passing the NextToken from the state input.
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
              NextToken.$: $.NextToken
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
                MaxAttempts: 5
                JitterStrategy: FULL
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException
                  - Organizations.AwsOrganizationsNotInUseException
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: OrganizationNotInUse
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage
          OrganizationNotInUse:
            Type: Succeed
            Comment: No organization exists in this account; nothing to do.
          ProcessAccountsPage:
            Type: Map
            Comment: Inline Map over the accounts in the current page.
            ItemsPath: $.Accounts
            MaxConcurrency: 5
            ItemSelector:
              AccountId.$: $$.Map.Item.Value.Id
            ResultSelector:
              ProcessedCount.$: States.ArrayLength($)
            ResultPath: $.PageResult
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: ListAccountTags
              States:
                ListAccountTags:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultSelector:
                    RequestedTags.$: '$.Tags[?(@.Key==''organizations:account-closure'' && @.Value==''REQUESTED'')]'
                  ResultPath: $.TagCheck
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: CountRequestedTags
                CountRequestedTags:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Filter step that counts matching closure tags.
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                    RequestedCount.$: States.ArrayLength($.TagCheck.RequestedTags)
                  Next: IsClosureRequested
                IsClosureRequested:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.RequestedCount
                      NumericGreaterThan: 0
                      Next: DescribeAccount
                  Default: NotRequested
                NotRequested:
                  Type: Succeed
                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultSelector:
                    Status.$: $.Account.Status
                  ResultPath: $.Account
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordAccountError
                  Next: CheckAccountStatus
                CheckAccountStatus:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: ACTIVE
                      Next: CloseAccount
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: SUSPENDED
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                    - Variable: $.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: PENDING_CLOSURE
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                  Default: SkipAccount
                SkipAccount:

                CloseAccount:

                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.AccountId
                  ResultPath: $.CloseResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 5
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountAlreadyClosedException
                      ResultPath: $.CloseResult
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.ConstraintViolationException
                      ResultPath: $.Error

                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL

                RecordAccountError:

                    Outcome: FAILED
                    Error.$: $.Error.Error
                    Cause.$: $.Error.Cause

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy authentication stack - Amazon Cognito user pool with Lambda triggers, Hosted UI (Cognito-provided domain), Google identity provider backed by AWS Secrets Manager, and a frontend app client.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: studybuddy.example.com
    Description: Host name of the StudyBuddy frontend (no scheme, no path, no trailing slash). Used to build OAuth callback and logout URLs.
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid host name such as studybuddy.example.com, without scheme, path, or trailing slash.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used in resource names and tags.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google OAuth credentials (placeholders - operators replace after deployment)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'studybuddy/${EnvironmentName}/google-oauth'
      Description: Google OAuth client credentials for the StudyBuddy Cognito Google identity provider. Replace client_id and client_secret with real values after deployment.
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"client_id": "REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"}'
        GenerateStringKey: client_secret
        PasswordLength: 64
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource that reads the Google credentials at deploy time
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleCredentialsReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadGoogleOAuthSecret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  GoogleCredentialsReaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-google-credentials-reader'
      Description: CloudFormation custom resource that reads Google OAuth credentials from Secrets Manager.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt GoogleCredentialsReaderRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          secrets_client = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or "GoogleCredentials"
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return

                  secret_arn = event["ResourceProperties"]["SecretArn"]
                  response = secrets_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                  secret = json.loads(response["SecretString"])

                  client_id = secret.get("client_id")
                  client_secret = secret.get("client_secret")
                  if not client_id or not client_secret:
                      raise ValueError("Secret must contain non-empty client_id and client_secret keys")

                  data = {"ClientId": client_id, "ClientSecret": client_secret}
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, secret_arn, noEcho=True)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Failed to read Google credentials: %s" % type(exc).__name__)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id,
                                   reason="Failed to read Google credentials: %s" % type(exc).__name__)
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  GoogleCredentialsReaderLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${GoogleCredentialsReaderFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  GoogleCredentials:
    Type: Custom::GoogleCredentials
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt GoogleCredentialsReaderFunction.Arn
      SecretArn: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret
      LogGroupName: !Ref GoogleCredentialsReaderLogGroup
      RotationNonce: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito trigger Lambda functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PreSignUpRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-pre-signup'
      Description: StudyBuddy Cognito pre sign-up trigger.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PreSignUpRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps({
                  "trigger": event.get("triggerSource"),
                  "userPoolId": event.get("userPoolId"),
              }))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreSignUpLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PreSignUpFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  PostConfirmationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-post-confirmation'
      Description: StudyBuddy Cognito post confirmation trigger.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps({
                  "trigger": event.get("triggerSource"),
                  "userPoolId": event.get("userPoolId"),
              }))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostConfirmationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostConfirmationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  PostAuthenticationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication'
      Description: StudyBuddy Cognito post authentication trigger.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              print(json.dumps({
                  "trigger": event.get("triggerSource"),
                  "userPoolId": event.get("userPoolId"),
              }))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthenticationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostAuthenticationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito user pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-users'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: StudyBuddy
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PreSignUpInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google identity provider
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !GetAtt GoogleCredentials.ClientId
        client_secret: !GetAtt GoogleCredentials.ClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: profile email openid
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain (Cognito-provided prefix)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Frontend app client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'studybuddy-${EnvironmentName}-web'
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - given_name
        - family_name
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the StudyBuddy Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy frontend app client.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyWebClient

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito Hosted UI.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  GoogleRedirectURI:
    Description: Authorized redirect URI to register in the Google Cloud console OAuth client.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse'

  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the Google OAuth client_id and client_secret. Put the real values here, then update the stack with a new RotationNonce value on the GoogleCredentials resource.
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a CodeBuild project that publishes CloudFormation templates to a bucket
  in every enabled AWS region, with SNS and EventBridge build status notifications.

# NOTE: The regional template buckets (<ProjectName>-<AccountId>-<region>) are created
# by the CodeBuild build, not by CloudFormation. Deleting this stack does NOT remove
# them. When decommissioning, empty and delete those buckets manually.
#
# NOTE: All buckets are private. Templates and the index are reached through IAM or
# presigned URLs only. If you need public or organization-wide sharing, add it on
# purpose through bucket policies (for example with an aws:PrincipalOrgID condition).
# The central artifact bucket is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key, so any
# principal reading the index or artifacts from it also needs kms:Decrypt on the
# artifact key (see the ArtifactKeyArn output), in addition to S3 permissions.
#
# NOTE: The regional buckets intentionally use SSE-S3 (AES256). KMS keys are regional,
# so a customer-managed key per region would require the build to create KMS keys in
# every region, which is outside this stack's resource set and least-privilege scope.
# SSE-S3 also keeps packaged nested-stack and Lambda artifacts readable by
# CloudFormation without cross-key grants.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cfn-template-publisher
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,29}$'
    MaxLength: 30
    Description: >-
      Lowercase name used for resources, IAM scopes and regional bucket names.
      The 30-character limit keeps <ProjectName>-<AccountId>-<region> within 63 characters.
    ConstraintDescription: 3-30 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$'
    Description: Optional email address for build notifications. Leave empty to skip the subscription.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.

Conditions:
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key for the notification topic (EventBridge cannot publish to
  # topics encrypted with the AWS-managed alias/aws/sns key).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NotificationKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} build notification topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NotificationKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-notifications
      TargetKeyId: !Ref NotificationKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key for the central artifact and index bucket (data at rest).
  # Kept separate from the notification key so the EventBridge grant does not
  # extend to stored artifacts. The key policy only trusts the account root;
  # the CodeBuild role receives access through its inline IAM policy.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} artifact bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-artifacts
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-build-notifications
      DisplayName: !Sub ${ProjectName} build notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref NotificationKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref NotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgePublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  NotificationEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Central artifact and index bucket (private, SSE-KMS with customer-managed key)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-artifacts
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/codebuild/${ProjectName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeBuild service role (least privilege, inline policies only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Service role for the ${ProjectName} CodeBuild template publisher
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: template-publisher
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RegionalTemplateBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:CreateBucket'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:GetBucketVersioning'
                  - 's3:PutBucketVersioning'
                  - 's3:GetEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:PutEncryptionConfiguration'
                  - 's3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock'
                  - 's3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock'
                  - 's3:PutBucketOwnershipControls'
                  - 's3:GetBucketPolicy'
                  - 's3:PutBucketPolicy'
                  - 's3:PutBucketTagging'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-*/*
              - Sid: CentralArtifactBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:ViaService': !Sub s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: CodeCommitSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'codecommit:GitPull'
                  - 'codecommit:GetRepository'
                  - 'codecommit:GetBranch'
                  - 'codecommit:ListBranches'
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}*
              - Sid: RegionDiscoveryAndIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribeRegions'
                  - 'sts:GetCallerIdentity'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TemplateValidation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:ValidateTemplate'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub ${LogGroup.Arn}:*
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer'
                  - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/${ProjectName}*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CodeBuild project
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ProjectName
      Description: Packages and publishes CloudFormation templates to a private bucket in every enabled region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
      TimeoutInMinutes: 60
      QueuedTimeoutInMinutes: 60
      ConcurrentBuildLimit: 1
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      LogsConfig:
        CloudWatchLogs:
          Status: ENABLED
          GroupName: !Ref LogGroup
        S3Logs:
          Status: DISABLED
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux-x86_64-standard:5.0
        ImagePullCredentialsType: CODEBUILD
        PrivilegedMode: false
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: PROJECT_NAME
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ProjectName
          - Name: ACCOUNT_ID
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Name: HOME_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          - Name: ARTIFACT_BUCKET
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          - Name: BUCKET_PREFIX
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}
          - Name: SOURCE_REPO_NAME
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ProjectName
          - Name: SOURCE_BRANCH
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: main
          - Name: TEMPLATES_DIR
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: templates
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        # Not wrapped in Fn::Sub on purpose: shell ${VAR} syntax is used throughout,
        # and all stack-specific values arrive through environment variables.
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          env:
            shell: bash
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.12
              commands:
                - pip3 install --quiet --upgrade git-remote-codecommit
            pre_build:
              commands:
                - |
                  bash <<'SCRIPT'
                  set -euo pipefail
                  STATE_DIR=/tmp/publisher-state
                  rm -rf "$STATE_DIR" /tmp/source
                  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR/regions"
                  : > "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions"
                  : > "$STATE_DIR/succeeded_regions"
                  : > "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv"

                  CALLER_ACCOUNT="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
                  if [ "$CALLER_ACCOUNT" != "$ACCOUNT_ID" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: running in account $CALLER_ACCOUNT, expected $ACCOUNT_ID" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "Publishing for project $PROJECT_NAME in account $CALLER_ACCOUNT (home region $HOME_REGION)"

                  echo "Cloning codecommit::${HOME_REGION}://${SOURCE_REPO_NAME} (branch ${SOURCE_BRANCH})"
                  if ! git clone --depth 1 --branch "$SOURCE_BRANCH" "codecommit::${HOME_REGION}://${SOURCE_REPO_NAME}" /tmp/source; then
                    echo "ERROR: unable to clone CodeCommit repository '${SOURCE_REPO_NAME}' branch '${SOURCE_BRANCH}' in ${HOME_REGION}." >&2
                    echo "Create the repository (its name must start with '${PROJECT_NAME}') and push templates to '${TEMPLATES_DIR}/'." >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  SRC_ROOT="/tmp/source/${TEMPLATES_DIR}"
                  if [ ! -d "$SRC_ROOT" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: templates directory '${TEMPLATES_DIR}' not found in repository" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  find "$SRC_ROOT" -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.json' \) | sort > "$STATE_DIR/templates"
                  if [ ! -s "$STATE_DIR/templates" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: no *.yaml, *.yml or *.json templates found under '${TEMPLATES_DIR}'" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "Found $(wc -l < "$STATE_DIR/templates") template(s)"

                  while IFS= read -r tpl; do
                    size="$(wc -c < "$tpl")"
                    if [ "$size" -le 51200 ]; then
                      echo "Validating ${tpl#"$SRC_ROOT"/}"
                      aws cloudformation validate-template --region "$HOME_REGION" --template-body "file://$tpl" > /dev/null
                    else
                      echo "Skipping inline validation of ${tpl#"$SRC_ROOT"/} (larger than 51200 bytes)"
                    fi
                  done < "$STATE_DIR/templates"

                  aws ec2 describe-regions --region "$HOME_REGION" \
                    --filters Name=opt-in-status,Values=opt-in-not-required,opted-in \
                    --query 'Regions[].RegionName' --output text | tr '\t' '\n' | sed '/^$/d' | sort > "$STATE_DIR/region_list"
                  if [ ! -s "$STATE_DIR/region_list" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: no enabled regions discovered" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "Enabled regions: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$STATE_DIR/region_list")"
                  SCRIPT
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  bash <<'SCRIPT'
                  set -euo pipefail
                  STATE_DIR=/tmp/publisher-state
                  SRC_ROOT="/tmp/source/${TEMPLATES_DIR}"

                  # Regional buckets intentionally use SSE-S3 (AES256); see template header comment.
                  ensure_bucket() {
                    local region="$1" bucket="$2"
                    if aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                      echo "[$region] Bucket $bucket already exists"
                    else
                      echo "[$region] Creating bucket $bucket"
                      if [ "$region" = "us-east-1" ]; then
                        aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" > /dev/null
                      else
                        aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                          --create-bucket-configuration "LocationConstraint=${region}" > /dev/null
                      fi
                      aws s3api wait bucket-exists --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region"
                    fi
                    aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
                    aws s3api put-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --ownership-controls 'Rules=[{ObjectOwnership=BucketOwnerEnforced}]'
                    aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"AES256"},"BucketKeyEnabled":true}]}'
                    aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled
                    local policy
                    policy="$(printf '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"DenyInsecureTransport","Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:*","Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::%s","arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"],"Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:SecureTransport":"false"}}}]}' "$bucket" "$bucket")"
                    aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" --policy "$policy"
                    aws s3api put-bucket-tagging --bucket "$bucket" --region "$region" \
                      --tagging "TagSet=[{Key=Name,Value=${PROJECT_NAME}},{Key=Project,Value=${PROJECT_NAME}}]"
                  }

                  process_region() {
                    local region="$1"
                    local bucket="${BUCKET_PREFIX}-${region}"
                    local records="$STATE_DIR/regions/${region}.tsv"
                    : > "$records"
                    ensure_bucket "$region" "$bucket"
                    while IFS= read -r tpl; do
                      local rel="${tpl#"$SRC_ROOT"/}"
                      local out="$STATE_DIR/packaged/${region}/${rel}"
                      mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
                      local fmt_args=()
                      case "$tpl" in
                        *.json) fmt_args=(--use-json) ;;
                      esac
                      echo "[$region] Packaging $rel"
                      aws cloudformation package --region "$region" \
                        --template-file "$tpl" \
                        --s3-bucket "$bucket" \
                        --s3-prefix "artifacts/${rel%.*}" \
                        --output-template-file "$out" \
                        ${fmt_args[@]+"${fmt_args[@]}"} > /dev/null
                      aws s3 cp "$out" "s3://${bucket}/templates/${rel}" --region "$region" --only-show-errors
                      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$region" "$bucket" "templates/${rel}" >> "$records"
                    done < "$STATE_DIR/templates"
                  }

                  while IFS= read -r region; do
                    echo "=== Processing region $region ==="
                    set +e
                    ( set -euo pipefail; process_region "$region" )
                    rc=$?
                    set -e
                    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
                      echo "$region" >> "$STATE_DIR/succeeded_regions"
                      cat "$STATE_DIR/regions/${region}.tsv" >> "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv"
                      echo "[$region] OK"
                    else
                      echo "$region" >> "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions"
                      echo "[$region] FAILED (exit code $rc); continuing with remaining regions" >&2
                    fi
                  done < "$STATE_DIR/region_list"

                  echo "Succeeded regions: $(wc -l < "$STATE_DIR/succeeded_regions"), failed regions: $(wc -l < "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions")"
                  SCRIPT
            post_build:
              commands:
                - |
                  bash <<'SCRIPT'
                  set -euo pipefail
                  STATE_DIR=/tmp/publisher-state
                  if [ "${CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING:-0}" != "1" ] || [ ! -f "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv" ]; then
                    echo "An earlier phase failed; skipping index generation" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi

                  python3 - "$STATE_DIR/index.tsv" "$STATE_DIR/index.html" "$STATE_DIR/index.json" "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions" <<'PY'
                  import datetime
                  import html
                  import json
                  import os
                  import sys
                  import urllib.parse

                  tsv_path, html_path, json_path, failed_path = sys.argv[1:5]
                  project = os.environ["PROJECT_NAME"]
                  build_id = os.environ.get("CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID", "unknown")
                  generated = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

                  entries = []
                  with open(tsv_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      for line in fh:
                          line = line.rstrip("\n")
                          if not line:
                              continue
                          region, bucket, key = line.split("\t")
                          entries.append({
                              "region": region,
                              "bucket": bucket,
                              "key": key,
                              "s3_uri": f"s3://{bucket}/{key}",
                              "url": f"https://{bucket}.s3.{region}.amazonaws.com/{urllib.parse.quote(key)}",
                          })

                  with open(failed_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      failed = [r.strip() for r in fh if r.strip()]

                  with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      json.dump({"project": project, "buildId": build_id, "generated": generated,
                                 "failedRegions": failed, "templates": entries}, fh, indent=2)

                  rows = "\n".join(
                      "<tr><td>{}</td><td>{}</td><td><a href=\"{}\">{}</a></td></tr>".format(
                          html.escape(e["region"]), html.escape(e["key"]),
                          html.escape(e["url"]), html.escape(e["s3_uri"]))
                      for e in entries)
                  failed_html = html.escape(", ".join(failed)) if failed else "none"
                  page = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
                  <html lang="en">
                  <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{html.escape(project)} CloudFormation templates</title></head>
                  <body>
                  <h1>{html.escape(project)} CloudFormation templates</h1>
                  <p>Generated {generated} by build {html.escape(build_id)}.</p>
                  <p>Buckets are private: use IAM credentials or presigned URLs to access templates.</p>
                  <p>Failed regions: {failed_html}</p>
                  <table border="1" cellpadding="4">
                  <thead><tr><th>Region</th><th>Key</th><th>Location</th></tr></thead>
                  <tbody>
                  {rows}
                  </tbody>
                  </table>
                  </body>
                  </html>
                  """
                  with open(html_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                      fh.write(page)
                  print(f"Indexed {len(entries)} template object(s)")
                  PY

                  aws s3 cp "$STATE_DIR/index.html" "s3://${ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/index.html" \
                    --region "$HOME_REGION" --content-type 'text/html; charset=utf-8' --only-show-errors
                  aws s3 cp "$STATE_DIR/index.json" "s3://${ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/index.json" \
                    --region "$HOME_REGION" --content-type 'application/json' --only-show-errors
                  echo "Index uploaded to s3://${ARTIFACT_BUCKET}/index.html"

                  if [ -s "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: publishing failed in regions: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$STATE_DIR/failed_regions")" >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  echo "All regions published successfully"
                  SCRIPT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build status notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildStatusRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-build-status
      Description: !Sub Sends ${ProjectName} CodeBuild status changes to SNS
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codebuild
        detail-type:
          - CodeBuild Build State Change
        detail:
          project-name:
            - !Ref CodeBuildProject
          build-status:
            - SUCCEEDED
            - FAILED
            - STOPPED
      Targets:
        - Id: BuildNotificationTopic
          Arn: !Ref NotificationTopic
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              project: $.detail.project-name
              status: $.detail.build-status
              buildId: $.detail.build-id
              region: $.region
              time: $.time
            InputTemplate: '"CodeBuild project <project> finished with status <status>. Build: <buildId>. Region: <region>. Time: <time>."'

Outputs:
  ProjectName:
    Description: CodeBuild project name
    Value: !Ref CodeBuildProject
  CodeBuildProjectArn:
    Description: CodeBuild project ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildProject.Arn
  CodeBuildServiceRoleArn:
    Description: CodeBuild service role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Central artifact and index bucket
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  ArtifactKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key encrypting the central artifact bucket (readers need kms:Decrypt on it)
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
  IndexLocation:
    Description: S3 location of the generated index page (private; use IAM or presigned URLs)
    Value: !Sub s3://${ArtifactBucket}/index.html
  RegionalBucketNamePattern:
    Description: Naming pattern of the regional buckets created by the build (not managed by CloudFormation)
    Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-<region>
  SourceRepositoryName:
    Description: CodeCommit repository the build clones (create it and push templates to templates/)
    Value: !Ref ProjectName
  NotificationTopicArn:

    Value: !GetAtt NotificationKey.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Adds Security Hub automation rules that suppress reviewed and accepted findings.
  By default, this template adds automation rules to an existing, already-enabled
  AWS Security Hub, with the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark and AWS Foundational Security Best
  Practices standards already enabled. It creates a minimal Security Hub subscription, with no
  standards enabled, only when CreateSecurityHub is "true". This lets the stack deploy in an account
  where Security Hub is not yet enabled. For production, deploy this stack in the Security Hub delegated
  administrator account, in the home Region, with CreateSecurityHub set to "false". The rules then
  apply to member-account findings.

# NOTE: The control IDs, bucket names and GuardDuty finding type in this template are
# representative. Before production use, replace them with the exact reviewed and accepted values
# from the organization's exception register. Keep each criterion field to 20 values or fewer.
#
# NOTE: Production deployments, where Security Hub is already enabled in the delegated
# administrator account and home Region, must set CreateSecurityHub to "false". Creating a Hub in an
# account that is already subscribed fails.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Security Hub subscription
        Parameters:
          - CreateSecurityHub
      - Label:
          default: Scoped account IDs (leave blank to fall back to the administrator account)
        Parameters:
          - CisScopedAccountId
          - EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId
          - AutomationAccountIdA
          - AutomationAccountIdB
      - Label:
          default: Human IAM users excluded from IAM suppression
        Parameters:
          - ExcludedHumanUser1
          - ExcludedHumanUser2

Parameters:
  CreateSecurityHub:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >-
      Set to "false" when deploying into an account where Security Hub is already enabled. That is the
      normal production case for this template. Creating a Hub in an already-subscribed account fails.
      Set to "true" only to create a minimal Security Hub subscription with no standards enabled.

  CisScopedAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: Designated sub-account whose reviewed CIS findings are suppressed. Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: Account with an accepted exception for EBS encryption by default (EC2.7). Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  AutomationAccountIdA:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: First automation account that runs infrequently. Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  AutomationAccountIdB:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID or empty.
    Description: Second automation account that runs infrequently. Leave blank to use the administrator account.

  ExcludedHumanUser1:
    Type: String
    Default: security-admin-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name (1-64 characters).
    Description: Named human IAM user whose IAM findings must NOT be suppressed.

  ExcludedHumanUser2:
    Type: String
    Default: breakglass-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name (1-64 characters).
    Description: Second named human IAM user whose IAM findings must NOT be suppressed.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateSecurityHub: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityHub, "true"]
  HasCisScopedAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CisScopedAccountId, ""]]
  HasEbsEncryptionExemptAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId, ""]]
  HasAutomationAccountIdA: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AutomationAccountIdA, ""]]
  HasAutomationAccountIdB: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AutomationAccountIdB, ""]]

Resources:
  # Minimal, optional Security Hub subscription. It is created only when CreateSecurityHub is "true".
  # No standards are enabled. Production deployments with an existing Hub skip this resource.
  SecurityHubSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::Hub
    Condition: ShouldCreateSecurityHub
    Properties:
      EnableDefaultStandards: false
      ControlFindingGenerator: SECURITY_CONTROL
      AutoEnableControls: false
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression

  # Rule 1: Organization-wide IAM findings, excluding named human users.
  SuppressOrgWideIamFindingsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-OrgWide-IAM-Findings
      Description: Suppresses reviewed and accepted IAM findings organization-wide, excluding named human IAM users.
      RuleOrder: 10
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: IAM.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.9
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsIamUser
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: AwsAccount
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedHumanUser1}'
            Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
          - Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedHumanUser2}'
            Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: IAM findings reviewed and accepted organization-wide. Named human users are excluded from this suppression and must still be remediated.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 2: CIS findings scoped to one designated sub-account.
  SuppressCisFindingsDesignatedSubAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-CIS-Findings-Designated-SubAccount
      Description: Suppresses reviewed and accepted CIS benchmark findings for the designated sub-account only.
      RuleOrder: 20
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [HasCisScopedAccountId, !Ref CisScopedAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceAssociatedStandardsId:
          - Value: ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark
            Comparison: PREFIX
          - Value: standards/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark
            Comparison: PREFIX
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: CloudWatch.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.6
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.9
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.10
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.11
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.12
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.13
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudWatch.14
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: CloudTrail.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: KMS.4
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: CIS controls reviewed and accepted for the designated sub-account.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 3: Organization-wide CIS and FSBP findings (admin ports for bastion/testing,
  # S3 account-level public access block and HTTPS-only access, AWS Config regional coverage).
  SuppressOrgWideCisFsbpFindingsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-OrgWide-CIS-FSBP-Findings
      Description: Suppresses reviewed and accepted CIS and AWS FSBP findings organization-wide (admin ports for bastion and testing, S3 public-access and HTTPS settings, AWS Config regional coverage).
      RuleOrder: 30
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          # Security groups permitting administrative ports (bastion hosts and testing)
          - Value: EC2.13
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.14
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.18
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.19
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.53
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: EC2.54
            Comparison: EQUALS
          # S3 public-access block and HTTPS-only access settings
          - Value: S3.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: S3.5
            Comparison: EQUALS
          # AWS Config regional coverage
          - Value: Config.1
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: CIS and AWS FSBP findings reviewed and accepted organization-wide. Admin ports are needed for bastion hosts and testing, S3 public-access and HTTP-access settings are accepted, and AWS Config regional coverage is accepted as configured.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 4: Public-access findings for known, intentionally public buckets.
  SuppressPublicAccessIntentionallyPublicBucketsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Public-Access-Intentionally-Public-Buckets
      Description: Suppresses public-access findings for a known list of S3 buckets that are public on purpose.
      RuleOrder: 40
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: S3.2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: S3.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: S3.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceType:
          - Value: AwsS3Bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
        # Replace with the approved intentionally public bucket ARNs (20 or fewer).
        ResourceId:
          - Value: arn:aws:s3:::example-static-website-bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:s3:::example-public-assets-bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: arn:aws:s3:::example-public-downloads-bucket
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: These buckets are intentionally public (static website or public assets) and have been reviewed and approved.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 5: EBS default encryption finding for one specific account.
  SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionSingleAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-EBS-Default-Encryption-Single-Account
      Description: Suppresses the EBS default encryption finding (EC2.7) for one exempt account.
      RuleOrder: 50
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: EC2.7
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [HasEbsEncryptionExemptAccountId, !Ref EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: EBS encryption by default has an accepted exception for this account.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 6: Unused credentials and access key rotation for two infrequent automation accounts.
  SuppressUnusedCredentialKeyRotationAutomationAccountsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Unused-Credential-Key-Rotation-Automation-Accounts
      Description: Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two accounts that run automation infrequently.
      RuleOrder: 60
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: IAM.3
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.8
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: IAM.22
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !If [HasAutomationAccountIdA, !Ref AutomationAccountIdA, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: !If [HasAutomationAccountIdB, !Ref AutomationAccountIdB, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
            Comparison: EQUALS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: These accounts run automation infrequently. Unused credentials and access key rotation timing are expected and accepted.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]

  # Rule 7: Expected cross-account Bedrock API activity reported by GuardDuty.
  # The Type value below is the ASFF-formatted GuardDuty finding type and is NOT confirmed.
  # Check it against the GuardDuty finding-type catalog before deploying. If the exact type cannot
  # be confirmed, remove the Type criterion and keep only these filters:
  #   ProductName EQUALS GuardDuty

  SuppressGuardDutyCrossAccountBedrockActivityRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:

      Description: Suppresses one specific GuardDuty finding type for expected and approved cross-account Amazon Bedrock API activity.
      RuleOrder: 70
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      IsTerminal: false
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        WorkflowStatus:
          - Value: NEW
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: NOTIFIED
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: GuardDuty
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Type:
          - Value: TTPs/Discovery/Discovery:IAMUser-AnomalousBehavior
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Title:
          - Value: Bedrock
            Comparison: CONTAINS
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: Cross-account Amazon Bedrock API calls are expected and approved.
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRules-CFN
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Purpose: FindingSuppression
        ReviewStatus: Accepted
        SecurityHubSubscription: !If [ShouldCreateSecurityHub, !Ref SecurityHubSubscription, pre-existing]
