final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions IAM roles, managed policies and the messaging and data resources they depend on (KMS key, SQS queue, DynamoDB table with streams, SNS topic) for the e-commerce serverless architecture.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used in resource names.

Resources:
  MessagingKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for e-commerce messaging (SQS and SNS) in the ${Environment} environment"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  MessagingKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/ecommerce-messaging-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MessagingKey

  OrdersQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "POC-Queue-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref MessagingKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "ecommerce-orders-${Environment}"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: HASH
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  OrdersTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "POC-Topic-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref MessagingKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  OrderProcessorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ecommerce-order-processor-role-${Environment}"
      Description: Role for the Lambda function that consumes the orders SQS queue and writes to the orders DynamoDB table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  StreamProcessorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ecommerce-stream-processor-role-${Environment}"
      Description: Role for the Lambda function that reads the orders DynamoDB stream and publishes to the orders SNS topic.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  ApiGatewaySqsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ecommerce-apigw-sqs-role-${Environment}"
      Description: Role for API Gateway to send messages to the orders SQS queue.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: ecommerce

  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-lambda-basic-execution-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows Lambda functions to write logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CreateLambdaLogGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
          - Sid: WriteLambdaLogStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaRole
        - !Ref StreamProcessorLambdaRole

  SqsConsumePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-sqs-consume-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows consuming messages from the orders SQS queue.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ConsumeOrdersQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
          - Sid: DecryptOrdersQueueMessages
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
      Roles:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaRole

  DynamoDbWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-dynamodb-write-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows writing items to the orders DynamoDB table.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: WriteOrdersTable
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
      Roles:
        - !Ref OrderProcessorLambdaRole

  DynamoDbStreamReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-dynamodb-stream-read-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows reading records from the orders DynamoDB table stream.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOrdersTableStream
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersTable.StreamArn
          - Sid: ListTableStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: '*'
      Roles:
        - !Ref StreamProcessorLambdaRole

  SnsPublishPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-sns-publish-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows publishing messages to the orders SNS topic.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PublishOrdersTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref OrdersTopic
          - Sid: UseMessagingKeyForSns
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
      Roles:
        - !Ref StreamProcessorLambdaRole

  ApiGatewaySqsSendPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "ecommerce-apigw-sqs-send-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows API Gateway to send messages to the orders SQS queue.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SendToOrdersQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
          - Sid: UseMessagingKeyForSqs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ApiGatewaySqsRole

Outputs:
  OrderProcessorLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the order processor Lambda role.
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrderProcessorLambdaRoleArn"

  StreamProcessorLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the stream processor Lambda role.
    Value: !GetAtt StreamProcessorLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-StreamProcessorLambdaRoleArn"

  ApiGatewaySqsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway to SQS role.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySqsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewaySqsRoleArn"

  OrdersQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the orders SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrdersQueueArn"

  OrdersQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the orders SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref OrdersQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrdersQueueUrl"

  OrdersTableName:
    Description: Name of the orders DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref OrdersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrdersTableName"

  OrdersTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the orders DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrdersTableArn"

  OrdersTableStreamArn:
    Description: ARN of the orders DynamoDB table stream.
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.StreamArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrdersTableStreamArn"

  OrdersTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the orders SNS topic.
    Value: !Ref OrdersTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OrdersTopicArn"

  MessagingKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the orders queue and topic.
    Value: !GetAtt MessagingKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MessagingKeyArn"

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      ConnectivityType: public
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the test VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet hosting the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet for test resources.

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway.
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayId'
  NatEipPublicIp:
    Description: Public IP address of the NAT gateway (expected egress source address).

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatEipPublicIp'

    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'
  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private route table.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provides Amazon Athena named queries for monthly reporting on AppStream 2.0 usage data, including the Glue database, a dedicated Athena WorkGroup, and a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket for query results.

Resources:
  # Glue Data Catalog database that the named queries run against.
  # NOTE: The AppStream 2.0 usage report tables ("sessions" and "applications",
  # partitioned by year/month/day) are expected to be added later by the
  # usage-report pipeline (for example, a Glue crawler or DDL run separately).
  # Athena named queries do not validate table existence, so they deploy safely
  # before the tables exist.
  AppStreamUsageDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: appstream-usage
        Description: Database for AppStream 2.0 usage report data (sessions and applications tables are added later by the usage-report pipeline).

  ResultsBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts Athena query results for AppStream 2.0 usage reporting.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AppStreamUsageReporting

  ResultsBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/appstream-usage-reporting
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ResultsBucketKey

  ResultsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ResultsBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AppStreamUsageReporting

  ResultsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ResultsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ResultsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ResultsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  AthenaWorkGroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-usage-reporting
      Description: WorkGroup for AppStream 2.0 usage monthly reporting queries.
      State: ENABLED
      RecursiveDeleteOption: true
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration: true
        PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub 's3://${ResultsBucket}/athena-results/'
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_KMS
            KmsKey: !GetAtt ResultsBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AppStreamUsageReporting

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Average Session Length per Stack (Current Month)
      Description: Average AppStream 2.0 session length in minutes and session count per stack for the current month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          stack_name,
          count(*) AS session_count,
          avg(session_duration_in_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY avg_session_length_minutes DESC;

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Average Session Length per Stack (Previous Month)
      Description: Average AppStream 2.0 session length in minutes and session count per stack for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          stack_name,
          count(*) AS session_count,
          avg(session_duration_in_seconds) / 60.0 AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY avg_session_length_minutes DESC;

  DailySessionCountCurrentMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Daily Session Count (Current Month)
      Description: Number of distinct AppStream 2.0 sessions per day for the current month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          year,
          month,
          day,
          count(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY year, month, day
        ORDER BY year, month, day;

  DailySessionCountPreviousMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Daily Session Count (Previous Month)
      Description: Number of distinct AppStream 2.0 sessions per day for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          year,
          month,
          day,
          count(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY year, month, day
        ORDER BY year, month, day;

  AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - All Session Details (Current Month)
      Description: All AppStream 2.0 session records for the current month ordered by session start time.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT *
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        ORDER BY session_start_time;

  AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - All Session Details (Previous Month)
      Description: All AppStream 2.0 session records for the previous month ordered by session start time.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT *
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        ORDER BY session_start_time;

  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Streaming Hours per User (Current Month)
      Description: Total AppStream 2.0 streaming hours and session count per user for the current month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          user_id,
          authentication_type,
          count(*) AS session_count,
          sum(session_duration_in_seconds) / 3600.0 AS streaming_hours
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY user_id, authentication_type
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC;

  StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Streaming Hours per User (Previous Month)
      Description: Total AppStream 2.0 streaming hours and session count per user for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          user_id,
          authentication_type,
          count(*) AS session_count,
          sum(session_duration_in_seconds) / 3600.0 AS streaming_hours
        FROM sessions
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY user_id, authentication_type
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC;

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Unique Users per Application (Current Month)
      Description: Number of unique AppStream 2.0 users per application for the current month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          applications.application_name,
          count(DISTINCT sessions.user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM applications
        JOIN sessions
          ON applications.user_session_id = sessions.user_session_id
        WHERE sessions.year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND sessions.month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY applications.application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC;

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Unique Users per Application (Previous Month)
      Description: Number of unique AppStream 2.0 users per application for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          applications.application_name,
          count(DISTINCT sessions.user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM applications
        JOIN sessions
          ON applications.user_session_id = sessions.user_session_id
        WHERE sessions.year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND sessions.month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY applications.application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC;

Outputs:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database used by the AppStream usage named queries.
    Value: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
  AthenaWorkGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Athena WorkGroup for AppStream usage reporting.
    Value: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
  ResultsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores Athena query results.
    Value: !Ref ResultsBucket
  ResultsBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts Athena query results (grant kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey to Athena users as needed).
    Value: !GetAtt ResultsBucketKey.Arn
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Average Session Length per Stack (Current Month).
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQuery
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Average Session Length per Stack (Previous Month).
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQuery
  DailySessionCountCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Daily Session Count (Current Month).
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountCurrentMonthQuery
  DailySessionCountPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Daily Session Count (Previous Month).
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountPreviousMonthQuery
  AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for All Session Details (Current Month).
    Value: !Ref AllSessionDetailsCurrentMonthQuery
  AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for All Session Details (Previous Month).
    Value: !Ref AllSessionDetailsPreviousMonthQuery
  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Streaming Hours per User (Current Month).
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonthQuery
  StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Streaming Hours per User (Previous Month).
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserPreviousMonthQuery
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Unique Users per Application (Current Month).
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonthQuery
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: NamedQueryId for Unique Users per Application (Previous Month).
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationPreviousMonthQuery

  # PublicRouteTable sends 0.0.0.0/0 to the internet gateway. Workloads that need a public

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-db-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  PrivateDbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-db-subnet-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  # Single NAT gateway in AZ 1: a single point of failure that adds cross-AZ data charges
  # for AZs 2 and 3. Production high availability needs one NAT gateway per AZ.
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-app-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateAppDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-db-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  # Database subnets get outbound internet through the NAT gateway, as requested.
  # For stricter isolation, remove this default route.
  PrivateDbDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the VPC

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of public subnet IDs

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateAppSubnetIds'

  PrivateDbSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of private database subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateDbSubnet1, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3]]

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateDbSubnetIds'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateAppRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private application route table
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight Admin Suite – monitoring and metadata data lake. Extracts QuickSight
  usage, dataset, Q topic, folder and access metadata via scheduled Glue jobs and
  streams AWS/QuickSight CloudWatch metrics through Firehose into an S3 data lake
  for Athena analytics. NOTE: both S3 buckets and the KMS key use DeletionPolicy
  Retain and survive stack deletion; redeploying with the same bucket names fails
  until the retained buckets are removed manually.

Metadata:
  RetentionNotice:
    Buckets: >-
      AdminSuiteBucket (admin-suite-<AccountId>) and ScriptBucket
      (<ScriptBucketName>-<AccountId>) are retained on stack deletion and stack
      replacement. Empty and delete them manually before redeploying this
      template under the same names.
    KmsKey: >-
      AdminSuiteKmsKey is retained on stack deletion and replacement so the data
      in the retained buckets stays readable. Schedule its deletion manually once
      the retained buckets are no longer needed.
  EncryptionNotice: >-
    Both buckets use SSE-KMS with the customer managed key AdminSuiteKmsKey
    instead of AES256 (SSE-S3). This is a deliberate security hardening change.
    The script uploader, Glue security configuration and Firehose streams all
    write with the same key.
  QuickSightSubscription: >-
    No QuickSight subscription is created by this template. The Glue jobs finish
    with empty output when QuickSight is not subscribed in the account.
  QMetricNames: >-
    The Q index and Q action metric streams filter only on the AWS/QuickSight
    namespace because their metric names could not be verified.
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Glue script storage
        Parameters:
          - ScriptBucketName

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    MaxLength: 50
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Glue script bucket name. The account ID is appended
      (<prefix>-<AccountId>) so the global bucket name does not collide with other accounts.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS customer managed key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight Admin Suite data lake and Glue script buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-admin-suite'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: ExpireGlueTempFiles
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: temp/
            ExpirationInDays: 7
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Consolidated IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Consolidated role for the QuickSight Admin Suite (Glue, Firehose, CloudWatch metric streams, CloudFormation, script uploader).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BucketLevel
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ObjectLevel
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseDataLakeKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGlueAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:GetJob'
                  - 'glue:GetJobs'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRuns'
                  - 'glue:StartJobRun'
                  - 'glue:BatchStopJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetTrigger'
                  - 'glue:GetTriggers'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabase'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabases'
                  - 'glue:CreateDatabase'
                  - 'glue:GetTable'
                  - 'glue:GetTables'
                  - 'glue:CreateTable'
                  - 'glue:UpdateTable'
                  - 'glue:GetPartition'
                  - 'glue:GetPartitions'
                  - 'glue:BatchCreatePartition'
                  - 'glue:GetSecurityConfiguration'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:securityConfiguration/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightMetadataRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:List*'
                  - 'quicksight:Describe*'
                  - 'quicksight:Search*'
                  - 'quicksight:Get*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteIamAccess
          PolicyDocument:

  ScriptUploaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Writes inline Glue ETL scripts into the script bucket for the QuickSight Admin Suite.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import traceback
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              bucket = props.get('Bucket', '')
              key = props.get('Key', '')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or 's3://{}/{}'.format(bucket, key)
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      body = props.get('Body', '')
                      # Bucket default encryption (SSE-KMS with the solution CMK) applies.
                      s3.put_object(
                          Bucket=bucket,
                          Key=key,
                          Body=body.encode('utf-8'),
                          ContentType='text/x-python',
                      )
                      physical_id = 's3://{}/{}'.format(bucket, key)
                  # Delete: scripts stay in the retained bucket.
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'S3Uri': physical_id}, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  traceback.print_exc()
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc)[:250])

        - Key: Solution
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

    Type: Custom::GlueScriptUpload

      Body: |
        import sys
        import json
        import datetime
        import boto3
        from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
        from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

        args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['admin_bucket', 'aws_region'])
        BUCKET = args['admin_bucket']
        REGION = args['aws_region']
        ACCOUNT = boto3.client('sts', region_name=REGION).get_caller_identity()['Account']
        qs = boto3.client('quicksight', region_name=REGION)
        s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name=REGION)
        DT = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        SKIP = ('ResourceNotFoundException', 'UnsupportedUserEditionException')


        def paginate(fn, key, **kwargs):
            items, token = [], None
            while True:
                params = dict(kwargs)
                if token:
                    params['NextToken'] = token
                try:
                    resp = fn(**params)
                except ClientError as e:
                    if e.response['Error']['Code'] in SKIP:
                        print('Skipping {}: {}'.format(fn.__name__, e))
                        return items
                    raise
                items.extend(resp.get(key, []))
                token = resp.get('NextToken')
                if not token:
                    return items


        def safe(fn, **kwargs):
            try:
                return fn(**kwargs)
            except ClientError as e:
                print('Skipping {} {}: {}'.format(fn.__name__, kwargs, e))
                return None


        def write(prefix, rows):
            body = '\n'.join(json.dumps(r, default=str) for r in rows)
            key = 'monitoring/quicksight/{}/dt={}/{}.json'.format(prefix, DT, prefix)
            s3.put_object(Bucket=BUCKET, Key=key, Body=body.encode('utf-8'))
            print('Wrote {} rows to s3://{}/{}'.format(len(rows), BUCKET, key))


        users = paginate(qs.list_users, 'UserList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, Namespace='default')
        write('users', [dict(u, account_id=ACCOUNT, snapshot_date=DT) for u in users])

        groups = paginate(qs.list_groups, 'GroupList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, Namespace='default')
        memberships = []
        for g in groups:
            for m in paginate(qs.list_group_memberships, 'GroupMemberList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT,
                              Namespace='default', GroupName=g['GroupName']):
                memberships.append({'account_id': ACCOUNT, 'group_name': g['GroupName'],
                                    'member_name': m.get('MemberName'), 'member_arn': m.get('Arn'),
                                    'snapshot_date': DT})
        write('group_membership', memberships)

        asset_sources = [
            ('dashboard', qs.list_dashboards, 'DashboardSummaryList', 'DashboardId',
             qs.describe_dashboard_permissions, 'DashboardId'),
            ('analysis', qs.list_analyses, 'AnalysisSummaryList', 'AnalysisId',
             qs.describe_analysis_permissions, 'AnalysisId'),
            ('dataset', qs.list_data_sets, 'DataSetSummaries', 'DataSetId',
             qs.describe_data_set_permissions, 'DataSetId'),
            ('datasource', qs.list_data_sources, 'DataSources', 'DataSourceId',
             qs.describe_data_source_permissions, 'DataSourceId'),
        ]
        access_rows = []
        for asset_type, list_fn, list_key, id_key, perm_fn, perm_arg in asset_sources:
            for asset in paginate(list_fn, list_key, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT):
                asset_id = asset.get(id_key)
                if not asset_id:
                    continue
                resp = safe(perm_fn, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, **{perm_arg: asset_id})
                for perm in (resp or {}).get('Permissions', []):
                    access_rows.append({'account_id': ACCOUNT, 'asset_type': asset_type,
                                        'asset_id': asset_id, 'asset_name': asset.get('Name'),
                                        'principal': perm.get('Principal'),
                                        'actions': perm.get('Actions', []),
                                        'snapshot_date': DT})
        write('assets_access', access_rows)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates the VPC and DNS for a Puppet Quick Start deployment, including a VPC, public subnet, internet gateway, public routing, and a private Route 53 hosted zone with A records for the Puppet master and agents.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. The public subnet CIDR must fall within this range.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/19'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet. Must fall within the VPC CIDR, and must contain the Puppet master and agent IP addresses. Instances in this subnet do not receive public IP addresses automatically; instances that need direct internet access must request one explicitly (for example an Elastic IP or AssociatePublicIpAddress on the network interface).

  PuppetMasterIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.10'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Private IP address for puppet.example.com. Must fall within the public subnet CIDR (CloudFormation cannot validate this).

  LinuxAgentIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.11'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Private IP address for linuxagent.example.com. Must fall within the public subnet CIDR (CloudFormation cannot validate this).

  WindowsAgentIp:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.12'
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Private IP address for windowsagent.example.com. Must fall within the public subnet CIDR (CloudFormation cannot validate this).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private internal DNS zone for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  PuppetMasterRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetMasterIp

  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIp

  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIp

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet created for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map private DNS service
  discovery (SRV records) and step-based CPU auto scaling. Creates its own VPC,
  public and private subnets, internet gateway, NAT gateway, ECS cluster, IAM
  roles, CloudWatch log group and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used in resource names, tags, the Cloud Map namespace and the log group name.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Name of the microservice, used for the ECS service, task definition family, container, Cloud Map service and log group path.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image to run (public Docker Hub image by default).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port the container listens on. Used for port mappings, security group rules and the Cloud Map SRV record.

  ContainerCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
    Description: Task CPU units. The CPU and memory pair must be a valid Fargate combination.

  ContainerMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '8192'
    Description: Task memory in MiB. The CPU and memory pair must be a valid Fargate combination.

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Initial number of running tasks (must be within the auto scaling bounds of 2 to 10).

  EnableCustomTaskRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create an optional IAM task role the containers can assume to access other AWS resources.

Conditions:
  CreateCustomTaskRole: !Equals [!Ref EnableCustomTaskRole, 'true']

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Cluster and Security
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Egress note: outbound traffic is limited to TCP on the container port inside
  # the VPC and TCP 443 to the internet via the NAT gateway. The two /1 HTTPS
  # rules together still reach every public HTTPS address; they restrict the
  # protocol and port, not the destination hosts. The default Docker Hub image
  # has no fixed IP ranges, so destination hosts cannot be narrowed further
  # without moving the image to a private registry reached via VPC endpoints.
  # DNS queries to the Amazon VPC resolver are not filtered by security groups.
  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Security group for ${ServiceName} containers in ${EnvironmentName}'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Allow container traffic from within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: East-west calls to sibling services discovered through Cloud Map within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - Description: HTTPS only via NAT for image pulls, CloudWatch Logs and AWS APIs - lower half of IPv4, all public HTTPS hosts reachable
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/1
        - Description: HTTPS only via NAT for image pulls, CloudWatch Logs and AWS APIs - upper half of IPv4, all public HTTPS hosts reachable
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 128.0.0.0/1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-container-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Logging and IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateCustomTaskRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadServiceParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Task Definition
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref ServiceName
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - CreateCustomTaskRole
        - !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      RuntimePlatform:
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud Map Service Discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.internal'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Cloud Map service for ${ServiceName} in ${EnvironmentName}'
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !GetAtt PrivateDnsNamespace.Id
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: PrivateRoute
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      EnableECSManagedTags: true
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale down when average CPU utilization is at or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale up in graduated steps when average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the private subnets
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

  ContainerSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the container security group
    Value: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup

  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  ECSServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS service
    Value: !Ref ECSService

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the task definition
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

  NamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace
    Value: !GetAtt PrivateDnsNamespace.Id

  DiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn

  ServiceDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: Private DNS name other services use to discover this service
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.internal'

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for container logs
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

  TaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Condition: CreateCustomTaskRole
    Description: ARN of the optional custom task role
    Value: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
