final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demos with an OCI primary region.
  Creates a VPC, internet gateway, private subnet, route table, transit gateway with
  VPC attachment, HTTPS-only security group, an optional static-route site-to-site VPN
  to OCI, and VPC flow logs encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.

# Note: no speculative properties (such as TransitGatewayAttachmentId on
# AWS::EC2::VPNConnection, or VpnTunnelOptionsSpecifications preshared keys) are set.
# VPN tunnel options stay at AWS defaults, which the OCI side can match.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
      - Label:
          default: Network addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr
          - InternalCidr
          - OciBackboneCidr
      - Label:
          default: OCI site-to-site VPN
        Parameters:
          - EnableOciVpn
          - OciVpnPeerIp
          - OciCustomerGatewayAsn

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: oci-hybrid-backbone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-32 characters using lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used in resource Name tags, the KMS alias and the log group name.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: CIDR block for the AWS VPC.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet. It must fall inside VpcCidr.

  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: Internal CIDR range. It is the only allowed source for HTTPS inbound.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (x.x.x.x/y).
    Description: >-
      OCI backbone CIDR. It must not overlap VpcCidr. It is the only allowed HTTPS outbound
      destination and the destination of the VPC and transit gateway routes to OCI.

  EnableOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the customer gateway and the site-to-site VPN to OCI. OciVpnPeerIp must also be set.

  OciVpnPeerIp:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI IPSec headend. Leave empty to skip creating the VPN.

  OciCustomerGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 31898
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: BGP ASN of the OCI side (OCI public ASN is 31898). CustomerGateway requires it even though routing is static.

Conditions:
  CreateOciVpn: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableOciVpn, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OciVpnPeerIp, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core VPC networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpc
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-igw
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-private-subnet
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-rt
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub ${ProjectName} transit gateway for OCI hybrid interconnect
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-tgw
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-tgw-rt
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-tgw-vpc-attachment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcAttachmentRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwRouteToVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  OciRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HttpsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS inbound from the internal CIDR and HTTPS outbound to the OCI backbone only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: HTTPS inbound from the internal CIDR range
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS outbound to the OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-https-sg
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional site-to-site VPN to OCI (static routes only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnPeerIp
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayAsn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-oci-cgw
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-oci-vpn
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the VPN transit gateway attachment lookup function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpn-attachment-lookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeTgwAttachments
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpn-lookup-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-vpn-lookup
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpn-lookup-logs
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      Description: Looks up the transit gateway attachment ID of the OCI VPN connection
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import time
          import urllib.request

          import boto3

          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")


          def send(event, context, status, data, physical_id, reason=""):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or "See CloudWatch Logs stream " + context.log_stream_name,
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data,
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)


          def find_attachment(vpn_id, tgw_id, context):
              filters = [
                  {"Name": "resource-type", "Values": ["vpn"]},
                  {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpn_id]},
                  {"Name": "transit-gateway-id", "Values": [tgw_id]},
              ]
              while True:
                  resp = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_attachments(Filters=filters)
                  for att in resp.get("TransitGatewayAttachments", []):
                      if att.get("State") == "available":
                          return att["TransitGatewayAttachmentId"]
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 60000:
                      raise TimeoutError("VPN transit gateway attachment did not become available in time")
                  time.sleep(15)


          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "vpn-attachment-lookup-pending")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      send(event, context, "SUCCESS", {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event["ResourceProperties"]
                  attachment_id = find_attachment(props["VpnConnectionId"], props["TransitGatewayId"], context)
                  print("Found VPN attachment " + attachment_id)
                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS", {"AttachmentId": attachment_id}, attachment_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Lookup failed: " + str(exc))
                  send(event, context, "FAILED", {}, physical_id, str(exc)[:200])
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpn-lookup
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpnAttachmentLookup:
    Type: Custom::VpnAttachmentLookup
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupFunction.Arn
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref OciVpnConnection
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  VpnAttachmentRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TgwRouteToOci:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flow logs with KMS encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-vpn-lookup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs-key
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  FlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver to the encrypted CloudWatch log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-log-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DeliverFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs-role
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpc-flowlog
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect-demo

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the backbone VPC
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the backbone VPC
    Value: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet
    Value: !Ref Subnet
  RouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the subnet route table
    Value: !Ref RouteTable
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway route table
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  VpcTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the transit gateway VPC attachment
    Value: !Ref VpcTransitGatewayAttachment
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the HTTPS-only security group
    Value: !Ref HttpsSecurityGroup
  FlowLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn
  FlowLogKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the flow log KMS key
    Value: !Ref FlowLogKeyAlias
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group that holds VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
  FlowLogId:
    Description: ID of the VPC flow log
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog
  OciCustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateOciVpn
    Description: ID of the OCI customer gateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline: S3, IAM, five Glue jobs and their schedules'

Resources:
  AdminConsoleBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight admin console S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminConsoleBucketKey

  AdminConsoleBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminConsoleBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AdminConsoleGlueRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the QuickSight admin console Glue data preparation jobs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminConsoleFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ServiceFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:*'
                  - 'quicksight:*'
                  - 'glue:*'
                  - 'cloudwatch:*'
                  - 'logs:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminConsoleBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucket.Arn
              - Sid: AdminConsoleObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource: !Sub '${AdminConsoleBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: AdminConsoleKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleDatasetInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Collects QuickSight dataset and object access information (Python Shell)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_dataset_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--OBJECT_ACCESS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleUserAccessInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Collects QuickSight user and group membership information (Python Shell)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_user_access_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
        '--OBJECT_ACCESS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleFolderInfoJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Collects QuickSight folder assets, lookup and path information (Python Shell)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_folder_info.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--FOLDER_ASSETS_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_assets/'
        '--FOLDER_LOOKUP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_lookup/'
        '--FOLDER_PATH_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_path/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleGroupMembershipEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Transforms QuickSight group membership data (Glue ETL)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_group_membership_etl.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_PATH': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleCloudTrailEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Description: Prepares CloudTrail log data for the admin console (Glue ETL)
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/scripts/adminconsole_cloudtrail_etl.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/temp/'
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--CLOUDTRAIL_TABLE_NAME': cloudtrail_logs
        '--CLOUDTRAIL_LOG_LOCATION': !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/cloudtrail/'
      Tags:
        Application: quicksight-admin-console

  AdminConsoleDatasetInfoTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the dataset info job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleDatasetInfoJob

  AdminConsoleUserAccessInfoTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the user access info job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleUserAccessInfoJob

  AdminConsoleFolderInfoTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the folder info job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleFolderInfoJob

  AdminConsoleGroupMembershipEtlTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the group membership ETL job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleGroupMembershipEtlJob

  AdminConsoleCloudTrailEtlTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the CloudTrail ETL job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AdminConsoleCloudTrailEtlJob

Outputs:
  AdminConsoleBucketName:
    Description: Name of the admin console S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminConsoleBucketName'

  AdminConsoleBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the admin console bucket
    Value: !GetAtt AdminConsoleBucketKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminConsoleBucketKeyArn'

  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight group membership data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/group_membership/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GroupMembershipS3Path'

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight object access data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/object_access/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ObjectAccessS3Path'

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder assets data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_assets/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderAssetsS3Path'

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_lookup/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderLookupS3Path'

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder path data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/quicksight/folder_path/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderPathS3Path'

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table
    Value: cloudtrail_logs
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogTableName'

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location of the CloudTrail log data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${AdminConsoleBucket}/admin-console/monitoring/cloudtrail/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogS3Location'

  AdminConsoleGlueRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the admin console Glue jobs
    Value: !GetAtt AdminConsoleGlueRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AdminConsoleGlueRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds custom ECS-optimized AMIs from the latest
  Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI. It runs a Chef (CINC) recipe stored in a KMS-encrypted
  S3 bucket and uses a custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and collects
  metadata before it creates the AMI. Every image is scanned with Amazon Inspector, which
  this stack activates, and tested. The AMI is then distributed to a target region. A
  lifecycle policy deprecates old AMIs. Builds run in a private subnet that reaches AWS
  services only through VPC endpoints. This stack creates all networking, encryption,
  storage and IAM resources.

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-al2-golden
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (2-41 characters).
    Description: Name prefix used for every resource and for the Project tag.
  DistributionRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code, for example us-east-1.
    Description: Region where the resulting AMI is distributed and shared with the current account.
  ParentImageId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: Public SSM parameter that resolves to the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI.
  ArtifactVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.1
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version, for example 1.0.1.
    Description: Semantic version for the component, image recipe and workflow. Increase it whenever you change any of them.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.large
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
      - m5.large
      - m5.xlarge
      - c5.large
      - c5.xlarge
    Description: Instance type used for build and test instances.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 500
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB. The ECS-optimized AL2 AMI needs at least 30 GiB.
  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp3
      - gp2
      - io1
      - io2
    Description: Root EBS volume type.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.42.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the build VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.42.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    Description: CIDR block for the private build subnet (no internet route). It must fall inside VpcCidr.
  ChefRecipeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/recipes/default.rb
    AllowedPattern: '^chef/[a-zA-Z0-9!_.*()/-]+\.rb$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be under the chef/ prefix and end in .rb.
    Description: S3 object key of the Chef recipe that the component downloads and runs.
  CincClientVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 18.2.7
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a CINC Client release version, for example 18.2.7.
    Description: Pinned version of the open-source CINC Client (Chef Infra compatible) EL7 x86_64 RPM, staged in S3 for offline installation.
  PipelineSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 3 * * ? *)
    Description: Schedule expression for the daily pipeline run, in UTC.
  AmiDeprecationAgeDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Age in days after which the lifecycle policy deprecates AMIs.
  AmisToRetain:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Minimum number of the newest AMIs the lifecycle policy never deprecates.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention period, in days, for CloudWatch log groups and S3 build logs.

  # Networking (private build subnet, AWS access through VPC endpoints only)

      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-private-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'
      GroupDescription: Image Builder build and test instances - no ingress, egress limited to VPC endpoints and S3
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints (SSM, Image Builder, KMS)
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt S3PrefixList.PrefixListId
          Description: HTTPS to S3 through the gateway endpoint
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt S3PrefixList.PrefixListId
          Description: HTTP to S3-hosted Amazon Linux 2 yum repositories through the gateway endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from build instances only, no egress
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt BuildSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build and test instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
          Description: Non-routable placeholder that removes the default allow-all egress rule
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-s3-gateway'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ec2messages'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ImageBuilderEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.imagebuilder'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-kms'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key, artifact and log bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${ProjectName} Image Builder artifact bucket'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-artifacts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: expire-build-logs
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: logs/
            ExpirationInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
          - Id: expire-noncurrent-versions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: abort-incomplete-uploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper function: seeds Chef artifacts, resolves the S3 prefix list and
  # activates Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning (required for image scanning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HelperFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HelperFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: seed-artifacts-lookup-and-inspector
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt HelperFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: SeedChefArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/chef/*'
              - Sid: EncryptArtifactsViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: LookupS3PrefixList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ActivateInspectorEc2Scanning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:Enable
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CreateInspectorServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: inspector2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: CreateInspectorAgentlessServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: agentless.inspector2.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HelperFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Image Builder helper for ${ProjectName} - seeds Chef artifacts into S3, resolves the regional S3 prefix list ID and activates Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt HelperFunctionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: Text
        LogGroup: !Ref HelperFunctionLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
          inspector = boto3.client("inspector2")

          POLL_SECONDS = 15
          SAFETY_MARGIN_SECONDS = 30
          DISABLED_GRACE_SECONDS = 60


          def seed_artifacts(props, context):
              bucket = props["BucketName"]
              recipe_key = props["RecipeKey"]
              installer_key = props["InstallerKey"]
              s3.put_object(
                  Bucket=bucket,
                  Key=recipe_key,
                  Body=props["RecipeContent"].encode("utf-8"),
                  ContentType="text/x-ruby",
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(props["InstallerUrl"], timeout=240) as resp:
                  s3.upload_fileobj(
                      resp,
                      bucket,
                      installer_key,
                      ExtraArgs={"ContentType": "application/x-rpm"},
                  )
              return {"Key": recipe_key, "InstallerKey": installer_key}, recipe_key


          def lookup_prefix_list(props, context):
              resp = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                  Filters=[{"Name": "prefix-list-name", "Values": [props["PrefixListName"]]}]
              )
              lists = resp.get("PrefixLists", [])
              if not lists:
                  raise ValueError("Prefix list %s not found" % props["PrefixListName"])
              pl_id = lists[0]["PrefixListId"]
              return {"PrefixListId": pl_id}, pl_id


          def ec2_scan_status(account_id):
              resp = inspector.batch_get_account_status(accountIds=[account_id])
              for account in resp.get("accounts", []):
                  if account.get("accountId") == account_id:
                      return account.get("resourceState", {}).get("ec2", {}).get("status")
              return None


          def enable_inspector(props, context):
              account_id = props["AccountId"]
              physical_id = "inspector2-ec2-%s" % account_id
              status = ec2_scan_status(account_id)
              print("Inspector EC2 scan status before activation: %s" % status)
              if status == "ENABLED":
                  return {"Ec2ScanStatus": status}, physical_id

              resp = inspector.enable(resourceTypes=["EC2"])
              failed = resp.get("failedAccounts", [])
              if failed:
                  raise RuntimeError("Inspector activation failed: %s" % failed)

              started = time.time()
              deadline = started + context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() / 1000.0 - SAFETY_MARGIN_SECONDS
              while time.time() < deadline:
                  status = ec2_scan_status(account_id)
                  print("Inspector EC2 scan status: %s" % status)
                  if status == "ENABLED":
                      return {"Ec2ScanStatus": status}, physical_id
                  if status == "SUSPENDED" or (
                      status == "DISABLED" and time.time() - started > DISABLED_GRACE_SECONDS
                  ):
                      raise RuntimeError("Inspector EC2 scanning ended in state %s" % status)
                  time.sleep(POLL_SECONDS)
              raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for Inspector EC2 scanning (last state %s)" % status)


          MODES = {
              "SeedArtifacts": seed_artifacts,
              "PrefixList": lookup_prefix_list,
              "EnableInspector": enable_inspector,
          }


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              mode = props.get("Mode")
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", context.log_stream_name)
              data = {}
              status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              try:
                  # Delete is a no-op for every mode: seeded objects stay in the retained
                  # bucket and Inspector is account-wide, so it is never disabled here.
                  if event["RequestType"] in ("Create", "Update"):
                      if mode not in MODES:
                          raise ValueError("Unknown mode: %s" % mode)
                      data, physical_id = MODES[mode](props, context)
              except Exception as exc:  # report every failure back to CloudFormation
                  print("Request failed (%s): %s" % (mode, exc))
                  status = cfnresponse.FAILED
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, data, physical_id)
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  S3PrefixList:
    Type: Custom::S3PrefixList
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt HelperFunction.Arn
      Mode: PrefixList
      PrefixListName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'

  InspectorEc2Activation:
    Type: Custom::InspectorActivation
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt HelperFunction.Arn
      Mode: EnableInspector
      AccountId: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SeedChefRecipe:
    Type: Custom::SeedChefRecipe
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt HelperFunction.Arn
      Mode: SeedArtifacts
      BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      RecipeKey: !Ref ChefRecipeKey
      InstallerUrl: !Sub 'https://downloads.cinc.sh/files/stable/cinc/${CincClientVersion}/el/7/cinc-${CincClientVersion}-1.el7.x86_64.rpm'
      InstallerKey: !Sub 'chef/installers/cinc-${CincClientVersion}-1.el7.x86_64.rpm'
      RecipeContent: |
        # Default Chef recipe seeded by CloudFormation for the ECS AL2 golden AMI.
        package 'jq'

        directory '/etc/imagebuilder' do
          owner 'root'
          group 'root'
          mode '0755'
        end

        file '/etc/imagebuilder/chef-baked' do
          content "Configured by Chef through EC2 Image Builder\n"
          owner 'root'
          group 'root'
          mode '0644'
        end

        service 'docker' do
          action :enable
        end

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-instance'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: chef-artifacts-and-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadChefArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/chef/*'
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/logs/*'
              - Sid: ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - Sid: UseArtifactKeyViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-instance'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-execution'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: imagebuilder-workflow-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2ReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeRegions
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeExportImageTasks
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2BuildLifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2ManageImageBuilderInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ec2:ResourceTag/CreatedBy: EC2 Image Builder
              - Sid: PassBuildInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildInstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
              - Sid: ReadInstanceProfile
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:GetInstanceProfile
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildInstanceProfile.Arn
              - Sid: SsmOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation

                  - ssm:ListInventoryEntries
                  - ssm:GetInventory

                  - ssm:GetParameter

                Resource: '*'

                Resource: '*'

                Effect: Allow

                  - inspector2:ListCoverage

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-lifecycle'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-chef-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ArtifactVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs CINC Client (Chef Infra compatible) from S3, then downloads and runs a Chef recipe from S3
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${ArtifactVersion}'
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: !Sub
        - |
          name: ${ProjectName}-chef-recipe
          description: Installs CINC Client from S3, downloads a Chef recipe from S3 and runs it in local mode.
          schemaVersion: 1.0
          phases:
            - name: build
              steps:
                - name: PrepareWorkspace
                  action: CreateFolder
                  inputs:
                    - path: /tmp/chef
                - name: DownloadInstaller
                  action: S3Download
                  maxAttempts: 3
                  inputs:
                    - source: s3://${Bucket}/${InstallerKey}
                      destination: /tmp/chef/cinc.rpm
                - name: InstallChef
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - |
                        set -euo pipefail
                        if ! rpm -q cinc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                          rpm -Uvh /tmp/chef/cinc.rpm
                        fi
                - name: DownloadRecipe
                  action: S3Download
                  maxAttempts: 3
                  inputs:
                    - source: s3://${Bucket}/${RecipeKey}
                      destination: /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                - name: RunRecipe
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - |
                        set -euo pipefail
                        export CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent
                        if command -v cinc-apply >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                          cinc-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                        elif [ -x /opt/cinc/bin/cinc-apply ]; then
                          /opt/cinc/bin/cinc-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                        else
                          chef-apply /tmp/chef/recipe.rb
                        fi
                - name: Cleanup
                  action: DeleteFolder
                  inputs:
                    - path: /tmp/chef
                      force: true
            - name: validate
              steps:
                - name: ValidateChefOutput
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - test -f /etc/imagebuilder/chef-baked
            - name: test
              steps:
                - name: TestImage
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - test -f /etc/imagebuilder/chef-baked
                      - systemctl is-enabled docker
                      - test -f /etc/ecs/ecs.config || test -d /etc/ecs
        - Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          RecipeKey: !GetAtt SeedChefRecipe.Key
          InstallerKey: !GetAtt SeedChefRecipe.InstallerKey
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ArtifactVersion
      Description: ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 image customized with a Chef recipe
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageId
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation
      - S3GatewayEndpoint
      - SsmEndpoint
      - SsmMessagesEndpoint
      - Ec2MessagesEndpoint
      - ImageBuilderEndpoint
      - KmsEndpoint
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Private build and test infrastructure for the ECS AL2 golden AMI
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref ArtifactBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: logs/imagebuilder
      ResourceTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-distribution'
      Description: !Sub 'Distributes the ${ProjectName} AMI to the target region and shares it with this account'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref DistributionRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ecs-al2-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Custom ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 AMI built by ${ProjectName}'
            AmiTags:
              Project: !Ref ProjectName
              BaseImage: amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  BuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-build-workflow'
      Version: !Ref ArtifactVersion
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Build workflow that updates the SSM agent, runs components, collects metadata and creates the AMI
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${ArtifactVersion}'
      Data: |
        name: custom-build-image
        description: Launch the build instance, update the SSM agent, run components, collect metadata and create the AMI.
        schemaVersion: 1.0

        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"

          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
              parameters:
                allowDowngrade:
                  - "false"

          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: CollectMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              and:
                - stringEquals: "AMI"
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
                - booleanEquals: true
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.collectImageMetadata"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              stringEquals: "AMI"
              value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

        outputs:
          - name: "ImageId"
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateOutputAMI.imageId"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn: InspectorEc2Activation
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-pipeline'
      Description: Daily pipeline that builds, scans and tests the custom ECS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt BuildWorkflow.Arn
        - WorkflowArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:workflow/test/test-image/x.x.x'
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref PipelineSchedule
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  AmiLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ami-lifecycle'
      Description: !Sub 'Deprecates ${ProjectName} AMIs older than the configured age'
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      Status: ENABLED
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref AmiDeprecationAgeDays
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: !Ref AmisToRetain
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Project: !Ref ProjectName
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
