AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions five EC2 instances in a new private VPC together with their CloudWatch alarms (CPU utilization, status check, and attached EBS reachability) and a KMS-encrypted SNS notification topic.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used as a prefix in Name tags and alarm names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: Public SSM parameter path for the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.

Resources:
  MonitoringVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-monitoring-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet'

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for monitored instances - no inbound access, HTTPS egress to in-VPC endpoints only
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt MonitoringVpc.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS to in-VPC endpoints only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-sg'

  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-role'

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  EbsEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the EBS root volumes of the monitored EC2 instances
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseThroughEbsForAccountPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowGrantsForAttachedEbsResources
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action: kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ebs-key'

  EbsEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-ebs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EbsEncryptionKey

  InstanceLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-lt'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1

  Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      Monitoring: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            VolumeSize: 30
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsEncryptionKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-instance-1'

  Instance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref InstanceLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt InstanceLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref InstanceProfile
      Monitoring: true
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:

    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the EC2 alarm notification SNS topic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Test DynamoDB table with CloudWatch health and performance alarms.

Parameters:
  ReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    Description: Receiving region used as the ReceivingRegion dimension for replication alarms.

Resources:
  DynamoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-test-table"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the DynamoDB alarm SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmPublishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-alarm-topic"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} DynamoDB Alarms"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: testing

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when write throttle events occur on the table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests-PutItem"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when PutItem requests are throttled on the table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
        - Name: Operation
          Value: PutItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ConditionalCheckFailedRequests"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when conditional check failures occur on the table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors"
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when DynamoDB user errors occur in this account and region.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors-PutItem"

      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      AlarmActions:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Content-level PII classification scanner for S3 Access Point objects using
  Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities, with results stored in DynamoDB and
  optional SNS notifications. The target access point ARN is passed in the
  invocation payload (accessPointArn). By default the Lambda runs outside any
  VPC, which only works for internet-origin access points. For VPC-origin
  access points, supply VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds.
  Optional S3/DynamoDB Gateway and Comprehend/SNS Interface endpoints are
  created when CreateVpcEndpoints is true. No CloudWatch Logs or S3 Control
  endpoints are created, so an in-VPC Lambda without a Logs endpoint or NAT
  cannot ship logs, and the advisory network-origin self-check is skipped
  when the function is VPC-attached.

# External precondition (outside this template's scope): the bucket behind the
# access point must delegate access control to access points in its bucket
# policy. If it does not, GetObject through the access point will be denied.

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Leave empty for internet-origin access points. Set only when
      'aws s3control get-access-point' returns NetworkOrigin: VPC; the Lambda
      is then deployed inside this VPC.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Private subnet IDs inside VpcId for the Lambda and Interface endpoints.
      Supply only when VpcId is set.
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Security group ID used only when VpcId is set. Must allow outbound 443,
      and inbound 443 from itself so Interface endpoints attached to it accept
      traffic from the Lambda.
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Route table IDs that receive the S3 and DynamoDB Gateway endpoints when
      endpoints are created. Used only when VpcId is set.
  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: >-
      Create S3/DynamoDB Gateway and Comprehend/SNS Interface endpoints when
      VpcId is set. Set to "false" if the target VPC already has any S3,
      DynamoDB, Comprehend, or SNS endpoint, because duplicates fail and roll
      back the stack.
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Scanner Lambda memory size in MB.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Scanner Lambda timeout in seconds.
  DefaultLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: "en"
    AllowedValues: ["en", "es"]
    Description: Default Comprehend language code (languages supported by DetectPiiEntities).
  DefaultMaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: Default maximum number of files scanned per invocation (per-invocation cost and runtime cap).
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to PII findings notifications.

Conditions:
  DeployInVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition DeployInVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, "true"]
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, ""]]

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: scanId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: objectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: scanId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: objectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS

  FindingsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the PII scanner findings SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  FindingsTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-pii-findings"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FindingsTopicKey

  FindingsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: PII Scanner Findings
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt FindingsTopicKey.Arn

  FindingsEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref FindingsTopic

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - DeployInVpc
        - - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole"
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pii-scanner
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadThroughAccessPointsOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*/object/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:DataAccessPointAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              - Sid: AccessPointOriginSelfCheck
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*"
              - Sid: ComprehendDetectPii
                Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: WriteReports
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: PublishFindings
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref FindingsTopic
              - Sid: UseFindingsTopicKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt FindingsTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub "sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ScannerLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${ScannerLogGroup}:*"

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ScannerLogGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Content-level PII scanner for S3 Access Point objects using Comprehend DetectPiiEntities
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ScannerLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      VpcConfig: !If
        - DeployInVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ReportTable
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref FindingsTopic
          NOTIFY_ENABLED: !If [HasNotificationEmail, "true", "false"]
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref DefaultLanguageCode
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES: !Ref DefaultMaxFiles
          IN_VPC: !If [DeployInVpc, "true", "false"]
          SAMPLE_BYTES: "1048576"
          MAX_OBJECT_BYTES: "1073741824"
          MIN_SCORE: "0.8"
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os,uuid,time,json,logging,boto3
          from decimal import Decimal as D
          from botocore.config import Config
          L=logging.getLogger();L.setLevel(logging.INFO);E=os.environ
          C=Config(retries={'max_attempts':5,'mode':'adaptive'})
          s3=boto3.client('s3',config=C);cp=boto3.client('comprehend',config=C)
          T=boto3.resource('dynamodb',config=C).Table(E['TABLE_NAME'])
          X=('.txt','.csv','.tsv','.json','.log','.md','.xml','.html','.yaml','.yml','.sql','.eml')
          def chunks(t,n=90000):
           b=t.encode();i=0
           while i<len(b):
            j=min(i+n,len(b))
            while j<len(b) and b[j]&0xC0==0x80:j-=1
            yield b[i:j].decode('utf-8','replace');i=j
          def origin(ap):
           try:
            p=ap.split(':');c=boto3.client('s3control',config=Config(connect_timeout=3,read_timeout=5,retries={'max_attempts':1}))
            o=c.get_access_point(AccountId=p[4],Name=p[5].split('/',1)[1]).get('NetworkOrigin')
            if o=='VPC':L.warning('NetworkOrigin=VPC but function is not VPC-attached; set VpcId/SubnetIds/SecurityGroupId')
           except Exception as x:L.info('origin check skipped: %s',x)
          def text(ap,k):
           if k.lower().endswith(X):return 1
           ct=s3.head_object(Bucket=ap,Key=k).get('ContentType','')
           return ct.startswith('text/') or ct in('application/json','application/xml')
          def scan(ap,k,sz,lc,sb,ms):
           a={'Bucket':ap,'Key':k}
           if sz>sb:a['Range']='bytes=0-%d'%(sb-1)
           t=s3.get_object(**a)['Body'].read().decode('utf-8','replace')
           c,m,f={},{},[]
           for i,ch in enumerate(chunks(t)):
            if not ch.strip():continue
            for e in cp.detect_pii_entities(Text=ch,LanguageCode=lc)['Entities']:
             if e['Score']<ms:continue
             y=e['Type'];s=D(str(round(e['Score'],4)));c[y]=c.get(y,0)+1;m[y]=max(m.get(y,s),s)
             if len(f)<50:f.append({'type':y,'chunk':i,'begin':e['BeginOffset'],'end':e['EndOffset']})
           return {'bytesScanned':min(sz,sb),'sampled':sz>sb,'piiFound':bool(c),'entityCounts':c,'maxScores':m,'offsets':f}
          def handler(ev,ctx):
           g=ev.get;ap=ev['accessPointArn'];mx=int(g('maxFiles',E['DEFAULT_MAX_FILES']));lc=g('languageCode',E['DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE'])
           sb=int(g('sampleBytes',E['SAMPLE_BYTES']));ms=float(g('minScore',E['MIN_SCORE']));mb=int(E['MAX_OBJECT_BYTES'])
           sid=g('scanId') or str(uuid.uuid4());tok=g('continuationToken');n=sk=er=0;hits=[]
           if E['IN_VPC']!='true':origin(ap)
           with T.batch_writer(overwrite_by_pkeys=['scanId','objectKey']) as w:
            while n<mx:
             a={'Bucket':ap,'MaxKeys':min(1000,mx-n),'Prefix':g('prefix','')}
             if tok:a['ContinuationToken']=tok
             p=s3.list_objects_v2(**a);tok=p.get('NextContinuationToken')
             for o in p.get('Contents',[]):
              k,sz=o['Key'],o['Size'];n+=1
              it={'scanId':sid,'objectKey':k,'accessPointArn':ap,'sizeBytes':sz,'languageCode':lc,'scannedAt':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime())}
              try:
               if k.endswith('/') or sz==0 or sz>mb or not text(ap,k):it['status']='SKIPPED';sk+=1
               else:
                it.update(scan(ap,k,sz,lc,sb,ms));it['status']='SCANNED'
                if it['piiFound']:hits.append(k)
              except Exception as x:it['status']='ERROR';it['error']=str(x)[:500];er+=1;L.warning('%s: %s',k,x)
              w.put_item(Item=it)
             if not tok or ctx.get_remaining_time_in_millis()<60000:break
           r={'scanId':sid,'objectsScanned':n,'objectsWithPii':len(hits),'skipped':sk,'errors':er,'nextContinuationToken':tok}
           if hits and E['NOTIFY_ENABLED']=='true':
            boto3.client('sns').publish(TopicArn=E['TOPIC_ARN'],Subject='PII scan %s: %d object(s) with PII'%(sid[:8],len(hits)),Message=json.dumps(dict(r,accessPointArn=ap,keys=hits[:200]),indent=1))
           L.info(json.dumps(r));return r

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the AWS Glue Data Catalog databases and tables for querying Amazon
  Neptune property-graph (LPG) and RDF data, for example through the Amazon
  Athena Neptune connector. Only catalog metadata is created.

Parameters:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the Glue database that holds the property-graph (LPG) tables.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

  RDFGlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the Glue database that holds the RDF tables.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue databases
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
        Description: Glue database with tables describing Neptune property-graph (LPG) vertices, edges and views.

  GraphDatabaseRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RDFGlueDatabaseName
        Description: Glue database with tables describing Neptune RDF data queried by class or SPARQL.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LPG tables
  # Tables describe Neptune data rather than S3 data, so StorageDescriptor
  # Location and SerDe settings are left out. If a downstream tool needs a
  # Location, add a placeholder only after checking it is valid.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: edge
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: out
              Type: string
            - Name: in
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: view
          query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').as('source').out('route').as('destination').select('source','destination').by('code').limit(10)"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: source
              Type: string
            - Name: destination
              Type: string

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDF tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AirportRDFTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: class
          classuri: 'class:Airport'
          subject: id
          preds_prefix: prop
          strip_uri: 'true'
          prefix_class: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/'
          prefix_prop: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  RouteRDFTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: sparql
          strip_uri: 'true'
          prefix_prop: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/'
          prefix_op: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/'
          sparql: 'select ?incode ?outcode ?dist where { ?resin op:route ?resout . GRAPH ?route { ?resin op:route ?resout } . ?route prop:dist ?dist . ?resin prop:code ?incode . ?resout prop:code ?outcode . }'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  RouteRDFNoPrefixTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: sparql
          strip_uri: 'true'
          sparql: 'select ?incode ?outcode ?dist where { ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route> ?resout . GRAPH ?route { ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route> ?resout } . ?route <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/dist> ?dist . ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?incode . ?resout <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?outcode . }'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

Outputs:
  GraphDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database for property-graph (LPG) tables.
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabase

  GraphDatabaseParameterName:
    Description: LPG Glue database name supplied through the GlueDatabaseName parameter.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabaseName

  GraphDatabaseRDFName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables.
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabaseRDF

  GraphDatabaseRDFParameterName:
    Description: RDF Glue database name supplied through the RDFGlueDatabaseName parameter.
    Value: !Ref RDFGlueDatabaseName

  LPGTableNames:
    Description: Tables created in the property-graph (LPG) Glue database.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AirportTable
        - !Ref CountryTable
        - !Ref ContinentTable
        - !Ref RouteTable
        - !Ref CustomAirportTable

  RDFTableNames:
    Description: Tables created in the RDF Glue database.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AirportRDFTable
        - !Ref RouteRDFTable
        - !Ref RouteRDFNoPrefixTable

      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA

        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email

          Required: true
          Mutable: true

        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

      IdTokenValidity: 1

      AllowClassicFlow: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
        - Key: Component
          Value: provisioning

  ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Authenticated role for the ${AWS::StackName} PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning identity pool'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-auth-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTTrustedUserProvisioningClaim
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateProvisioningClaim
                  - iot:DescribeProvisioningTemplate
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:provisioningtemplate/*'
              - Sid: IoTListProvisioningTemplates
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:ListProvisioningTemplates
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${ProvisioningIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
        - Key: Component
          Value: provisioning

  ProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Unauthenticated role for the ${AWS::StackName} PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning identity pool'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-unauth-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-identity:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${ProvisioningIdentityPool}'
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
        - Key: Component
          Value: provisioning

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Production DNS stack for radiotopia.fm. Creates the public Route 53 hosted zone,
  all production DNS record sets (email authentication, web apex, CloudFront aliases,
  ACM validation, and third-party vendor verification/DKIM), and the CloudFront
  distributions with private, KMS-encrypted S3 origins and a shared WAFv2 Web ACL
  backing the media, tower, v1, and plus subdomains. Deploy in us-east-1.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
    Description: Deployment environment tag value.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-google-site-verification
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Google site verification token (value after "google-site-verification=").

  SecondaryDomainVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-secondary-domain-verification
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9=._:-]+$'
    MaxLength: 250
    Description: Second vendor domain-ownership verification TXT value published at the apex.

  DmarcReportMailbox:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc-reports@radiotopia.fm
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$'
    Description: Mailbox that receives DMARC aggregate reports.

  SquarespaceVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: replace-me-squarespace-verify
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: Squarespace domain-verification CNAME label (record becomes <token>.radiotopia.fm.).

  AcmMediaValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder-media.radiotopia.fm.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME name for the media.radiotopia.fm certificate.
  AcmMediaValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME value for the media.radiotopia.fm certificate.

  AcmTowerValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder-tower.radiotopia.fm.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME name for the tower.radiotopia.fm certificate.
  AcmTowerValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME value for the tower.radiotopia.fm certificate.

  AcmV1ValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder-v1.radiotopia.fm.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME name for the v1.radiotopia.fm certificate.
  AcmV1ValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME value for the v1.radiotopia.fm certificate.

  AcmPlusValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder-plus.radiotopia.fm.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME name for the plus.radiotopia.fm certificate.
  AcmPlusValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _placeholder.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation CNAME value for the plus.radiotopia.fm certificate.

  FeedProxyHostname:
    Type: String
    Default: replace-me.feed-proxy.example.com.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.$'
    Description: Fully-qualified feed-proxy hostname (with trailing dot) for feeds.radiotopia.fm.

  EventIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.0.2.10
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])$'
    Description: IPv4 address for the live.radiotopia.fm special event subdomain.

  GoogleDkimKeyPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-google-dkim-part1
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 237
    Description: First chunk of the Google Workspace DKIM public key (p= value), max 237 chars.
  GoogleDkimKeyPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-google-dkim-part2
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 253
    Description: Remaining chunk of the Google Workspace DKIM public key, max 253 chars.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-zendesk-verification
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 253
    Description: Zendesk domain verification token published at zendeskverification.radiotopia.fm.

  CampaignMonitorDkimKeyPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-campaign-monitor-dkim-part1
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 244
    Description: First chunk of the Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (p= value), max 244 chars.
  CampaignMonitorDkimKeyPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE-ME-campaign-monitor-dkim-part2
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 253
    Description: Remaining chunk of the Campaign Monitor DKIM public key, max 253 chars.

  SquarespaceDkim1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: replace-me-sqs1._domainkey.radiotopia.fm.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+\._domainkey\.radiotopia\.fm\.$'
    Description: First Squarespace email campaigns DKIM CNAME name.
  SquarespaceDkim1Target:
    Type: String
    Default: replace-me-sqs1.dkim.squarespace-mail.com.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.$'
    Description: First Squarespace email campaigns DKIM CNAME target.
  SquarespaceDkim2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: replace-me-sqs2._domainkey.radiotopia.fm.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+\._domainkey\.radiotopia\.fm\.$'
    Description: Second Squarespace email campaigns DKIM CNAME name.
  SquarespaceDkim2Target:
    Type: String
    Default: replace-me-sqs2.dkim.squarespace-mail.com.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.$'
    Description: Second Squarespace email campaigns DKIM CNAME target.

Mappings:
  ProviderEndpoints:
    CloudFront:
      AliasHostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
    Squarespace:
      WebTarget: ext-cust.squarespace.com.
      VerifyTarget: verify.squarespace.com.
    Google:
      MxHost: 1 smtp.google.com.
    MailChimp:
      DkimK2Target: dkim2.mcsv.net.
      DkimK3Target: dkim3.mcsv.net.
    Zendesk:
      Dkim1Target: zendesk1._domainkey.zendesk.com.
      Dkim2Target: zendesk2._domainkey.zendesk.com.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public production hosted zone for radiotopia.fm
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key for S3 origin bucket encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for radiotopia.fm CloudFront S3 origin buckets
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontOacUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # WAFv2 Web ACL shared by all CloudFront distributions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontWebAcl:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudfront-web-acl'
      Description: Shared Web ACL for radiotopia.fm CloudFront distributions
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: RadiotopiaCloudFrontWebAcl
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
        - Name: RateLimitPerIp
          Priority: 3
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitPerIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 origin buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: media.radiotopia.fm

  TowerBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: tower.radiotopia.fm

  V1Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: v1.radiotopia.fm

  PlusBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: plus.radiotopia.fm

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront Origin Access Controls
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaOriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-media-oac'
        Description: OAC for the media.radiotopia.fm S3 origin
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  TowerOriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tower-oac'
        Description: OAC for the tower.radiotopia.fm S3 origin
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  V1OriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-v1-oac'
        Description: OAC for the v1.radiotopia.fm S3 origin
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  PlusOriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-plus-oac'
        Description: OAC for the plus.radiotopia.fm S3 origin
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distributions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: radiotopia.fm production - media
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: MediaS3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt MediaBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt MediaOriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: MediaS3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
          ResponseHeadersPolicyId: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: radiotopia
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Subdomain
          Value: media.radiotopia.fm

  TowerDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: radiotopia.fm production - tower
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CloudFrontWebAcl.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: TowerS3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt TowerBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt TowerOriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: TowerS3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6

            - !Sub '"${SecondaryDomainVerificationToken}"'
        - Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm.

          TTL: '300'
          ResourceRecords:

        - Name: radiotopia.fm.

        - Name: www.radiotopia.fm.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP protocol) for a protein variant
  effect prediction agent, including a Lambda gateway target, a Cognito custom JWT
  authorizer, a least-privilege gateway IAM role, and SSM parameters publishing the
  configuration.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deployment note (greenfield vs. brownfield):
# The original request asks for the Lambda ARN, the Cognito discovery URL and the
# Cognito client ID to be read from existing SSM parameters. This template targets
# a greenfield account where those parameters do not exist. Resolving them with
# {{resolve:ssm:...}} or AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<String> would fail at deploy
# time. So this template creates minimal stand-ins for those dependencies (backend
# Lambda + Cognito user pool/client), publishes their values to SSM, and references
# them directly with !Ref / !GetAtt.
# In a brownfield account, the stand-in resources (BackendFunction,
# BackendFunctionRole, UserPool, UserPoolDomain, UserPoolResourceServer,
# UserPoolClient and the *Parameter resources) can be replaced with SSM parameter
# lookups, e.g. Parameters typed as AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<String>.
#
# Region note: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway and AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
# are newer resource types. Confirm they are available in the target region
# (e.g. us-east-1) before deploying. If cfn-lint does not recognize them, update
# the cfn-lint resource specifications (cfn-lint --update-specs).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must start with a letter or number; max 41 characters.
    Description: Project name used in resource names, SSM parameter paths and tags.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway exposing protein variant effect prediction tools via MCP
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description of the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^([0-9a-zA-Z][-]?){1,100}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alphanumeric characters with single hyphens between them, up to 100 characters, or blank.
    Description: Optional gateway name. Leave blank to generate one from the project name (<ProjectName>-gateway).

Conditions:
  HasCustomGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Backend stand-in: Lambda function implementing the MCP tools
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BackendFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-backend-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Application
          Value: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  BackendFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-variant-effect-backend'
      Description: Stand-in backend for protein variant effect prediction tools exposed through the AgentCore Gateway.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt BackendFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          VALID_AMINO_ACIDS = set("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY")


          def _tool_name(context):
              """Extract the tool name from the AgentCore Gateway client context.

              The gateway sends the name as '<target-name>___<tool-name>'.
              """
              try:
                  custom = context.client_context.custom or {}
              except AttributeError:
                  custom = {}
              full_name = custom.get("bedrockAgentCoreToolName", "")
              return full_name.split("___")[-1] if full_name else ""


          def _invoke_endpoint(event):
              sequence = str(event.get("sequence", "")).strip().upper()
              if not sequence:
                  return {"error": "The 'sequence' argument is required."}
              invalid = sorted(set(sequence) - VALID_AMINO_ACIDS)
              if invalid:
                  return {"error": "Sequence contains invalid residues: " + "".join(invalid)}
              variants = event.get("variants") or []
              return {
                  "job_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                  "status": "SUBMITTED",
                  "sequence_length": len(sequence),
                  "variant_count": len(variants),
                  "submitted_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              }


          def _get_results(event):
              job_id = str(event.get("job_id", "")).strip()
              if not job_id:
                  return {"error": "The 'job_id' argument is required."}
              return {
                  "job_id": job_id,
                  "status": "COMPLETED",
                  "results": {
                      "message": "Stub result: replace this backend with the real prediction service.",
                      "predictions": [],
                  },
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              event = event or {}
              tool = _tool_name(context)
              if tool == "invoke_endpoint":
                  response = _invoke_endpoint(event)
              elif tool == "get_results":
                  response = _get_results(event)
              else:
                  response = {"error": "Unknown tool: " + (tool or "<none>")}
              print(json.dumps({"tool": tool, "has_error": "error" in response}))
              return response
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Application
          Value: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Auth stand-in: Cognito user pool for machine-to-machine JWT auth
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-userpool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke tools exposed by the AgentCore Gateway
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read job results through the AgentCore Gateway

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway/invoke'
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dependency configuration published to SSM Parameter Store
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/lambda-arn'
      Description: ARN of the backend Lambda function used as the AgentCore Gateway target.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-discovery-url'
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL of the Cognito user pool used by the gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-client-id'
      Description: Cognito app client ID allowed by the gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  CognitoUserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/cognito-user-pool-id'
      Description: Cognito user pool ID backing the gateway JWT authorizer.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway IAM role (least privilege)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: Service role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the backend Lambda target.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeBackendLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Application
          Value: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway (MCP) with Cognito custom JWT authorizer
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Gateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If [HasCustomGatewayName, !Ref GatewayName, !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway']
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SupportedVersions:
            - '2025-03-26'
          Instructions: Tools for submitting protein sequences for variant effect prediction and retrieving job results.
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Application: protein-variant-effect-prediction

  BackendFunctionGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref BackendFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway target: Lambda with inline MCP tool schema
  # (GatewayTarget does not support Tags, so none are set here.)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    DependsOn:
      - GatewayRole
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-target'
      Description: Lambda target exposing protein variant effect prediction tools.
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: Submit a protein sequence (and optional variants) for variant effect prediction. Returns a job ID.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Description: Prediction job submission request.
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Wild-type protein sequence using one-letter amino acid codes.
                      variants:
                        Type: array
                        Description: Optional list of variants to score, e.g. A123V.
                        Items:
                          Type: string
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: Check the completion status of a prediction job and retrieve its results.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Description: Job status request.
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Job ID returned by invoke_endpoint.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayIdentifier
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayId'

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayArn'

  GatewayUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt Gateway.GatewayUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayUrl'

  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArn'

  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name storing the gateway role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayRoleArnParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayRoleArnParameterName'

  GatewayTargetId:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway Lambda target.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayTarget.TargetId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayTargetId'

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the backend Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt BackendFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-LambdaFunctionArn'

  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID used for gateway authentication.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoUserPoolId'

  CognitoClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID allowed by the gateway JWT authorizer.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoClientId'

  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoDiscoveryUrl'

  CognitoTokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for client_credentials tokens.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CognitoTokenEndpoint'
