AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC for secured application deployment, with optional NAT egress and a KMS-encrypted artifact bucket.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway (used only when NAT is enabled).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Set to true to create a NAT Gateway for outbound internet egress (OAuth / external IdP flows).

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, "true"]

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  AlbPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-private-subnet-1"

  AlbPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-private-subnet-2"

  LambdaPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lambda-private-subnet"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  AlbPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw"

  PrivateNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates one Step Functions state machine (a STANDARD two-step Pass workflow) behind two
  separate regional API Gateway REST APIs. One API exposes a GET endpoint and the other
  exposes a POST endpoint. Each API has its own least-privilege IAM role that can start
  executions of the state machine and nothing else. Each API is deployed to its own
  throttled stage.

Resources:
  # Step Functions
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Simple two-step pass workflow
        StartAt: StepOne
        States:
          StepOne:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              step: one
            ResultPath: $.stepOne
            Next: StepTwo
          StepTwo:
            Type: Pass
            Result:
              step: two
            ResultPath: $.stepTwo
            End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # IAM roles for API Gateway
  GetApiStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PostApiStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # GET API
  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-api'
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts a Step Functions execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            #set($qs = $input.params().querystring)
            {
              "input": "{#foreach($key in $qs.keySet())\"$util.escapeJavaScript($key)\": \"$util.escapeJavaScript($qs.get($key))\"#if($foreach.hasNext),#end#end}",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      Description: Deployment of the GET API

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      StageName: getstage
      Description: Stage for the GET API
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 10
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # POST API
  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-api'
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts a Step Functions execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))",
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: "$input.json('$')"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      Description: Deployment of the POST API

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
      StageName: poststage
      Description: Stage for the POST API
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 10
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachine.Name

    Description: ID of the GET REST API
    Value: !Ref GetApi
  PostApiId:
    Description: ID of the POST REST API
    Value: !Ref PostApi

    Description: Stage name of the GET API
    Value: !Ref GetApiStage
  PostApiStageName:
    Description: Stage name of the POST API
    Value: !Ref PostApiStage
  GetApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the GET endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${GetApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${GetApiStage}/execution'
  PostApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${PostApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${PostApiStage}/execution'

    Value: !GetAtt PostApiStartExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights - Foundation IAM roles and Secrets Manager secrets for the
  Hospitality Insights project. NOTE - this template defines IAM roles with explicit
  RoleNames and must be deployed with the CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM capability.

Metadata:
  DeploymentNotes:
    Capabilities: >-
      This stack creates IAM roles with explicit RoleName values. Deploy with
      --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.
    DownstreamResources: >-
      DynamoDB tables, SQS queues, SNS topics, S3 buckets and Step Functions state
      machines are created by other stacks. Permissions in this stack are scoped by
      the name prefix <ProjectName>-<Environment>-* so no literal IDs are needed.
    Secrets: >-
      Both secrets are created with generated placeholder values and use the default
      AWS-managed KMS key (aws/secretsmanager). An operator must replace the
      ScrapingBee placeholder with the real API key after deployment. Both secrets are
      retained on stack deletion or replacement.
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - Environment
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project name
      Environment:
        default: Deployment environment

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: ProjectName may contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used as a prefix for resource names, ARNs, secrets and tags.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scraper Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights scraper Lambda functions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: SQSConsumeAndProduce
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: S3RawDataWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: ReadScrapingBeeSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Ref ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bedrock AgentCore runtime role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Only bedrock-agentcore actions confirmed in the IAM Service Authorization
  # Reference are listed (GetWorkloadAccessToken, GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT,
  # GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId, CreateEvent, ListEvents, GetMemoryRecord).
  # No speculative action names are used. No AWS::BedrockAgentCore::* resources
  # are created in this template; only the execution role is in scope.
  AgentCoreRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights Bedrock AgentCore runtime.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessToken
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workload-identity-directory/default/workload-identity/*'
              - Sid: AgentCoreSessionMemory

                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateEvent
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListEvents
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetMemoryRecord
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:memory/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: S3Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/*'
              - Sid: S3ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: RuntimeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
              - Sid: RuntimeLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: RuntimeDescribeLogGroups

                Action:

                  - xray:PutTraceSegments

                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics

                Action:

                Resource: '*'

          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

        - Key: Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Audit events SQS queue stack with KMS encryption and key rotation, an optional
  dead letter queue for non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for old messages
  and DLQ activity, and SNS alerting for alarm notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Description: Application name used as the prefix for all resource names
    Default: audit-events
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address that receives alarm notifications. Leave empty to skip the subscription.
    Default: ''

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 3600
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 3
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 604800
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 1800
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 2
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 900
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 1

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Resources:
  AuditKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit events queues and alarm topic'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqMessageRetentionPeriod]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditQueuesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref AuditEventsQueue
        - !If [IsNotDev, !Ref DeadLetterQueue, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !If
              - IsNotDev
              - - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
                - !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
              - - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  OldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Triggers when the oldest message in the ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit events queue exceeds the environment age threshold, indicating consumers are falling behind or stalled.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AlarmEvaluationPeriods]
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageAgeThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-audit-events-dlq-messages'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Triggers when any message is visible in the ${ApplicationName}-${Environment} audit events dead letter queue, indicating messages failed processing.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:

    Description: URL of the audit events queue
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsQueueName:
    Description: Name of the audit events queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName

  DeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueue

  DeadLetterQueueArn:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the audit data
    Value: !GetAtt AuditKmsKey.Arn

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key encrypting the audit data
    Value: !Ref AuditKmsKeyAlias

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  OldestMessageAgeAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the oldest message age alarm
    Value: !Ref OldestMessageAgeAlarm

  DeadLetterQueueAlarmName:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: Name of the dead letter queue activity alarm
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito identity stack for the researchapp / AgentCore application. Creates a user pool
  with optional software-token MFA, admin and customer groups, a hosted domain, a custom
  resource server, web and machine-to-machine app clients, an unwired post-confirmation
  group-assignment Lambda, and SSM parameters under /app/researchapp/agentcore/.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine (client credentials) app client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web (authorization code) app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators of researchapp AgentCore
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers of researchapp AgentCore
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore
      Name: researchapp-agentcore-api
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp AgentCore resources

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  GroupAssignmentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the researchapp AgentCore post-confirmation group assignment function
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AddUserToCustomerGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  # Post-confirmation group assignment function. Intentionally NOT wired as an active trigger.
  # To activate it later, add LambdaConfig.PostConfirmation to the user pool referencing this
  # function's ARN and add an AWS::Lambda::Permission allowing cognito-idp.amazonaws.com to
  # invoke it (SourceArn set to the user pool ARN).
  GroupAssignmentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group (inactive trigger)
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt GroupAssignmentRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          GROUP_NAME: !Ref CustomerGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp":
                  return event
              group_name = os.environ["GROUP_NAME"]
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=event["userPoolId"],
                  Username=event["userName"],
                  GroupName=group_name,
              )
              logger.info("Added user to group %s", group_name)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  GroupAssignmentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${GroupAssignmentFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # The M2M client secret is stored in Secrets Manager (encrypted at rest) instead of a
  # plain-text SSM String parameter. SSM only stores the secret's ARN.
  MachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-secret
      Description: Client credentials for the researchapp AgentCore machine-to-machine app client
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${MachineAppClient}","client_secret":"${MachineAppClient.ClientSecret}"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: researchapp
        - Key: Component
          Value: AgentCore

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-arn
      Description: Cognito user pool ARN for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-client-id
      Description: Web app client ID (authorization code flow) for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-id
      Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID (client credentials flow) for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  MachineClientSecretArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-secret-arn
      Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the machine-to-machine client secret
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClientSecret
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  MachineScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-oauth-scopes
      Description: OAuth scopes granted to the machine-to-machine client
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp-agentcore/read
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  WebScopesParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-oauth-scopes
      Description: OAuth scopes granted to the web app client (space separated)
      Type: String
      Value: openid email profile researchapp-agentcore/read
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery-url
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the researchapp AgentCore user pool
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token-url
      Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for the researchapp AgentCore Cognito domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  AuthorizeUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize-url
      Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint for the researchapp AgentCore Cognito domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito-domain
      Description: Cognito hosted domain for researchapp AgentCore
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Tags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Web app client ID
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineAppClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
  MachineClientSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing the machine client secret
    Value: !Ref MachineClientSecret
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain
    Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  TokenUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  AuthorizeUrl:
    Description: OAuth2 authorize endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
  GroupAssignmentFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the unwired post-confirmation group assignment Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt GroupAssignmentFunction.Arn
  SsmParameterPath:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path holding the configuration
    Value: /app/researchapp/agentcore/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the CryptoTickerAPI AWS AppSync GraphQL API with an HTTP data source for
  the CoinGecko API and a DynamoDB data source (APIDataTable) for ticker price history.

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: CryptoTickerAPI

  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AWS AppSync to push CryptoTickerAPI logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: CryptoTickerAPI

  APIDataTableDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AWS AppSync to read and write price history in APIDataTable
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: APIDataTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CoinGeckoDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS AppSync for the CoinGecko HTTP data source
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CoinGeckoHttpDataSourceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - appsync:GetDataSource
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:appsync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:apis/${CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId}/datasources/CoinGeckoDataSource

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: HTTP data source for the public CoinGecko price API
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSourceRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  APIDataTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source storing ticker price history
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        UseCallerCredentials: false

  CryptoTickerAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          priceUsd: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord!]!
          nextToken: String
        }

  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: FetchTickerPriceFunction
      Description: Fetches the current USD price for a ticker from CoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const id = ctx.args.symbol.trim().toLowerCase();
          return {
            method: 'GET',
            resourcePath: '/api/v3/simple/price',
            params: {
              query: { ids: id, vs_currencies: 'usd' },
              headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          if (ctx.result.statusCode !== 200) {
            util.error(`CoinGecko returned status ${ctx.result.statusCode}`, 'UpstreamError');
          }
          const id = ctx.args.symbol.trim().toLowerCase();
          const body = JSON.parse(ctx.result.body);
          const entry = body[id];
          if (!entry || entry.usd === undefined || entry.usd === null) {
            util.error(`No price found for ticker ${id}`, 'NotFound');
          }
          return { ticker: id, priceUsd: entry.usd };
        }

  StoreTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: StoreTickerPriceFunction
      Description: Stores a historical price record for the ticker in APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { ticker, priceUsd } = ctx.prev.result;
          const timestamp = util.time.nowISO8601();
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ hk: ticker, sk: timestamp }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ticker, priceUsd, timestamp }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return {
            ticker: ctx.result.ticker,
            priceUsd: ctx.result.priceUsd,
            timestamp: ctx.result.timestamp,
          };
        }

  TickerQueryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const limit = ctx.args.limit ?? 25;
          const query = {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: '#hk = :hk',
              expressionNames: { '#hk': 'hk' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':hk': ctx.source.ticker }),
            },
            scanIndexForward: false,
            limit: limit,
          };
          if (ctx.args.nextToken) {
            query.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          return query;
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return {
            items: ctx.result.items ?? [],
            nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken ?? null,
          };
        }

  CryptoTickerAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID of the CryptoTickerAPI AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL of the CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the CryptoTickerAPI AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.Arn
  ApiKey:
    Description: Default API key for calling the CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPIKey.ApiKey

    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores price history
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable
  APIDataTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table that stores price history
    Value: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Elemental MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints,
  plus optional VOD (packaging group and configurations backed by a stack-created source
  bucket) and live-to-VOD archiving support (stack-created archive bucket, customer managed
  KMS encryption key, and IAM role).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming and Tagging
        Parameters:
          - LogicalNamePrefix
          - Environment
          - CustomTagKey
          - CustomTagValue
      - Label:
          default: Live Packaging
        Parameters:
          - OutputType
          - ManifestName
          - HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
          - StartoverWindowSeconds
      - Label:
          default: VOD and Live-to-VOD
        Parameters:
          - ArchiveBucket
          - VodSourceBucket

Parameters:
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: live-stream
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must start with a letter or number; max 31 characters.
    Description: Prefix used for every resource Id and name.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment, applied as the Environment tag.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key. Leave empty to skip the custom tag.

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value (used only when CustomTagKey is set).

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Which origin endpoint(s) and VOD packaging configuration(s) to create.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-64 characters of letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
    Description: Manifest name for the origin endpoints and the VOD packaging manifests.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: HLS segment duration in seconds (live HLS endpoint and VOD HLS configuration).

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the origin endpoints (0 disables startover).

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Empty, or up to 21 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens starting with a letter or number.
    Description: >-
      Name suffix for a stack-created live-to-VOD archive bucket. A non-empty value enables
      archiving and sets origin endpoint Origination to DENY. Leave empty to disable.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Empty, or up to 21 lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens starting with a letter or number.
    Description: >-
      Name suffix for a stack-created VOD source content bucket. A non-empty value enables
      the VOD workflow. Leave empty to disable.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, '']]
  EnableArchive: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  EnableVod: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  EnableBucketAccess: !Or
    - !Condition EnableArchive
    - !Condition EnableVod
  CreateHls: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDash: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateVodHls: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Condition CreateHls
  CreateVodDash: !And
    - !Condition EnableVod
    - !Condition CreateDash

Resources:
  BucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: EnableBucketAccess
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${LogicalNamePrefix} MediaPackage VOD source and live-to-VOD archive buckets'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseByAccountPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-media-buckets-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  BucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: EnableBucketAccess
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${LogicalNamePrefix}-media-buckets'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BucketEncryptionKey

  ArchiveS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EnableArchive
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-${ArchiveBucket}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-archive'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EnableVod
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-${VodSourceBucket}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-source'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EnableArchive
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
              - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'

  VodSourceS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleBucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
              - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageRoleObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3Role.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'

  MediaPackageS3Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBucketAccess
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mp-s3-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Allows AWS Elemental MediaPackage to read VOD source content and write live-to-VOD archives.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - !If
          - EnableVod
          - PolicyName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-source-read'
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: VodSourceBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                    - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                  Resource: !GetAtt VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn
                - Sid: VodSourceObjectRead
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                  Resource: !Sub '${VodSourceS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
                - Sid: VodSourceKeyDecrypt
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'kms:Decrypt'
                    - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  Resource: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - EnableArchive
          - PolicyName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-archive-write'
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Sid: ArchiveBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                    - 's3:GetBucketRequestPayment'
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                  Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn
                - Sid: ArchiveObjectReadWrite
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                    - 's3:PutObject'
                  Resource: !Sub '${ArchiveS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
                - Sid: ArchiveKeyUse
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'kms:Decrypt'
                    - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                    - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  Resource: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LiveChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'Live streaming channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref LiveChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - EnableArchive
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 60
        PlaylistType: NONE
        AdMarkers: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref LiveChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${LogicalNamePrefix}'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - EnableArchive
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestWindowSeconds: 60
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        MinUpdatePeriodSeconds: 15
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
        Profile: NONE
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: EnableVod
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodHlsConfig:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-hls'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            AdMarkers: NONE
            IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
            RepeatExtXKey: false
            ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodDashConfig:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-dash'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            ManifestLayout: FULL
            MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
            Profile: NONE
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-vod-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the IAM roles, instance profiles and managed policies that Cluster API
  Provider AWS (CAPA) needs for EC2-based and EKS-based cluster lifecycle
  management. Deploy with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:
  ControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cloud Provider AWS Control Plane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ControlPlaneCompute
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cluster API Provider AWS Controllers
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: NetworkingComputeAndLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateCarrierGateway
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate

              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute

              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint

              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate

              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress

              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:GetSecurityGroupsForVpc
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags

              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup

              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup

            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:autoscaling:*:${AWS::AccountId}:autoScalingGroup:*:autoScalingGroupName/*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingServiceLinkedRole

            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
            Condition:

            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': spot.amazonaws.com

            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io'
