            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:TagResource
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'

            Effect: Allow
            Action:

              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:access-entry/*'

  ControllersEksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers-eks.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cluster API Provider AWS Controllers (EKS)
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EksOptimizedAmiParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*:*:parameter/aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/*'
          - Sid: EksServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EksNodegroupServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EksFargateServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSForFargate'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'iam:AWSServiceName': eks-fargate.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: IamInspectionAndOidc
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:AddClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders
              - iam:TagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:UpdateOpenIDConnectProviderThumbprint
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: PassEksRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'iam:PassedToService': eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EksClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AssociateEncryptionConfig
              - eks:AssociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:CreateFargateProfile
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
              - eks:DescribeIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:DisassociateIdentityProviderConfig
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListIdentityProviderConfigs
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KmsForEksEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'kms:ResourceAliases': alias/cluster-api-provider-aws-*

  NodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: For the Kubernetes Cloud Provider AWS nodes
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: NodeEc2AndEcr
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr:ListImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NodeNetworkInterfaceTagging
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ec2:CreateTags
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
          - Sid: BootstrapSecretRetrieval
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: SsmSessionManager
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
            Resource: '*'

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksPolicy

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksPolicy

  NodesRole:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  DynamoDB table with configurable keys, PROVISIONED or on-demand billing, point-in-time
  recovery, and optional customer-managed KMS encryption and CloudWatch alarms that notify an SNS topic.

# Notes:
# - The table has DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy set to Retain. Deleting the stack
#   leaves the table and its data in place, so you must delete the table yourself.
# - The KMS key is also retained after the stack is deleted. Retained keys keep costing money
#   until you schedule them for deletion.
# - When EnableCustomerManagedKms is 'false', DynamoDB uses its default AWS-owned key,
#   so data is always encrypted at rest.
# - Changing the key schema (partition key or sort key) replaces the table. Because of
#   Retain, the old table stays and the new one fails to create while the name is taken.
#   Change the AppName or EnvironmentName, or migrate the data, before you change keys.
# - When AlertEmail is set, AWS sends a confirmation email. Alerts are delivered only
#   after someone confirms the subscription.
# - The SNS topic is encrypted with the customer-managed key only when CMK is enabled.
#   The AWS-managed key alias/aws/sns is never used, because CloudWatch cannot publish
#   to topics encrypted with it.
# - Alarms use plain metrics with only the TableName and Operation dimensions.
#   No SEARCH expressions are used.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: myapp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    Description: Application name used in resource names and tags.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    Description: Partition (HASH) key attribute name.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Partition key attribute type.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,255}$'
    Description: Sort (RANGE) key attribute name. Leave empty for no sort key.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Sort key attribute type. Used only when SortKeyName is set.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40000
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units. Used only with PROVISIONED billing.
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40000
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units. Used only with PROVISIONED billing.
  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Turn on point-in-time recovery.
  EnableCustomerManagedKms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Encrypt the table (and alarm topic) with a customer-managed KMS key.
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Create CloudWatch alarms and an SNS topic for alerts.
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to the alarm topic. Leave empty for no subscription.
  ThrottleAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Throttle events in 5 minutes at which the throttle alarms fire.
  SystemErrorAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: System errors in 5 minutes per operation at which the error alarms fire.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  PitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  UseCmk: !Equals [!Ref EnableCustomerManagedKms, 'true']
  CreateAlarms: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, 'true']
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]
  CreateEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarms
    - !Condition HasAlertEmail
  EncryptAlarmTopic: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarms
    - !Condition UseCmk

Resources:
  TableKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseCmk
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${AppName}-${EnvironmentName} DynamoDB table and alarm topic'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSNSToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TableKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseCmk
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableKmsKey

  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-table'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [PitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseCmk
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt TableKmsKey.Arn
        - SSEEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !If
        - EncryptAlarmTopic
        - !Ref TableKmsKey
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-read-throttles'
      AlarmDescription: Read requests to the DynamoDB table are being throttled.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-write-throttles'
      AlarmDescription: Write requests to the DynamoDB table are being throttled.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  GetItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-getitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB GetItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: GetItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  PutItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-putitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB PutItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: PutItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UpdateItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-updateitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB UpdateItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: UpdateItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DeleteItemSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-${EnvironmentName}-dynamodb-deleteitem-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: DynamoDB DeleteItem requests are returning system (HTTP 500) errors.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
        - Name: Operation
          Value: DeleteItem
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300

      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:

  QuerySystemErrorsAlarm:

Outputs:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Builds Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64 and arm64 with EC2 Image Builder.
  The AMIs include Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages (synapseclient,
  pandas, pysftp) and SSM user sudo access, and are distributed publicly and
  to an AWS Organization. Build instances run in a private VPC without
  internet access, using VPC endpoints, CodeArtifact and S3. NOTE (intended
  security trade-off): root volumes are left unencrypted because AMIs backed
  by encrypted EBS snapshots cannot be made public. NOTE (deployment caveat):
  new accounts enable EC2 Block public access for AMIs by default; run
  aws ec2 disable-image-block-public-access for this account and region
  before running the pipelines. Organization sharing works only if the
  deploying account belongs to the organization or its management account
  allows the share, and is enabled only when OrganizationId and
  OrganizationManagementAccountId are both supplied.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image Settings
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Organization Sharing
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - OrganizationManagementAccountId

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version (major.minor.patch), e.g. 1.0.0.
    Description: >-
      Semantic version applied to the image recipes and the component. Increment
      it whenever recipe or component content changes.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16384
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for the built AMIs (minimum 8 for AL2023).

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(o-[a-z0-9]{10,32})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx).
    Description: >-
      AWS Organization ID to share the AMIs with. Leave empty to disable
      organization sharing.

  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: >-
      12-digit account ID of the organization's management account. Required
      together with OrganizationId to build the organization ARN.

Conditions:
  ShareWithOrganization: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationManagementAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield account, private only: no internet gateway, no
  # public IPs, no 0.0.0.0/0 route)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnetSecondary:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-private-rt'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Encrypts objects in the Image Builder build artifact bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:

        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountIamPolicies
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildArtifactBucket:

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BuildArtifactKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BuildArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BuildArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ArtifactStagingFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Docker Compose staging custom resource
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StageBuildArtifacts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutComposeBinaries
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-x86_64'
                  - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-aarch64'
              - Sid: EncryptComposeBinaries
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildArtifactKey.Arn
              - Sid: LookupS3PrefixList
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # Not attached to the VPC: it fetches the pinned Compose release from GitHub
  # at deploy time so build instances never need internet access.
  ArtifactStagingFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Stages pinned Docker Compose binaries in S3 and looks up the S3 prefix list ID
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ArtifactStagingFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 600
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib
          import os
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')


          def fetch(url, path):
              req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'imagebuilder-artifact-stager'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp, open(path, 'wb') as out:
                  while True:
                      chunk = resp.read(1024 * 1024)
                      if not chunk:
                          break
                      out.write(chunk)


          def sha256(path):
              digest = hashlib.sha256()
              with open(path, 'rb') as f:
                  for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                      digest.update(chunk)
              return digest.hexdigest()


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              physical_id = 'compose-' + props['ComposeVersion'] + '-' + props['BucketName']
              data = {}
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] != 'Delete':
                      lists = ec2.describe_managed_prefix_lists(
                          Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [props['S3PrefixListName']]}]
                      )['PrefixLists']
                      if not lists:
                          raise ValueError('S3 prefix list not found: ' + props['S3PrefixListName'])
                      data['S3PrefixListId'] = lists[0]['PrefixListId']

                      base = 'https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/' + props['ComposeVersion'] + '/'
                      for arch in props['Architectures']:
                          name = 'docker-compose-linux-' + arch
                          path = '/tmp/' + name
                          fetch(base + name, path)
                          fetch(base + name + '.sha256', path + '.sha256')
                          with open(path + '.sha256') as f:
                              expected = f.read().split()[0].strip()
                          actual = sha256(path)
                          if actual != expected:
                              raise ValueError('Checksum mismatch for ' + name)
                          s3.upload_file(path, props['BucketName'], props['KeyPrefix'] + name)
                          os.remove(path)
                          os.remove(path + '.sha256')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildArtifactStaging:
    Type: Custom::BuildArtifactStaging
    DependsOn: BuildArtifactBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ArtifactStagingFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref BuildArtifactBucket
      ComposeVersion: v2.29.7
      KeyPrefix: docker-compose/v2.29.7/
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
        - aarch64

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM for build instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build and test instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BuildDependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CodeArtifactAuthToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action: codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: !GetAtt CodeArtifactDomain.Arn
              - Sid: CodeArtifactRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codeartifact:GetRepositoryEndpoint
                  - codeartifact:ReadFromRepository
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PypiRepository.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PypiUpstreamRepository.Arn
              - Sid: CodeArtifactBearerToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetServiceBearerToken
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sts:AWSServiceName: codeartifact.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ReadComposeBinaries
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-x86_64'
                  - !Sub '${BuildArtifactBucket.Arn}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-aarch64'
              - Sid: DecryptComposeBinaries
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildArtifactKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder component
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DockerPythonToolsComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-docker-python-tools'
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and grants ssm-user sudo access
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${ImageVersion}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Data: !Sub |
        name: docker-python-tools
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and configure ssm-user sudo access.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins
                    - aws s3 cp --only-show-errors --region ${AWS::Region} "s3://${BuildArtifactBucket}/docker-compose/v2.29.7/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m)" /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod 0755 /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install python3 python3-pip
                    - aws codeartifact login --tool pip --region ${AWS::Region} --domain ${CodeArtifactDomain.Name} --domain-owner ${AWS::AccountId} --repository ${PypiRepository.Name}
                    - python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
                    - python3 -m pip config unset global.index-url || true
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - id -u ssm-user >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash ssm-user
                    - usermod -aG docker ssm-user
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
              - name: Cleanup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf clean all
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - docker --version
                    - systemctl is-enabled docker
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - docker compose version
                    - docker-compose version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('Python imports OK')"
              - name: VerifySsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - test -f /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - grep -q '^ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL$' /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipes (root volumes intentionally unencrypted so AMIs can be public)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tools
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x'
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt DockerPythonToolsComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tools
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt DockerPythonToolsComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SharedInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for x86_64 and arm64 builds
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      ResourceTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration (public + optional organization sharing)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution'
      Description: Distributes AMIs publicly and optionally to an AWS Organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 with Docker, Docker Compose and Python tools (${AWS::StackName})'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns: !If
                - ShareWithOrganization
                - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationManagementAccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipelines (one per recipe)
  # DependsOn on the VPC endpoints and artifact staging is a deliberate
  # exception to the "no explicit DependsOn" rule: nothing else references the
  # endpoints, and builds must not start before private DNS and the staged
  # Docker Compose binaries are available.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn:
      - SsmVpcEndpoint
      - SsmMessagesVpcEndpoint
      - Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint
      - ImageBuilderVpcEndpoint
      - LogsVpcEndpoint
      - StsVpcEndpoint
      - CodeArtifactApiVpcEndpoint
      - CodeArtifactRepositoriesVpcEndpoint
      - S3InterfaceVpcEndpoint
      - S3GatewayVpcEndpoint
      - BuildPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
      - BuildArtifactStaging
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds, tests and distributes the Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt X86ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SharedInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt ImageDistributionConfiguration.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    DependsOn:
      - SsmVpcEndpoint
      - SsmMessagesVpcEndpoint
      - Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint
      - ImageBuilderVpcEndpoint
      - LogsVpcEndpoint
      - StsVpcEndpoint
      - CodeArtifactApiVpcEndpoint
      - CodeArtifactRepositoriesVpcEndpoint
      - S3InterfaceVpcEndpoint
      - S3GatewayVpcEndpoint
      - BuildPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
      - BuildArtifactStaging
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds, tests and distributes the Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt Arm64ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SharedInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito identity stack. Creates a user pool
  (agentops-ecommerce-users), a public SRP web client (agentops-web-client), three
  user groups (team-alpha, team-beta, admin), a Secrets Manager generated shared demo
  password, and a custom resource Lambda that seeds six demo users.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '32'
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        Environment: demo

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:role
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Description: Team Alpha members of the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Description: Team Beta members of the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Platform administrators of the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  DemoPasswordSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: Shared password for the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo users
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"purpose": "agentops-demo-users"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 16
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeederRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the AgentOps demo user seeder Lambda
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: seeder-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/agentops-demo-user-seeder'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/agentops-demo-user-seeder:*'
        - PolicyName: seeder-cognito
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
        - PolicyName: seeder-secret
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-demo-user-seeder
      Description: Seeds the AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo users into Cognito
      Runtime: python3.13
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt SeederRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          log = logging.getLogger()
          log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          idp = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
          PID = 'agentops-demo-user-seed'
          USERS = [
              ('alice@demo.local', 'member', 'TeamAlphaGroup'),
              ('bob@demo.local', 'member', 'TeamAlphaGroup'),
              ('charlie@demo.local', 'team_admin', 'TeamAlphaGroup'),
              ('dave@demo.local', 'member', 'TeamBetaGroup'),
              ('eve@demo.local', 'team_admin', 'TeamBetaGroup'),
              ('admin@demo.local', 'admin', 'AdminGroup'),
          ]

          def err_code(e):
              return e.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code', 'Unknown')

          def seed(pool, props, pw):
              for email, role, group_key in USERS:
                  attrs = [
                      {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role},
                  ]
                  try:
                      idp.admin_create_user(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                            UserAttributes=attrs, MessageAction='SUPPRESS')
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if err_code(e) != 'UsernameExistsException':
                          raise
                      idp.admin_update_user_attributes(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                                       UserAttributes=attrs)
                  idp.admin_set_user_password(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                              Password=pw, Permanent=True)
                  idp.admin_add_user_to_group(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email,
                                              GroupName=props[group_key])
                  log.info('Seeded %s (role=%s)', email, role)

          def purge(pool):
              for email, _, _ in USERS:
                  try:
                      idp.admin_delete_user(UserPoolId=pool, Username=email)
                      log.info('Deleted %s', email)
                  except ClientError as e:
                      if err_code(e) != 'UserNotFoundException':
                          log.warning('Could not delete %s: %s', email, err_code(e))
                  except Exception as e:
                      log.warning('Could not delete %s: %s', email, type(e).__name__)

          def handler(event, context):
              status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              reason = None
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              try:
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  pool = props['UserPoolId']
                  log.info('%s request for pool %s', request_type, pool)
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      purge(pool)
                  else:
                      secret = sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=os.environ['SECRET_ARN'])
                      pw = json.loads(secret['SecretString'])['password']
                      seed(pool, props, pw)
              except Exception as e:
                  detail = err_code(e) if isinstance(e, ClientError) else type(e).__name__
                  log.error('Seeder error during %s: %s', request_type, detail)
                  if request_type != 'Delete':
                      status = cfnresponse.FAILED
                      reason = 'Demo user seeding failed: %s' % detail
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, {'SeededUsers': str(len(USERS))},
                               PID, reason=reason)
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeederLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${SeederFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  DemoUserSeed:
    Type: Custom::DemoUserSeeder
    DependsOn: SeederLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      TeamAlphaGroup: !Ref TeamAlphaGroup
      TeamBetaGroup: !Ref TeamBetaGroup
      AdminGroup: !Ref AdminGroup

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Public app client ID (agentops-web-client)
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  Region:
    Description: AWS region where the user pool is deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the demo user seeder Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
  DemoPasswordSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret holding the shared demo user password (retrieve with aws secretsmanager get-secret-value)
    Value: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Client VPN usage reporting through CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a
  CloudWatch Dashboard, covering AD/SAML, Mutual Auth and Mixed Auth endpoints.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Reporting Configuration
        Parameters:
          - QueryFolderPath
          - ClientVpnLogGroupName
    ParameterLabels:
      QueryFolderPath:
        default: Query folder path (organisational prefix)
      ClientVpnLogGroupName:
        default: Client VPN connection log group name (without leading slash)

Parameters:
  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,200}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-200 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', '/' or '-'.
    Description: >-
      Optional folder prefix used to group and organise the Client VPN reporting
      queries (applied to the dashboard name and widget titles).

  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._#-][A-Za-z0-9._/#-]{0,510}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      1-511 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', '/', '#' or '-', and must not
      start with '/'. The stack prepends a leading '/' to form the final log group
      name, which avoids the AWS-reserved 'aws/' prefix.
    Description: >-
      Client VPN connection log group name without a leading slash. The stack
      prepends '/' to form the final log group name (for example, the default
      becomes /aws/aws-client-vpn/prod), which avoids the AWS-reserved 'aws/'
      prefix. The log group is created by this template.

Resources:
  ClientVpnLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key encrypting the AWS Client VPN connection log group /${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: client-vpn-reporting
        - Key: QueryFolder
          Value: !Ref QueryFolderPath

  ClientVpnLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ClientVpnLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: client-vpn-reporting
        - Key: QueryFolder
          Value: !Ref QueryFolderPath

  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Join
        - ''
        - - !Join
            - '-'
            - !Split
              - '/'
              - !Join
                - '-'
                - !Split
                  - '.'
                  - !Ref QueryFolderPath
          - '-client-vpn-usage-report'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 5,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# AWS Client VPN Usage Report\n**Query folder path:** `${QueryFolderPath}`  \n**Source log group:** `/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}`\n\n**Authentication type classification rules**\n\n| authType | Rule |\n|---|---|\n| Mixed Auth | `username` present **and** `common-name` present |\n| AD/SAML | `username` present, `common-name` blank |\n| Mutual Auth | `common-name` present, `username` blank |\n| Unknown | both `username` and `common-name` blank |"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 5,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, sum(`ingress-bytes`) as ingressBytes, sum(`egress-bytes`) as egressBytes, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 5,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Usage per Authentication Type",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`ingress-bytes`) as ingressBytes, sum(`egress-bytes`) as egressBytes, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by authType, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 11,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Distinct Users",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | stats count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, authType | sort distinctUsers desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 11,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Distinct Users – Per User Activity",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter not isblank(user) | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, max(@timestamp) as lastSeen by user, authType, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort lastSeen desc | limit 1000"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 17,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Connection Durations",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-seconds`) | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, avg(`connection-duration-seconds`) as avgSeconds, min(`connection-duration-seconds`) as minSeconds, max(`connection-duration-seconds`) as maxSeconds, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, authType | sort totalSeconds desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 17,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Connection Durations – Longest Connections",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter ispresent(`connection-duration-seconds`) | stats max(`connection-duration-seconds`) as durationSeconds, max(@timestamp) as lastSeen by `connection-id`, user, authType, `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort durationSeconds desc | limit 100"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 23,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – AD/SAML Breakdown",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter authType = 'AD/SAML' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 8,
              "y": 23,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Mutual Auth Breakdown",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter authType = 'Mutual Auth' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 16,
              "y": 23,
              "width": 8,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "${QueryFolderPath} – Mixed Auth Breakdown",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "stacked": false,
                "query": "SOURCE '/${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields if(not isblank(username) and not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mixed Auth', if(not isblank(username), 'AD/SAML', if(not isblank(`common-name`), 'Mutual Auth', 'Unknown'))) as authType, coalesce(username, `common-name`) as user | filter authType = 'Mixed Auth' | stats count_distinct(`connection-id`) as connections, count_distinct(user) as distinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) as totalSeconds by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort connections desc"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: Name of the AWS Client VPN usage reporting CloudWatch Dashboard.
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnUsageDashboard
  DashboardUrl:
    Description: Console URL of the AWS Client VPN usage reporting dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${ClientVpnUsageDashboard}'
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Description: Effective (slash-prefixed) name of the log group that Client VPN endpoints should publish connection logs to.
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup
  ClientVpnLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the Client VPN connection log group.
    Value: !GetAtt ClientVpnLogGroup.Arn
  LogGroupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key encrypting the Client VPN connection log group.
    Value: !GetAtt ClientVpnLogsKmsKey.Arn
  QueryFolderPath:
    Description: Organisational folder prefix applied to the reporting queries.
    Value: !Ref QueryFolderPath

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication (Cognito) - user pool, app clients, staff role groups, M2M resource server and hosted domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names, the domain prefix and tags.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsProd, ACTIVE, INACTIVE]
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: AnyCompanyHotel

  SpaClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      WriteAttributes:
        - email

  AdminAuthClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-auth-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: AnyCompany Hotel system administrators with full access.
      Precedence: 0

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Property managers responsible for a single hotel property.
      Precedence: 20

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Regional managers overseeing multiple properties within a region.
      Precedence: 10

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Revenue managers responsible for pricing and yield management.
      Precedence: 30

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Front desk staff handling guest check-in, check-out and reservations.
      Precedence: 40

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Housekeeping staff managing room status and cleaning schedules.
      Precedence: 50

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      Name: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs.

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/read"
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/write"
        - !Sub "${ResourceServer}/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

  UserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Issuer URL of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolProviderUrl"

  SpaClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the public SPA app client (SRP auth, no secret).
    Value: !Ref SpaClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SpaClientId"

  AdminAuthClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the admin auth client for server-side test harnesses and simulators.
    Value: !Ref AdminAuthClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminAuthClientId"

  M2MClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the M2M client. Retrieve its secret at runtime via DescribeUserPoolClient.
    Value: !Ref M2MClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-M2MClientId"

  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: Identifier of the M2M OAuth2 resource server.
    Value: !Ref ResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ResourceServerIdentifier"

  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain prefix.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainName"

  UserPoolDomainUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the Cognito hosted domain.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolDomainUrl"

  OAuth2TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for the client_credentials flow.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-OAuth2TokenEndpoint"
