AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito authentication stack for the Hospitality Insights application in the prod environment, with a user pool, hosted UI domain, app client, post-authentication Lambda trigger, user groups and optional SAML SSO federation.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Application name used in resource names, tags and the hosted UI domain.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or 1-32 characters of letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
    Description: Name of the federated SAML identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or an HTTPS URL.
    Description: SAML metadata/login URL of the identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-42 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, must not start or end with a hyphen, and must not contain the reserved words aws, amazon or cognito.
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The account ID is appended to keep it globally unique. Must not contain aws, amazon or cognito.
  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/callback
    AllowedPattern: ^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL.
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the hosted UI.
  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/logout
    AllowedPattern: ^https://.+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL.
    Description: OAuth sign-out URL for the hosted UI.

Conditions:
  EnableSSO: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginUrl, '']]

Resources:
  PostAuthLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub KMS key encrypting the ${AppName}-${Environment} post-authentication Lambda log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-logs-key

  PostAuthLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt PostAuthLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-logs

  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-role
      Description: !Sub Execution role for the ${AppName}-${Environment} Cognito post-authentication Lambda
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostAuthLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt PostAuthLogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: PostAuthUpdateLastLogin
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth-role

  PostAuthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth
      Description: Cognito post-authentication trigger that records the user's last login time in custom:last_login
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref PostAuthLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime
          import logging

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
              username = event.get("userName")
              timestamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
              try:
                  cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": timestamp}
                      ],
                  )
                  logger.info("Updated last_login for user in pool %s", user_pool_id)
              except Exception:
                  # Never block sign-in because the attribute update failed.
                  logger.exception("Failed to update last_login for user in pool %s", user_pool_id)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-post-auth

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-user-pool
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '0'
            MaxLength: '64'
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Name: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-user-pool

  PostAuthInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SSOLoginUrl
        IDPSignout: 'true'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub ${HostedUIDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${AppName}-${Environment}-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutUrl
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOIdentityProvider
        - - COGNITO
      AuthSessionValidity: 3
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Administrators with full access to Hospitality Insights.

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2
      Description: Standard users with regular access to Hospitality Insights.

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3
      Description: Power users with extended access to Hospitality Insights.

    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for client connection and session management, using a DynamoDB session table with TTL, direct DynamoDB integrations for $connect and $disconnect, and a Lambda echo function for $default.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableWriteDelete
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Store new connection in the session table
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole.Arn
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          #set($ttl = $context.requestTimeEpoch / 1000 + 7200)
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Item": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"},
              "ttl": {"N": "$ttl"}
            }
          }

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref ConnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: '$default'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: ConnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Remove disconnected connection from the session table
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDbRole.Arn
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": {"S": "$context.connectionId"}
            }
          }

  DisconnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DisconnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: '$default'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DisconnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  EchoFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  EchoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Echoes incoming WebSocket messages back to the client
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt EchoFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": event.get("body", "")}

  EchoFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${EchoFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Lambda proxy integration for echo function
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DefaultRoute
      RouteResponseSelectionExpression: '$default'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  DefaultRouteResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::RouteResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteId: !Ref DefaultRoute
      RouteResponseKey: '$default'

  EchoFunctionInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoFunction
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: WebSocket API deployment

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: WebSocket API stage
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}'
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: WebSocket API ID
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  SessionTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB session table name
    Value: !Ref SessionTable
  EchoFunctionArn:
    Description: Echo Lambda function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt EchoFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Basic test VPC with one public subnet, an internet gateway, a public route table and a network ACL allowing all TCP and UDP traffic. Instances in the public subnet do not get public IP addresses automatically. They must request one at launch or use an Elastic IP.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the test VPC. The public subnet uses the first /22 block of this range.
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16

      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC

      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true

        - Key: Environment
          Value: test

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:

    Properties:

        From: 0

      Egress: true

      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an AWS FIS experiment template for cross-region chaos testing. It
  disrupts network connectivity from this region to a target region and pauses
  S3 and DynamoDB cross-region replication. It also creates the IAM role it
  needs and a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group for experiment logs.

# NOTE: TargetRegion must be different from the deployment region (AWS::Region).
# The template does not enforce this with a Rule, because support for pseudo
# parameters in Rule assertions is uncertain. Pick a different region when you
# deploy this stack.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name, for example us-west-2.
    Description: >-
      Region that application traffic and replication are cut off from. It must
      differ from the region you deploy this stack in.

  DisruptionDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    AllowedPattern: '^PT([1-9][0-9]?M|1[0-2]H|[1-9]H)$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be an ISO 8601 duration from PT1M to PT99M, or from PT1H to PT12H.
    Description: >-
      How long the network disruption and replication pause last, as an ISO 8601
      duration. The default is 20 minutes.

Resources:
  ExperimentLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key that encrypts FIS cross-region chaos experiment logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}/cross-region-chaos'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: fis-cross-region-chaos-logs

  ExperimentLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/fis-cross-region-chaos-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ExperimentLogKey

  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}/cross-region-chaos'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ExperimentLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: fis-cross-region-chaos-logs

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role that AWS FIS assumes to run the cross-region chaos experiment.
      MaxSessionDuration: 43200
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisNetworkDisruption
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: NetworkDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayPeeringAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcPeeringConnections
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:GetManagedPrefixListEntries
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: RouteTableDisruptCrossRegionConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: TransitGatewayDisruptCrossRegionConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: FisS3ReplicationPause
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Discovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3PauseReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PauseReplication
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    's3:ResourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        - PolicyName: FisDynamoDbReplicationPause
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDbDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbPauseReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetResourcePolicy
                  - dynamodb:PutResourcePolicy
                  - dynamodb:DeleteResourcePolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
        - PolicyName: FisLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: LogDeliverySetup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: UseExperimentLogKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ExperimentLogKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: fis-cross-region-chaos

  CrossRegionChaosExperiment:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Cut off application network traffic to the target region and pause S3
        and DynamoDB cross-region replication on resources tagged
        ChaosAllowed=true.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      # Placeholder stop condition, used because a greenfield account has no
      # CloudWatch alarms. Before you run this in production, replace it with
      # alarm-based stop conditions (Source: aws:cloudwatch:alarm, with Value
      # set to the alarm ARN).
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Targets:
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        DynamoDbGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
      # None of the actions sets StartAfter, so all four start at the same time
      # and the disruptions overlap in one window.
      Actions:
        disruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:transit-gateway-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity
          Description: Block transit gateway traffic from this region to the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGateways
        disruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:route-table-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity
          Description: Block subnet traffic from this region to the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
        pauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: Pause S3 replication to buckets in the target region.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3Buckets
        pauseDynamoDbReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause replication on DynamoDB global tables.
          # This action only accepts 'duration'. It has no 'region' parameter,
          # so it pauses replication to every replica of each targeted table.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref DisruptionDuration
          Targets:
            Tables: DynamoDbGlobalTables
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      ExperimentOptions:
        AccountTargeting: single-account
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: skip
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cross-region-chaos'
        Purpose: fis-cross-region-chaos

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: ID of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref CrossRegionChaosExperiment
  FisExperimentRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that FIS assumes to run the experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group for experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogGroup
  ExperimentLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch log group for experiment logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn
  ExperimentLogKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the experiment logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogKey.Arn
  ExperimentLogKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key that encrypts the experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogKeyAlias
  TargetRegionUsed:
    Description: Region that traffic and replication are cut off from.
    Value: !Ref TargetRegion
  DisruptionDurationUsed:
    Description: How long the disruptions last (ISO 8601).
    Value: !Ref DisruptionDuration

  PrivateRouteTable2:

    Properties:

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting VPC flow logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-kms-key'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs'

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: UseFlowLogsKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-role'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'

  # Networking (greenfield account - private subnet, AWS services via
  # interface VPC endpoints, no internet path)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-private-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateRouteTable

  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build and test instances (egress to VPC endpoints only)
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS from Image Builder build and test instances
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  SsmVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-ssm-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  SsmMessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-ssmmessages-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  Ec2MessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-ec2messages-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.imagebuilder
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-imagebuilder-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  LogsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-logs-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint

      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC

      VpcEndpointType: Interface

        DnsRecordIpType: ipv4
        PrivateDnsOnlyForInboundResolverEndpoint: AllResolvers
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sample-image-builder-s3-endpoint

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Instance role for EC2 Image Builder build and test instances (test stack only)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for EC2 Image Builder workflows and lifecycle policies (test stack only)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Dev
        - Key: Project
          Value: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Component
  # NOTE: the WebDownload source below is a public internet host. With the
  # private, endpoint-only network it is unreachable at build time. Resolving
  # this requires a user decision: (a) a reviewed NAT/egress exception, or
  # (b) hosting the installer in a stack-created S3 bucket (s3:// source).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Downloads, installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Downloads, installs and runs Chef Client on Linux
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefInstaller
                action: WebDownload
                maxAttempts: 3
                inputs:
                  - source: https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
                    destination: /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    overwrite: true
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod 0700 /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    - sudo bash /tmp/chef-install.sh -P chef -v 18
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo mkdir -p /tmp/chef-repo/cookbooks
                    - cd /tmp/chef-repo
                    - sudo CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept-silent
              - name: CleanupChefInstaller
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rm -f /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    - sudo rm -rf /tmp/chef-repo
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent chef-client --version
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Custom build workflow
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Data: |
        name: sample-workflow
        description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: ssmAgent
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
              parameters:
                allowDowngrade:
                  - "false"
          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: InventoryCollection
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              and:
                - stringEquals: "AMI"
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
                - booleanEquals: true
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.collectImageMetadata"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: RunSanitizeScript
            action: SanitizeInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              and:
                - stringEquals: "AMI"
                  value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
                - not:
                    stringEquals: "Windows"
                    value: "$.imagebuilder.platform"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            if:
              stringEquals: "AMI"
              value: "$.imagebuilder.imageType"
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"
        outputs:
          - name: ImageId
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateOutputAMI.imageId"
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Recipe
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized recipe with Chef Client and chrony time configuration test
      ParentImage: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SampleComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/x.x.x
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Infrastructure configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for the sample Image Builder pipeline
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      ResourceTags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Distribution configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Description: Distributes the sample AMI to us-east-1 with launch permissions for the current account
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: AMI built by the sample Image Builder pipeline
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Dev
              Project: sample-image-builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Pipeline
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      Description: Daily image pipeline building the sample AMI
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt SampleImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleDistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt SampleWorkflow.Arn
        - WorkflowArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:workflow/test/test-image/x.x.x
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 9 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder - Lifecycle policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates Dev AMIs older than 6 months
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      Tags:
        Environment: Dev
        Project: sample-image-builder

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a Cognito authentication layer (User Pool, Identity Pool, and IAM roles)
  for a Lex web UI using either Lex V1 or Lex V2, with optional live chat API access.

# NOTE: Lex V1 is deprecated by AWS. Its IAM actions and ARNs are still valid for
# existing bots. To use only the Lex V2 path, set BotName to "" and supply
# LexV2BotId and LexV2BotAliasId.
#
# NOTE: If both BotName and LexV2BotId are provided, both the V1 and V2 policies are
# attached. This is intentional: V1 is used if a bot name is provided, and V2 is used
# if a bot ID is provided. The two are not mutually exclusive.

Parameters:
  CognitoIdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\s+=,.@-]+$'
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool.

  BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
    Description: >-
      Lex V1 bot name. Leave empty to skip the Lex V1 policies (Lex V1 is deprecated).

  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Lex V2 bot ID. When set, the Lex V2 policies are attached.

  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional Lex V2 bot alias ID. Use it together with LexV2BotId.

  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, unauthenticated identities cannot call the Lex and API actions.

  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: When true, adds permission to call the livechat endpoint through execute-api.

Conditions:
  NeedsLexV1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BotName, '']]
  NeedsLexV2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, '']]
  ShouldForceCognitoLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, 'true']
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, 'true']
  EnableUnauthLiveChat: !And
    - !Condition EnableLiveChat
    - !Not [!Condition ShouldForceCognitoLogin]

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      AliasAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: 'OFF'
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref CognitoIdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for unauthenticated Cognito identities of the Lex web UI.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - !If
          - NeedsLexV1
          - PolicyName: LexV1Access
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:GetSession
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${BotName}:*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - NeedsLexV2
          - PolicyName: LexV2Access
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - lex:StartConversation
                    - lex:GetSession
                    - lex:PutSession
                    - lex:DeleteSession
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - ShouldForceCognitoLogin
          - PolicyName: ForceCognitoLoginDeny
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:*
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: '*'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - EnableUnauthLiveChat
          - PolicyName: LiveChatApiAccess
            PolicyDocument:

        - Key: ManagedBy

      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'

            Resource: '*'

          Statement:

            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true

        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Customer support authentication stack - Amazon Cognito user pool with admin and customer groups, a web app client (authorization code), a machine-to-machine client (client credentials), a resource server, a hosted UI domain, a PostConfirmation Lambda that adds sign-ups to the customer group, and SSM parameters for backend services.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (3-32 characters).
    Description: Application name used for resource naming and tagging.
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-auth
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must not start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The account ID is appended to keep it globally unique.
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport-api
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_:/.-]{1,256}$'
    Description: Identifier of the Cognito resource server that defines the custom read scope.
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:8080/callback
    AllowedPattern: '^https://.+$|^http://localhost(:[0-9]+)?/.*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL (http is allowed only for localhost).
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the web application client.
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:8080/logout
    AllowedPattern: '^https://.+$|^http://localhost(:[0-9]+)?/.*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an HTTPS URL (http is allowed only for localhost).
    Description: Sign-out URL for the web application client.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention in days for the PostConfirmation Lambda log group.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AppName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators of the customer support system (highest precedence).
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customers of the customer support system. New sign-ups are added automatically.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref ResourceServerIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the customer support API.

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PostConfirmationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito PostConfirmation Lambda that assigns new users to the customer group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AppName}-post-confirmation:*'
        - PolicyName: PostConfirmationAddUserToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Component
          Value: customer-support-auth

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AppName}-post-confirmation'
      Description: Adds newly confirmed sign-ups to the customer Cognito group.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostConfirmationRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          GROUP_NAME = os.environ["CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME"]


          def handler(event, context):
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp":
                  return event

              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]

              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName=GROUP_NAME,
              )
              logger.info("Added user to group %s", GROUP_NAME)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Component
          Value: customer-support-auth

  PostConfirmationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${PostConfirmationFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Component
          Value: customer-support-auth

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  WebAppClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito web application client ID for the customer support system.
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito machine-to-machine client ID. Retrieve the secret at runtime with cognito-idp DescribeUserPoolClient.
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/userpool_id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the customer support system.
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_auth_scope
      Type: String
      Description: Custom OAuth read scope defined by the Cognito resource server.
      Value: !Sub '${ResourceServerIdentifier}/read'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL for the Cognito user pool.
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  TokenEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_token_url
      Type: String
      Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  AuthorizeEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_auth_url
      Type: String
      Description: OAuth 2.0 authorize endpoint of the Cognito hosted UI domain.
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Description: Fully qualified Cognito hosted UI domain.
      Value: !Sub '${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName
        Component: customer-support-auth

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Description: Web application client ID (authorization code grant).
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine client ID (client credentials grant). The secret is not exported; use DescribeUserPoolClient at runtime.
    Value: !Ref MachineClient
  HostedUIDomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI base URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  SsmParameterPathPrefix:
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix holding the authentication configuration.
    Value: /app/customersupport/agentcore/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the IAM roles needed by Amazon SageMaker Projects and their AWS Service Catalog
  product templates. A parameter controls whether each role is created. Every role uses
  the /service-role/ path and has a maximum session duration of one hour.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Core SageMaker Projects Roles
        Parameters:
          - CreateExecutionRole
          - CreateLaunchRole
          - CreateUseRole
      - Label:
          default: Service Roles Used by SageMaker Project Templates
        Parameters:
          - CreateCloudformationRole
          - CreateCodeBuildRole
          - CreateCodePipelineRole
          - CreateEventsRole
          - CreateApiGatewayRole
          - CreateFirehoseRole
          - CreateGlueRole
          - CreateLambdaRole

Parameters:
  CreateExecutionRole:

    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole.

    Default: 'NO'

  CreateCloudformationRole:

  CreateCodeBuildRole:

    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'

    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodeBuildRole.
  CreateCodePipelineRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'

    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsCodePipelineRole.
  CreateEventsRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'
      - 'NO'
    Description: Create the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsEventsRole.
  CreateApiGatewayRole:

    Default: 'YES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'YES'

Conditions:

  CreateUseRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateUseRole, 'YES']

  CreateCodeBuildRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateCodeBuildRole, 'YES']
  CreateCodePipelineRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateCodePipelineRole, 'YES']
  CreateEventsRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateEventsRole, 'YES']

  CreateFirehoseRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateFirehoseRole, 'YES']
  CreateGlueRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateGlueRole, 'YES']
  CreateLambdaRoleCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateLambdaRole, 'YES']

Resources:
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateExecutionRoleCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole

        Statement:

      ManagedPolicyArns:

  LaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateLaunchRoleCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole
      Description: Launch role used by AWS Service Catalog to provision SageMaker project templates.
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSageMakerAdmin-ServiceCatalogProductsServiceRolePolicy'

  UseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateUseRoleCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole
      Description: Role assumed by the resources that SageMaker project templates provision.
      Path: /service-role/
