AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys a two-AZ VPC with public and private subnets, an Internet Gateway, and one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone.

Metadata:
  SecurityNotes:
    PublicSubnets: Public subnets reach the internet through the Internet Gateway route in the public route table. Public IPs are not auto-assigned on launch for security reasons, so any future public-facing resource must explicitly request its own public IP or Elastic IP.

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    VPC:
      Cidr: 10.10.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
    PublicSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.10.1.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.10.10.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.10.11.0/24

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, VPC, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS standby stack for a cross-cloud disaster recovery blueprint with OCI as the
  primary cloud. Deploys a VPC, private subnet, hardened EC2 health-check endpoint
  with an Elastic IP, SSM interface endpoints, and KMS-encrypted VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: oci-aws-dr
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-32 characters of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
    Description: Project name used in resource Name tags and the flow log group name.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.82.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.82.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-rtb'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (KMS encrypted)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} DR standby VPC Flow Logs encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-dr-standby-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs-kms'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # The log group name carries a per-stack suffix (last segment of the stack ID)
  # so a group retained by a previous failed/rolled-back stack never collides.
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${ProjectName}-dr-standby-${StackSuffix}'
          - StackSuffix:
              Fn::Select:
                - 2
                - Fn::Split:
                    - '/'
                    - !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver records to the DR standby log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-flowlogs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EBS encryption key (dedicated, explicitly referenced by the root volume so
  # the launch does not depend on the account's implicit default EBS key)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EbsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${ProjectName} DR standby EBS volume encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEbsUseViaEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowEbsGrantsViaEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              Bool:
                'kms:GrantIsForAWSResource': true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ebs-kms'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EbsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-ebs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EbsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NOTE: HTTP/HTTPS ingress is restricted to 10.0.0.0/8 as requested, so the
  # Elastic IP endpoint will NOT answer health checks from the public internet.
  # OCI-side health checks must originate from 10.0.0.0/8 sources (e.g. over a
  # site-to-site VPN or interconnect, or from a source NATed into that range).
  # Ingress must not be widened to 0.0.0.0/0.
  # NOTE: The instance serves HTTP on port 80 only. The HTTPS (443) ingress rule
  # is retained as requested for a future TLS listener; no certificate or TLS
  # server is configured in this template.
  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: DR standby health-check instance - HTTP/HTTPS from internal 10.0.0.0/8 only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTP health check from internal network
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
        - Description: HTTPS from internal network (reserved for future TLS listener)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to internal network (includes SSM VPC endpoints)
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: SSM interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from the DR standby instance only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: HTTPS from DR standby instance
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS within the VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.82.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM interface endpoints (instance egress is limited to HTTPS in 10.0.0.0/8,
  # so public SSM endpoints are unreachable without these)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-ssm'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-ec2messages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compute
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: DR standby instance role for AWS Systems Manager access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-instance-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  # LaunchTemplateName is intentionally omitted so CloudFormation generates a
  # unique name and interrupted rollbacks cannot cause name collisions.
  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      TagSpecifications:
        - ResourceType: launch-template
          Tags:
            - Key: Name
              Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-lt'
            - Key: Environment
              Value: dr-standby
            - Key: DRRole
              Value: standby
            - Key: PrimaryCloud
              Value: OCI
            - Key: StandbyCloud
              Value: AWS
            - Key: Project
              Value: !Ref ProjectName
            - Key: ManagedBy
              Value: CloudFormation
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt InstanceProfile.Arn
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        # Root volume size is inherited from the AMI snapshot.
        BlockDeviceMappings:
          - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
            Ebs:
              VolumeType: gp3
              Encrypted: true
              KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKmsKey.Arn
              DeleteOnTermination: true
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-root-volume'
              - Key: Environment
                Value: dr-standby
              - Key: DRRole
                Value: standby
              - Key: PrimaryCloud
                Value: OCI
              - Key: StandbyCloud
                Value: AWS
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName
              - Key: ManagedBy
                Value: CloudFormation
          - ResourceType: network-interface
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-eni'
              - Key: Environment
                Value: dr-standby
              - Key: DRRole
                Value: standby
              - Key: PrimaryCloud
                Value: OCI
              - Key: StandbyCloud
                Value: AWS
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName
              - Key: ManagedBy
                Value: CloudFormation

  StandbyInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      # Mirrors the launch template root volume exactly so encryption is explicit
      # on the instance itself.
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !GetAtt EbsKmsKey.Arn
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64:
          Fn::Sub: |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -euo pipefail
            # Outbound access is limited to HTTPS inside 10.0.0.0/8, so no packages
            # are installed; the preinstalled python3 serves the static page.
            mkdir -p /var/www/html
            cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF'
            <!DOCTYPE html>
            <html>
              <head><title>${ProjectName} DR Standby</title></head>
              <body>
                <h1>${ProjectName} - AWS DR standby</h1>
                <p>Status: OK</p>
                <p>Primary cloud: OCI | Standby cloud: AWS</p>
              </body>
            </html>
            EOF
            echo "OK" > /var/www/html/health
            cat > /etc/systemd/system/dr-healthcheck.service <<'EOF'
            [Unit]
            Description=DR standby static health-check web server
            After=network-online.target
            Wants=network-online.target

            [Service]
            Type=simple
            ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 80 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /var/www/html
            Restart=always
            RestartSec=5

            [Install]
            WantedBy=multi-user.target
            EOF
            systemctl daemon-reload
            systemctl enable --now dr-healthcheck.service
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-instance'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  StandbyEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      InstanceId: !Ref StandbyInstance
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-standby-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: dr-standby
        - Key: DRRole
          Value: standby
        - Key: PrimaryCloud
          Value: OCI
        - Key: StandbyCloud
          Value: AWS
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the DR standby VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the DR standby private subnet
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'
  InstanceId:
    Description: ID of the DR standby health-check EC2 instance
    Value: !Ref StandbyInstance
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceId'
  InstancePrivateIp:
    Description: Private IP address of the DR standby instance
    Value: !GetAtt StandbyInstance.PrivateIp
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstancePrivateIp'
  ElasticIP:
    Description: Elastic IP providing the stable failover endpoint
    Value: !Ref StandbyEIP
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ElasticIP'
  HealthCheckUrl:
    Description: HTTP health-check URL (reachable only from 10.0.0.0/8 sources)
    Value: !Sub 'http://${StandbyEIP}/health'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckUrl'
  InstanceSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID of the DR standby instance
    Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceSecurityGroupId'
  InstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DR standby instance IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InstanceRoleArn'
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsLogGroupName'
  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogsKmsKeyArn'

    Value: !GetAtt EbsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EbsKmsKeyArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Route 53 DNS zone for prxu.org in Production: Google Workspace mail
  (TXT and MX records), CloudFront CDN alias records (A/AAAA) and service
  CNAMEs. Assumed legacy hostnames: cdn and cdn-staging are CNAMEs to
  dovetail-cdn and dovetail-cdn-staging. Deploy this stack in us-east-1
  (US East, N. Virginia), because CLOUDFRONT-scope WAFv2 web ACLs can only
  be created there.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Assumptions and notes
# - DEPLOYMENT REGION: deploy this stack in us-east-1. The shared WAFv2 WebACL
#   uses Scope CLOUDFRONT, and AWS only allows that scope in us-east-1. No
#   region is hardcoded in any resource property.
# - The request does not name the legacy CNAME hostnames. This template uses
#   cdn.<domain>         -> dovetail-cdn.<domain>
#   cdn-staging.<domain> -> dovetail-cdn-staging.<domain>
# - The backends for the authenticated feed proxy and the dovetail router are
#   not specified, and nothing outside this template may be referenced. Their
#   CNAMEs therefore point at in-zone CDN hostnames.
# - ACM DNS validation CNAME records are left out on purpose. ACM creates the
#   validation record name and value (_<random-token>.<host> ->
#   _<random-token>.acm-validations.aws.) only after a certificate request is
#   made, so the values are not known ahead of time and cannot be hardcoded.
#   Hardcoding values from another account would be invalid. If certificates
#   are needed, define AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate resources with
#   ValidationMethod DNS and DomainValidationOptions.HostedZoneId set to this
#   zone, and ACM will create the validation records itself. CloudFront needs
#   those certificates in us-east-1. Until they exist, the distributions use
#   the default CloudFront certificate and have no Aliases. Each distribution
#   already sets MinimumProtocolVersion TLSv1.2_2021. That TLS 1.2 minimum
#   takes effect once custom certificates and Aliases are added.
# - The origin bucket is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key. The key
#   policy grants CloudFront access scoped to this account's distributions
#   (wildcard SourceArn). It does not list individual distributions, which
#   would create a circular dependency (Key -> Distribution -> Bucket -> Key).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org.
    AllowedPattern: ^([a-z0-9-]+\.)+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a lowercase fully qualified domain name ending with a period (for example prxu.org.).
    Description: Hosted zone domain name, including the trailing period.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    AllowedValues:
      - Production
      - Staging
      - Development
    Description: Deployment environment used for tagging.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE_ME
    Description: Public Google Workspace domain verification TXT value. This is not a secret.

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted zone
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public DNS zone for ${DomainName} (${Environment}) - Google Workspace mail, CloudFront CDNs and service CNAMEs'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace mail records
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'

  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key for the origin bucket
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the shared CloudFront S3 origin bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudFrontOACUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  OriginBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cdn-origin'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OriginBucketKey

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared private S3 origin bucket and Origin Access Control
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OriginBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OriginBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  OriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-oac'
        Description: Shared Origin Access Control for the CDN origin bucket
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared WAFv2 WebACL (CLOUDFRONT scope - stack must be in us-east-1)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdnWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cdn-webacl'
      Description: Shared WAF web ACL for all CDN CloudFront distributions
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      VisibilityConfig:
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: CdnWebACL
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          Priority: 1
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          Priority: 2
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList
        - Name: RateLimitPerIP
          Priority: 3
          Action:
            Block: {}
          Statement:
            RateBasedStatement:
              Limit: 2000
              AggregateKeyType: IP
          VisibilityConfig:
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: RateLimitPerIP
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: email-and-cdn-dns

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront distributions (one per CDN subdomain, each with its own prefix)
  # The cache policy ID is the AWS managed "CachingOptimized" policy.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DovetailCdn:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn.${DomainName}'
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CdnWebACL.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: S3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt OriginBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginPath: /dovetail-cdn
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt OriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: S3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: dovetail-cdn

  DovetailCdnStaging:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'dovetail-cdn-staging.${DomainName}'
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CdnWebACL.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: S3Origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt OriginBucket.RegionalDomainName
            OriginPath: /dovetail-cdn-staging
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt OriginAccessControl.Id
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: S3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true
          MinimumProtocolVersion: TLSv1.2_2021
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: dovetail-cdn-staging

  FeederCdn:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'f.${DomainName}'
        Enabled: true
        HttpVersion: http2and3
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        WebACLId: !GetAtt CdnWebACL.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple learning VPC with optional Internet Gateway, public subnet, route table, and security group components.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Prefix used in the Name tag of every resource.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create and attach an Internet Gateway.

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the public subnet.

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the public route table.

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the web security group.

  AllowedSourceCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    Description: IPv4 CIDR range allowed to reach HTTP and HTTPS ports.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0).

Conditions:
  HasInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  HasPublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  HasRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  HasSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  HasPublicRoute: !And
    - !Condition HasInternetGateway
    - !Condition HasRouteTable
  HasSubnetRouteAssociation: !And
    - !Condition HasPublicSubnet
    - !Condition HasRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PublicSubnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PublicRT'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasSubnetRouteAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: HasSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP and HTTPS inbound traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
          Description: Allow HTTP
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-WebSG'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-VpcId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing zone hub VPC with public and private subnets across two Availability Zones,
  NAT gateways, a Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke connectivity, VPC flow logs
  to CloudWatch Logs, and private VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages,
  CloudWatch Logs and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name prefix used in resource Name tags and export names.

Mappings:
  NetworkConfig:
    Vpc:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.0.1.0/24
    PublicSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.0.2.0/24
    PrivateSubnet1:
      Cidr: 10.0.10.0/24
    PrivateSubnet2:
      Cidr: 10.0.11.0/24
    SpokeSummary:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/8

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PublicSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, PrivateSubnet2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # NOTE: Spoke accounts must be granted access to this Transit Gateway through
  # AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) outside this template. A RAM resource
  # share requires spoke account IDs or an AWS Organizations ARN, which do not
  # exist in a greenfield deployment.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "${EnvironmentName} hub Transit Gateway for spoke connectivity"
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-hub-tgw-attachment"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRoute1ToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, SpokeSummary, Cidr]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, SpokeSummary, Cidr]
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc"
      RetentionInDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsToCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from the hub VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
          Description: HTTPS from hub VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [NetworkConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
          Description: HTTPS responses within hub VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Student Services Bedrock AgentCore identity and IAM foundation stack.
  Provisions a shared base managed policy, least-privilege execution roles
  trusted by bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com, and per-domain Cognito user pools
  configured for OAuth2 client_credentials machine-to-machine authentication.
  No AgentCore runtime or gateway resources are created; all identities are
  exported for consumption by downstream stacks.

# NOTE: No Lambda functions, S3 buckets, DynamoDB tables, knowledge bases or
# SageMaker endpoints are created by this stack. The DynamoDB, bedrock:Retrieve
# and sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint permissions are wildcard-scoped per the request
# so downstream stacks can create those resources later. Tighten the resource
# ARNs once those resources exist.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared base managed policy (attached to every execution role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Shared base permissions for Student Services Bedrock AgentCore execution roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsDescribeGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # StudentServicesAgent (orchestrator) - execution role only, IAM inbound auth
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the StudentServicesAgent orchestrator on Bedrock AgentCore.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: StudentServicesAgent

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # StudentServicesGateway - Cognito only, no execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-student-services-gateway
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Domain: StudentServicesGateway

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub student-services-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool

  StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Identifier: student-services-gateway
      Name: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke the Student Services gateway

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-student-services-gateway-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - student-services-gateway/invoke
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CourseRegistration domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the CourseRegistration agent on Bedrock AgentCore.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: CourseRegistration

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-course-registration
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Domain: CourseRegistration

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Identifier: course-registration
      Name: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke the CourseRegistration agent

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      ClientName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-course-registration-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-registration/invoke
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CourseCatalog domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the CourseCatalog agent on Bedrock AgentCore.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBedrockAgentCoreAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CourseCatalogKnowledgeBaseRetrieve
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KnowledgeBaseRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Domain
          Value: CourseCatalog

  CourseCatalogUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-course-catalog
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Domain: CourseCatalog

  CourseCatalogUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Implements the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark section 3 log-metric-filter-and-alarm controls (3.1–3.14) with a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail management events, CloudWatch Logs metric filters, CloudWatch alarms, Logs Insights query definitions, and a KMS-encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications.

Resources:
  CisMonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for CIS section 3 monitoring resources in stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Section3

  CisMonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisMonitoringKey

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Section3

  CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-cloudtrail-to-cwl'
      Description: Allows a CloudTrail trail to deliver management events to the CIS monitoring log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailDeliveryToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLogStreamCreationAndDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Section3

  CisAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-alarms'
      DisplayName: CIS AWS Foundations Section 3 Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-AWS-Foundations-Section3

  CisAlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref CisAlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref CisAlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref CisAlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # 3.1 Unauthorized API calls
  UnauthorizedAPICallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ (($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*")) && ($.sourceIPAddress != "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com") && ($.eventName != "HeadBucket") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: 'CISBenchmark'
          MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricValue: '1'

  UnauthorizedAPICallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: UnauthorizedAPICallsMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API calls detected
      Namespace: 'CISBenchmark'
      MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CisAlarmTopic

  UnauthorizedAPICallsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls'
