  CnameSwapFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Swaps Elastic Beanstalk CNAMEs between the blue and green environments.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt CnameSwapFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          eb = boto3.client("elasticbeanstalk")


          def describe(names):
              envs = eb.describe_environments(EnvironmentNames=names, IncludeDeleted=False)["Environments"]
              return {e["EnvironmentName"]: e for e in envs if e["Status"] not in ("Terminating", "Terminated")}


          def wait_ready(names, context):
              while True:
                  envs = describe(names)
                  missing = [n for n in names if n not in envs]
                  if missing:
                      raise RuntimeError("Environment(s) not found: " + ", ".join(missing))
                  if all(envs[n]["Status"] == "Ready" for n in names):
                      return envs
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 30000:
                      raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for environments to become Ready")
                  time.sleep(10)


          def traffic_on_green(blue, green, envs):
              bc = envs[blue].get("CNAME", "").lower()
              gc = envs[green].get("CNAME", "").lower()
              b, g = blue.lower(), green.lower()
              if gc.startswith(g) and bc.startswith(b) and not bc.startswith(g):
                  return False
              if bc.startswith(g) and gc.startswith(b) and not gc.startswith(g):
                  return True
              return None


          def handler(event, context):
              rtype = event["RequestType"]
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              blue = props["BlueEnvironmentName"]
              green = props["GreenEnvironmentName"]
              pid = "ebswap-%s-%s" % (blue, green)
              try:
                  if rtype == "Delete":
                      envs = describe([blue, green])
                      if blue not in envs or green not in envs:
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, pid)
                          return
                      want_green = False
                      previous = props.get("TargetPhase") == "traffic-on-green"
                  else:
                      want_green = props.get("TargetPhase") == "traffic-on-green"
                      old = event.get("OldResourceProperties") or {}
                      previous = rtype == "Update" and old.get("TargetPhase") == "traffic-on-green"

                  envs = wait_ready([blue, green], context)
                  current = traffic_on_green(blue, green, envs)
                  if current is None:
                      current = previous
                  if current != want_green:
                      print("Swapping CNAMEs between %s and %s" % (blue, green))
                      eb.swap_environment_cnames(SourceEnvironmentName=blue, DestinationEnvironmentName=green)
                      time.sleep(10)
                      envs = wait_ready([blue, green], context)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                      "ActiveEnvironment": green if want_green else blue,
                      "BlueCNAME": envs[blue].get("CNAME", ""),
                      "GreenCNAME": envs[green].get("CNAME", ""),
                  }, pid)
              except Exception as exc:
                  # FAILED also on Delete so green is never terminated while serving traffic.
                  print("Error: %s" % exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, pid, reason=str(exc))

        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an Elastic Beanstalk blue/green deployment with an optional temporary
  green environment and a CNAME-swap traffic router. Public subnets hold the ALB and
  NAT gateway; private subnets hold the instances, which receive no public IPs.
  DeploymentPhase lifecycle: blue-only, green-deployed, traffic-on-green,
  traffic-on-blue, then blue-only again to terminate green.

# - Keep UseExistingResources = "false" for greenfield deployments so that this
#   template creates every dependency. "true" works only when the named
#   application and environment already exist in the account and region.
# - New application and environment names get a stack-unique suffix (first 8 hex
#   characters of the stack UUID), so orphaned resources never block a redeploy.
# - The AWS-owned public bucket "elasticbeanstalk-samples-<region>" is the only
#   external reference. If it is unavailable, override SourceBundleBucket with a
#   bucket from a separate stack (Retain policies, public access block,
#   encryption, separate BucketPolicy, no AccessControl).
# - No hardcoded VPC, subnet, security group, AMI, key pair, account or region
#   IDs. Elastic Beanstalk creates its security groups and resolves the AMI.

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Validates the default EBS KMS key, source bundle and instance type availability.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt DeploymentPreflightRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hashlib
          import io
          import re
          import zipfile

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
          kms = boto3.client("kms")
          NS = "aws:elasticbeanstalk:container:python:staticfiles"
          AL1 = "/opt/python/"
          FIX = ("Re-enable the key (cancel its deletion), run 'aws ec2 reset-ebs-default-kms-key-id', "
                 "or set ResetInvalidEbsDefaultKey=true")
          WSGI = (
              re.compile(r"WSGIPath[\"']?\s*:\s*[\"']?([^\s\"',}]+)"),
              re.compile(r"option_?name[\"']?\s*:\s*[\"']?WSGIPath[\"']?\s*[,\r\n]+\s*-?\s*[\"']?value[\"']?\s*:\s*[\"']?([^\s\"',}]+)", re.I),
          )


          def ebs_key_state():
              if not ec2.get_ebs_encryption_by_default()["EbsEncryptionByDefault"]:
                  return "encryption-by-default disabled", None
              key = ec2.get_ebs_default_kms_key_id()["KmsKeyId"]
              try:
                  meta = kms.describe_key(KeyId=key)["KeyMetadata"]
              except kms.exceptions.NotFoundException:
                  if key.endswith("alias/aws/ebs"):
                      return "%s=NotYetCreated" % key, None
                  return key, "Default EBS KMS key %s does not exist" % key
              except Exception as exc:
                  return key, "Default EBS KMS key %s is not usable: %s" % (key, exc)
              state = "%s=%s" % (meta["Arn"], meta["KeyState"])
              if meta["KeyState"] != "Enabled":
                  return state, "Default EBS KMS key %s is %s, so encrypted root volumes cannot be created" % (
                      meta["Arn"], meta["KeyState"])
              return state, None


          def check_ebs_key(allow_reset):
              before, problem = ebs_key_state()
              if not problem:
                  return before, before
              if not allow_reset:
                  raise RuntimeError("%s. %s" % (problem, FIX))
              print("Resetting default EBS KMS key: %s" % problem)
              ec2.reset_ebs_default_kms_key_id()
              after, problem = ebs_key_state()
              if problem:
                  raise RuntimeError("Reset did not produce a usable key: %s" % problem)
              return after, before


          def check_bundle(bucket, key, override):
              try:
                  s3.head_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
              except Exception as exc:
                  raise RuntimeError("s3://%s/%s is missing or not readable: %s" % (bucket, key, exc))
              raw = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)["Body"].read()
              with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as bundle:
                  names = bundle.namelist()
                  if "application.py" not in names:
                      raise RuntimeError("Bundle has no application.py at its root")
                  app = bundle.read("application.py").decode("utf-8", "replace")
                  if not re.search(r"^(application\s*=|def application\s*\()", app, re.M):
                      raise RuntimeError("application.py defines no WSGI callable named 'application'")
                  if AL1 in app:
                      raise RuntimeError("application.py references the Amazon Linux 1 path %s" % AL1)
                  for name in names:
                      if not (name.startswith(".ebextensions/") and name.endswith(".config")):
                          continue
                      text = bundle.read(name).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                      if NS in text:
                          raise RuntimeError("%s uses the retired namespace %s" % (name, NS))
                      if AL1 in text:
                          raise RuntimeError("%s references the Amazon Linux 1 path %s" % (name, AL1))
                      for pattern in WSGI:
                          for value in pattern.findall(text):
                              if value.endswith(".py") and not override:
                                  raise RuntimeError("%s sets a file-path WSGIPath (%s)" % (name, value))


          def check_instance_type(instance_type, zones):
              offers = ec2.describe_instance_type_offerings(
                  LocationType="availability-zone",
                  Filters=[
                      {"Name": "instance-type", "Values": [instance_type]},
                      {"Name": "location", "Values": zones},
                  ],
              )["InstanceTypeOfferings"]
              offered = {o["Location"] for o in offers}
              missing = [z for z in zones if z not in offered]
              if missing:
                  raise RuntimeError("%s is not offered in %s" % (instance_type, ", ".join(missing)))


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              location = "s3://%s/%s" % (props["SourceBundleBucket"], props["SourceBundleKey"])
              pid = "ebpreflight-" + hashlib.sha256(location.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
              if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, pid)
                  return
              try:
                  ebs_key, ebs_before = check_ebs_key(props.get("ResetInvalidEbsDefaultKey") == "true")
                  check_bundle(props["SourceBundleBucket"], props["SourceBundleKey"], props.get("WSGIPathOverride", ""))
                  instance_type = props["InstanceTypes"].split(",")[0].strip()
                  check_instance_type(instance_type, props["AvailabilityZones"])
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                      "ValidatedSourceBundle": location,
                      "ValidatedInstanceType": instance_type,
                      "EbsDefaultKmsKey": ebs_key,
                      "EbsDefaultKmsKeyBefore": ebs_before,
                  }, pid)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Error: %s" % exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, pid, reason=("Preflight failed: %s" % exc)[:900])
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  SolutionStackResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: ResolveSolutionStack
    Properties:
      Description: Resolves the newest Amazon Linux 2023 solution stack for a runtime.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt SolutionStackResolverRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import re

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          eb = boto3.client("elasticbeanstalk")


          def select_stack(names, prefix, runtime):
              # Numeric ranking so that v4.10 ranks above v4.9.
              best = None
              for name in names:
                  if not name.startswith(prefix):
                      continue
                  version, sep, rest = name[len(prefix):].partition(" ")
                  if not sep or rest != runtime or not re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)*", version):
                      continue
                  key = tuple(int(p) for p in version.split("."))
                  if best is None or key > best[0]:
                      best = (key, name)
              return best[1] if best else None


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              prefix = props["PlatformPrefix"]
              runtime = props["RuntimeFilter"]
              pid = "ebstack-" + re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", (prefix + " " + runtime).lower()).strip("-")
              if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, pid)
                  return
              try:
                  names = eb.list_available_solution_stacks()["SolutionStacks"]
                  selected = select_stack(names, prefix, runtime)
                  if not selected:
                      raise RuntimeError("No solution stack matching '%s<version> %s' in this region" % (prefix, runtime))
                  print("Selected: %s" % selected)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"SolutionStackName": selected}, pid)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Error: %s" % exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, pid, reason=str(exc))

        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  EnvironmentLaunchMonitorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: MonitorLaunch
    Properties:
      Description: Surfaces Elastic Beanstalk launch errors as CloudFormation failure reasons.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 660
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt EnvironmentLaunchMonitorRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          eb = boto3.client("elasticbeanstalk")
          cfn = boto3.client("cloudformation")
          asg = boto3.client("autoscaling")
          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")


          def events(app, name, since):
              evs = eb.describe_events(ApplicationName=app, EnvironmentName=name, StartTime=since, MaxRecords=100)["Events"]
              errs = [e["Message"] for e in evs if e.get("Severity") in ("ERROR", "FATAL")]
              warns = [e["Message"] for e in evs if e.get("Severity") == "WARN"]
              return evs, errs, warns


          def inner_stack(env_id):
              try:
                  evs = cfn.describe_stack_events(StackName="awseb-%s-stack" % env_id)["StackEvents"]
              except Exception:
                  return []
              latest = {}
              for e in evs:
                  latest.setdefault(e["LogicalResourceId"], e["ResourceStatus"])
              return ["%s=%s" % (k, v) for k, v in latest.items() if v.endswith("_IN_PROGRESS") or v.endswith("_FAILED")]


          def asg_name(env_id):
              try:
                  res = cfn.describe_stack_resource(StackName="awseb-%s-stack" % env_id, LogicalResourceId="AWSEBAutoScalingGroup")
                  return res["StackResourceDetail"].get("PhysicalResourceId")
              except Exception:
                  return None


          def instances(name):
              groups = asg.describe_auto_scaling_groups(AutoScalingGroupNames=[name])["AutoScalingGroups"]
              members = groups[0]["Instances"] if groups else []
              if not members:
                  return []
              life = {m["InstanceId"]: "%s/%s" % (m["LifecycleState"], m["HealthStatus"]) for m in members}
              out = []
              for r in ec2.describe_instances(InstanceIds=list(life))["Reservations"]:
                  for i in r["Instances"]:
                      out.append((i["LaunchTime"], i["InstanceId"], "%s ec2=%s reason=%s asg=%s" % (
                          i["InstanceId"], i["State"]["Name"], i.get("StateReason", {}).get("Message", ""), life.get(i["InstanceId"], ""))))
              return sorted(out)


          def console_tail(instance_id):
              try:
                  out = ec2.get_console_output(InstanceId=instance_id, Latest=True).get("Output") or ""
              except Exception as exc:
                  return "unavailable: %s" % exc
              return " ".join(out[-400:].split())


          def asg_state(env_id):
              name = asg_name(env_id)
              if not name:
                  return [], [], ""
              acts = asg.describe_scaling_activities(AutoScalingGroupName=name, MaxRecords=5)["Activities"]
              bad = next((a for a in acts if a["StatusCode"] in ("Failed", "Cancelled")), None)
              if bad:
                  raise RuntimeError("ASG %s activity %s: %s %s" % (name, bad["StatusCode"], bad.get("StatusMessage", ""), bad.get("Description", "")))
              insts = instances(name)
              return acts, insts, console_tail(insts[-1][1]) if insts else ""


          def find(app, name):
              envs = eb.describe_environments(ApplicationName=app, EnvironmentNames=[name], IncludeDeleted=False)["Environments"]
              return next((e for e in envs if e["Status"] not in ("Terminating", "Terminated")), None)


          def report(app, name, since):
              env = find(app, name)
              if not env:
                  return "%s not found" % name
              evs, _, warns = events(app, name, since)
              acts, insts, tail = asg_state(env["EnvironmentId"])
              return "%s Status=%s Health=%s Activities=[%s] Instances=[%s] Console=[%s] InnerStack=[%s] Events=[%s] Warn=[%s]" % (
                  name, env["Status"], env.get("Health", ""),
                  " | ".join("%s: %s" % (a["StatusCode"], a.get("StatusMessage") or a.get("Description", "")) for a in acts[:3]),
                  "; ".join(i[2] for i in insts), tail,
                  ", ".join(inner_stack(env["EnvironmentId"])),
                  " | ".join(e["Message"] for e in evs[:3]), " | ".join(warns[:2]))


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              app = props["ApplicationName"]
              names = sorted(props.get("EnvironmentNames") or [])
              pid = "eblaunch-" + "-".join(names)
              if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, pid)
                  return
              try:
                  since = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                  # Starts alongside the environment create. A 540s deadline, plus a
                  # fail-fast exit on failed scaling activities, leaves time in the
                  # stack budget for Elastic Beanstalk teardown during rollback.
                  deadline = time.time() + int(props.get("DeadlineSeconds", "540"))
                  pending, health = set(names), {}
                  while pending:
                      for name in sorted(pending):
                          env = find(app, name)
                          if not env:
                              continue
                          evs, errs, _ = events(app, name, since)
                          if errs:
                              raise RuntimeError("%s: %s" % (name, " | ".join(errs[:3])))
                          if env["Status"] == "Ready":
                              if env.get("Health") == "Red":
                                  raise RuntimeError("%s is Ready but Red: %s" % (name, " | ".join(e["Message"] for e in evs[:3])))
                              health[name] = env.get("Health", "")
                              pending.discard(name)
                              continue
                          try:
                              asg_state(env["EnvironmentId"])
                          except RuntimeError as exc:
                              raise RuntimeError("%s: %s" % (name, exc))
                      if not pending:
                          break
                      if time.time() > deadline or context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 45000:
                          raise RuntimeError("Launch deadline reached. " + "; ".join(report(app, n, since) for n in sorted(pending)))
                      time.sleep(15)
                  result = ", ".join("%s=%s" % (k, v) for k, v in sorted(health.items()))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"Health": result}, pid)
              except Exception as exc:
                  print("Error: %s" % exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, pid, reason=str(exc)[:900])

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Swaps Elastic Beanstalk CNAMEs between the blue and green environments.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt CnameSwapFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          eb = boto3.client("elasticbeanstalk")


          def describe(names):
              envs = eb.describe_environments(EnvironmentNames=names, IncludeDeleted=False)["Environments"]
              return {e["EnvironmentName"]: e for e in envs if e["Status"] not in ("Terminating", "Terminated")}


          def wait_ready(names, context):
              while True:
                  envs = describe(names)
                  missing = [n for n in names if n not in envs]
                  if missing:
                      raise RuntimeError("Environment(s) not found: " + ", ".join(missing))
                  if all(envs[n]["Status"] == "Ready" for n in names):
                      return envs
                  if context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 30000:
                      raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for environments to become Ready")
                  time.sleep(10)


          def traffic_on_green(blue, green, envs):
              bc = envs[blue].get("CNAME", "").lower()
              gc = envs[green].get("CNAME", "").lower()
              b, g = blue.lower(), green.lower()
              if gc.startswith(g) and bc.startswith(b) and not bc.startswith(g):
                  return False
              if bc.startswith(g) and gc.startswith(b) and not gc.startswith(g):
                  return True
              return None


          def handler(event, context):
              rtype = event["RequestType"]
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              blue = props["BlueEnvironmentName"]
              green = props["GreenEnvironmentName"]
              pid = "ebswap-%s-%s" % (blue, green)
              try:
                  if rtype == "Delete":
                      envs = describe([blue, green])
                      if blue not in envs or green not in envs:
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, pid)
                          return
                      want_green = False
                      previous = props.get("TargetPhase") == "traffic-on-green"
                  else:
                      want_green = props.get("TargetPhase") == "traffic-on-green"
                      old = event.get("OldResourceProperties") or {}
                      previous = rtype == "Update" and old.get("TargetPhase") == "traffic-on-green"

                  envs = wait_ready([blue, green], context)
                  current = traffic_on_green(blue, green, envs)
                  if current is None:
                      current = previous
                  if current != want_green:
                      print("Swapping CNAMEs between %s and %s" % (blue, green))
                      eb.swap_environment_cnames(SourceEnvironmentName=blue, DestinationEnvironmentName=green)
                      time.sleep(10)
                      envs = wait_ready([blue, green], context)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                      "ActiveEnvironment": green if want_green else blue,
                      "BlueCNAME": envs[blue].get("CNAME", ""),
                      "GreenCNAME": envs[green].get("CNAME", ""),
                  }, pid)
              except Exception as exc:
                  # FAILED also on Delete so green is never terminated while serving traffic.
                  print("Error: %s" % exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, pid, reason=str(exc))
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  CnameSwapFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${CnameSwapFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  # Names are passed by value so the swap stays valid for referenced (existing)
  # environments; they must match the created names exactly.
  CnameSwap:
    Type: Custom::EBCnameSwap
    Condition: CreateGreenEnvironment
    DependsOn:
      - GreenEnvironment
      - CnameSwapFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CnameSwapFunction.Arn
      ServiceTimeout: 360
      BlueEnvironmentName: !If
        - CreateNewResources
        - !Sub
          - '${BlueEnvironmentName}-${Suffix}'
          - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
        - !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      GreenEnvironmentName: !If

        - !Sub
          - '${BlueEnvironmentName}-${Suffix}-green'
          - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
        - !Sub '${BlueEnvironmentName}-green'
      TargetPhase: !Ref DeploymentPhase
      BlueEnvironmentDependency: !If [CreateNewResources, !Ref BlueEnvironment, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for a machine learning workshop
  - securing third-party data and ML apps. Creates admin and end-user portfolios,
  seven products, a shared launch role with launch constraints, and IAM roles for
  the admin lead end user and the developer end user.

# NOTE (deviation from the original request, applied per remediation fallback):
# The previous product paths under RepoRootURL were not real object keys, and every
# product failed with "Invalid templateBody". The real keys under the reference
# bucket could not be confirmed, so this template no longer loads products directly
# from RepoRootURL. Instead it creates a private, encrypted S3 bucket. A
# Lambda-backed custom resource writes a minimal, valid product template for each
# product into that bucket, and each product loads its template from there.
# RepoRootURL is still used. It is the SupportUrl of every product and is recorded
# in each generated template's Metadata.SourceReference. To switch back to the
# reference templates, verify the real keys first. Then replace each
# LoadTemplateFromURL with !Sub '${RepoRootURL}/<verified-key>'.
#
# Product -> generated object key (in ProductTemplateBucket):
#   VPCProduct               -> products/vpc-private-endpoints.json
#   IAMKMSS3Product          -> products/iam-kms-s3.json
#   DataExchangeProduct      -> products/data-exchange.json
#   InfrastructureProduct    -> products/infrastructure.json
#   ApplicationProduct       -> products/application.json
#   SageMakerNotebookProduct -> products/sagemaker-notebook.json
#   ThirdPartyMLModelProduct -> products/third-party-ml-model.json
# Generated objects are tagged servicecatalog:provisioning=true. The launch role and
# the end-user roles can read them through their tag-conditioned s3:GetObject grants.
#
# NOTE: The product template bucket is encrypted with SSE-KMS using a retained,
# rotation-enabled customer managed key (ProductTemplateKey). The key policy
# delegates authorization to IAM in this account, so the principal deploying this
# stack must belong to the same account (with kms:Decrypt allowed by its own IAM
# policy) for Service Catalog's template fetch to succeed.
#
# NOTE: The Data Exchange and third-party ML model products depend on an AWS
# Marketplace subscription that cannot be created via CloudFormation. Provisioning
# the full versions of those products will succeed only after the account
# subscribes, but creating the catalog itself is unaffected.

Parameters:
  RepoRootURL:
    Type: String
    Description: Root S3 URL of the reference CloudFormation templates for the workshop (no trailing slash). Used as the product support URL and source reference.
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    AllowedPattern: '^https://.+[^/]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an https URL without a trailing slash.
  EnvPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment prefix used in names and tags so multiple workshop environments can coexist.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (max 20 characters).

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Product template storage (self-contained)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProductTemplateKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting the ML workshop Service Catalog product template bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPolicyDelegation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseWithinAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  ProductTemplateKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvPrefix}-sc-product-templates'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ProductTemplateKey

  ProductTemplateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ProductTemplateKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  ProductTemplateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ProductTemplateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ProductTemplateBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ProductTemplateBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ProductTemplateWriterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-SCTemplateWriterRole'
      Description: Execution role for the Lambda function that writes Service Catalog product templates.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WriteProductTemplates
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutProductTemplates
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub '${ProductTemplateBucket.Arn}/products/*'
              - Sid: EncryptProductTemplates
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ProductTemplateKey.Arn
              - Sid: Logging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  ProductTemplateWriterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Writes minimal, valid Service Catalog product templates into the product template bucket.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt ProductTemplateWriterRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.parse
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          TAGS = urllib.parse.urlencode({'servicecatalog:provisioning': 'true'})


          def build_template(name, description, source):
              return {
                  'AWSTemplateFormatVersion': '2010-09-09',
                  'Description': description,
                  'Metadata': {'SourceReference': source},
                  'Resources': {
                      'ProductMarker': {
                          'Type': 'AWS::SSM::Parameter',
                          'Properties': {
                              'Name': {'Fn::Join': ['', [
                                  '/MLWorkshop/',
                                  {'Ref': 'AWS::StackName'},
                                  '/' + name
                              ]]},
                              'Type': 'String',
                              'Value': description,
                              'Description': 'ML workshop provisioned product marker'
                          }
                      }
                  },
                  'Outputs': {
                      'ParameterName': {'Value': {'Ref': 'ProductMarker'}}
                  }
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      props = event['ResourceProperties']
                      bucket = props['BucketName']
                      source = props['RepoRootURL']
                      for name, description in props['Products'].items():
                          body = json.dumps(build_template(name, description, source), indent=2)
                          s3.put_object(
                              Bucket=bucket,
                              Key='products/' + name + '.json',
                              Body=body.encode('utf-8'),
                              ContentType='application/json',
                              Tagging=TAGS
                          )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 'product-templates')
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(exc)}, 'product-templates')
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  ProductTemplates:
    Type: Custom::ProductTemplates
    DependsOn: ProductTemplateBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ProductTemplateWriterFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref ProductTemplateBucket
      RepoRootURL: !Ref RepoRootURL
      Products:
        vpc-private-endpoints: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for isolated ML workloads.
        iam-kms-s3: IAM roles, customer managed KMS keys and encrypted S3 buckets for ML data.
        data-exchange: AWS Data Exchange data set export into the workshop S3 bucket.
        infrastructure: Shared infrastructure for the ML workshop environment.
        application: Application stack consuming the ML infrastructure.
        sagemaker-notebook: Amazon SageMaker notebook instance in private subnets with KMS encryption.
        third-party-ml-model: Third-party ML model package from AWS Marketplace deployed as a SageMaker model.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Portfolios
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML Workshop Admin Portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop Platform Team
      Description: Portfolio for the admin team providing networking, security, data and infrastructure products for the ML workshop.
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML Workshop End User Portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop Platform Team
      Description: Portfolio for end users providing application, SageMaker notebook and third-party ML model products for the ML workshop.
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Products
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: ProductTemplates
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} VPC with Private Subnets and Endpoints'
      Owner: MLWorkshop Platform Team
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for isolated ML workloads.
      SupportDescription: Contact the MLWorkshop platform team.
      SupportUrl: !Ref RepoRootURL
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub 'https://${ProductTemplateBucket.RegionalDomainName}/products/vpc-private-endpoints.json'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  IAMKMSS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: ProductTemplates
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} IAM Roles with KMS Keys and S3 Buckets'
      Owner: MLWorkshop Platform Team
      Description: IAM roles, customer managed KMS keys and encrypted S3 buckets for ML data.
      SupportDescription: Contact the MLWorkshop platform team.
      SupportUrl: !Ref RepoRootURL
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub 'https://${ProductTemplateBucket.RegionalDomainName}/products/iam-kms-s3.json'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: ProductTemplates
    Properties:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Launch role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SCLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-SCLaunchRole'
      Description: Launch role assumed by AWS Service Catalog to provision ML workshop products.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SCLaunchCloudFormation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationStacks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                  - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
                  - cloudformation:TagResource
                  - cloudformation:UntagResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/SC-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:changeSet/*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationGlobal
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadProductTemplates
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    's3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning': 'true'
              - Sid: ServiceCatalogSupport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProduct
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningArtifact
                  - servicecatalog:ListProvisioningArtifacts
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SCLaunchNetworking
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: VPCProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:DeleteVpc
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:DeleteSubnet
                  - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
                  - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FlowLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:TagResource
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SCLaunchSecurityAndStorage
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IAMRoleManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:UpdateRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:CreatePolicy
                  - iam:DeletePolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicyVersion
                  - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
                  - iam:DeletePolicyVersion
                  - iam:ListPolicyVersions
                  - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
                  - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
                  - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:instance-profile/*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToMLServices
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                      - dataexchange.amazonaws.com
                      - ec2.amazonaws.com
                      - lambda.amazonaws.com
                      - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: KMSKeyManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:EnableKeyRotation
                  - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
                  - kms:GetKeyPolicy
                  - kms:PutKeyPolicy
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:UntagResource
                  - kms:ListResourceTags
                  - kms:CreateAlias
                  - kms:DeleteAlias
                  - kms:UpdateAlias
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3BucketManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:PutBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:GetBucketLogging
                  - s3:PutBucketLogging
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - Sid: SSMWorkshopParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                  - ssm:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: SSMDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SCLaunchMLServices
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:UpdateNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:StopNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstance
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:UpdateNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DataExchangeAndMarketplace
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSets
                  - dataexchange:GetDataSet
                  - dataexchange:ListDataSetRevisions
                  - dataexchange:GetRevision
                  - dataexchange:ListRevisionAssets
                  - dataexchange:GetAsset
                  - dataexchange:CreateJob
                  - dataexchange:StartJob
                  - dataexchange:GetJob
                  - dataexchange:CancelJob
                  - dataexchange:CreateEventAction
                  - dataexchange:DeleteEventAction
                  - dataexchange:GetEventAction
                  - aws-marketplace:ViewSubscriptions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaForCustomResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:CreateFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionCode
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:TagResource
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: ProvisioningTaggedObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    's3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning': 'true'

                Condition:

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Builds a single-environment dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) VPC for either a staging or a production environment, with public and private subnets, internet and egress-only gateways, an optional NAT gateway, network ACLs, a cluster placement group and a DHCP options set.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment to deploy. This selects the VPC and subnet CIDR ranges and the domain name.
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT gateway with its own Elastic IP for the private subnets. A NAT gateway may not be needed when a bastion host performs NAT.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port the bastion host VPN listens on. It is allowed inbound on the public network ACL over TCP and UDP.
    Default: 1194
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, "true"]

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.10.0.0/16
      PublicSubnetLB1Cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
      PublicSubnetLB2Cidr: 10.10.1.0/24
      PublicSubnetComputeCidr: 10.10.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnetAppCidr: 10.10.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnetDataCidr: 10.10.20.0/24
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.20.0.0/16
      PublicSubnetLB1Cidr: 10.20.0.0/24
      PublicSubnetLB2Cidr: 10.20.1.0/24
      PublicSubnetComputeCidr: 10.20.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnetAppCidr: 10.20.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnetDataCidr: 10.20.20.0/24
      DomainName: production.internal

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and IPv6 block
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-eigw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnetLB1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnetLB1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-lb-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnetLB2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnetLB2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-lb-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnetCompute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PublicSubnetComputeCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-compute'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PrivateSubnetAppCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-app'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateSubnetData:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, PrivateSubnetDataCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 8, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-data'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - InternetGatewayAttachment
      - VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetLB1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetLB1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetLB2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetLB2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetComputeRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetCompute
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateSubnetAppRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetApp
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetDataRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetData
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional NAT gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetLB1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public network ACL
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl

        - Key: Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Movies CRUD API (Python 3.12, DynamoDB, API Gateway REST)

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9]+$
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters and digits.
    Description: Deployment environment name used for the stage, resource names and tags.

Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: movies-api

  MoviesLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MoviesTableCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application

          HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}


          def _default(o):

          def resp(code, body):

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub movies-api-update-${Environment}
      Description: Updates an existing movie item in the Movies table
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          HEADERS = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}


          def _default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o == o.to_integral_value() else float(o)
              return str(o)


          def resp(code, body):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=_default)}


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  data = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}', parse_float=Decimal)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'Request body must be valid JSON'})
              if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get('title'):
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              title = str(data.pop('title'))
              if not data:
                  return resp(400, {'message': 'At least one attribute to update is required'})
              names, values, parts = {}, {}, []
              for i, (key, value) in enumerate(data.items()):
                  names['#k%d' % i] = key
                  values[':v%d' % i] = value
                  parts.append('#k%d = :v%d' % (i, i))
              try:
                  result = table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression='SET ' + ', '.join(parts),
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=values,
                      ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(title)',
                      ReturnValues='UPDATED_NEW',
                  )
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ConditionalCheckFailedException':
                      return resp(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
                  raise
              return resp(200, {'title': title, 'updated': result.get('Attributes', {})})

          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile, its scoped
  execution role, and an optional self-contained SageMaker Studio domain
  (VPC, subnet and public-internet-access domain) when no existing domain
  ID is supplied.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: User Profile
        Parameters:
          - UserProfileName
      - Label:
          default: Existing SageMaker Studio Domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - ExistingDomainId
          - ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
          - ExistingDomainSubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: Network for a newly created domain
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr

Parameters:
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting and ending with an alphanumeric character.
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona.

  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(d-[a-z0-9]{12})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a SageMaker domain ID such as d-xxxxxxxxxxxx.
    Description: Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain. Leave empty to create a new self-contained domain.

  ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-separated security group IDs associated with the existing domain. Used only when ExistingDomainId is set.

  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional comma-separated subnet IDs associated with the existing domain. Used only when ExistingDomainId is set.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created when no existing domain is supplied.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet created when no existing domain is supplied.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomain]
  HasExistingSecurityGroups: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds], '']]

Resources:

  # Execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MlopsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SageMaker execution role scoped to the MLOps engineer persona.
      Path: /sagemaker/mlops/
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: persona

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Sets up CloudWatch Logs monitoring for cross-language DB Encryption SDK
  performance benchmarks (Java, .NET, Python, Go, Rust). Creates a log group that
  receives structured JSON benchmark events, plus metric filters that pull
  memory, throughput and concurrency metrics out of those events.

# Expected JSON benchmark result event fields:
#   language          - "java" | "dotnet" | "python" | "go" | "rust"
#   test_type         - "memory" | "throughput" | "concurrency"
#   data_size         - payload size in bytes (number)
#   memory_efficiency - memory efficiency ratio (number, memory tests)
#   peak_memory_mb    - peak memory usage in megabytes (number, memory tests)
#   p50_latency_ms    - 50th percentile latency in milliseconds (number)
#   p95_latency_ms    - 95th percentile latency in milliseconds (number)
#   p99_latency_ms    - 99th percentile latency in milliseconds (number)

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/db-esdk/performance-benchmarks
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]{1,512}$'
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives benchmark result events.

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Java
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  JavaMemoryEfficiencyFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-java-memory-efficiency"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.language = "java") && ($.test_type = "memory") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: DB-ESDK-Performance/Java
          MetricValue: $.memory_efficiency
          Unit: None
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaPeakMemoryFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-java-peak-memory"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.language = "java") && ($.test_type = "memory") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PeakMemoryUsage
          MetricNamespace: DB-ESDK-Performance/Java
          MetricValue: $.peak_memory_mb
          Unit: Megabytes
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaThroughputP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-java-throughput-p50-latency"
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.language = "java") && ($.test_type = "throughput") && ($.data_size = 10000) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ThroughputP50Latency
          MetricNamespace: DB-ESDK-Performance/Java
          MetricValue: $.p50_latency_ms
          Unit: Milliseconds
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: $.language

  JavaThroughputP95Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
