AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Data Master project – IAM roles for the ingestion-to-analytics data pipeline

# This template creates only AWS::IAM::Role resources and their inline policies.
# It does not create KMS keys, VPCs, buckets, streams, secrets or other non-IAM
# resources. Deploy it with CAPABILITY_IAM.
#
# Role names: no role sets an explicit RoleName, so CloudFormation generates
# unique names. This avoids name collisions and the need for
# CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.
# AWS DMS looks for a role named exactly "dms-vpc-role" when it manages VPC
# resources itself. If you need that automatic behavior, add
# "RoleName: dms-vpc-role" to DmsVpcRole only, and deploy with
# CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an existing KMS key used to encrypt raw data. If you leave it empty, KMS permissions are scoped to the keys in this account and region.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid KMS key ARN.

  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: 12-digit AWS account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole trust conditions. If you leave it empty, the current account is used.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.

Conditions:
  HasKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
  HasTargetAccountId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetAccountId, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS VPC management role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - DMS VPC management role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDmsAssumeRoleScopedToTargetAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS -> Kinesis target role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - DMS role for writing to Kinesis Data Streams
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-kinesis-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KinesisWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: KmsEncryptForStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Pipes: Kinesis -> Firehose
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipesFirehoseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - EventBridge Pipes role for forwarding data to Firehose
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-pipes-firehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: KinesisSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: FirehoseTargetWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*
              - Sid: KmsDecryptSource
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Kinesis Data Firehose delivery role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Firehose delivery role for raw data lake ingestion
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-firehose-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Delivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KinesisSourceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: TransformLambdaInvoke
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*:*
              - Sid: FormatConversionGlueCatalog
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTableVersion
                  - glue:GetTableVersions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm_*/*
              - Sid: DeliveryErrorLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/dm-*:log-stream:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda processing controller
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProcessingControllerFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Lambda processing controller execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-processing-controller
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3DataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: StartOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:execution:dm-*:*
              - Sid: ControlStateTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda router
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RouterFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Lambda routing function execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-router
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RouteToFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*
              - Sid: RouteToKinesis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: RouteToSqs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*
              - Sid: RouteToEventBus
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue crawler
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Glue crawler role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-glue-crawler
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReadForCrawling
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsDecryptRawData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: LakeFormationDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess

      Tags:
        - Key: Project

        - Key: Component

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueEtlJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Glue ETL job role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-glue-etl
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*

                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: LakeFormationDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lake Formation data location registration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LakeFormationDataAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Lake Formation role for registered S3 data lake locations
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

        - PolicyName: dm-lakeformation-data-access

            Statement:
              - Sid: S3DataLakeLocations

          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Fargate task execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - ECS Fargate task execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Fargate worker task role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - ECS Fargate worker task role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-worker
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: WorkQueueConsume
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*
              - Sid: StepFunctionsTaskCallback
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:SendTaskSuccess
                  - states:SendTaskFailure
                  - states:SendTaskHeartbeat
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EMR Serverless job runtime role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EmrServerlessJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - EMR Serverless job runtime role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: emr-serverless.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-emr-serverless-job
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3ReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*']
              - Sid: GlueCatalogAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm_*/*
              - Sid: JobLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/emr-serverless/dm-*
              - Sid: LakeFormationDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions orchestration role (only role that references other roles)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsOrchestrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Step Functions pipeline orchestration role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-stepfunctions-orchestration
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*:*
              - Sid: GlueJobsAndCrawlers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:StartCrawler
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:crawler/dm-*
              - Sid: EcsRunTask
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RunTask
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:task-definition/dm-*:*
              - Sid: EcsTaskControl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:StopTask
                  - ecs:DescribeTasks
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:task/*
              - Sid: EmrServerlessJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - emr-serverless:StartJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:GetJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:CancelJobRun
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:emr-serverless:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:/applications/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:emr-serverless:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:/applications/*/jobruns/*
              - Sid: SyncIntegrationRules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForECSTaskRule
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForEMRServerlessJobRule
              - Sid: PassPipelineRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt WorkerRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt EmrServerlessJobRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
                      - emr-serverless.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ExecutionLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS Managed Grafana monitoring role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GrafanaMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Data Master - Amazon Managed Grafana monitoring role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: grafana.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !If [HasTargetAccountId, !Ref TargetAccountId, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-grafana-monitoring
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetInsightRuleReport
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:GetQueryResults
                  - logs:StopQuery
                  - tag:GetResources
                  - ec2:DescribeRegions
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ProjectLogsQuery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:GetLogGroupFields
                  - logs:StartQuery
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/emr-serverless/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/ecs/dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Monitors the health of a cross-region failover Remittance application using CloudWatch metric alarms aggregated into API Gateway, Lambda and RDS composite alarms.

Resources:
  ApiGateway4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Average 4XX error rate for the Remittance API is above 0 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Average 5XX error rate for the Remittance API is above 1 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Average latency for the Remittance API is at or above 10000 ms over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances Lambda function errors are above 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance Lambda function errors are above 0 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances Lambda function invocations are above 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance Lambda function invocations are above 2 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances Lambda function average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:

    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance Lambda function average duration is at or above 10000 ms over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average database connections are at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:

    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average deadlocks are at or above 10.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average network transmit throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average network receive throughput is at or above 10485760 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average queries are at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average disk queue depth is at or above 50.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average read latency is at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: dbcluster1-instance1 average write latency is at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight Admin Suite monitoring and data-extraction pipeline. Creates a private
  output S3 bucket encrypted with a customer managed KMS key, a single IAM role,
  seven scheduled AWS Glue jobs (five Python shell, two Spark ETL) that collect
  QuickSight asset access, asset metadata, folder, Q topic, Q access, dataset and
  data source details, and five CloudWatch metric streams that deliver QuickSight
  metrics to S3 through Kinesis Data Firehose DirectPut delivery streams.

# NOTE ON GLUE SCRIPTS:
# There is no pre-existing script bucket in this account. All Glue job scripts
# are expected under the glue-scripts/ prefix of the bucket created by this
# template: s3://admin-suite-<AccountId>/glue-scripts/<job_name>.py
# AWS Glue does not check that the script exists when a job is created, so you
# can upload the scripts after the stack is deployed. Until you do, scheduled
# runs will fail. Objects in the bucket are encrypted with the AdminSuiteKey
# customer managed KMS key, so whoever uploads the scripts needs
# kms:GenerateDataKey on that key.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key
  # The key policy does not reference AdminSuiteRole, which avoids a circular
  # dependency. The role gets key access through its own IAM policy, which the
  # account root statement allows.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight Admin Suite bucket, Firehose delivery and logs.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/admin-suite
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Output bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowAdminSuiteRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role (Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose, CloudWatch metric streams)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'AdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role for the QuickSight Admin Suite Glue jobs, Firehose delivery streams and CloudWatch metric streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGlue
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueJobAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/etl_job_admin_suite_*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/trigger_etl_job_admin_suite_*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteS3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BucketLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ObjectLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource: !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteKms
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseAdminSuiteKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/admin-suite:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteFirehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: FirehoseDeliveryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteIAM
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IAMReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:GetGroup
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListUsers
                  - iam:ListGroups
                  - iam:ListGroupsForUser
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassOwnRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/AdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
                      - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Python shell jobs (Python 3.9, Glue 3.0)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  AssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Collects QuickSight folder structure information.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Collects QuickSight Q topic metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  QAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Collects QuickSight Q object access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Spark ETL jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X, 2 workers)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DsPropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Collects QuickSight dataset properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--S3_OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteBucket}/glue-temp/'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
      Tags:
        Project: QuickSightAdminSuite
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  DatasourcePropertiesJob:

      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties

      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/glue-scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:

  AssetsAccessTrigger:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Kitten CRUD API using Amazon API Gateway with direct DynamoDB service integrations (no Lambda), on-demand DynamoDB billing, request validation, and full CORS support.

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by API Gateway to call DynamoDB directly for the Kitten API
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenApi
      Description: Serverless CRUD API for the Kitten service
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  KittenModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenModel
      Description: Request body schema for creating or replacing a Kitten
      ContentType: application/json
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: KittenModel
        type: object
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          color:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
        required:
          - name
          - color

  KittenRequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenBodyAndParamsValidator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  CreateKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref KittenRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": {"S": "$context.requestId"},
                "name": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.name')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"},
                "color": {"S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.color')).replaceAll("\\'","'")"}
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '201'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$context.requestId"
                }
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Standard Step Functions state machine with a Pass state, a version and an alias. The alias is started by API Gateway, EventBridge rules and EventBridge Scheduler.

Resources:
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Pass-only state machine. It has no permission policies because the Pass state calls no services.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        StartAt: PassState
        States:
          PassState:
            Type: Pass
            Result: 1
            End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: Initial version of the Pass state machine

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: Alias that sends all traffic to the published version
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # API Gateway trigger
  ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets API Gateway start executions on the state machine alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StepFunctionsStartExecutionApi
      Description: REST API that starts executions on the state machine alias
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  ExecuteResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  ExecuteGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ExecuteResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      # NONE is used because the request asks for it. Use AWS_IAM in production.
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStartExecutionRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub '{"stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}"}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ExecuteGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment of the StartExecution API

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      Description: Production stage
      TracingEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  # EventBridge rule for executions that end without success
  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the terminated-state-change rule start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  TerminatedStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias when a Step Functions execution is aborted, fails or times out
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - ABORTED
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge rule that runs every minute (starts disabled)
  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the scheduled rule start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias every minute (disabled at creation)
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge rule for AWS Tag service events
  TagRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets the tag-event rule start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: StepFunctionsTriggers

  TagEventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts the alias on AWS Tag service tag change events
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge Scheduler trigger
  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Lets EventBridge Scheduler start executions on the alias
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
