final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the IAM bootstrap resources for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) on
  Amazon EKS. Creates four IAM roles, three instance profiles, four managed
  policies attached to those roles, and one standalone read-only EKS console
  policy. This template sets fixed RoleName, InstanceProfileName and
  ManagedPolicyName values, so you must deploy it with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMRoleControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA control-plane role assumed by EC2 control-plane instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AWSIAMRoleNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA nodes role assumed by EC2 worker instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  AWSIAMRoleControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA controllers role assumed by EC2 instances and EKS Pod Identity.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession

  AWSIAMRoleEKSControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-controlplane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA EKS control plane service role assumed by Amazon EKS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance Profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers

  AWSIAMInstanceProfileNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleNodes

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider (control plane)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider running on CAPA control-plane nodes.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudProviderAutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudProviderEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudProviderLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudProviderELBServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: CloudProviderKMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action: kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: node registration and image pulls (control plane + nodes)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyCloudProviderNodes:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Permissions for CAPA cluster nodes to register, pull images, read bootstrap data and use SSM.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleNodes
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: NodesEC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignIpv6Addresses
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NodesECR
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr:ListImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NodesBootstrapSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: NodesSSM
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: Cluster API controllers (controllers + control plane)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyControllers:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: Permissions for the Cluster API AWS controllers to manage cluster infrastructure.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ControllersEC2Networking
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateCarrierGateway
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteCarrierGateway
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeCarrierGateways
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DescribeEgressOnlyInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ControllersEC2LaunchTemplates
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ControllersAutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeInstanceRefreshes
              - autoscaling:StartInstanceRefresh
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ControllersLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ControllersAutoScalingServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: autoscaling.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ControllersELBServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ControllersSpotServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/spot.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForEC2Spot'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: spot.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: ControllersPassCAPARoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io'
          - Sid: ControllersBootstrapSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
              - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
              - secretsmanager:TagResource
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          # Public AWS-owned SSM parameters have an empty account field in their ARN.
          - Sid: ControllersEKSOptimizedAMIParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*::parameter/aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policy: EKS-specific controller permissions (controllers + control plane)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Omitted on purpose (objective 25): these EKS actions are not certain to be
  # valid in the current IAM service authorization reference, or CAPA does not
  # need them for bootstrap:
  #   - eks:DescribeClusterVersions
  #   - eks:CreatePodIdentityAssociation, eks:DescribePodIdentityAssociation,
  #     eks:UpdatePodIdentityAssociation, eks:DeletePodIdentityAssociation,
  #     eks:ListPodIdentityAssociations
  # Add them after you confirm them against the IAM service authorization reference.
  AWSIAMManagedPolicyControllersEKS:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers-eks.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: EKS-specific permissions for the Cluster API AWS controllers to manage EKS clusters, node groups, add-ons and Fargate profiles.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControllers
        - !Ref AWSIAMRoleControlPlane
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Effect: Allow
            Action: ssm:GetParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:*::parameter/aws/service/eks/optimized-ami/*'

            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: eks.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSNodegroupServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSNodegroup'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSFargateServiceLinkedRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKSForFargate'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: EKSOIDCProviders

            Action:
              - iam:AddClientIDToOpenIDConnectProvider

              - iam:UpdateOpenIDConnectProviderThumbprint

            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSManageRoles
            Effect: Allow

              - iam:AttachRolePolicy

              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Two-AZ VPC networking foundation with managed NAT gateways, VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs, and S3 gateway plus ECR interface VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /22.
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC (prefix /16 to /22).
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC flow log events in CloudWatch Logs.
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: PublicAddressing
          Value: Explicit only - attach an Elastic IP or front with a load balancer

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: PublicAddressing
          Value: Explicit only - attach an Elastic IP or front with a load balancer

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 4, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver flow log records to the stack's CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS restricted to the VPC CIDR range
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to within the VPC only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First Availability Zone used by the network
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ1'
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second Availability Zone used by the network
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ2'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1 (AZ 1); public IPs are not auto-assigned, request them explicitly
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2 (AZ 2); public IPs are not auto-assigned, request them explicitly
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1 (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2 (AZ 2)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group protecting the interface VPC endpoints
    Value: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provides VPC networking for the KerberosEMRonEKS Microsoft AD infrastructure, including public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, encrypted VPC flow logs and private interface endpoints for SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages and Secrets Manager.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatEIP1

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatEIP2

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGW1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGW2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRT

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRT1

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRT2

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting KerberosEMRonEKS VPC flow logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKey

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-flowlogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogGroup

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}:log-stream:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogRole

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCFlowLog

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoints-SG
      GroupDescription: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoints-SG - HTTPS access to VPC interface endpoints from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS to the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpoints-SG

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCId

  VPCCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the KerberosEMRonEKS VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCCidr

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1Id

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2Id

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1Id

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2Id

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 1
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway1Id

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 2
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-NatGateway2Id

  VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the shared VPC endpoint security group
    Value: !Ref VPCEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpointSecurityGroupId

  FlowLogKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt VPC flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKmsKeyArn

  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogGroupName

  SSMEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the SSM interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref SSMEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMEndpointId

  SSMMessagesEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the SSM Messages interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref SSMMessagesEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMMessagesEndpointId

  EC2MessagesEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the EC2 Messages interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref EC2MessagesEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-EC2MessagesEndpointId

  SecretsManagerEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Secrets Manager interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref SecretsManagerEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: KerberosEMRonEKS-SecretsManagerEndpointId

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with one test user profile and its execution role.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: sagemaker-vpconly-domain
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain.
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-user
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the test user profile.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the dedicated domain VPC.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (private only - VpcOnly mode reaches AWS services via endpoints)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DomainSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: SageMaker Domain security group for Studio apps and EFS access
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to in-VPC interface endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-domain-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  DomainSecurityGroupNfsIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DomainSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref DomainSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 2049
      ToPort: 2049
      Description: NFS to the domain EFS home volume

  DomainSecurityGroupAppsIngress:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates saved CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for Claude Code usage, performance and cost analytics, scoped to the Claude Code metrics log group.

Parameters:
  MetricsLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]{1,512}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name of 1-512 characters containing only letters, numbers, periods, hyphens, underscores, forward slashes and hash signs.
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives Claude Code OpenTelemetry metrics.

Resources:
  ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref MetricsLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 90

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Group 1 - Real-Time Monitoring
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RtTokenRequestRatePerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/1-Real-Time Monitoring/Token and Request Rate per User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Tokens and API requests per user per minute (requests approximated by input token records)
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`user.email`, `user.account_uuid`, "unknown") as user_id
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") as is_request
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tokens_per_minute,
                sum(is_request) as requests_per_minute
          by bin(1m) as minute, user_id
        | sort minute desc, tokens_per_minute desc
        | limit 500

  RtCurrentTpmRpmQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/1-Real-Time Monitoring/Current TPM and RPM Averages'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Average and peak tokens-per-minute (TPM) and requests-per-minute (RPM) across all users
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") as is_request
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tpm,
                sum(is_request) as rpm
          by bin(1m)
        | stats avg(tpm) as avg_tpm,
                max(tpm) as peak_tpm,
                avg(rpm) as avg_rpm,
                max(rpm) as peak_rpm

  RtRateLimitRiskQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/1-Real-Time Monitoring/Rate Limit Risk'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Users whose per-minute token or request volume approaches typical rate limits
        # Adjust the thresholds below to match your organization's limits
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`user.email`, `user.account_uuid`, "unknown") as user_id
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") as is_request
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tpm,
                sum(is_request) as rpm
          by bin(1m) as minute, user_id
        | filter tpm > 80000 or rpm > 40
        | sort tpm desc
        | limit 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Group 2 - User & Session Analytics
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserSessionUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/2-User & Session Analytics/Session Level Usage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Token and cost totals per session, including duration
        filter ispresent(`session.id`)
        | fields coalesce(`user.email`, `user.account_uuid`, "unknown") as user_id
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as total_tokens,
                sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as total_cost_usd,
                min(@timestamp) as session_start,
                max(@timestamp) as session_end,
                count(*) as metric_records
          by `session.id`, user_id
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 200

  UserHourlyActivityTimelineQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/2-User & Session Analytics/Hourly Activity Timeline'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Hourly activity per user: tokens, cost and active sessions
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`user.email`, `user.account_uuid`, "unknown") as user_id
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tokens,
                sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as cost_usd,
                count_distinct(`session.id`) as active_sessions
          by bin(1h) as hour, user_id
        | sort hour desc, tokens desc
        | limit 1000

  UserErrorThrottlingDetectionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/2-User & Session Analytics/Error and Throttling Detection'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Records indicating API errors, throttling or rate limiting
        filter @message like /(?i)(error|throttl|rate.?limit|429|overloaded|529)/
        | fields coalesce(`user.email`, `user.account_uuid`, "unknown") as user_id
        | stats count(*) as error_events
          by bin(5m) as window, user_id, `session.id`
        | sort window desc, error_events desc
        | limit 500

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Group 3 - Cost & Attribution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CostByUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/3-Cost & Attribution/Cost by User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Total estimated cost and token usage per user
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`user.email`, `user.account_uuid`, "unknown") as user_id
        | stats sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as total_cost_usd,
                sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as total_tokens,
                count_distinct(`session.id`) as sessions
          by user_id
        | sort total_cost_usd desc
        | limit 500

  CostByModelQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/3-Cost & Attribution/Cost by Model'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Total estimated cost and token usage per model
        filter ispresent(model)
        | stats sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as total_cost_usd,
                sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as total_tokens,
                count_distinct(`user.account_uuid`) as users
          by model
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  CostByOrganizationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/3-Cost & Attribution/Cost by Organization'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Total estimated cost and token usage per organization
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields coalesce(`organization.id`, "unknown") as org_id
        | stats sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as total_cost_usd,
                sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as total_tokens,
                count_distinct(`user.account_uuid`) as users,
                count_distinct(`session.id`) as sessions
          by org_id
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Group 4 - Analysis & Debugging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnalysisModelEfficiencyQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Model Efficiency'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Output-to-input ratio and cost per 1K tokens for each model
        filter ispresent(model)
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") * `claude_code.token.usage` as input_tokens
        | fields strcontains(type, "output") * `claude_code.token.usage` as output_tokens
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as total_input,
                sum(output_tokens) as total_output,
                sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as total_tokens,
                sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as total_cost_usd
          by model
        | fields model, total_input, total_output, total_tokens, total_cost_usd,
                 total_output / total_input as output_input_ratio,
                 total_cost_usd * 1000 / total_tokens as cost_per_1k_tokens
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  AnalysisCacheHitRateOverallQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Cache Hit Rate - Overall'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Overall prompt cache hit and miss rates
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields strcontains(type, "cacheRead") * `claude_code.token.usage` as cache_read
        | fields strcontains(type, "cacheCreation") * `claude_code.token.usage` as cache_creation
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") * `claude_code.token.usage` as uncached_input
        | stats sum(cache_read) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(cache_creation) as cache_creation_tokens,
                sum(uncached_input) as uncached_input_tokens
        | fields cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens,
                 cache_read_tokens * 100 / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) as cache_hit_rate_pct,
                 (cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) * 100 / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) as cache_miss_rate_pct

  AnalysisCacheHitRateOverTimeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Cache Hit Rate - Over Time'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Hourly prompt cache hit rate trend
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | fields strcontains(type, "cacheRead") * `claude_code.token.usage` as cache_read
        | fields strcontains(type, "cacheCreation") * `claude_code.token.usage` as cache_creation
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") * `claude_code.token.usage` as uncached_input
        | stats sum(cache_read) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(cache_creation) as cache_creation_tokens,
                sum(uncached_input) as uncached_input_tokens
          by bin(1h) as hour
        | fields hour, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens,
                 cache_read_tokens * 100 / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) as cache_hit_rate_pct
        | sort hour desc

  AnalysisCacheHitRateBySessionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Cache Hit Rate - By Session'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Prompt cache hit rate per session, lowest hit rates first
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`) and ispresent(`session.id`)
        | fields strcontains(type, "cacheRead") * `claude_code.token.usage` as cache_read
        | fields strcontains(type, "cacheCreation") * `claude_code.token.usage` as cache_creation
        | fields strcontains(type, "input") * `claude_code.token.usage` as uncached_input
        | stats sum(cache_read) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(cache_creation) as cache_creation_tokens,
                sum(uncached_input) as uncached_input_tokens
          by `session.id`
        | fields `session.id`, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens,
                 cache_read_tokens * 100 / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) as cache_hit_rate_pct
        | sort cache_hit_rate_pct asc
        | limit 200

  AnalysisPeakUsageWindowsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Peak Usage Windows'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Busiest 15-minute windows by token volume
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tokens,
                sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as cost_usd,
                count_distinct(`user.account_uuid`) as active_users,
                count_distinct(`session.id`) as active_sessions
          by bin(15m) as window
        | sort tokens desc
        | limit 25

  AnalysisSessionDeepDiveQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Session Deep Dive'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Replace REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID with the session to investigate
        filter `session.id` = "REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID"
        | fields @timestamp, model, type,
                 `claude_code.token.usage` as tokens,
                 `claude_code.cost.usage` as cost_usd,
                 `user.email`, `organization.id`, @message
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 1000

  AnalysisFieldExplorerQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Field Explorer'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Inspect raw records to discover available metric names and attributes
        fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  AnalysisDailyUsageSummaryQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Daily Usage Summary'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Daily totals for tokens, cost, users and sessions
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`) or ispresent(`claude_code.cost.usage`)
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as total_tokens,
                sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as total_cost_usd,
                count_distinct(`user.account_uuid`) as active_users,
                count_distinct(`session.id`) as sessions
          by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day desc

  AnalysisTokenTypeBreakdownQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Token Type Breakdown'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Token volume split by token type (input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreation) and model
        filter ispresent(`claude_code.token.usage`)
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tokens,
                count(*) as records
          by type, model
        | sort tokens desc

  AnalysisModelUsageTrendQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: 'Claude Code/4-Analysis & Debugging/Model Usage Trend'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        # Hourly token and cost trend per model
        filter ispresent(model)
        | stats sum(`claude_code.token.usage`) as tokens,
                sum(`claude_code.cost.usage`) as cost_usd
          by bin(1h) as hour, model
        | sort hour desc, tokens desc
        | limit 1000

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AppSync GraphQL API "SuperCoolAPI" with IAM auth, full CloudWatch request logging, and multiple DynamoDB data sources backed by Table1.

Resources:
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AppSync to push request logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs'

  SuperCoolApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  SuperCoolApiLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/appsync/apis/${SuperCoolApi.ApiId}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows AppSync data sources to access the Table1 DynamoDB table.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AppSyncDynamoDBAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Full read-write access to Table1 and its secondary indexes.
      Roles:
        - !Ref AppSyncDynamoDBRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: TableReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
              - !Sub '${Table1.Arn}/index/*'

  TableDataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: AppSyncDynamoDBAccessPolicy
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolApi.ApiId
      Name: TableDataSourceRef
      Description: DynamoDB data source referencing table and region with Ref.
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB

      RequestMappingTemplate: |

    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver

    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo

      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap IAM identities (roles,
  instance profiles and customer managed policies) for EKS clusters with
  managed node groups and Fargate support. Deploy with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA control plane role assumable by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA controllers role assumable by EC2 instances and EKS pods
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEKSPodsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA nodes role assumable by EC2 instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-controlplane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA EKS control plane service role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

  EKSFargateRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-fargate.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA EKS Fargate pod execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEKSFargatePodsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'

  EKSNodegroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-nodegroup.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA EKS managed node group role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AndEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'

        Statement:

            Action:
