AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates the IAM execution role and its policies for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster that runs on Amazon EKS, along with a dedicated VPC, private subnets, security group, KMS-encrypted lifecycle scripts S3 bucket, and its customer managed KMS key.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-eks
    Description: Prefix used for resource names. The execution role is named by appending "ExecRole" to this prefix.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 56
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character, contain only alphanumerics and hyphens, and be at most 56 characters.
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: sagemaker-hyperpod-eks-cluster
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster used to scope the eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity permission.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the HyperPod VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
  RigInputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of the RIG input S3 bucket.
  RigOutputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of a separate RIG output S3 bucket.
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the RIG policy.
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to grant gated access permissions (S3 access points and SQS) in the RIG policy.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateRigResources: !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
  HasRigInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigInputS3Bucket, '']]
  HasRigOutputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputS3Bucket, '']]
  IsGatedAccessEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Condition ShouldCreateRigResources
    - !Condition HasRigInputBucket
  GrantGatedAccess: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Condition IsGatedAccessEnabled
  GrantRigOutputAccess: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Condition HasRigOutputBucket

Resources:
  HyperPodVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-vpc'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker HyperPod cluster nodes
      VpcId: !Ref HyperPodVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-sg'
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  HyperPodSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow all traffic between HyperPod nodes in this security group

  LifecycleScriptsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the SageMaker HyperPod lifecycle scripts S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKeyWithinAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  LifecycleScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LifecycleScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  HyperPodExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      Description: Execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with Amazon EKS
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-EKSCNIPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EKSCNIDescribeAndAttach
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EKSCNICreateTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-ExecutionRolePolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EniManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${HyperPodVPC}'
              - Sid: Ec2ReadNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPullImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchDescribeAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksPodIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsGet
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${LifecycleScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsKmsDecrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LifecycleScriptsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker:HyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-RigPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RigInputList
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputS3Bucket}'
          - Sid: RigInputGet
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigInputS3Bucket}/*'
          - Sid: RigInvokeSageMakerLambda
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - !If
            - GrantGatedAccess
            - Sid: GatedAccessS3Get
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*/object/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*/object/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - GrantGatedAccess
            - Sid: GatedAccessSqs
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:SendMessage
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - GrantRigOutputAccess
            - Sid: RigOutputList
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - GrantRigOutputAccess
            - Sid: RigOutputReadWriteDelete
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  PrivateSubnet1EniPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet1EniPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EniManagementSubnet1
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${PrivateSubnet1}'

  PrivateSubnet2EniPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-Subnet2EniPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EniManagementSubnet2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${PrivateSubnet2}'

  SecurityGroupEniPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-SecurityGroupEniPolicy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EniManagementSecurityGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${HyperPodSecurityGroup.GroupId}'

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref HyperPodExecutionRole

    Value: !GetAtt HyperPodExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Private subnet tier with NAT egress and an S3 gateway endpoint. Creates a VPC,
  internet gateway, three public subnets hosting per-AZ NAT gateways, three private
  subnets with dedicated route tables defaulting to their same-AZ NAT gateway, a
  shared network ACL for the private subnets, and an S3 gateway VPC endpoint
  attached to all private route tables.

Mappings:
  CidrConfig:
    Vpc:
      Cidr: 10.24.0.0/16
    PublicSubnetA:
      Cidr: 10.24.0.0/24
    PublicSubnetB:
      Cidr: 10.24.1.0/24
    PublicSubnetC:
      Cidr: 10.24.2.0/24
    PrivateSubnetA:
      Cidr: 10.24.24.0/24
    PrivateSubnetB:
      Cidr: 10.24.25.0/24
    PrivateSubnetC:
      Cidr: 10.24.26.0/24
    PrivateGroup:
      Cidr: 10.24.24.0/21

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets (host NAT gateways only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PublicSubnetA, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PublicSubnetB, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PublicSubnetC, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT gateways (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEipA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatEipB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatEipC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateSubnetA, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateSubnetB, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateSubnetC, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private route tables, default routes via same-AZ NAT, associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-a'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-b'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-c'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  PrivateDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  PrivateSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network ACL for private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-nacl'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # Inbound: HTTPS between tiers inside the VPC
  PrivateNaclInboundHttpsVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Inbound: TCP return traffic for NAT/S3 egress on ephemeral ports
  PrivateNaclInboundEphemeralTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Inbound: UDP return traffic on ephemeral ports (e.g. NTP)
  PrivateNaclInboundEphemeralUdp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Outbound: HTTPS via NAT gateways and to the S3 gateway endpoint
  PrivateNaclOutboundHttps:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  # Outbound: HTTP via NAT gateways for OS and package repositories
  PrivateNaclOutboundHttp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  # Outbound: external NTP via NAT gateways
  PrivateNaclOutboundNtp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 123
        To: 123

  # Outbound: TCP replies to intra-VPC connections accepted by inbound rules
  PrivateNaclOutboundEphemeralTcpVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Outbound: UDP replies to intra-VPC traffic on ephemeral ports
  PrivateNaclOutboundEphemeralUdpVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 210
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, Vpc, Cidr]
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  PrivateSubnetANetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetBNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetCNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 gateway endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

Outputs:
  PrivateSubnets:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs (A, B, C)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB, !Ref PrivateSubnetC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnets'

  PrivateRouteTables:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private route table IDs (A, B, C)
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateRouteTableA, !Ref PrivateRouteTableB, !Ref PrivateRouteTableC]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTables'

  PrivateSubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: CIDR block covering the private subnet group
    Value: !FindInMap [CidrConfig, PrivateGroup, Cidr]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetGroupCidr'

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created by this stack
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  NetworkAclId:
    Description: ID of the network ACL associated with the private subnets
    Value: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-NetworkAclId'

  S3EndpointId:
    Description: ID of the S3 gateway VPC endpoint
    Value: !Ref S3VpcEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-S3EndpointId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an IAM baseline of persona groups, roles, instance profiles and
  managed policies (SysAdmin, IAMAdmin, InstanceOps, ReadOnlyAdmin,
  ReadOnlyBilling) with MFA, billing-console and logging-KMS guardrails.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KNOWN LIMITATIONS
# 1. Instance profile (EC2 role) credentials never carry
#    aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true. Every Allow statement in the non-billing
#    policies needs MFA, so those policies grant nothing when used through an
#    instance profile. The EC2 roles and instance profiles exist only to meet
#    the baseline requirement. Remove the MFA condition from a role-specific
#    policy if workloads really need it.
# 2. The logging KMS protection matches keys that have an alias starting with
#    "alias/logging" or that carry the tag Purpose=logging. Keys with neither
#    are not protected. This template creates no logging key and references no
#    key ARN.
# 3. The IAMAdmin persona has iam:* and can change its own permissions,
#    including these policies. Treat that persona as fully privileged.
# 4. The SysAdmin persona uses NotAction on iam:*. It can still call
#    sts:AssumeRole on any role whose trust policy allows the account root,
#    including IAMAdminRole. Narrow the role trust policies if that matters.
# 5. DenyBillingConsole covers account:*, so the non-billing personas also
#    cannot manage account contact details or Regions.
# 6. ReadOnlyAdmin uses an enumerated read-only action set rather than the
#    AWS-managed ReadOnlyAccess policy. Services not listed are not visible.
# 7. Managed policies are limited to 6,144 characters. Adding more actions may
#    require splitting a persona across more than one policy.
# 8. Deploy with CAPABILITY_IAM. Names are generated by CloudFormation.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SysAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: System administrator persona - near-full access outside of IAM, MFA required.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllExceptIam
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction:
              - 'iam:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: AllowIamReadAndPassRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:Get*'
              - 'iam:List*'
              - 'iam:PassRole'
              - 'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
              - 'payments:*'
              - 'tax:*'
              - 'invoicing:*'
              - 'purchase-orders:*'
              - 'consolidatedbilling:*'
              - 'freetier:*'
              - 'account:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action: &LoggingKmsActions
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/logging*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTamperingByTag
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsAliasModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging*'

  IAMAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: IAM administrator persona - full IAM access, MFA required.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFullIam
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:*'
              - 'sts:GetCallerIdentity'
              - 'access-analyzer:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'aws-portal:*'
              - 'billing:*'
              - 'payments:*'
              - 'tax:*'
              - 'invoicing:*'
              - 'purchase-orders:*'
              - 'consolidatedbilling:*'
              - 'freetier:*'
              - 'account:*'
            Resource: '*'

              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                kms:ResourceAliases: 'alias/logging*'
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTamperingByTag
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DisableKey'
              - 'kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:CancelKeyDeletion'
              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'
              - 'kms:PutKeyPolicy'
              - 'kms:UpdateKeyDescription'
              - 'kms:TagResource'
              - 'kms:UntagResource'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
              - 'kms:RetireGrant'
              - 'kms:DeleteImportedKeyMaterial'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: logging
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsAliasModification
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/logging*'

            Resource: '*'

              - 'kms:DisableKeyRotation'

          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsKeyTamperingByTag

              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'
              - 'kms:DeleteAlias'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:

          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsAliasModification

              - 'kms:UpdateAlias'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Three-tier (web, application, database) VPC spanning three Availability Zones.
  The VPC uses 10.0.0.0/16 with one subnet per tier per AZ. The web tier shares one
  route table whose default route points to an Internet Gateway. Each AZ has its own
  NAT Gateway with an Elastic IP in its web subnet. Each application and database
  subnet has its own route table with a default route through the NAT Gateway in the
  same AZ.

# Notes:
# - This template does not create tier security groups or network ACLs. You could
#   add them later, for example web, application and database security groups that
#   allow only the traffic each tier needs.
# - Web subnets do not auto-assign public IPs (MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false) to meet
#   the AWS-0164 control. The web tier is still internet-routable through the
#   Internet Gateway route. Public-facing web workloads should get a public address
#   explicitly: by requesting one at launch, with an Elastic IP, or behind an
#   internet-facing load balancer.

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    Web1:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    Web2:
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    Web3:
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
    App1:
      CIDR: 10.0.10.0/24
    App2:
      CIDR: 10.0.11.0/24
    App3:
      CIDR: 10.0.12.0/24
    Db1:
      CIDR: 10.0.20.0/24
    Db2:
      CIDR: 10.0.21.0/24
    Db3:
      CIDR: 10.0.22.0/24

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web2, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Web3, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application tier subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App2, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, App3, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db1, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db2, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Db3, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier routing (shared route table -> Internet Gateway)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-rt'

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ, placed in the web subnet of that AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application tier routing (one route table per AZ -> NAT Gateway in the same AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az1'

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az2'

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-az3'

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database tier routing (one route table per AZ -> NAT Gateway in the same AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az1'

  DbDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az2'

  DbDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-az3'

  DbDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the three-tier VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of the Availability Zones used (index 0, 1, 2)
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !GetAtt WebSubnet1.AvailabilityZone
        - !GetAtt WebSubnet2.AvailabilityZone
        - !GetAtt WebSubnet3.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZs'

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of web tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
        - !Ref WebSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnetIds'

  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of application tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref AppSubnet1
        - !Ref AppSubnet2
        - !Ref AppSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnetIds'

  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of database tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref DbSubnet1
        - !Ref DbSubnet2
        - !Ref DbSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnetIds'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for the Amazon EKS Quick Start.
  Deploy with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming configuration
        Parameters:
          - RolePrefix
          - SsmParameterPath
    ParameterLabels:
      RolePrefix:
        default: IAM role name prefix
      SsmParameterPath:
        default: SSM parameter path

Parameters:
  RolePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens, maximum 20 characters.
    Description: Prefix applied to every IAM role and instance profile name.
  SsmParameterPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /quickstart/amazon-eks
    AllowedPattern: '^/[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]+[^/]$'
    MaxLength: 200
    ConstraintDescription: Must begin with a slash and must not end with a slash.
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path under which role ARNs and instance profile values are stored.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CopyZips'
      Description: Lambda execution role that copies Quick Start zip artifacts between S3 buckets.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: copy-zips
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: WriteDestinationArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: ListDestinationBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  ReadResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ReadResourceInfo'
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access across the account.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CreateVpcRole'
      Description: Lambda execution role that creates the CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC IAM role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: create-vpc-role
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageKubernetesVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Sid: AttachApprovedManagedPoliciesOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess'
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-DeleteBucketContents'
      Description: Lambda execution role that empties Quick Start S3 buckets before deletion.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: delete-bucket-contents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*'
              - Sid: DeleteObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancers'
      Description: Lambda execution role that removes load balancers created by Kubernetes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-load-balancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CleanupLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies'
      Description: Lambda execution role that removes security group dependencies.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-security-group-dependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  CleanupLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-CleanupLambdas'
      Description: Lambda execution role that removes VPC-attached Lambda functions and their ENIs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAndCleanupEnis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  GetCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-GetCallerArn'
      Description: Lambda execution role that resolves the ARN of the stack caller.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: get-caller-arn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ResolveCaller
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadStackInfo
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  RegisterTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-RegisterType'
      Description: Lambda execution role that registers CloudFormation custom resource types.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: register-type
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageTypeRegistration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadSchemaHandlerPackages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart*/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RolePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: PassTypeExecutionRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${RolePrefix}-*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  NodeSGRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-NodeSG'
      Description: Lambda execution role that manages EKS node security group rules.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: node-security-group
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DescribeEksCluster
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-FargateProfile'
      Description: Lambda execution role that creates and deletes EKS Fargate profiles.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: fargate-profile
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageFargateProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:TagResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:fargateprofile/*/*/*'
              - Sid: DescribeSubnets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassFargateExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: eks.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  ResolveSsmParameterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ResolveSsmParameter'
      Description: Lambda execution role that resolves SSM parameter values.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: resolve-ssm-parameter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${SsmParameterPath}*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS service roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ControlPlane'
      Description: EKS cluster control plane service role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: control-plane-ec2-describe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-FargateExecution'
      Description: EKS Fargate pod execution role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Node instance roles and instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstance'
      Description: Instance role for EKS managed node groups.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: managed-node-cfn-signal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalStackCompletion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-UnmanagedNodeInstance'
      Description: Instance role for self-managed EKS worker nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: unmanaged-node-cfn-signal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalStackCompletion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: QuickStart
          Value: !Ref RolePrefix

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${RolePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceProfile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole

      Roles:
