AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and app tier subnets across two AZs, a shared route table, and private S3 gateway and Kinesis interface endpoints.

# Note: An interface endpoint service may not be available in every AZ of a
# region. Kinesis Data Firehose in particular is limited in some AZs. If the
# deployment fails for this reason, change the AZ index used by the web subnets.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-vpc

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-subnet-2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-app-subnet-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-app-subnet-2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-shared-rt

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier security group allowing HTTPS from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the VPC address range
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-sg

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowReadOnlyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the lab VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of web-tier subnet 1
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of web-tier subnet 2
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of app-tier subnet 1
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of app-tier subnet 2
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the web tier security group

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  One-time, per-account stack of shared IAM prerequisites for many Amazon EKS
  clusters provisioned through Lambda-backed CloudFormation custom resources.
  Deploy once per account with CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM; per-cluster stacks consume
  the exported role ARNs and instance profiles.

# NOTE: The custom-resource Lambda function code, the custom-resource
# ServiceTokens and the deployment-asset S3 buckets are all created by the
# per-cluster stacks. This stack only creates the shared IAM roles and
# instance profiles and exports their identifiers.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,23}$'
    MaxLength: 24
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters,
      digits and hyphens, and be 2-24 characters long.
    Description: >-
      Common name prefix used to derive every role, instance profile and
      export name in this stack.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda custom-resource execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZipsRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that copies deployment assets between S3 buckets.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CopyZips
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: WriteDestinationAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: ListDestinationBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZipsRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  # This handler is read-only by design: it only describes/reads arbitrary
  # AWS resources and is never granted any write permissions.
  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReaderRole'
      Description: Read-only execution role for the custom resource that reads arbitrary AWS resources.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReaderRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRoleRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that creates the VPC-related IAM role.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePrefixedVpcRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRoleRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-DeleteBucketContentsRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that empties S3 buckets.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeleteBucketContents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListPrefixedBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*'
              - Sid: DeletePrefixedBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-DeleteBucketContentsRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancersRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that removes orphaned load balancers, security groups and ENIs after cluster teardown.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLoadBalancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DeleteLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:loadbalancer/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:elasticloadbalancing:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:targetgroup/*'
              - Sid: DeleteDependentSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'
              - Sid: DeleteDependentNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancersRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CleanupLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLambdasRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that removes leftover Lambda functions and their ENIs.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CleanupLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DeleteLeftoverFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Sid: DeleteLeftoverNetworkInterfaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLambdasRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  GetCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-GetCallerArnRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that looks up the calling identity.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GetCallerArn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GetCallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-GetCallerArnRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  RegisterTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-RegisterTypeRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that registers CloudFormation resource provider types.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegisterType
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RegisterTypes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageRegisteredTypes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:type/resource/*'
              - Sid: ReadProviderPackages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${NamePrefix}-*/*'
              - Sid: PassPrefixedRolesToCloudFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - resources.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                      - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-RegisterTypeRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  ResolveParameterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResolveParameterRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that resolves SSM parameters under the common configuration path.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResolveParameter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadConfigParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${NamePrefix}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${NamePrefix}/*'
              - Sid: DecryptSecureStringViaSsm
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResolveParameterRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  CreateCfnVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateCfnVpcRoleRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that creates the IAM role CloudFormation assumes to provision cluster VPC resources.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateCfnVpcRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePrefixedCfnVpcRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateCfnVpcRoleRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS control plane and Fargate roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ControlPlaneRole'
      Description: Role assumed by the Amazon EKS control plane.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ControlPlaneRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-FargateProfileRole'
      Description: Pod execution role assumed by Amazon EKS Fargate profiles.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:fargateprofile/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-FargateProfileRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 worker node roles and instance profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceRole'
      Description: EC2 instance role for EKS managed node groups.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalStackResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole'
      Description: EC2 instance role for self-managed (unmanaged) EKS worker nodes.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalStackResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: shared-eks-prerequisites

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ManagedNodeInstanceProfile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole

Outputs:
  CopyZipsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CopyZips custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CopyZipsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZipsRoleArn'

  ResourceReaderRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the read-only ResourceReader custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ResourceReaderRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReaderRoleArn'

  CreateVpcRoleRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CreateVpcRole custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CreateVpcRoleRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRoleRoleArn'

  DeleteBucketContentsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DeleteBucketContents custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt DeleteBucketContentsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-DeleteBucketContentsRoleArn'

  CleanupLoadBalancersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CleanupLoadBalancers custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CleanupLoadBalancersRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancersRoleArn'

  CleanupLambdasRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CleanupLambdas custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CleanupLambdasRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CleanupLambdasRoleArn'

  GetCallerArnRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the GetCallerArn custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt GetCallerArnRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-GetCallerArnRoleArn'

  RegisterTypeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the RegisterType custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt RegisterTypeRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-RegisterTypeRoleArn'

  ResolveParameterRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ResolveParameter custom-resource execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ResolveParameterRole.Arn
    Export:

        ExcludeCharacters: '|;,."<>%`'
        ExcludeLowercase: false
        ExcludeUppercase: false

    Type: AWS::IAM::Group

Description: Creates a DynamoDB table and an IAM managed policy for application data storage.

        - Key: App

  BsDynamoDBCrudPolicy:

        Version: '2012-10-17'

              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:Query

              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a Transit Gateway network hub and a Resource Access Manager (RAM) resource share
  for enterprise network transit. When deployed in a spoke account, it instead resolves the
  shared Transit Gateway through a custom resource.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Stack Dependencies
        Parameters:
          - ReferenceFunctionsStackName
      - Label:
          default: Naming Convention
        Parameters:
          - CompanyName
          - SystemName
          - AccountName
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Transit Gateway Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayAccount
          - TransitGatewayASN
          - AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
          - DnsSupport
          - VpnEcmpSupport
      - Label:
          default: Resource Share Configuration
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayResourceShareName
          - Organization
          - AllowExternalPrincipals
      - Label:
          default: Account Configuration
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationAccount
          - JumpstartAccount
          - ManagementAccount
          - LogAccount
          - RecoveryAccount
          - BuildAccount
          - CoreAccount
          - ProductionAccount
          - StagingAccount
          - UATAccount
          - QAAccount
          - TestingAccount
          - DevelopmentAccount

Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Description: Name of the CloudFormation Stack containing Reference Functions (used only in spoke accounts)
    Type: String
    Default: ReferenceFunctions

  CompanyName:
    Description: Company Name
    Type: String
    Default: Camelz

  SystemName:
    Description: System Name
    Type: String
    Default: Prototype

  AccountName:
    Description: Account Name
    Type: String
    Default: Core

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment Name
    Type: String
    Default: Core

  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Description: Account ID owning the Transit Gateway. Leave empty when this account is the primary transit account.
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  TransitGatewayASN:
    Description: Private Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Amazon side of a BGP session
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Description: Automatically accept cross-account attachments
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  DnsSupport:
    Description: Enable DNS support
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Description: Enable Equal Cost Multipath Protocol support for VPN
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable

  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Description: Name of the RAM Resource Share for the Transit Gateway
    Type: String
    Default: Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare

  Organization:
    Description: Organization ARN to share the Transit Gateway with. Leave empty to share with individual accounts only.
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:organizations::\d{12}:organization/o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid AWS Organizations organization ARN

  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Description: Allow principals outside the Organization. Forced to true when individual accounts are specified without an Organization.
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  OrganizationAccount:
    Description: Organization Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  JumpstartAccount:
    Description: Jumpstart Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  ManagementAccount:
    Description: Management Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  LogAccount:
    Description: Log Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  RecoveryAccount:
    Description: Recovery Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  BuildAccount:
    Description: Build Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  CoreAccount:
    Description: Core Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  ProductionAccount:
    Description: Production Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  StagingAccount:
    Description: Staging Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  UATAccount:
    Description: UAT Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  QAAccount:
    Description: QA Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  TestingAccount:
    Description: Testing Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

  DevelopmentAccount:
    Description: Development Account ID
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^\d{12}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS Account ID

Conditions:
  IsPrimaryTransitAccount: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, '']
    - !Equals [!Ref TransitGatewayAccount, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId']
  IsSpokeAccount: !Not [!Condition IsPrimaryTransitAccount]
  HasOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Organization, '']]
  HasOrganizationAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationAccount, '']]
  HasJumpstartAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref JumpstartAccount, '']]
  HasManagementAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ManagementAccount, '']]
  HasLogAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LogAccount, '']]
  HasRecoveryAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RecoveryAccount, '']]
  HasBuildAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BuildAccount, '']]
  HasCoreAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CoreAccount, '']]
  HasProductionAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ProductionAccount, '']]
  HasStagingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StagingAccount, '']]
  HasUATAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref UATAccount, '']]
  HasQAAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QAAccount, '']]
  HasTestingAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestingAccount, '']]
  HasDevelopmentAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, '']]
  HasAnyAccount: !Or
    - !Or
      - !Condition HasOrganizationAccount
      - !Condition HasJumpstartAccount
      - !Condition HasManagementAccount
      - !Condition HasLogAccount
      - !Condition HasRecoveryAccount
      - !Condition HasBuildAccount
      - !Condition HasCoreAccount
    - !Or
      - !Condition HasProductionAccount
      - !Condition HasStagingAccount
      - !Condition HasUATAccount
      - !Condition HasQAAccount
      - !Condition HasTestingAccount
      - !Condition HasDevelopmentAccount
  ForceExternalPrincipals: !And
    - !Condition HasAnyAccount
    - !Not [!Condition HasOrganization]

Resources:
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway'
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals: !If
        - ForceExternalPrincipals
        - true
        - !Ref AllowExternalPrincipals
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}'
      Principals:
        - !If [HasOrganization, !Ref Organization, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasOrganizationAccount, !Ref OrganizationAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasJumpstartAccount, !Ref JumpstartAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasManagementAccount, !Ref ManagementAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasLogAccount, !Ref LogAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasRecoveryAccount, !Ref RecoveryAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasBuildAccount, !Ref BuildAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasCoreAccount, !Ref CoreAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasProductionAccount, !Ref ProductionAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasStagingAccount, !Ref StagingAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasUATAccount, !Ref UATAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasQAAccount, !Ref QAAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasTestingAccount, !Ref TestingAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [HasDevelopmentAccount, !Ref DevelopmentAccount, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
        - Key: Company
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: System
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: Account
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayReference:
    Type: Custom::TransitGatewayReference
    Condition: IsSpokeAccount
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !ImportValue
        Fn::Sub: '${ReferenceFunctionsStackName}-TransitGatewayReferenceFunctionArn'
      AccountId: !Ref TransitGatewayAccount
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

Outputs:
  TransitGateway:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !If
      - IsPrimaryTransitAccount
      - !Ref TransitGateway
      - !GetAtt TransitGatewayReference.TransitGatewayId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGateway'

  TransitGatewayResourceShareArn:
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Description: Transit Gateway RAM Resource Share ARN
    Value: !GetAtt TransitGatewayResourceShare.Arn

      BlockedOutputsMessaging: The response was blocked because it falls outside AWS pricing and infrastructure design topics or contains restricted content.
      TopicPolicyConfig:
        TopicsConfig:
          - Name: OffTopicGeneralConversation

            Examples:
              - What is the weather like today?
              - Can you give me a recipe for lasagna?
              - Who won the football game last night?
              - Recommend a good movie to watch this weekend.
      ContentPolicyConfig:
        FiltersConfig:
          - Type: SEXUAL
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: VIOLENCE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: HATE
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: INSULTS
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: MISCONDUCT
            InputStrength: MEDIUM
            OutputStrength: NONE
          - Type: PROMPT_ATTACK
            InputStrength: HIGH
            OutputStrength: NONE
      WordPolicyConfig:
        ManagedWordListsConfig:
          - Type: PROFANITY
      SensitiveInformationPolicyConfig:
        PiiEntitiesConfig:
          - Type: EMAIL
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: PHONE
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
          - Type: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER
            Action: BLOCK
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Component
          Value: guardrail

Description: >-

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ses-smtp-credential-generator'
      Description: Converts an IAM secret access key into an SES SMTP password and stores it in SSM.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref LogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import logging

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")

          # Constants from the AWS published SES SMTP credential conversion algorithm.
          DATE = "11111111"
          SERVICE = "ses"
          TERMINAL = "aws4_request"
          MESSAGE = "SendRawEmail"
          VERSION = 0x04


          def _sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()


          def calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region):
              signature = _sign(("AWS4" + secret_access_key).encode("utf-8"), DATE)
              signature = _sign(signature, region)
              signature = _sign(signature, SERVICE)
              signature = _sign(signature, TERMINAL)
              signature = _sign(signature, MESSAGE)
              signature_and_version = bytes([VERSION]) + signature
              return base64.b64encode(signature_and_version).decode("utf-8")


          def _owner_tag(physical_id):
              return "Managed by CloudFormation custom resource " + physical_id


          def _put(name, value, description, kms_key_id):
              kwargs = {
                  "Name": name,
                  "Value": value,
                  "Type": "SecureString",
                  "Overwrite": True,
                  "Description": description,
              }
              if kms_key_id:
                  kwargs["KeyId"] = kms_key_id
              ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)
              logger.info("Stored parameter %s", name)


          def _owned_by(name, physical_id):
              resp = ssm.describe_parameters(
                  ParameterFilters=[{"Key": "Name", "Option": "Equals", "Values": [name]}]
              )
              params = resp.get("Parameters", [])
              if not params:
                  return False
              return params[0].get("Description", "") == _owner_tag(physical_id)


          def _delete(name, physical_id):
              # Only delete if this resource instance still owns the parameter. A replacement that
              # reuses the same parameter name will have already re-tagged it with its own ID.
              try:
                  if not _owned_by(name, physical_id):
                      logger.info("Skipping delete of %s (not present or owned by newer resource)", name)
                      return
                  ssm.delete_parameter(Name=name)
                  logger.info("Deleted parameter %s", name)
              except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                  logger.info("Parameter %s not found, nothing to delete", name)


          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              user_name = props.get("UserName", "unknown")
              version = props.get("KeyVersion", "0")
              username_param = props.get("UsernameParameterName", "")
              password_param = props.get("PasswordParameterName", "")
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or "ses-smtp-{}-v{}".format(user_name, version)
              logger.info("Received %s request for parameters %s and %s",
                          request_type, username_param, password_param)

              try:
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      physical_id = "ses-smtp-{}-v{}".format(user_name, version)
                      access_key_id = props["AccessKeyId"]
                      secret_access_key = props["SecretAccessKey"]
                      region = props["Region"]
                      kms_key_id = props.get("KmsKeyId", "")

                      smtp_password = calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region)
                      description = _owner_tag(physical_id)
                      _put(username_param, access_key_id, description, kms_key_id)
                      _put(password_param, smtp_password, description, kms_key_id)
                  elif request_type == "Delete":
                      if username_param:
                          _delete(username_param, physical_id)
                      if password_param:
                          _delete(password_param, physical_id)

                  data = {
                      "UsernameParameterName": username_param,
                      "PasswordParameterName": password_param,
                  }
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.error("Failed to process %s request: %s", request_type, type(exc).__name__)
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {},
                      physical_id,
                      reason="Failed to process {} request: {}".format(request_type, type(exc).__name__),
                  )

Description: >-
  WebSocket API (API Gateway v2) backed by a single Python Lambda function that pushes
  live grant-processing job status updates to connected clients. Includes a DynamoDB
  connections table, a customer-managed KMS key for Lambda environment encryption, and
  a separate customer-managed KMS key for API Gateway CloudWatch Logs encryption.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: grant-status
    Description: Application name used as a prefix for resource names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3-40 chars).
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API deployment stage.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    Description: Retention period in days for CloudWatch Logs log groups.
    AllowedValues: [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
  RelatedFunctionNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList

    Description: >-
      Comma-separated names of related Lambda functions in this same account that may also
      use the Lambda environment KMS key for decryption.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key #1 - Lambda environment variable encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaEnvKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for encrypting ${AppName} Lambda environment variables'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:RotateKeyOnDemand
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLambdaEnvEncryptionAtDeployTime
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'lambda.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowRestrictedDecryptForApprovedFunctions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:

                  - ','

                    - - !Sub '${AppName}-ws-handler'

            Action:

              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource

              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion

              - kms:RotateKeyOnDemand

            Resource: '*'

      Tags:

          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose

  LogsKeyAlias:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for ${AppName}-ws-handler'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BasicLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LambdaLogGroup.Arn}:log-stream:*'
        - PolicyName: ConnectionsTableAccess

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query

        - PolicyName: LambdaEnvKeyDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

            Statement:

        - Key: Application

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup

          TABLE = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['CONNECTIONS_TABLE'])
          TTL_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get('CONNECTION_TTL_SECONDS', '7200'))


          def _response(status_code, body):
              return {'statusCode': status_code, 'body': json.dumps(body)}

              kwargs = {'ProjectionExpression': 'connectionId'}
              while True:
                  page = TABLE.scan(**kwargs)
                  for item in page.get('Items', []):
                      yield item['connectionId']
                  if 'LastEvaluatedKey' not in page:
                      break
                  kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = page['LastEvaluatedKey']


          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event['requestContext']
              route_key = request_context['routeKey']
              connection_id = request_context['connectionId']
              now = int(time.time())

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  TABLE.put_item(Item={
                      'connectionId': connection_id,
                      'connectedAt': now,
                      'ttl': now + TTL_SECONDS,
                  })
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'connected'})

              if route_key == '$disconnect':
                  TABLE.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'disconnected'})

              client = _management_client(request_context)

              if route_key == 'sendmessage':
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  except ValueError:
                      _post(client, connection_id, {'error': 'Message body must be valid JSON'})
                      return _response(400, {'error': 'invalid JSON'})
                  update = {
                      'type': 'job-status',
                      'jobId': body.get('jobId'),
                      'status': body.get('status'),
                      'detail': body.get('detail'),
                      'timestamp': now,
                  }
                  delivered = 0
                  for target_id in _all_connection_ids():
                      if _post(client, target_id, update):
                          delivered += 1
                  return _response(200, {'message': 'status broadcast', 'recipients': delivered})

              _post(client, connection_id, {
                  'error': 'Unrecognised action',
                  'supportedActions': ['sendmessage'],
              })
              return _response(200, {'message': 'default route handled'})

        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: grant-processing-status

  # WebSocket API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api

      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

        Application: !Ref AppName
        Purpose: grant-processing-status

  WebSocketIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ConnectRoute:

      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$connect'

Description: Creates standard IAM Identity Center permission sets for centralized administrative access. When no InstanceArn is provided, the stack deploys only a configuration record. The permission sets are created once a valid IAM Identity Center organization instance ARN is supplied.

Parameters:
  InstanceArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance. Leave it empty to deploy only the configuration record.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:(aws|aws-us-gov|aws-cn):sso:::instance/(sso)?ins-[a-zA-Z0-9-.]{16}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IAM Identity Center instance ARN.

    AllowedPattern: '^PT([1-9]|1[0-2])H$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO-8601 duration from PT1H to PT12H.
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: IdentityCenter
    Description: Prefix for every permission set name.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    MaxLength: 15
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 15 characters. Allowed characters are letters, digits and +=,.@-_

    Default: production

    AllowedValues:

      - test
      - development

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Stripe -> Squarespace -> SNS (Slack relay) webhook handler. API Gateway POST /webhooks (prod stage) invokes a Lambda function that verifies Stripe webhook events, looks up the matching Squarespace Commerce order and inventory, and publishes a formatted sales notification to an SNS topic for relaying to Slack.

Parameters:
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 0
    Default: ''
    Description: Squarespace Commerce API token. Stored in Secrets Manager. If you leave it blank, the stack generates a placeholder secret that you must replace after deployment.
  StripeWebhookSigningSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 0
    Default: ''
    Description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Stored in Secrets Manager. If you leave it blank, the stack generates a placeholder secret that you must replace after deployment.

Conditions:
  HasSquarespaceToken: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SquarespaceApiToken, '']]
  HasStripeSecret: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret, '']]

Resources:
  SquarespaceApiTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/squarespace-api-token'
      Description: Squarespace Commerce API token used by the Stripe webhook handler.
      SecretString: !If
        - HasSquarespaceToken
        - !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GenerateSecretString: !If
        - HasSquarespaceToken
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - PasswordLength: 32
          ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  StripeSigningSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/stripe-webhook-signing-secret'
      Description: Stripe webhook signing secret used to verify incoming webhook events.
      SecretString: !If
        - HasStripeSecret
        - !Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GenerateSecretString: !If
        - HasStripeSecret
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - PasswordLength: 32
          ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  SalesNotificationTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key that encrypts the sales notification SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  SalesNotificationTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SalesNotificationTopicKey

  SalesNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      DisplayName: Sales Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn

  WebhookFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-stripe-webhook-handler'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  WebhookFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the Stripe webhook handler Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebhookFunctionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: PublishSalesNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
              - Sid: EncryptSalesNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWebhookSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
                  - !Ref StripeSigningSecret
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  WebhookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-stripe-webhook-handler'
      Description: Verifies Stripe webhooks, enriches them with Squarespace order and inventory data, and publishes to SNS.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref WebhookFunctionLogGroup
        LogFormat: Text
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
          STRIPE_SECRET_ARN: !Ref StripeSigningSecret
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN_ARN: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
          SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS: '300'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, os, time, urllib.request
          import boto3

          sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          API = 'https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce'
          _cache = {}

          def secret(arn):
              if arn not in _cache:
                  _cache[arn] = sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=arn)['SecretString']
              return _cache[arn]

          def resp(code, msg):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': msg})}

          def log(level, msg, **kw):
              print(json.dumps({'level': level, 'msg': msg, **kw}))

          def verify(payload, header, sec):
              ts, sigs = None, []
              for item in (header or '').split(','):
                  k, _, v = item.strip().partition('=')
                  if k == 't':
                      ts = v
                  elif k == 'v1':
                      sigs.append(v)
              if not ts or not ts.isdigit() or not sigs:
                  return False
              if abs(time.time() - int(ts)) > int(os.environ.get('SIGNATURE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS', '300')):
                  return False
              exp = hmac.new(sec.encode(), f'{ts}.{payload}'.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
              return any(hmac.compare_digest(exp, s) for s in sigs)

          def sq(path, token):
              req = urllib.request.Request(f'{API}/{path}', headers={
                  'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'User-Agent': 'stripe-webhook-handler/1.0'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
                  return json.loads(r.read())

          def handler(event, context):
              body = event.get('body') or ''
              if event.get('isBase64Encoded'):
                  body = base64.b64decode(body).decode('utf-8')
              headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in (event.get('headers') or {}).items()}
              if not verify(body, headers.get('stripe-signature'), secret(os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_ARN'])):
                  log('WARN', 'invalid stripe signature')
                  return resp(400, 'invalid signature')
              try:
                  evt = json.loads(body)
              except ValueError:
                  return resp(400, 'invalid json')
              obj = (evt.get('data') or {}).get('object') or {}
              meta = obj.get('metadata') or {}
              order_id = meta.get('squarespace_order_id')
              amount = obj.get('amount_received') or obj.get('amount_total') or obj.get('amount') or 0
              lines = [f"Stripe event {evt.get('type')} ({evt.get('id')})",
                       f"Amount: {amount / 100:.2f} {str(obj.get('currency', '')).upper()}"]
              if order_id:
                  try:
                      tok = secret(os.environ['SQUARESPACE_TOKEN_ARN'])
                      order = sq(f'orders/{order_id}', tok)
                      lines.append(f"Squarespace order #{order.get('orderNumber')} for {order.get('customerEmail')}")
                      items = order.get('lineItems') or []
                      vids = [i['variantId'] for i in items if i.get('variantId')][:50]
                      stock = {}
                      if vids:
                          inv = sq('inventory/' + ','.join(vids), tok)
                          stock = {i.get('variantId'): i for i in inv.get('inventory', [])}
                      for i in items:
                          s = stock.get(i.get('variantId'), {})
                          left = 'unlimited' if s.get('isUnlimited') else s.get('quantity', 'n/a')
                          lines.append(f"- {i.get('productName')} x{i.get('quantity')} "
                                       f"(SKU {i.get('sku')}, stock left: {left})")
                  except Exception as e:
                      log('ERROR', 'squarespace lookup failed', order=order_id, error=str(e))
                      lines.append(f'Squarespace order {order_id}: lookup failed')
              else:
                  lines.append('No squarespace_order_id found in Stripe metadata')
              sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ['TOPIC_ARN'],
                          Subject=f"New sale: {evt.get('type', 'stripe event')}"[:100],
                          Message='\n'.join(lines))
              log('INFO', 'notification published', event_id=evt.get('id'), order=order_id)
              return resp(200, 'ok')

  WebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhooks'
      Description: Receives Stripe webhook events for sales notifications.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  WebhooksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi

  WebhooksPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhooksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  WebhookApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: WebhooksPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      Description: Deployment of the webhooks API.

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage for Stripe webhooks.
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebhookApiDeployment
      TracingEnabled: true
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          MetricsEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebhookApi}/*/POST/webhooks'

  WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-stripe-webhook-handler-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when the Stripe webhook handler Lambda function reports any invocation errors within one minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookFunction
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  WebhookUrl:
    Description: Stripe webhook endpoint URL (POST).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ProdStage}/webhooks'
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the webhooks REST API.
    Value: !Ref WebhookApi
  WebhookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the webhook handler Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
  WebhookFunctionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the webhook handler execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
  SalesNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic to subscribe the Slack relay (AWS Chatbot or HTTPS endpoint) to.
    Value: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
  SalesNotificationTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the sales notification topic.
    Value: !GetAtt SalesNotificationTopicKey.Arn
  SquarespaceApiTokenSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the Squarespace API token.
    Value: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
  StripeSigningSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the Stripe webhook signing secret.
    Value: !Ref StripeSigningSecret
  WebhookFunctionLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for the webhook handler.
    Value: !Ref WebhookFunctionLogGroup
  WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm on function errors.
    Value: !Ref WebhookFunctionErrorsAlarm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SAA lab 05 - On-demand DynamoDB table with an optional DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster and supporting private networking.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: saa-lab-05
    Description: Prefix used to name all lab resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,15}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (2-16 characters).
  EnableDax:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to "true" to deploy the DAX cluster, subnet group and service role.
  DaxReplicationFactor:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
    Description: Number of nodes in the DAX cluster.

Conditions:
  DaxEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableDax, 'true']

Resources:
  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-orders'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  LabVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-a'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-b'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Clients allowed to connect to the DAX cluster
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
          Description: DAX traffic within the lab VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-client-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: DAX cluster - allows port 8111 only from the client security group
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt ClientSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: DAX unencrypted endpoint from client security group
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS within the lab VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-subnets'
      Description: DAX subnets across two AZs
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB

  DaxServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-role'
      Description: Service role that allows DAX to access the orders table
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dax.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax-dynamodb-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: OrdersTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  DaxCluster:
    Type: AWS::DAX::Cluster
    Condition: DaxEnabled
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-dax'
      Description: DAX cache for the orders table
      NodeType: dax.t3.small
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxServiceRole.Arn
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DaxSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the orders DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref OrdersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableName'
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the orders DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableArn'
  DaxStatus:
    Description: Whether the DAX cluster is deployed
    Value: !If [DaxEnabled, 'enabled', 'disabled']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DaxStatus'
  ClientSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group to attach to DAX clients
    Value: !GetAtt ClientSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecurityGroupId'
  DaxEndpoint:
    Description: DAX cluster discovery endpoint, or "disabled" when DAX is not deployed
    Value: !If [DaxEnabled, !GetAtt DaxCluster.ClusterDiscoveryEndpoint, 'disabled']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DaxEndpoint'
