AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL songs API with IAM auth, X-Ray tracing and a DynamoDB backend

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role that allows AppSync to read and write the songs table
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SongsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role that allows AppSync to push logs to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  SongsApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-songs-api'
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ERROR
        ExcludeVerboseContent: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  SongsSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String): Song
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  SongsTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the songs table
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  ValidationNoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidationNoneDataSource
      Description: Local NONE data source used for input validation
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtistFunction
      Description: Validates that the artist argument is present and contains only letters
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt ValidationNoneDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const artist = ctx.args.artist;
          if (artist === undefined || artist === null || artist === '') {
            util.error('Artist is required', 'ValidationError');
          }
          const isValid = util.matches('^[A-Za-z]+$', artist);
          if (isValid === false) {
            util.error('Artist must contain only letters', 'ValidationError');
          }
          return { payload: { artist: artist } };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      Name: AddSongFunction
      Description: Writes a new song to DynamoDB with an automatically generated id
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: util.autoId() }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({
              name: ctx.args.name,
              artist: ctx.args.artist
            }),
            condition: {
              expression: 'attribute_not_exists(#id)',
              expressionNames: { '#id': 'id' }
            }
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt AddSongFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return { operation: 'Scan' };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL of the songs API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: ID of the songs AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the songs AppSync API (callers need appsync:GraphQL on <ApiArn>/types/*/fields/*)
    Value: !GetAtt SongsApi.Arn
  SongsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores songs
    Value: !Ref SongsTable
  SongsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table that stores songs
    Value: !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito email-based user pool with a strong password policy and public app client, plus a regional REST API with a Cognito-protected GET /me endpoint and an unauthenticated GET /open endpoint, both backed by one Lambda function and deployed to a prod stage.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  IdentityFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Returns the caller's authenticated identity claims, if any.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              authorizer = request_context.get("authorizer") or {}
              claims = authorizer.get("claims") or {}
              body = {
                  "path": event.get("path"),
                  "method": event.get("httpMethod"),
                  "authenticated": bool(claims),
                  "claims": claims,
              }
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }

  IdentityFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${IdentityFunction}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'marbot.io account connection and monitoring integration - connects this AWS account to marbot.io via an EventBridge API destination, a cross-account monitoring role with feature-flagged permissions, and a custom resource that registers the connection.'

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'marbot endpoint'
        Parameters:
          - EndpointId
      - Label:
          default: 'Feature flags'
        Parameters:
          - AutomatedMonitoring
          - AccountAlias
          - AlarmGraphs
          - CodePipelineApproval

Parameters:
  EndpointId:
    Description: 'Your marbot endpoint ID (used as API key, keep secret). Supply it through parameter overrides. If left empty, the marbot API destination, keep-alive rule and connection registration are not created.'
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64})?$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be empty or 1-64 characters of letters, digits, and hyphens.'
  AutomatedMonitoring:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to automatically configure CloudWatch alarms and monitoring rules.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  AccountAlias:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to enrich account IDs with friendly aliases.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  AlarmGraphs:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to embed metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  CodePipelineApproval:
    Description: 'Allow marbot to approve or reject CodePipeline manual approval requests.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'

Mappings:
  MarbotConfig:
    Vendor:
      AccountId: '853553028582'
      ApiBaseUrl: 'https://api.marbot.io'

Conditions:
  HasEndpointId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EndpointId, '']]
  HasAutomatedMonitoring: !Equals [!Ref AutomatedMonitoring, 'true']
  HasAccountAlias: !Equals [!Ref AccountAlias, 'true']
  HasAlarmGraphs: !Equals [!Ref AlarmGraphs, 'true']
  HasCodePipelineApproval: !Equals [!Ref CodePipelineApproval, 'true']

Resources:
  Connection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Properties:
      Description: 'marbot.io API connection'
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: 'X-API-Key'
          ApiKeyValue: !Ref EndpointId

  ApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Properties:
      Description: 'marbot.io endpoint'
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt Connection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/v1/endpoint/${EndpointId}'
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 5

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Properties:
      Description: 'Allows EventBridge to invoke the marbot.io API destination.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeMarbotApiDestination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'events:InvokeApiDestination'
                Resource: !GetAtt ApiDestination.Arn

  AliveRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Properties:
      Description: 'Keeps the marbot.io connection alive by posting account details every 30 days.'
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(30 days)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MarbotApiDestination
          Arn: !GetAtt ApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub |
            {"Type": "alive", "AccountId": "${AWS::AccountId}", "Region": "${AWS::Region}", "StackName": "${AWS::StackName}", "StackId": "${AWS::StackId}"}

  MarbotPermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-marbot-boundary'
      Description: 'Permissions boundary for the marbot.io cross-account role.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAutomatedMonitoring
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm'
              - 'cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric'
              - 'cloudwatch:ListMetrics'
              - 'cloudwatch:TagResource'
              - 'cloudwatch:UntagResource'
              - 'cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource'
              - 'events:PutRule'
              - 'events:DeleteRule'
              - 'events:DescribeRule'
              - 'events:EnableRule'
              - 'events:DisableRule'
              - 'events:PutTargets'
              - 'events:RemoveTargets'
              - 'events:ListRules'
              - 'events:ListTargetsByRule'
              - 'events:TagResource'
              - 'events:UntagResource'
              - 'events:ListTagsForResource'
              - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
              - 'ec2:DescribeVolumes'
              - 'ec2:DescribeNatGateways'
              - 'rds:DescribeDBInstances'
              - 'rds:DescribeDBClusters'
              - 'rds:ListTagsForResource'
              - 'lambda:ListFunctions'
              - 'lambda:ListTags'
              - 'sqs:ListQueues'
              - 'sqs:ListQueueTags'
              - 'dynamodb:ListTables'
              - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags'
              - 'ecs:ListClusters'
              - 'ecs:ListServices'
              - 'ecs:DescribeServices'
              - 'tag:GetResources'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAccountAlias
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
              - 'organizations:DescribeAccount'
              - 'organizations:ListAccounts'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAlarmGraphs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage'
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricData'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCodePipelineApproval
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'codepipeline:PutApprovalResult'
              - 'codepipeline:GetPipelineState'
              - 'codepipeline:GetPipeline'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codepipeline:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: DenyIamPrivilegeEscalation
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'iam:Create*'
              - 'iam:Delete*'
              - 'iam:Put*'
              - 'iam:Attach*'
              - 'iam:Detach*'
              - 'iam:Update*'
              - 'iam:Add*'
              - 'iam:Remove*'
              - 'iam:PassRole'
              - 'iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion'
              - 'iam:Tag*'
              - 'iam:Untag*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyModifyMarbotRoleAndBoundary
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'iam:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-marbot'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:policy/${AWS::StackName}-marbot-boundary'
          - Sid: DenyModifyMarbotConnectionInfrastructure
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'events:DeleteConnection'
              - 'events:UpdateConnection'
              - 'events:DeleteApiDestination'
              - 'events:UpdateApiDestination'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyOrganizationsAndAuditTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - 'organizations:Leave*'
              - 'organizations:Create*'
              - 'organizations:Delete*'
              - 'organizations:Update*'
              - 'organizations:Move*'
              - 'organizations:Remove*'
              - 'organizations:Invite*'
              - 'cloudtrail:StopLogging'
              - 'cloudtrail:DeleteTrail'
              - 'cloudtrail:UpdateTrail'
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Resource: '*'

  MarbotRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-marbot'
      Description: 'Cross-account role assumed by marbot.io to monitor this account.'
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasAutomatedMonitoring, !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub
                - 'arn:aws:iam::${MarbotAccountId}:root'
                - MarbotAccountId: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, AccountId]
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'sts:ExternalId': !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]

  AutomatedMonitoringPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotRole
      PolicyName: AutomatedMonitoring
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageMarbotAlarms
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm'
              - 'cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:TagResource'
              - 'cloudwatch:UntagResource'
              - 'cloudwatch:ListTagsForResource'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:marbot*'
          - Sid: ManageMarbotRules
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'events:PutRule'
              - 'events:DeleteRule'
              - 'events:DescribeRule'
              - 'events:EnableRule'
              - 'events:DisableRule'
              - 'events:PutTargets'
              - 'events:RemoveTargets'
              - 'events:ListTargetsByRule'
              - 'events:TagResource'
              - 'events:UntagResource'
              - 'events:ListTagsForResource'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/marbot*'
          - Sid: DiscoverResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric'
              - 'cloudwatch:ListMetrics'
              - 'events:ListRules'
              - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
              - 'ec2:DescribeVolumes'
              - 'ec2:DescribeNatGateways'
              - 'rds:DescribeDBInstances'
              - 'rds:DescribeDBClusters'
              - 'rds:ListTagsForResource'
              - 'lambda:ListFunctions'
              - 'lambda:ListTags'
              - 'sqs:ListQueues'
              - 'sqs:ListQueueTags'
              - 'dynamodb:ListTables'
              - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags'
              - 'ecs:ListClusters'
              - 'ecs:ListServices'
              - 'ecs:DescribeServices'
              - 'tag:GetResources'
            Resource: '*'

  AccountAliasPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasAccountAlias
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotRole
      PolicyName: AccountAlias
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
              - 'organizations:DescribeAccount'
              - 'organizations:ListAccounts'
            Resource: '*'

  AlarmGraphsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasAlarmGraphs
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotRole
      PolicyName: AlarmGraphs
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage'
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricData'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory'
            Resource: '*'

  CodePipelineApprovalPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: HasCodePipelineApproval
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref MarbotRole
      PolicyName: CodePipelineApproval
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - 'codepipeline:PutApprovalResult'
              - 'codepipeline:GetPipelineState'
              - 'codepipeline:GetPipeline'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:codepipeline:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  MarbotConnectFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: 'Execution role for the marbot.io connect custom resource function.'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  MarbotConnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: 'Registers the account connection with marbot.io.'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MarbotConnectFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import cfnresponse


          def post(url, api_key, payload):
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  url,
                  data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
                  headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-API-Key': api_key},
                  method='POST',
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as res:
                  return res.status


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or 'marbot-connect-' + props.get('ExternalId', 'unknown')
              endpoint_id = props.get('EndpointId', '')
              url = props.get('ApiBaseUrl', 'https://api.marbot.io') + '/v1/endpoint/' + endpoint_id
              payload = {
                  'Type': 'disconnect' if request_type == 'Delete' else 'connect',
                  'AccountId': props.get('AccountId'),
                  'Region': props.get('Region'),
                  'StackName': props.get('StackName'),
                  'StackId': props.get('StackId'),
                  'RoleArn': props.get('RoleArn'),
                  'ExternalId': props.get('ExternalId'),
                  'Features': {
                      'AutomatedMonitoring': props.get('AutomatedMonitoring'),
                      'AccountAlias': props.get('AccountAlias'),
                      'AlarmGraphs': props.get('AlarmGraphs'),
                      'CodePipelineApproval': props.get('CodePipelineApproval'),
                  },
              }
              try:
                  status = post(url, endpoint_id, payload)
                  print('marbot responded with HTTP status %s for %s' % (status, request_type))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  print('marbot request failed: %s' % type(e).__name__)
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id)

  MarbotConnectLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${MarbotConnectFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  MarbotConnect:
    Type: Custom::MarbotConnect
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    DependsOn: MarbotConnectLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotConnectFunction.Arn
      ApiBaseUrl: !FindInMap [MarbotConfig, Vendor, ApiBaseUrl]
      EndpointId: !Ref EndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      StackId: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt MarbotRole.Arn
      ExternalId: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      AutomatedMonitoring: !Ref AutomatedMonitoring
      AccountAlias: !Ref AccountAlias
      AlarmGraphs: !Ref AlarmGraphs
      CodePipelineApproval: !Ref CodePipelineApproval

Outputs:
  MarbotRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the cross-account role assumed by marbot.io.'
    Value: !GetAtt MarbotRole.Arn
  ExternalId:
    Description: 'Stack-unique external ID required to assume the marbot role.'
    Value: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
  ApiDestinationArn:
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Description: 'ARN of the marbot.io EventBridge API destination.'
    Value: !GetAtt ApiDestination.Arn
  ConnectionArn:
    Condition: HasEndpointId
    Description: 'ARN of the marbot.io EventBridge connection.'
    Value: !GetAtt Connection.Arn
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Description: 'ARN of the permissions boundary applied to the marbot role.'
    Value: !Ref MarbotPermissionsBoundary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained mobile/web backend that provisions a DynamoDB table, a Cognito
  identity pool with guest (unauthenticated) access, and an IAM role for
  unauthenticated users. NOTE - Amazon Mobile Analytics and Amazon Cognito Sync
  are legacy services (modern replacements are Amazon Pinpoint and AWS AppSync);
  their IAM actions are retained as requested.

Metadata:
  DeprecationNotice:
    MobileAnalytics: Amazon Mobile Analytics is a legacy service. Amazon Pinpoint is the modern replacement. The mobileanalytics:PutEvents action is kept as requested.
    CognitoSync: Amazon Cognito Sync is a legacy service. AWS AppSync is the modern replacement. The cognito-sync actions are kept as requested.

Resources:
  AppTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  SnsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key that encrypts the app notification SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  SnsTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sns'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SnsTopicKey

  AppNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn

  AppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}_identity_pool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      AllowClassicFlow: false

  CognitoUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref AppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UnauthenticatedGuestAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: MobileAnalyticsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CognitoSyncScopedToPool
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:ListDatasets
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:UpdateRecords
                  - cognito-sync:BulkPublish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AppIdentityPool}/*'
              - Sid: SnsPublishToAppTopic
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AppNotificationTopic
              - Sid: KmsForEncryptedTopicPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: DynamoDbPutItemToAppTable
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref AppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  AppTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref AppTable
  AppTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool
    Value: !Ref AppIdentityPool
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthenticatedRole.Arn
  NotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS notification topic
    Value: !Ref AppNotificationTopic
  SnsTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the SNS topic
    Value: !GetAtt SnsTopicKey.Arn
  Region:
    Description: AWS Region where the backend is deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provides the Glue Data Catalog database, an optional crawler and an optional
  Spark ETL job for the catalog and transform layer of a data lake. Greenfield
  deviation: instead of accepting the ARN of an existing source bucket, this
  template creates the source S3 bucket itself (along with the target and
  artifacts buckets used by the ETL job) and references it internally.
  All data lake buckets are encrypted with a customer managed KMS key that this
  template creates.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: datalake
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, starting with a letter (2-31 characters).
    Description: Naming prefix used for the database, crawler, job, role and log group names.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment used in resource names and tags.
  SourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: raw/
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()-]+/)*$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a sequence of path segments each ending with a slash.
    Description: Key prefix inside the source bucket that the crawler scans and the role can read.
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
    AllowedPattern: '^cron\(.+\)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must use the Glue cron(...) format.
    Description: Glue cron schedule expression for the crawler (default is daily at 02:00 UTC).
  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue crawler.
  EnableEtlJob:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the Glue Spark ETL job and its supporting resources.
  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - G.025X
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X
    Default: G.1X
    Description: Glue worker type for the ETL job.
  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of workers allocated to the ETL job.
  JobTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 2880
    Default: 60
    Description: ETL job timeout in minutes.
  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Default: 1
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs allowed for the ETL job.
  ScriptKey:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/etl_job.py
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()/-]+\\.py$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an S3 object key ending in .py.
    Description: Object key of the Spark script inside the template-created artifacts bucket.
  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: curated/
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9!_.*'()-]+/)+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one or more path segments each ending with a slash.
    Description: Output prefix inside the target bucket.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for the ETL job CloudWatch log group.

Conditions:
  CrawlerEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableCrawler
    - 'true'
  EtlJobEnabled: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableEtlJob
    - 'true'

Resources:
  DataLakeKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${NamePrefix} data lake buckets (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DataLakeKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-datalake'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataLakeKey

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-source'

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-target'

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireTemporaryFiles
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: temporary/
            ExpirationInDays: 7
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 1
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-artifacts'

  ArtifactsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}_${Environment}_db'
        Description: !Sub 'Data lake catalog database for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'

  EtlJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-glue-service-role'
      Description: Shared service role for the data lake Glue crawler and ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLakeS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource: !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadSourceObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/${SourcePrefix}*'
              - Sid: DecryptDataLakeObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: EncryptDataLakeObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                    - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  Resource: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: WriteTargetObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                    - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                    - 's3:PutObject'
                    - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
                    - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/${TargetPrefix}*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: ReadEtlScript
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                  Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactsBucket.Arn}/${ScriptKey}'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: UseTemporaryDirectory
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 's3:ListBucket'
                    - 's3:GetObject'
                    - 's3:PutObject'
                    - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt ArtifactsBucket.Arn
                    - !Sub '${ArtifactsBucket.Arn}/temporary/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - EtlJobEnabled
                - Sid: WriteEtlJobLogs
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                    - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                    - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  Resource:
                    - !GetAtt EtlJobLogGroup.Arn
                    - !Sub '${EtlJobLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: CrawlerEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Description: Discovers schema and partitions for newly added data in the source bucket.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${SourceBucket}/${SourcePrefix}'
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  GlueSecurityConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::Glue::SecurityConfiguration
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-glue-security-config'
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        S3Encryptions:
          - S3EncryptionMode: SSE-KMS
            KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
        CloudWatchEncryption:
          CloudWatchEncryptionMode: DISABLED
        JobBookmarksEncryption:
          JobBookmarksEncryptionMode: DISABLED

  GlueEtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl-job'
      Description: Spark ETL job that transforms source data lake data into the curated target location.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ArtifactsBucket}/${ScriptKey}'
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeoutMinutes
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      SecurityConfiguration: !Ref GlueSecurityConfiguration
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-enable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref EtlJobLogGroup
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${ArtifactsBucket}/temporary/'
        '--source_path': !Sub 's3://${SourceBucket}/${SourcePrefix}'
        '--target_path': !Sub 's3://${TargetBucket}/${TargetPrefix}'
        '--database_name': !Ref GlueDatabase
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue Data Catalog database.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Glue service role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
  SourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the source data lake bucket scanned by the crawler.
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
  SourceBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the source data lake bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
  DataLakeKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the data lake buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt DataLakeKey.Arn
  DataLakeKeyAliasName:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the data lake buckets.
    Value: !Ref DataLakeKeyAlias
  GlueCrawlerName:
    Condition: CrawlerEnabled
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler
  GlueEtlJobName:
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Description: Name of the Glue Spark ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueEtlJob
  TargetBucketName:
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Description: Name of the target bucket for transformed output.
    Value: !Ref TargetBucket
  ArtifactsBucketName:
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Description: Name of the artifacts bucket where the ETL script must be uploaded.
    Value: !Ref ArtifactsBucket
  EtlScriptLocation:
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled
    Description: S3 location the ETL job reads its script from.
    Value: !Sub 's3://${ArtifactsBucket}/${ScriptKey}'
  EtlJobLogGroupName:
    Condition: EtlJobEnabled

Description: Provisions the Cognito auth resources (user pool, app client, identity pool) and the authenticated and unauthenticated IAM roles for an Amplify sandbox (friendly name "amplifyAuth").

Resources:
  # Sandbox behaviour: the user pool is deleted with the stack because a sandbox is temporary and holds no data worth keeping.
  # Change DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy to Retain if this template is ever reused outside a sandbox.
  AmplifyAuthUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      UserPoolTags:
        amplify:deployment-type: sandbox
        amplify:friendly-name: amplifyAuth
        created-by: amplify

  # AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient has no tagging property, so it carries no tags.
  AmplifyAuthUserPoolAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref AmplifyAuthUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # Sandbox behaviour: change DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy to Retain if this template is ever reused outside a sandbox.
  AmplifyAuthIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref AmplifyAuthUserPoolAppClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt AmplifyAuthUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: amplify:deployment-type
          Value: sandbox
        - Key: amplify:friendly-name
          Value: amplifyAuth
        - Key: created-by
          Value: amplify

  # The role has only a trust policy. Amplify adds category-specific permissions later.
  AmplifyAuthAuthenticatedUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys an AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job that converts Shapefiles into individual
  GeoJSON files, along with its IAM service role and the supporting S3 buckets
  (raw GIS data, Glue scripts, and knowledge base). Requires CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w\-]{1,255}$'
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    AllowedPattern: '^s3://.+$'
    Description: >-
      S3 URI of the Glue ETL Python script. When left at the default, the script
      location resolves to the scripts bucket created by this stack.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 URI beginning with s3://.

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@\-]{1,64}$'
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by AWS Glue.
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-64 characters of letters, digits, and +=,.@_- characters.

Conditions:
  UseStackScriptsBucket: !Equals
    - !Ref GlueScriptLocation
    - 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'

Resources:
  DataBucketsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting the map-appraiser data and Glue script S3 buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  DataBucketsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub
        - 'alias/map-appraiser-data-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataBucketsKmsKey

  RawGisBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'map-appraiser-data-raw-gis-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  GlueScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'map-appraiser-glue-scripts-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  KnowledgeBaseBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub
        - 'map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base-${Suffix}'
        - Suffix: !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  RawGisBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RawGisBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  KnowledgeBaseBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref KnowledgeBaseBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS Glue for the Shapefile to GeoJSON ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLogsFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'logs:*'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: GlueS3ReadSourceAndScripts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceAndScriptBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadSourceAndScriptObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: WriteSparkLogsAndTempData
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/spark-logs/*'
                  - !Sub '${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/temp/*'
        - PolicyName: GlueS3KnowledgeBaseReadWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListKnowledgeBaseBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource: !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBaseObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: GlueKmsDataKeyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseDataBucketsKeyViaS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: map-appraiser

  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: Converts Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !If
          - UseStackScriptsBucket
          - !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'
          - !Ref GlueScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': 'python'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-spark-ui': 'true'
        '--spark-event-logs-path': !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/spark-logs/'
        '--job-bookmark-option': 'job-bookmark-enable'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/temp/'
        '--additional-python-modules': 'geopandas==0.14.1,shapely==2.0.2,pyproj==3.6.1,fiona==1.9.5'
      Tags:
        Project: map-appraiser

Outputs:
  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueJobName'

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue service role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleArn'

  ScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: Command to upload the ETL script to S3 before the first job run (the stack does not upload it). The caller needs kms:GenerateDataKey on the data buckets KMS key.
    Value: !If
      - UseStackScriptsBucket
      - !Sub 'aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py s3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py'
      - !Sub 'aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py ${GlueScriptLocation}'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ScriptUploadCommand'

  DataBucketsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the S3 buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt DataBucketsKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DataBucketsKmsKeyArn'

  RawGisBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket holding the raw GIS Shapefiles.
    Value: !Ref RawGisBucket
    Export:

  GlueScriptsBucketName:

    Value: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueScriptsBucketName'

  KnowledgeBaseBucketName:

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys the "DatadogPolicy" CloudFormation macro and its Lambda function,
  which build IAM policy documents for the Datadog integration role.

# The function is built from native CloudFormation resources (AWS::Lambda::Function
# plus an explicit IAM role). These are the same resources SAM's AWS::Serverless::Function
# would produce, so deploying this template does not need CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND.
# It needs only CAPABILITY_IAM, because it creates an unnamed IAM role.
#
# Usage from a consuming stack (a macro cannot be used in the stack that defines it):
#   DatadogIntegrationRole:
#     Type: AWS::IAM::Role
#     Properties:
#       ...
#       Policies:
#         - Fn::Transform:
#             Name: DatadogPolicy
#             Parameters:
#               PolicyType: LogArchive        # or CloudTrail
#               BucketNames: my-bucket-a,my-bucket-b   # or BucketName: my-bucket

Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the DatadogPolicy macro function (basic CloudWatch Logs access only).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
      Description: Processes DatadogPolicy macro fragments and generates Datadog integration IAM policies.
      # The request asked for Python 3.14. That runtime is not on the approved list,
      # so this uses python3.12, the newest approved Python runtime.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroFunctionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref DatadogPolicyMacroLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def _partition(region):
              region = region or ""
              if region.startswith("cn-"):
                  return "aws-cn"
              if region.startswith("us-gov-"):
                  return "aws-us-gov"
              return "aws"


          def _bucket_arns(params, partition):
              raw = params.get("BucketNames", params.get("BucketName"))
              if raw is None:
                  raise ValueError("A BucketName or BucketNames parameter is required")
              if isinstance(raw, str):
                  raw = raw.split(",")
              arns = []
              for item in raw:
                  value = str(item).strip()
                  if not value:
                      continue
                  if value.startswith("arn:"):
                      arns.append(value.split("/", 1)[0])
                  else:
                      arns.append("arn:{}:s3:::{}".format(partition, value))
              if not arns:
                  raise ValueError("At least one S3 bucket must be supplied")
              return arns


          def _policy(name, bucket_actions, object_actions, arns):

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) cluster, control panel,
  routing controls, safety rule and RECOVERY_CONTROL health checks for multi-region recovery.

# The ARC control-plane API is hosted in us-west-2. These CloudFormation resource types
# can still be deployed from us-east-1. Region1 and Region2 are only naming labels and
# do not decide where the resources are deployed.
#
# ARC routing control and safety rule resources only support Name, ClusterArn/ControlPanelArn,
# AssertionRule/GatingRule, RuleConfig and Tags. Tags are supported only on the Cluster,
# ControlPanel and SafetyRule resources. No other properties are used.

Parameters:
  Region1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name format (e.g. us-east-1).
    Description: Region label used in the name of routing control for Cell 1.

  Region2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name format (e.g. us-west-2).
    Description: Region label used in the name of routing control for Cell 2.

  ProjectId:
    Type: String
    Default: Dynamo59
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,63}$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    ConstraintDescription: alphanumeric, must start with a letter, 1-64 characters
    Description: Project identifier used as a prefix for resource names.

Resources:
  RecoveryCluster:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cluster'

  ControlPanel:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::ControlPanel
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-ControlPanel'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn

  RoutingControlCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  RoutingControlCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::RoutingControl
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}'
      ClusterArn: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn

  # Assertion rule only. GatingRule is not set because only one of the two can be specified.
  MinCellsActiveSafetyRule:
    Type: AWS::Route53RecoveryControl::SafetyRule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectId}-MinCellsActive'
      ControlPanelArn: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
      AssertionRule:
        WaitPeriodMs: 5000
        AssertedControls:
          - !GetAtt RoutingControlCell1.RoutingControlArn
          - !GetAtt RoutingControlCell2.RoutingControlArn
      RuleConfig:
        Type: ATLEAST
        Threshold: 1
        Inverted: false

  # RECOVERY_CONTROL health checks do not take endpoint properties
  # (IPAddress, FullyQualifiedDomainName, Port, ResourcePath, RequestInterval, FailureThreshold).
  HealthCheckCell1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt RoutingControlCell1.RoutingControlArn
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell1-${Region1}-HealthCheck'

  HealthCheckCell2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthCheckConfig:
        Type: RECOVERY_CONTROL
        RoutingControlArn: !GetAtt RoutingControlCell2.RoutingControlArn
      HealthCheckTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectId}-Cell2-${Region2}-HealthCheck'

Outputs:
  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC cluster.
    Value: !GetAtt RecoveryCluster.ClusterArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterArn'

  ControlPanelArn:
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC control panel.
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPanel.ControlPanelArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPanelArn'

  HealthCheckCell1Id:
    Description: ID of the RECOVERY_CONTROL health check for Cell 1.
    Value: !Ref HealthCheckCell1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckCell1Id'

  HealthCheckCell2Id:
    Description: ID of the RECOVERY_CONTROL health check for Cell 2.
    Value: !Ref HealthCheckCell2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-HealthCheckCell2Id'
