AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates a customer-managed KMS key and key alias to secure AWS service data encryption, with optional alerts when the key is scheduled for deletion or disabled.'

Metadata:
  'AWS::CloudFormation::Interface':
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'Parent Stacks'
        Parameters:
          - ParentAlertStack
      - Label:
          default: 'KMS Parameters'
        Parameters:
          - Service

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Description: 'Optional but recommended stack name of parent alert stack based on operations/alert.yaml template. Leave empty to disable deletion and disable alerts.'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Service:
    Description: 'Which AWS service is allowed to use this key? ALL_SERVICES allows all services in the caller account; S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS additionally allows public decryption through S3.'
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALL_SERVICES'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'ALL_SERVICES'
      - 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS'
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces

Conditions:
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]
  HasServiceAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'ALL_SERVICES']
  HasS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS']
  HasServiceRestriction: !Not [!Or [!Condition HasServiceAllServices, !Condition HasS3PublicAccess]]

Resources:
  Key:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Key'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key created by stack ${AWS::StackName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCryptographicUseByCallerAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:ListGrants'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition: !If
              - HasServiceRestriction
              - StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - !If
            - HasS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: AllowPublicS3Decryption
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action: 'kms:Decrypt'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  KeyAlias:
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref Key

  KeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Type: 'AWS::Events::Rule'
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Alerts when KMS key from stack ${AWS::StackName} is scheduled for deletion or disabled'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - 'aws.kms'
        detail-type:
          - 'AWS API Call via CloudTrail'
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - 'kms.amazonaws.com'
          eventName:
            - 'ScheduleKeyDeletion'
            - 'DisableKey'
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref Key
      Targets:
        - Id: rule
          Arn:
            'Fn::ImportValue': !Sub '${ParentAlertStack}-TopicARN'

Outputs:
  StackName:
    Description: 'Stack name.'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  KeyId:
    Description: 'Key ID.'
    Value: !Ref Key
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyId'
  KeyArn:
    Description: 'Key ARN.'
    Value: !GetAtt Key.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KeyArn'

Description: Creates an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) lifecycle policy and its supporting IAM role to automate EBS volume snapshots for web servers.

Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: '17:00'
    AllowedPattern: '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid 24-hour time in HH:MM format (e.g. 17:00).
    Description: Time of day (UTC) in HH:MM 24-hour format when the daily snapshot schedule starts.
  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24
    Description: Interval in hours between snapshots.
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of snapshots to retain for each volume.
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens (max 32 characters).
    Description: Logical name used in resource names and tags.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    Description: Environment tag value used to target EBS volumes.
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Key of the custom tag used to target EBS volumes.
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Value of the custom tag used to target EBS volumes.

Resources:
  DataLifecycleManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Service role that allows Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to manage EBS snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DataLifecycleManagerSnapshotPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowSnapshotCreation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::snapshot/*'
              - Sid: AllowSnapshotDeletion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::snapshot/*'
              - Sid: AllowSnapshotTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::snapshot/*'
              - Sid: AllowDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Daily EBS snapshot lifecycle policy for ${LogicalName}'
      State: ENABLED
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        PolicyType: EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
            CopyTags: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'

Outputs:
  LifecyclePolicyId:
    Description: ID of the DLM lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicy
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the DLM lifecycle policy.
    Value: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicy.Arn
  DataLifecycleManagerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by Data Lifecycle Manager.
    Value: !GetAtt DataLifecycleManagerRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access every day using an SSM Automation document and an EventBridge scheduled rule.

Resources:
  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Systems Manager Automation to enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3BlockPublicAccessEnforcement

  EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables all four S3 Block Public Access settings at the account level and verifies the configuration.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to run this document.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ global:ACCOUNT_ID }}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
          - name: VerifyPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            isEnd: true
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: GetPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ global:ACCOUNT_ID }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: BlockPublicAcls
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicAcls
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: BlockPublicPolicy
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicPolicy
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: IgnorePublicAcls
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.IgnorePublicAcls
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: RestrictPublicBuckets
                Selector: $.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.RestrictPublicBuckets
                Type: Boolean
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3BlockPublicAccessEnforcement

  EventBridgeSsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EventBridge to start the S3 Block Public Access SSM Automation document.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartS3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3BlockPublicAccessEnforcement

  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Runs the S3 Block Public Access enforcement SSM Automation document once a day.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeSsmAutomationRole.Arn

Outputs:
  SsmAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document that enforces S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Ref EnforceS3BlockPublicAccessDocument
  SsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by SSM Automation.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeSsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role EventBridge uses to start the Automation execution.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeSsmAutomationRole.Arn
  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily EventBridge scheduled rule.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule.Arn

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Project name used for tagging, the Lambda function name, and the Secrets Manager secret name.

  PasswordRequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether the user pool password policy requires at least one symbol.

Conditions:
  RequireSymbols: !Equals [!Ref PasswordRequireSymbols, 'true']

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [RequireSymbols, true, false]
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AgentCore Gateway tools
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AgentCore Gateway tools
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AgentCore Gateway

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore-gateway/read
        - agentcore-gateway/write
        - agentcore-gateway/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes

  SecretWriterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoClientSecretWriter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeUserPoolClient
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Sid: ManageClientSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SecretWriterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cognito-secret-writer'
      Description: Reads the Cognito app client secret and stores it in Secrets Manager
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SecretWriterRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, physical_id=None, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or f"See CloudWatch Logs: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id or event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or context.log_stream_name,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "NoEcho": True,
                  "Data": data or {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                  logger.info("CloudFormation response status: %s", resp.status)


          def upsert_secret(name, value, project):
              try:
                  resp = secrets.create_secret(
                      Name=name,
                      Description="Cognito client credentials for AgentCore Gateway",
                      SecretString=value,
                      Tags=[{"Key": "Project", "Value": project}],
                  )
                  return resp["ARN"]
              except ClientError as err:
                  if err.response["Error"]["Code"] != "ResourceExistsException":
                      raise
              resp = secrets.put_secret_value(SecretId=name, SecretString=value)
              return resp["ARN"]


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Request type: %s", event.get("RequestType"))
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              secret_name = props.get("SecretName")
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      if secret_name:
                          try:
                              secrets.delete_secret(
                                  SecretId=secret_name,
                                  ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True,
                              )
                          except ClientError as err:
                              if err.response["Error"]["Code"] != "ResourceNotFoundException":
                                  raise
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", physical_id=event.get("PhysicalResourceId"))
                      return

                  user_pool_id = props["UserPoolId"]
                  client_id = props["ClientId"]
                  client = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      ClientId=client_id,
                  )["UserPoolClient"]
                  value = json.dumps({
                      "client_id": client_id,
                      "client_secret": client["ClientSecret"],
                      "user_pool_id": user_pool_id,
                  })
                  arn = upsert_secret(secret_name, value, props.get("ProjectName", ""))
                  send_response(
                      event,
                      context,
                      "SUCCESS",
                      data={"SecretArn": arn, "SecretName": secret_name},
                      physical_id=secret_name,
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.exception("Custom resource failed")
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", reason=str(exc)[:500])
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SecretWriterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${SecretWriterFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientSecretWriter:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: SecretWriterLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretWriterFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      SecretName: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret'
      ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Description: OIDC discovery URL for the AgentCore Gateway Cognito user pool
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito app client ID for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ARN for the AgentCore Gateway
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  DomainUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/domain-url
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito hosted domain URL for the AgentCore Gateway user pool
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn'

  ClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientId'

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DiscoveryUrl'

  DomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainUrl'

  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TokenEndpoint'

  Scopes:
    Description: OAuth2 scopes granted to the app client
    Value: agentcore-gateway/read agentcore-gateway/write agentcore-gateway/admin
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Scopes'

  DiscoveryUrlParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the OIDC discovery URL
    Value: !Ref DiscoveryUrlParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DiscoveryUrlParameterName'

  ClientIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the app client ID
    Value: !Ref ClientIdParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientIdParameterName'

  UserPoolIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolIdParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolIdParameterName'

  UserPoolArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the user pool ARN
    Value: !Ref UserPoolArnParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArnParameterName'

  DomainUrlParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name holding the hosted domain URL
    Value: !Ref DomainUrlParameter
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainUrlParameterName'

  ClientSecretName:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret name containing the client credentials
    Value: !GetAtt ClientSecretWriter.SecretName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecretName'

  ClientSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager secret ARN containing the client credentials
    Value: !GetAtt ClientSecretWriter.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecretArn'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Multi-tenant SaaS Operations Cognito identity bootstrap - pooled tenant user pool,
  operations user pool, identity pools with principal tag mappings, and tag-based
  IAM roles for pooled and siloed tenant DynamoDB access.

Parameters:
  TenantCallbackURLParameter:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
    Default: https://localhost:4200
    Description: >-
      Tenant application callback host. Must be a full URL such as
      https://tenant.example.com (used for invite links, callback and logout URLs).
  AdminCallbackURLParameter:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
    Default: https://localhost:4300
    Description: >-
      Admin application callback host. Must be a full URL such as
      https://admin.example.com (used for invite links, callback and logout URLs).
  SiloedTenantRoleNameParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    Description: Name of the IAM role assumed by authenticated users of siloed tenants.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled tenant user pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Your temporary password for the SaaS Operations tenant application
          EmailMessage: !Sub >-
            Login into the tenant application at ${TenantCallbackURLParameter}
            with username {username} and temporary password {####}
          SMSMessage: !Sub >-
            Login into the tenant application at ${TenantCallbackURLParameter}
            with username {username} and temporary password {####}

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref TenantCallbackURLParameter
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref TenantCallbackURLParameter
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  CognitoUserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
        authorize_scopes: email openid profile
        oidc_issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}
        attributes_request_method: GET
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled tenant identity pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName

  CognitoIdentityPoolPrincipalTag:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.ProviderName
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  CognitoIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled tenant IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuthenticatedPooledUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated pooled tenant and operations users via Cognito identity pools.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: authenticated-pooled-user-dynamodb-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PooledTenantItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-pooled
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-pooled/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-pooled
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-pooled/index/*
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:StringLike:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys:
                      - !Sub ${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}-*
              - Sid: TenantAdminTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Siloed tenant IAM role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleNameParameter
      Description: Role assumed by authenticated siloed tenant users via Cognito identity pools.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: authenticated-siloed-user-dynamodb-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SiloedTenantTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}/index/*
              - Sid: TenantAdminTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping/index/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Operations users pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OperationUsersUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: Your temporary password for the SaaS Operations admin application
          EmailMessage: !Sub >-
            Login into the admin application at ${AdminCallbackURLParameter}
            with username {username} and temporary password {####}
          SMSMessage: !Sub >-
            Login into the admin application at ${AdminCallbackURLParameter}
            with username {username} and temporary password {####}

  OperationUsersUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AdminCallbackURLParameter
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref AdminCallbackURLParameter
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  OperationUsersUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  OperationUsersSystemAdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      Description: SaaS Operations system administrators group
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool

  OperationUsersUserPoolIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      ProviderName: Cognito
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
        authorize_scopes: email openid profile
        oidc_issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OperationUsersUserPool}
        attributes_request_method: GET
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Operations identity pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OperationUsersIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderName

  OperationUsersIdentityPoolPrincipalTag:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolPrincipalTag
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
      IdentityProviderName: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderName
      UseDefaults: false
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole

  OperationUsersIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

Outputs:
  CognitoUserPoolId:
    Description: Pooled tenant user pool ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
  CognitoUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Pooled tenant user pool app client ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
  CognitoIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Pooled tenant identity pool ID
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
  OperationUsersUserPoolId:
    Description: Operations users user pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
  OperationUsersUserPoolClientId:
    Description: Operations users user pool app client ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersUserPoolClient
  OperationUsersIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Operations users identity pool ID
    Value: !Ref OperationUsersIdentityPool
  OperationUsersUserPoolProviderURL:
    Description: Operations users user pool provider URL
    Value: !GetAtt OperationUsersUserPool.ProviderURL
  AuthenticatedSiloedUserRoleName:
    Description: Siloed tenant authenticated user role name
    Value: !Ref AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole
  AuthenticatedSiloedUserRoleArn:
    Description: Siloed tenant authenticated user role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedSiloedUserRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Reusable DynamoDB table stack with optional provisioned-capacity autoscaling, AWS Backup protection, streams, encryption, and CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the table partition (HASH) key attribute.
    Default: id
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of the partition key attribute (S = String, N = Number, B = Binary).
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional explicit table name. Leave blank to let CloudFormation generate one.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort (RANGE) key attribute name. Leave blank for no sort key.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of the sort key attribute.
    Default: N
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Attribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name (must be used as a GSI key).
    Default: ''
  Attribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of extra attribute 1.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Attribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name (must be used as a GSI key).
    Default: ''
  Attribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of extra attribute 2.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Attribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name (must be used as a GSI key).
    Default: ''
  Attribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of extra attribute 3.
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional name of global secondary index 1. Leave blank to skip.
    Default: ''
  GSI1PartitionKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute of GSI 1 (must match a defined attribute).
    Default: ''
  GSI1SortKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute of GSI 1 (must match a defined attribute).
    Default: ''
  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional name of global secondary index 2. Leave blank to skip.
    Default: ''
  GSI2PartitionKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute of GSI 2 (must match a defined attribute).
    Default: ''
  GSI2SortKey:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute of GSI 2 (must match a defined attribute).
    Default: ''
  TimeToLiveAttribute:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional attribute name used for Time to Live. Leave blank to disable TTL.
    Default: ''
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Description: DynamoDB stream view type, or disabled.
    Default: disabled
    AllowedValues: [disabled, KEYS_ONLY, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES]
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Table billing mode.
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]
  ReadMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum read capacity units (provisioned mode only).
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  ReadMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum read capacity units (provisioned mode only).
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum write capacity units (provisioned mode only).
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum write capacity units (provisioned mode only).
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Description: Target capacity utilization percentage for autoscaling.
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 20
    MaxValue: 90
  PointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  ServerSideEncryption:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with the AWS managed KMS key (alias/aws/dynamodb).
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain AWS Backup recovery points. Set to 0 to disable backups.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
  EnableAlerts:
    Type: String
    Description: Create an alert SNS topic, CloudWatch alarms, and backup vault notifications.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute1Name, '']]
  HasAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute2Name, '']]
  HasAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute3Name, '']]
  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1Name, '']]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2Name, '']]
  HasGSI1SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKey, '']]
  HasGSI2SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKey, '']]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttribute, '']]
  HasStream: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, disabled]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  EnablePITR: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  EnableSSE: !Equals [!Ref ServerSideEncryption, 'true']
  EnableBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  HasAlerts: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerts, 'true']
  HasBackupAlerts: !And [!Condition EnableBackup, !Condition HasAlerts]

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKey
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKey
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKey
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI2SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKey
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttribute
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStream
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [EnablePITR, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - SSEEnabled: false

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: '*'

  ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  AlertTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key encrypting the ${AWS::StackName} alert SNS topic'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBackupAndCloudWatchPublishers
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - backup.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AlertTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-alerts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlertTopicKey

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} DynamoDB alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AlertTopicKey.Arn

  AlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBackupAndCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - backup.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: EnableBackup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vault'
      Notifications: !If
        - HasAlerts
        - BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - BACKUP_JOB_FAILED
            - RESTORE_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RESTORE_JOB_FAILED
          SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeBackup
                  - dynamodb:DeleteBackup
                Resource: !Sub '${Table.Arn}/backup/*'

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt Table.Arn

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Read throttle events on DynamoDB table ${Table}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates the DynamoDB tables for the account-vending automation tool (talr).

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Stage must contain only alphanumeric characters.
    Description: Deployment stage appended to every table name.

Resources:
  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  DynamoDBScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccountInfoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AccountInfoTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TaskStatusTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TaskStatusTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: '*'

  AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

  GsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

  GsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

  GsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

  GsiAccountIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableReadScalableTarget:

    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'

      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${TaskStatusTable}'
      MinCapacity: 1

      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBScalingRole.Arn

    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AccountInfoTable}-table-read-scaling-policy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

        TargetValue: 50.0

        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
