AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Highly available network foundation and ECS cluster for a containerised Streamlit application, with a VPC across two Availability Zones, a NAT gateway in each zone, VPC flow logs and an ECS cluster with Container Insights enabled.

Parameters:
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets are public because their route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to the
  # internet gateway. Automatic public IP assignment is disabled (Trivy AWS-0164);
  # NAT gateways get public addresses from their own Elastic IPs, and any future
  # internet-facing load balancer gets its own public addresses.
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

  Cluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-cluster'
        - Key: Application
          Value: streamlit

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref Cluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcsClusterName'
  EcsClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS cluster
    Value: !GetAtt Cluster.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EcsClusterArn'
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group that receives VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogGroupName'

  Subnet1:

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
        - Description: Memcached to within the VPC

          ToPort: 11211
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-sg'

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless URL shortener using Amazon API Gateway (regional REST API), AWS Lambda
  (Python create and retrieve functions) and Amazon DynamoDB, including the
  account-level API Gateway CloudWatch logging role.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 3-255 characters; letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen and period only.
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores short identifiers and long URLs.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-40 characters; letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore only.
    Description: Prefix used for Lambda function names, the IAM role name and log group names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.12
      - python3.11
    Description: Python runtime for both Lambda functions.
  AppUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Base URL used to build returned short links (for example https://sho.rt). Leave
      empty to use the API Gateway stage invoke URL.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: platform-team
    Description: Owner tag value.

Resources:
  UrlTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}-create'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${FunctionNamePrefix}-api-access'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-lambda-role'
      Description: Shared execution role for the URL shortener create and retrieve functions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: url-shortener-dynamodb
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt UrlTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: url-shortener-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CreateFunctionLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RetrieveFunctionLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-create'
      Description: Generates a random short identifier and stores it against a long URL.
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref UrlTable
          APP_URL: !Ref AppUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import json
          import os
          import secrets
          import string
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          APP_URL = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "").strip()
          ALPHABET = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
          MIN_LEN = 12
          MAX_LEN = 16
          MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5


          def _response(status, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }


          def _base_url(event):
              if APP_URL:
                  return APP_URL.rstrip("/")
              ctx = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              headers = event.get("headers") or {}
              host = ctx.get("domainName") or headers.get("Host", "")
              stage = ctx.get("stage", "")
              return ("https://%s/%s" % (host, stage)).rstrip("/")


          def _generate_id():
              length = MIN_LEN + secrets.randbelow(MAX_LEN - MIN_LEN + 1)
              return "".join(secrets.choice(ALPHABET) for _ in range(length))


          def handler(event, context):
              raw = event.get("body") or "{}"
              if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                  raw = base64.b64decode(raw).decode("utf-8")
              try:
                  payload = json.loads(raw)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Request body must be valid JSON."})
              if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Request body must be a JSON object."})

              long_url = str(payload.get("long_url") or payload.get("url") or "").strip()
              parsed = urlparse(long_url)
              if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.netloc or len(long_url) > 2048:
                  return _response(400, {"message": "Provide a valid http(s) URL in 'long_url'."})

              for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
                  short_id = _generate_id()
                  try:
                      TABLE.put_item(
                          Item={
                              "short_id": short_id,
                              "long_url": long_url,
                              "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                          },
                          ConditionExpression="attribute_not_exists(short_id)",
                      )
                  except ClientError as err:
                      if err.response["Error"]["Code"] == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
                          continue
                      print("DynamoDB error: %s" % err)
                      return _response(500, {"message": "Unable to store the URL."})
                  return _response(
                      200,
                      {
                          "short_id": short_id,
                          "short_url": "%s/%s" % (_base_url(event), short_id),
                          "long_url": long_url,
                      },
                  )
              return _response(500, {"message": "Could not generate a unique identifier."})
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: RetrieveFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      Description: Looks up a short identifier and redirects to the original URL.
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref UrlTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import re

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9]{12,16}$")


          def _error(status, message):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": message}),
              }


          def handler(event, context):
              params = event.get("pathParameters") or {}
              short_id = str(params.get("shortid") or "")
              if not ID_PATTERN.match(short_id):
                  return _error(400, "Invalid short identifier.")
              try:
                  result = TABLE.get_item(Key={"short_id": short_id})
              except ClientError as err:
                  print("DynamoDB error: %s" % err)
                  return _error(500, "Unable to look up the URL.")
              item = result.get("Item")
              if not item or "long_url" not in item:
                  return _error(404, "Short link not found.")
              return {
                  "statusCode": 301,
                  "headers": {
                      "Location": item["long_url"],
                      "Cache-Control": "max-age=300",
                  },
                  "body": "",
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  UrlShortenerApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-api'
      Description: Regional REST API for the serverless URL shortener.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: create

  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  ShortIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt UrlShortenerApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{shortid}'

  CreatePostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      ResourceId: !Ref CreateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: AWS_IAM
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  AdminGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AdminResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: AWS_IAM
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"service": "url-shortener", "status": "ok", "create": "POST /create with {\"long_url\": \"https://example.com\"}"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'

  ShortIdGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.shortid: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  CreateFunctionApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${UrlShortenerApi}/*/POST/create'

  RetrieveFunctionApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref RetrieveFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${UrlShortenerApi}/*/GET/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreatePostMethod
      - AdminGetMethod
      - ShortIdGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      Description: URL shortener API deployment.

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Account-level role that allows API Gateway to push logs to CloudWatch.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiTestStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: test
      Description: Test stage for the URL shortener API.
      RestApiId: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationError":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          MetricsEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

Outputs:
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL of the test stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UrlShortenerApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiTestStage}'
  CreateEndpoint:
    Description: POST endpoint for creating short links.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UrlShortenerApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiTestStage}/create'
  AdminEndpoint:
    Description: Admin endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UrlShortenerApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiTestStage}/admin'
  RestApiId:
    Description: ID of the REST API.
    Value: !Ref UrlShortenerApi
  TableNameOutput:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref UrlTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt UrlTable.Arn
  CreateFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the create Lambda function.

  CreateFunctionArn:

    Description: ARN of the shared Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the account-level API Gateway CloudWatch logging role.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless on-call incident alerting service with DynamoDB tables, Lambda functions, a Step Functions escalation workflow, an HTTP API and SSM Parameter Store discovery values.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: oncall-alerting
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
    Description: Application name used for resource names, tags and the SSM path prefix.
  SenderEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: alerts@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.
    Description: SES sender email address used by the notifier function.

Resources:
  ConfigurationTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${AppName}-configuration
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ConfigKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ConfigKey
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  ServicesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${AppName}-services
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ServiceId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ServiceId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  OnCallSchedulesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${AppName}-oncall-schedules
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: TeamId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Day
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: TeamId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: Day
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${AppName}-incidents
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: IncidentId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: IncidentId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigurationTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ServicesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt OnCallSchedulesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt IncidentsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: SesSendEmail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*
        - PolicyName: SsmParameterRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  LambdaStartExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${AppName}-start-execution
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: states:StartExecution
            Resource: !Ref IncidentStateMachine

  IncidentProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-incident-processor
      Description: Handles incoming HTTP API requests for incidents.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          APP_NAME: !Ref AppName
          SSM_PREFIX: !Sub /${AppName}/
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder: real code is deployed separately.
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"message": "incident processor placeholder"})
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  NotifierFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AppName}-notifier
      Description: Sends on-call and escalation notifications through SES.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          APP_NAME: !Ref AppName
          SSM_PREFIX: !Sub /${AppName}/
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmail
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder: real code is deployed separately.
              print(json.dumps(event))
              return {"status": "notification placeholder"}
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${IncidentProcessorFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  NotifierLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${NotifierFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeNotifier
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub ${NotifierFunction.Arn}:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  IncidentStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${AppName}-incident-workflow
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Notify the on-call responder immediately and escalate after five minutes.
        StartAt: AlertInParallel
        States:
          AlertInParallel:
            Type: Parallel
            End: true
            Branches:
              - StartAt: NotifyOnCall
                States:
                  NotifyOnCall:
                    Type: Task
                    Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke
                    Parameters:
                      FunctionName: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                      Payload:
                        notificationType: INITIAL
                        incident.$: $
                    OutputPath: $.Payload
                    Retry:
                      - ErrorEquals:
                          - Lambda.ServiceException
                          - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                          - Lambda.SdkClientException
                          - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                        IntervalSeconds: 2
                        MaxAttempts: 3
                        BackoffRate: 2
                    End: true
              - StartAt: WaitForEscalation
                States:
                  WaitForEscalation:
                    Type: Wait
                    Seconds: 300
                    Next: SendEscalation
                  SendEscalation:
                    Type: Task
                    Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke
                    Parameters:
                      FunctionName: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                      Payload:
                        notificationType: ESCALATION
                        incident.$: $
                    OutputPath: $.Payload
                    Retry:
                      - ErrorEquals:
                          - Lambda.ServiceException
                          - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                          - Lambda.SdkClientException
                          - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                        IntervalSeconds: 2
                        MaxAttempts: 3
                        BackoffRate: 2
                    End: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/apigateway/${AppName}-api-access-logs
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AppName}-api
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      Description: HTTP API for the on-call incident alerting service.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  GetIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: GET /incidents/{incidentId}
      Target: !Sub integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}

  PutIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: PUT /incidents/{incidentId}
      Target: !Sub integrations/${IncidentProcessorIntegration}

  HttpApiDefaultStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - GetIncidentRoute
      - PutIncidentRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: $default
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationError":"$context.integrationErrorMessage"}'
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 50
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 25
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  IncidentProcessorApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IncidentProcessorFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*/incidents/*

  SenderEmailParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${AppName}/sender-email
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref SenderEmail
      Description: SES sender email address for notifications.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  StateMachineArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${AppName}/state-machine-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine
      Description: ARN of the incident escalation state machine.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

  ApiEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${AppName}/api-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt HttpApi.ApiEndpoint
      Description: Endpoint URL of the incident HTTP API.
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref AppName

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: HTTP API endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt HttpApi.ApiEndpoint
  HttpApiId:
    Description: HTTP API identifier.
    Value: !Ref HttpApi
  IncidentStateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the incident escalation state machine.
    Value: !Ref IncidentStateMachine
  IncidentProcessorFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the incident processor Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn
  NotifierFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the notifier Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
  ConfigurationTableName:
    Description: Configuration DynamoDB table name.
    Value: !Ref ConfigurationTable
  ServicesTableName:
    Description: Services DynamoDB table name.
    Value: !Ref ServicesTable
  OnCallSchedulesTableName:
    Description: On-call schedules DynamoDB table name.
    Value: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
  IncidentsTableName:
    Description: Incidents DynamoDB table name.
    Value: !Ref IncidentsTable
  ApiAccessLogGroupName:
    Description: Log group for HTTP API access logs.
    Value: !Ref ApiAccessLogGroup
  SsmParameterPrefix:
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix for runtime discovery.
    Value: !Sub /${AppName}/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys an AWS Config conformance pack for operational best practices on Amazon CloudWatch, including the AWS Config recorder, delivery channel, KMS-encrypted S3 delivery bucket and IAM role it needs.

Parameters:
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "TRUE"
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one alarm action (TRUE or FALSE). Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "TRUE"
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one insufficient-data action (TRUE or FALSE). Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "FALSE"
    Description: Whether CloudWatch alarms must have at least one OK action (TRUE or FALSE). Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "AWS::EC2::Instance"
    Description: AWS resource type that must have a CloudWatch alarm for the specified metric. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CPUUtilization"
    Description: Metric name that must have a CloudWatch alarm for the specified resource type. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CPUUtilization"
    Description: Metric name whose CloudWatch alarm settings are evaluated. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.
  CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod:
    Type: String
    Default: "300"
    Description: Required alarm evaluation period in seconds. Leave empty to omit this input from the rule.

Resources:
  ConfigBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key that encrypts AWS Config delivery data in the Config S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSConfigServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowUseViaS3InAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldConfigData
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  ConfigBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketPermissionsCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketExistenceCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigS3Delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  DeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn: ConfigBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket
      S3KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn

  CloudWatchConformancePack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - DeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      ConformancePackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudwatch-best-practices'
      ConformancePackInputParameters:
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
        - ParameterName: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod
          ParameterValue: !Ref CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod
      TemplateBody: |
        Parameters:
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
            Default: "TRUE"
            Type: String
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
            Default: "TRUE"
            Type: String
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
            Default: "FALSE"
            Type: String
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
            Default: "AWS::EC2::Instance"
            Type: String
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
            Default: "CPUUtilization"
            Type: String
          CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
            Default: "CPUUtilization"
            Type: String
          CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod:
            Default: "300"
            Type: String
        Conditions:
          cloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
          cloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
          cloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
          cloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
          cloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
          cloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
          cloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod:
            Fn::Not:
            - Fn::Equals:
              - ""
              - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod
        Resources:
          CloudwatchAlarmActionCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-check
              InputParameters:
                alarmActionRequired:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamAlarmActionRequired
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                insufficientDataActionRequired:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamInsufficientDataActionRequired
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                okActionRequired:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmActionCheckParamOkActionRequired
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK
          CloudwatchAlarmActionEnabledCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-enabled-check
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_ENABLED_CHECK
          CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-resource-check
              InputParameters:
                resourceType:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamResourceType
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                metricName:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmResourceCheckParamMetricName
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK
          CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheck:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-settings-check
              InputParameters:
                metricName:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamMetricName
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
                period:
                  Fn::If:
                  - cloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod
                  - Ref: CloudwatchAlarmSettingsCheckParamPeriod
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
              Scope:
                ComplianceResourceTypes:
                - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
              Source:
                Owner: AWS
                SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK
          CloudwatchLogGroupEncrypted:
            Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
            Properties:
              ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-log-group-encrypted
              Source:
                Owner: AWS

Description: Creates the encryption-at-rest foundation (KMS key, DynamoDB tables and S3 buckets) for the restaurant assistant application.

Parameters:

    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}[a-z0-9]$'

    Description: Project name used to derive resource names and tags.

    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:

      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used to derive resource names and tags.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for ${ProjectName}-${Environment} data encryption at rest'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseViaDynamoDBAndS3
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService:
                  - !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-data-key'

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-data-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If [IsProd, true, false]
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: data_type
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: data_type
          KeyType: RANGE

      Tags:

        - Key: Environment

      Tags:

        - Key: Environment

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-logs'

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/image-bucket/*'
            Condition:

                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:

          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:

            Condition:

  ImageBucket:

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:

            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true

        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogBucket

      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:

            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images'

  ImageBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyNonKmsEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEqualsIfExists:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: 'aws:kms'
          - Sid: DenyOtherKmsKeys

            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ImageBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
