final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared identity and state layer for a stateful Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agent demo. It provisions a Cognito user pool, a hosted domain, a resource server, M2M and web clients, a seeded test user, a DynamoDB finance tracking table, IAM execution roles for the MCP server and agent runtimes, and SSM discovery parameters.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: Project name used to name resources and to build the SSM Parameter Store path (/<ProjectName>/...). Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. It must not contain "aws", "amazon" or "cognito" because it also becomes the Cognito domain prefix.
    Default: finance-agent-demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 4-32 characters. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Start with a letter and do not end with a hyphen.
  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address (also the username) of the seeded Cognito test user. Replace the placeholder default.
    Default: testuser@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.
  TestUserPassword:
    Type: String
    Description: Permanent password for the seeded test user. Leave it empty to have Secrets Manager generate one. A custom value must be 12-64 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, numeric and symbol characters. Double quotes and backslashes are not allowed.
    Default: ''
    NoEcho: true
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^"\\]{12,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Leave it empty, or enter 12-64 characters without double quotes or backslashes.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTestUserPassword: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestUserPassword, ""]]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  FinanceResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName} Finance Agent API'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: finance.read
          ScopeDescription: Read finance tracking state
        - ScopeName: finance.write
          ScopeDescription: Write finance tracking state
        - ScopeName: mcp.invoke
          ScopeDescription: Invoke MCP server tools

  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${FinanceResourceServer}/finance.read'
        - !Sub '${FinanceResourceServer}/finance.write'
        - !Sub '${FinanceResourceServer}/mcp.invoke'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${FinanceResourceServer}/finance.read'
        - !Sub '${FinanceResourceServer}/finance.write'
        - !Sub '${FinanceResourceServer}/mcp.invoke'
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test user seeding (Lambda-backed custom resource)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestUserCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/test-user-credentials'
      Description: !Sub 'Credentials for the seeded Cognito test user of ${ProjectName}'
      SecretString: !If
        - HasCustomTestUserPassword
        - !Sub '{"username":"${TestUserEmail}","password":"${TestUserPassword}"}'
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      GenerateSecretString: !If
        - HasCustomTestUserPassword
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username":"${TestUserEmail}"}'
          GenerateStringKey: password
          PasswordLength: 24
          RequireEachIncludedType: true
          ExcludeCharacters: '"''\/@`'
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SeedTestUserLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-seed-test-user'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SeedTestUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} Cognito test user seeding function'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SeedTestUser
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt SeedTestUserLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: ManageTestUser
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminDeleteUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Sid: ReadTestUserSecret
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref TestUserCredentials
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  SeedTestUserFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-seed-test-user'
      Description: Seeds the Cognito test user with a permanent password read from Secrets Manager
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt SeedTestUserRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref SeedTestUserLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", context.log_stream_name)
              request_type = event.get("RequestType")
              logger.info("Request type: %s", request_type)

              if request_type == "Delete":
                  try:
                      cognito.admin_delete_user(
                          UserPoolId=props["UserPoolId"], Username=physical_id
                      )
                  except Exception as exc:  # user or pool already gone
                      logger.warning("Delete skipped: %s", exc)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                  return

              try:
                  pool_id = props["UserPoolId"]
                  secret = json.loads(
                      secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId=props["SecretArn"])["SecretString"]
                  )
                  username = secret["username"]
                  password = secret["password"]

                  try:
                      cognito.admin_create_user(
                          UserPoolId=pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {"Name": "email", "Value": username},
                              {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                          ],
                          MessageAction="SUPPRESS",
                      )
                  except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                      logger.info("Test user already exists, updating password")

                  cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      Password=password,
                      Permanent=True,
                  )
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"Username": username}, username
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.error("Failed to seed test user: %s", type(exc).__name__)
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {},
                      physical_id,
                      reason=f"Failed to seed test user: {type(exc).__name__}",
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  CognitoTestUser:
    Type: Custom::CognitoTestUser
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeedTestUserFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SecretArn: !Ref TestUserCredentials

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Finance tracking state
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FinanceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-state'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expires_at
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore runtime execution roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} MCP server AgentCore runtime'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrImageAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: EcrToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: Observability
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RuntimeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: RuntimeLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Metrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
        - PolicyName: WorkloadIdentity
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WorkloadAccessToken
                Effect: Allow

                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query

                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem

      Tags:
        - Key: ProjectName
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  AgentRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} agent AgentCore runtime'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcrImageAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrImagePull

                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: EcrToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: Observability
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RuntimeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/*'
              - Sid: DescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: RuntimeLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - logs:PutLogEvents

              - Sid: XRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Metrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
        - PolicyName: WorkloadIdentity
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WorkloadAccessToken

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a highly available two-tier VPC network across two Availability Zones, with public and private subnets and one NAT gateway per AZ. Public subnets do not auto-assign public IPs, so workloads that need public reachability must attach an Elastic IP or request a public IP explicitly.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in Availability Zone 1
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in Availability Zone 2
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in Availability Zone 1
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in Availability Zone 2
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix length between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet in AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet in AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
